REMOTE - Reports to CEO - Manages 4 Direct Reports - Full-Time

ABOUT iPromo

iPromo is a fast-growing promotional products and branded merchandise distributor. We serve enterprise clients, government agencies, and mid-market companies across the U.S., providing everything from branded apparel and hard goods to full-service company stores and kitting/fulfillment solutions. We are in an aggressive growth phase, expanding our apparel and hard goods business lines. We need a Controller who thrives in a high-growth B2B distribution environment and can build the financial infrastructure to support our next chapter.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Controller will own all day-to-day accounting operations and serve as the senior financial leader at iPromo. This is an execution-heavy leadership role focused on cleaning up the books, tightening controls, delivering a reliable close, and improving trust in the numbers. You will step into a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment, create order out of complexity, and build scalable processes. The ideal candidate has deep experience in a hard goods or physical products B2B distribution business and understands the financial nuances of inventory management, COGS tracking, vendor payables, sales commissions, and margin analysis in a product-based company.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Financial Reporting & Close: Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process. Prepare accurate financial statements (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) with variance analysis and KPI commentary for the CEO.

  • General Ledger & Accounting Operations: Manage all GL activity, journal entries, reconciliations, and chart of accounts. Ensure GAAP compliance across all transactions.

  • Accounts Payable & Vendor Management: Oversee AP to ensure timely and accurate payment of supplier invoices, manage vendor terms and credit, and reconcile vendor statements. Experience managing a large, diverse supplier base (hard goods, apparel, print) is essential.

  • Accounts Receivable & Collections: Supervise AR, monitor aging, and drive collections strategy. Manage customer credit policies and work cross-functionally with sales leadership to resolve disputed invoices and chargebacks.

  • Inventory & COGS Accounting: Maintain accurate inventory valuation, track landed costs, manage write-downs, and ensure COGS is properly allocated across product categories. Partner with operations (VP of Operations) on inventory reconciliation and warehouse accounting.

  • Sales Commission Accounting: Calculate, verify, and process monthly sales commissions for a growing sales team. Audit commission reports for accuracy against quota plans and comp structures.

  • Cash Flow & Treasury: Manage daily cash position, forecast cash flow, and optimize working capital. Monitor banking relationships, credit facilities, and payment processing (Stripe, wire transfers, ACH).

  • Tax & Compliance: Coordinate with external CPA firm on federal and state income tax filings, sales tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions, and annual audit/review. Manage any IRS correspondence or audits.

  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Partner with the CEO to build and maintain the annual operating budget. Provide rolling forecasts and scenario modeling to support hiring, revenue, and margin targets.

  • Systems & Process Improvement: Evaluate and improve financial systems and workflows. Experience with or willingness to implement ERP, accounting software (QuickBooks, NetSuite, or similar), and integration with CRM (HubSpot) and eCommerce platforms.

  • Internal Controls: Establish and enforce internal controls, approval workflows, and segregation of duties appropriate for a scaling business.

  • Cleanup & Process Gaps: Identify weak controls, broken processes, and operational risk across the accounting function and fix them. Bring structure, visibility, and accountability to areas that need it.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field. CPA strongly preferred.

  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 3 years in a Controller or Assistant Controller role.

  • Mandatory: Experience in a hard goods, physical products, or B2B distribution business. You must understand inventory accounting, landed cost calculations, vendor/supplier payment cycles, and product-based margin analysis. The Clinical Standards Lead role will work closely with new and experienced Functional Assessors to provide supervision and feedback, utilising quality and productivity data to enable professional development in line with the Performance Excellence Framework.

  • Supervise the support pathways of Functional Assessors as defined within the Performance Excellence Framework, utilising clinical audit and quality outcomes with a view to achieving sustained quality improvement within the contract.
  • Carry out telephone, video and/ or face-to-face functional assessments to establish any functional restriction caused by a claimant’s health concern. Be the point of contact during the consultation stage for claimants with a wide range of health conditions and disabilities.
  • Obtain evidence from the claimant, using active listening and asking appropriate questions to establish any functional restriction.
  • Apply critical thinking and logical reasoning to produce accurate, and detailed reports, utilising DWP systems and processes.
  • Ensure that reports are completed to a high standard to achieve the required quality grades, including in relation to accurate spelling and grammar.
  • Support achievement of service delivery KPIs through provision of an effective and efficient Assessment Service.

  • Proactively develop knowledge of health conditions through engaging with Continuous Professional Development (CPD) opportunities in line with professional registration and contractual requirements.

Role Summary

The Chief Data Officer is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise data strategy, ensuring data is treated as a strategic asset to drive decision-making, innovation, and business growth. This role oversees data governance, data architecture, analytics, AI/ML initiatives, and regulatory compliance related to data.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute enterprise-wide data strategy aligned with business objectives
  • Establish data as a core asset for competitive advantage and innovation
  • Advise executive leadership on data-driven opportunities and risks

2. Data Governance & Quality

  • Establish data governance frameworks, policies, and standards
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, lineage, and ownership across the organization
  • Implement master data management (MDM) practices

3. Data Architecture & Platforms

  • Oversee design and implementation of modern data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, lakehouse)
  • Ensure scalability, performance, and accessibility of data systems
  • Drive integration across enterprise systems

4. Analytics, BI & AI/ML

  • Lead advanced analytics, business intelligence, and AI/ML initiatives
  • Enable self-service analytics and data democratization
  • Deliver insights that drive business performance and innovation

5. Data Privacy, Security & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with data protection regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and industry standards
  • Partner with security teams to safeguard sensitive data
  • Manage data risk, ethics, and responsible AI practices

6. Data Monetization & Value Creation

  • Identify opportunities to monetize data and create new revenue streams
  • Optimize data usage across business units
  • Measure and track ROI of data initiatives

7. Culture, Talent & Enablement

  • Build and lead high-performing data and analytics teams
  • Promote a data-driven culture across the organization
  • Upskill business users on data literacy and tools

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 15–20+ years of experience in data, analytics, or technology leadership roles

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will lead relationships with some of our most strategically important customers, own their retention and renewal, and partner with Sales on growth. You will help major financial institutions realize lasting value from our solutions.

In this role, you will build relationships across customer teams, understand what they need to achieve, and bring the right people together to address complex challenges. You will work with Business Operations, Sales, Product, and Engineering to turn that understanding into better customer outcomes.

Your customers include banks, credit unions, lenders, mortgage servicers, debt buyers, and collection agencies. Our bankruptcy solutions help them move from detecting a filing to monitoring a case, filing a claim, and tracking recovery. You will help these organizations get value from that work across complex, consequential operations.

  • Own retention and renewal for a portfolio of Bankruptcy Risk accounts, including some of our largest and most strategic customers. Set renewal strategy early and lead commercial discussions and contract changes with Sales and Legal to protect recurring revenue.

  • Partner with Sales to identify and develop growth opportunities across our bankruptcy solutions, using your understanding of each customer’s goals, workflows, and unmet needs to shape the opportunity.

  • Lead strategic business reviews that start with the customer’s priorities, show the outcomes our solutions are delivering, and create a substantive conversation about what comes next.

  • Bring customer feedback, emerging needs, and recurring points of friction to Product and Operations. Work with those teams to improve the customer experience and help shape future solutions.

O ambiente Salesforce atual do cliente é altamente customizado, portanto, este não é um projeto baseado apenas em configurações padrão (out-of-the-box) do Salesforce.

  • Apoiar atividades de Administração Salesforce.

  • Trabalhar com tecnologias de integração baseadas em .NET, incluindo MVC RESTful APIs e arquitetura n-Tier.

  • Apoiar o trabalho técnico necessário como parte da iniciativa de consolidação dos CRMs.

Conhecimentos e Experiência Necessários

Salesforce

  • Flow Automation

Tecnologias de Integração

  • REST APIs

    • MVC RESTful APIs

  • Event-Driven Architecture

Dados e Migração

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.

﻿Développement organisationnel et programmes de gestion des talents

  • Préparer et tenir à jour les outils, modèles, guides, documents de processus et documents de référence en matière de développement organisationnel destinés aux employés, aux gestionnaires et aux partenaires RH.
  • Coordonner les échéanciers des programmes, les réunions, la collecte de données, les suivis et les communications afin d’assurer une mise en œuvre cohérente dans l’ensemble des fonctions et des régions.
  • Compiler et analyser les données relatives aux talents et à la main-d’œuvre, cerner les tendances et préparer des tableaux de bord, des sommaires et des présentations afin de soutenir la prise de décision.
  • Soutenir la mise à jour des données sur les talents, des renseignements relatifs à la relève, des plans de développement ainsi que des autres dossiers et systèmes liés au développement organisationnel.

Apprentissage et développement

  • Soutenir l’analyse des besoins d’apprentissage et la coordination des programmes de développement du leadership, des gestionnaires, de gestion du changement et de développement des employés.
  • Coordonner la logistique des activités d’apprentissage, les communications aux participants, le matériel, les évaluations et le suivi des formations complétées.
  • Participer à l’élaboration ou à l’adaptation de contenu de formation, de trousses d’outils, de ressources d’apprentissage en ligne et de guides destinés aux gestionnaires.
  • Recueillir et analyser la rétroaction et les indicateurs liés à l’apprentissage afin d’en évaluer l’efficacité et de recommander des améliorations.

Expérience employé, engagement et changement

  • Soutenir les sondages d’engagement des employés, les sondages éclair et les activités connexes de planification des actions, notamment la préparation et l’analyse des données ainsi que le suivi des actions.
  • Contribuer aux initiatives visant à renforcer la culture, la collaboration, l’inclusion, la sensibilisation culturelle, l’expérience employé et la proposition de valeur aux employés.
  • Soutenir les projets de gestion du changement au moyen de la cartographie des parties prenantes, de documents de communication, de ressources de formation, du suivi de l’adoption et d’autres activités de mise en œuvre.
  • Effectuer des recherches et des analyses comparatives sur les pratiques en matière de développement organisationnel, de gestion des talents, d’apprentissage et d’expérience employé, et résumer les recommandations.

﻿Soutien aux projets et aux parties prenantes

  • Coordonner les projets et volets de travail en développement organisationnel qui lui sont confiés, et tenir à jour les plans de projet, les livrables, la documentation et les mises à jour sur l’avancement.
  • Collaborer avec les partenaires d’affaires RH, les équipes de rémunération, d’acquisition de talents, des opérations RH et des communications, ainsi qu’avec d’autres fonctions de l’entreprise, au besoin.
  • Préparer des présentations, des communications et du matériel clairs et professionnels à l’intention de publics variés, notamment les employés et les membres de la direction.
  • Cerner les occasions de simplifier, de normaliser et d’automatiser les processus de développement organisationnel et utiliser de façon responsable les technologies RH et les outils fondés sur l’IA afin d’améliorer l’efficacité.
  • Maintenir une stricte confidentialité et assurer le traitement approprié des renseignements sensibles concernant les employés et les talents.

Profil recherché

Formation

  • Baccalauréat en ressources humaines, en développement organisationnel, en psychologie industrielle et organisationnelle, en administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe.

Expérience

  • Minimum de 3 ans d’expérience pertinente en développement organisationnel, en gestion des talents, en apprentissage et développement, en gestion de projets RH ou dans une discipline connexe des ressources humaines.
  • Une expérience dans le soutien de programmes ou de projets RH liés à la gestion de la performance, au développement des talents, à l’engagement, à l’apprentissage ou à la gestion du changement constitue un atout.

Connaissances et compétences

  • Solides compétences en coordination de projets, en organisation et en gestion du temps, ainsi qu’un excellent souci du détail.
  • Solides compétences analytiques et maîtrise de Microsoft Office, particulièrement Excel et PowerPoint. Une expérience avec des SIRH, des plateformes de sondage, des systèmes de gestion de l’apprentissage ou des talents constitue un atout.
  • Capacité à synthétiser l’information et à créer des outils, des présentations et des communications clairs et pratiques adaptés à différents publics.
  • Solides compétences interpersonnelles et en communication, ainsi qu’une capacité à collaborer efficacement dans un environnement virtuel et multiculturel.
  • Curiosité, capacité d’adaptation, initiative et esprit d’amélioration continue.
  • Haut degré de confidentialité, de professionnalisme et de jugement.
  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
  • Une bonne connaissance des bonnes pratiques cliniques ainsi que des règlements et lignes directrices applicables de Santé Canada et de la Food and Drug Administration (FDA) constitue un atout.

Notre entreprise

NOTRE ENTREPRISE

L’environnement de travail

Chez Innovaderm, vous travaillerez avec des collaborateurs compétents et dynamiques. Nos valeurs sont la collaboration, l’innovation, la fiabilité et la réactivité. Nous offrons un environnement de travail stimulant et des possibilités d’avancement intéressantes.

Dans ce poste, vous bénéficierez des conditions suivantes :

  • Flexibilité sur l’horaire
  • Poste permanent à temps plein
  • Gamme d’avantages sociaux (assurances médicales, dentaire, vision, régime de retraite, vacances, journées personnelles, clinique médicale virtuelle, rabais sur le transport en commun, activités sociales)
  • Formation et développement continu

À propos Indero

﻿

Anciennement connu sous le nom d’Innovaderm, Indero est un expert de renommée mondiale et un chef de file en recherche clinique en dermatologie. Nous comptons plus de vingt ans d’expérience couvrant un vaste éventail d’indications, de populations de patients, de voies d’administration et de classes de médicaments, avec une présence à l’échelle mondiale.

Indero est un CRO à double spécialisation en dermatologie et en rhumatologie, cumulant plus de 25 ans d’expérience en recherche clinique et en réalisation d’essais cliniques. Notre approche de services complets — allant de la conception des protocoles et du recrutement des patients à la surveillance des essais et à la biométrie — offre aux promoteurs des secteurs biotechnologique et pharmaceutique la rigueur scientifique et l’expertise sur mesure nécessaires pour mener leurs études à terme de façon efficace et performante. Grâce à nos capacités en Amérique du Nord, en Europe, en Asie‑Pacifique et en Amérique latine, à nos relations étendues et en constante évolution avec les investigateurs et les patients, ainsi qu’à une clinique de recherche dédiée où nous concevons et réalisons nos propres études, Indero est le partenaire CRO idéal pour répondre à des besoins cliniques à l’échelle mondiale.

Indero s’engage à offrir un traitement équitable et l’égalité des chances à toutes les personnes. À ce titre, Indero offre, sur demande, des mesures d’adaptation aux candidats en situation de handicap tout au long du processus de recrutement et de sélection.

Indero accepte uniquement les candidats pouvant légalement travailler au Canada.

Job Title: Channel Account Director

About the Job

The Account Director, Specialty Pharmacy Networks is responsible for leading contractual, and operational engagement across applicable Limited Distribution Networks (LDN), Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs), Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), and select independent pharmacy partners across Specialty Care and General Medicines portfolios reporting to the Senior Director, Specialty Pharmacy Strategic & Limited Networks.

The role also leads GPO channel execution and serves as the Trade & Channel subject matter expert and customer-facing lead for Health Systems and IDNs.

We are an innovative global healthcare company, committed to transforming the lives of people with immune challenges, rare diseases and blood disorders, cancers, and neurological disorders. From R&D to sales, our teams work together to advance treatment, improve products, understand unmet needs, and connect communities. We pursue progress to make a meaningful impact on patients around the world.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading GPO or institutional contracting strategies

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Verily Health is a data platform and technology company purpose-built to power AI-enabled precision health solutions that accelerate research and improve care for individuals and communities. Uniquely positioned at the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily transforms multimodal health data into insights, models, and actions that make healthcare more personalized, predictive, and precise.

Description


As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) you are responsible for managing the post-sales relationship with an assigned portfolio of Verily Viewpoint Site CTMS customers. This role is focused on driving successful onboarding and training of new users and stakeholders, increasing product adoption, proactively monitoring customer health, fostering long-term retention, identifying opportunities for growth, and executing customer renewals and contract discussions.


You will develop strong relationships with executive sponsors, operational leaders, and end users to become a trusted advisor. This will allow you to understand their business objectives and help them maximize the value of their investment in Verily Viewpoint Site CTMS. You will partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, Support, and Learning teams to advocate for customer needs, resolve challenges, and deliver an exceptional customer experience.


The Customer Success Manager is accountable for the revenue retention and growth of their portfolio of Viewpoint Site CTMS customers.


Responsibilities


  • Relationship Management & Strategic Alignment: Serve as the primary trusted advisor across account portfolios, conducting regular business reviews and tailored account planning to align product value with executive and operational goals.
  • Onboarding & Adoption: Lead implementation, end-user training, and adoption planning by mapping customer trial workflows to Verily Viewpoint Site CTMS capabilities and best practices.
  • Retention & Renewals: Accountable for portfolio retention and revenue growth by managing the end-to-end renewal process, contract negotiations (partnering with Legal/Finance), and expansion opportunities.
  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Serve as the voice of the customer internally—partnering with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to route feedback, resolve escalations, and validate new feature functionality.
  • Account Health & Operations: Proactively monitor customer health metrics (usage data, support tickets, protocol volume) and maintain accurate CRM documentation, playbooks, and renewal forecasting.

Qualifications


Minimum Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Services, Clinical Research, or Healthcare Technology.
  • Proven track record managing customer relationships, engaging executive and operational stakeholders, and driving retention and contract renewals.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, problem-solving, and cross-functional organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and accounts simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Domain Expertise: Experience with SaaS, healthcare technology, clinical research operations, site workflows, or Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS).
  • Enterprise Focus: Experience supporting enterprise healthcare organizations, Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), or Academic Medical Centers (AMCs).
  • Commercial Acumen: Hands-on experience with contract negotiation, pricing exceptions, deal desk processes, and renewal forecasting.
  • Customer Success Methodologies: Familiarity with customer health metrics, structured account planning methodologies, and proactive adoption strategies.

Qualified applicants must not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to Visio Lending employees, shall be deemed the property of Visio Lending.

About Visio Lending

Visio Lending is the nation’s leader in rental home financing. Founded in 2012 in Austin, Texas, Visio enables small- to medium- sized investors to grow their rental home and vacation rental portfolios. Headquartered in fantastic Austin, Texas, since late 2015, Visio has financed more than $1 billion in Rental360 loans. With more than $400 million in capital onboard, a proven record of investment grade bond issuance on Wall Street, and an outstanding 100+ team, Visio is poised for continued success.

Why We Love Working at Visio:

We at Visio are passionate about working together towards our goals to continually push this company forward. We innovate, collaborate, celebrate team successes, and recognize individual accomplishments. At Visio Lending, you’ll work on meaningful initiatives that directly support real estate investors nationwide. We offer a collaborative culture, growth opportunities, and flexibility with remote work options.

How to Apply?

To be considered for employment, please submit your application online. While we appreciate all the interest we receive, only candidates selected for phone screening, or an interview will be contacted directly. You will receive application status alerts via email so make sure your email address is accurate.

Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. Unanswered application questions or responses indicating “see resume” will be considered incomplete and you will be removed from consideration.

Visio Financial Services, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer

The Opportunity:

As a Senior Business Intelligence Engineer at Visio Lending, you'll play a key role in creating trusted, polished, decision-ready Power BI reports and reusable semantic models from governed, populated views and approved data products.

This role turns business requirements into intuitive report experiences, precise SQL-powered analysis, and maintainable Power BI content. The Senior Business Intelligence Engineer also serves as the technical owner of the Power BI platform, partnering closely with business owners, analysts, engineering, and security so platform, ingestion, and access decisions follow the established team process while reporting deliverables remain the central focus.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain intuitive Power BI reports, dashboards, and apps that make complex business information easy to understand and use.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and analysts to translate decisions, questions, report mock-ups, and acceptance criteria into clear report layouts, navigation, filters, drillthrough experiences, and visual interactions.
  • Own the Power BI platform's day-to-day technical operation, including workspace lifecycle, approved tenant settings, licenses and capacity coordination, content organization, publishing standards, and operational health. Keep the environment usable, governed, and reliable for report authors and consumers.
  • Write, validate, and tune complex SQL queries against governed views and approved data products to support report development, data exploration, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain reusable Power BI semantic models from approved, populated views and data products, including practical relationships, measures, DAX calculations, Power Query transformations, and model documentation.
  • Develop accurate, reusable DAX measures and calculations; validate results against agreed business examples and help identify data or definition issues before they reach report consumers.
  • Prototype report experiences and iteratively improve the user interface based on stakeholder feedback, usability, consistency, and business usefulness.
  • Comfortably and responsibly use approved AI tools to accelerate report design, SQL and DAX development, test cases, documentation, troubleshooting, and learning. Validate AI-assisted output, protect confidential information, and apply sound judgment before production use.
  • Publish and maintain report and app content through established workspace and release processes; verify visible freshness, report-to-model bindings, and representative consumer experience after approved releases.
  • Work with the engineering and security teams on row-level security, permissions, workspace roles, gateways, refreshes, Azure, and Fabric. Lead the Power BI-side configuration and consumer validation, while access policy and material security decisions remain a group decision with the appropriate owners.
  • Coordinate Power BI connections, gateway and refresh issues, and platform incidents with the engineering team. Own the Power BI operational response and escalate upstream ingestion, ADF, and source-data engineering to the appropriate owners.
  • Support report defects, data questions, and adoption needs; distinguish report, semantic-model, source-data, and access issues and coordinate the right resolution path.
  • Create reusable report templates, document report logic and usage, and coach authorized report authors on shared-model consumption and effective report design.
  • Participate in requirements reviews, user acceptance testing, and release validation; keep clear documentation of report behavior, known assumptions, and test results.
  • Other responsibilities and duties as assigned based on business needs
  • Authorized Remote Locations: AL, AR, AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MI, NC, SC, TX, UT
  • Salary Range: $108,000 - $126,000 (Exempt level position)

What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in information systems, business analytics, computer science, a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 4+ years of professional experience developing business intelligence reports and semantic models in Power BI or a comparable enterprise BI platform.
  • Strong report-design and user-experience skills, with a demonstrated ability to turn business questions into clear, usable reporting products.
  • Strong SQL writing, data exploration, and query-validation skills; able to use SQL confidently to analyze governed views and troubleshoot reporting results.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service, including semantic models, relationships, DAX, Power Query (M), report publishing, apps, and report-level troubleshooting.
  • Experience administering Power BI workspaces, apps, content lifecycle, and basic tenant or capacity settings in a governed production environment.
  • Experience working from defined business requirements, validating calculations and data with stakeholders, and supporting user acceptance testing.
  • Strong comfort using approved AI tools as a core part of modern BI work, with the ability to validate outputs, protect sensitive information, and apply judgment to AI-assisted work.
  • Working knowledge of workspace roles, Build permissions, and row-level security concepts, and the ability to participate effectively in group-based access and security decisions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with business partners and engineers in a remote environment.
  • Internal Applicants: Must meet minimum qualifications and have no recent disciplinary actions.

What We Prefer to Find:

  • A strong instinct for report usability, visual hierarchy, clarity, and decision-focused design.
  • Excellent SQL and analytical problem-solving skills, paired with care for data accuracy and business context.
  • Experience supporting financial, operational, or executive reporting where accuracy, reconciled results, and controlled releases matter.
  • Experience with shared semantic models, deployment pipelines, source control, or automated testing for Power BI content.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, capacity monitoring, or Power BI REST APIs.
  • Experience using tools such as DAX Studio, Performance Analyzer, or Tabular Editor to improve report and model performance.
  • Experience developing reusable report templates, documenting business logic, or enabling governed self-service reporting.

Senior Product Marketing Manager – Business & Government

About the Role

The Business & Government (BizGov) segment represents a critical and differentiated growth market for Blackboard — federal agencies, state and local governments, and corporate workforce and training organizations that rely on enterprise learning platforms. This is a specialized market with distinct buyers, procurement dynamics, and compliance requirements.

The Senior Product Marketing Manager, Business & Government owns the go-to-market strategy for Blackboard’s products in the federal, state and local government, and corporate/workforce learning markets. You are the recognized subject matter expert and trusted advisor to Sales, Product, and Marketing leaders on these buyers, their missions, their procurement constraints, their compliance environments, and the specific ways Blackboard’s suite of solutions delivers value to their learners.

Sitting within the GTM Marketing org and reporting to the VP, GTM Marketing, you will define and lead theBizGovGTM strategy and set the direction for positioning, messaging, competitive intelligence, and sales enablement that allow Blackboard’s sales teams to compete and win in these specialized segments. This is a senior individual contributor role with high visibility, significant autonomy, and direct accountability for one of Blackboard’s most differentiated market opportunities.

The right person for this role is intellectually curious about government and workforce learning markets, relentless about understanding the buyer and the regulations that govern them, and capable of translating technical product capabilities into plain-language value stories that resonate with a procurement officer, a training director, or a Chief Human Capital Officer alike. You bring the credibility and judgment to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Product, and Marketing and turn market insights into business decisions.

What You'll Own

Segment Positioning & Messaging

  • Define and drive the cross-functional GTM strategy forBizGovand share accountability with Sales for pipeline and bookings targets at a quarterly and annual level.
  • Own positioning and messaging for theBizGovsegment, including distinct value propositions for federal agency buyers, state and local government buyers, and corporate/workforce learning buyers.
  • Develop persona-specific messaging for key buyer types across the segment: procurement officials, learning and development directors, IT security officers, agency training leads, and workforce development program managers
  • Establish and govern the BizGov positioning framework and documentation, ensuring it evolves with product changes, competitive shifts, and evolving buyer priorities and is applied consistently across Marketing, Sales, and Product.
  • Advise the VP, GTM Marketing and peer product marketers on howBizGovpositioning integrates into Blackboard’s multi-product messaging architecture, shaping the broader architecture where segment needs diverge.

Go-To-Market Planning

  • Lead go-to-market planning for the BizGovsegment, setting the strategy, priorities, and success metrics that Product Management, Revenue Marketing, and Sales/CSMs execute against to drive high levels of conversion across all channels.
  • Influence Product Management roadmap priorities with segment and buyer insight, and translate roadmap investments into market-facing stories before launch, not after.
  • Build the BizGov segment business case and GTM models, including market sizing, target account prioritization, and pipeline contributions analysis, to inform investment decisions and annual planning.
  • Partner with Revenue Marketing and Customer Marketing to ensure campaigns are built to aligned strategies with accurate, current positioning.

Competitive Intelligence & Market Research

  • Own competitive intelligence for theBizGovsegment: monitor competitors, track changes in positioning, pricing, and product capabilities, and maintain battle cards that give sales a credible, current edge in competitive deals
  • Design and lead the segment's buyer research program, including win/loss interviews, customer conversations, and secondary research, and turn findings into recommendations that shape positioning, product, and sales strategy.
  • Track federal and state procurement trends, compliance requirements (e.g., FedRAMP, Section 508, FISMA), and government IT modernization initiatives that create opportunities or risks for Blackboard, and advise leadership on their implications for product, pricing, and GTM strategy.

Sales Enablement

  • Build and maintain the sales enablement materials that equip Blackboard’sBizGovsales team to have credible, differentiated conversations with government and corporate buyers: battle cards, discovery guides, objection handlers, and segment primers.
  • Develop RFP/RFI response language and standard proposal sections that reflect accurate, current product capabilities and compliance positioning.
  • Run segment-specific enablement sessions with theBizGovsales team — keeping them current on product changes, competitive dynamics, and evolving buyer priorities.
  • Measure enablement effectiveness by tracking which materials are used in active deals and correlating content usage with win rates, and use those insights to set the segment's enablement priorities.

Campaign Execution and Content Development

  • Shape the strategy for new logo and customer marketing campaigns in the BizGov segment and guide the development of campaign assets that demonstrate Blackboard’s value in government and workforce learning environments.
  • Identify and help develop reference customers and advocacy relationships within theBizGovsegment to align with GTM strategies in partnership with the Customer Marketing team.
  • Represent Blackboard’sBizGovperspective in event content, analyst briefings, and external communications.
  • RepresentBizGovinour annual user conferenceand other major market-facing moments, developing content and customer-facing materials that reinforce Blackboard’s narrative.

How You FitIntothe Team

Product Marketing at Blackboard owns GTM strategy, market positioning, sales enablement, and the content strategy that drives quality pipeline. You co-own the new bookings target AND the retention/cross-sell target forBizGov. As the Senior Product Marketing Manager, your GTM strategies and positioning work is what separates Blackboard from LMS competitors in a market where procurement is formal, compliance is non-negotiable, and the sales cycle demands organizational credibility. Required Skills and Experience

  • 8+ years of B2B product marketing experience with a bachelor's degree (or 6+ years with a Master's degree, or equivalent experience), with direct exposure to government, public sector, or enterprise workforce/training markets strongly preferred
  • Proven track record of developing positioning and messaging frameworks for complex, multi-stakeholder markets: you know what a good messaging doc looks like, and you can defend positioning choices with evidence to senior leaders
  • Track record of building sales enablement programs that sales teams adopt and that measurably improve win rates

Preferred Skills and Experience

Blackboard is a leading EdTech company and SaaS provider that delivers the digital environment for transformational teaching and learning. jobs.description:
Motional is at the forefront of the driverless revolution. We are looking for a Director of Onboard Core Software to lead the teams that deliver the software foundation Motional's products are built on: embedded firmware, the operating system, the runtime, and middleware on the vehicle's various computing platforms. You will own the onboard software infrastructure end to end and lead the teams responsible for it.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with systems software on physical hardware and has led engineering organizations with several levels of management. You should be comfortable owning a large area that spans many teams, taking on problems that aren't well defined yet, and working out boundaries directly with other organizations.

Mission Summary:

As the Director of Onboard Core Software, you will lead the strategic vision and execution for the software foundation of Motional's autonomous vehicles, from embedded firmware through the operating system, runtime, and middleware. This leadership role is centered on establishing a single roadmap, intake process, and escalation path for the onboard stack, and serving as the primary engineering counterpart to Vehicle Platform Engineering, Autonomy, and Safety for everything that runs on the vehicle's compute platform. You will keep the current-generation platform healthy in production while building the next-generation platform program. You will own cross-cutting system behaviors such as startup sequencing, storage lifecycle, compute, ECU bring-up, and cross-layer latency to ensure the platform performs safely and reliably, and that the entire product is a delight for our customers, from the autonomy features that drive the vehicle to the customer-facing features riders experience in our cars.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Stack Ownership: Own the onboard software stack from firmware through middleware. That includes software on embedded platforms including SoCs, safety MCUs, and GPU compute; the operating systems, drivers, and interfaces to the physical world; task runtime and compute resource management; system health monitoring; and safety and diagnostics software.
  • Organizational Leadership: Lead and develop a team of engineering managers and technical leaders. You own hiring, leveling, performance, and career growth for the group, and you will build leaders who can run their teams autonomously.
  • Cross-Functional Accountability: Be the main contact for onboard software for stakeholder and partner teams. You will settle boundary questions between organizations, run intake and prioritization, and handle escalations when your teams’ software is on the critical path.
  • Delivering Quality: Define what "done" means for onboard software at each release, including quality metrics to ensure delivery of a safe and reliable product.

What We're Looking For:

  • Education: BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent knowledge and work experience.
  • Experience: 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading organizations of 40 or more engineers as a manager of managers. This should be in a field where software runs on physical hardware, such as automotive, robotics, aerospace, or consumer devices.
  • Systems Software Depth: Hands-on experience building, or leading teams that built, embedded firmware, Linux kernel or BSP software, real-time middleware, or high-performance runtimes. You can talk through boot sequencing, IPC latency, or resource scheduling with Principal Engineers.
  • Production Operations: Experience running software in production on a fleet or in the field, including keeping a current platform healthy while bringing up the next one.
  • Technical Leadership: Experience hiring, developing, and retaining talent as an organization grows.
  • Cross-Organizational Ownership: Experience owning a large area that spans many teams. You build trust with peer organizations, work out boundaries directly, and make decisions people follow.
  • Communication: Clear writing and speaking. You can explain technical tradeoffs to executives, peers, and engineers across your team and others.
  • Inclusive Leadership: Experience building inclusive teams and making room for people with different working styles, ideas, and backgrounds.
  • Engineering Rigor: Ability to set and hold the team to high standards for engineering quality.

Bonus Points (Not Required):

  • Experience with functional safety in automotive (ISO 26262, safety MCUs, safety monitors, diagnostics), or working closely with a safety organization on requirements and designs for safety-critical/regulated environments.
  • Experience with high-performance, high-bandwidth, low-latency systems, such as moving large amounts of data across numerous subsystems with tight timing requirements.
  • Familiarity with physical AI ecosystems, where machine learning models sense and act in the real world. That includes how those models run on embedded compute, how they depend on sensors and the onboard runtime, and how on-road and simulation data is used to train and evaluate them.
  • Experience in the autonomous vehicle or robotaxi industry.

We encourage a hybrid schedule with in-office time at one of our locations in Boston, Pittsburgh, or Las Vegas to support collaboration, or this role can be fully remote.

Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move.

Higher purpose, greater impact.

jobs.description:
COMPANY 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

We are seeking a People Operations Manager to lead our frontline people support and drive operational and strategic HR and People Operations processes. In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to managers across the company and own key people operations service areas (e.g., benefits and leave, compensation operations, multi-state compliance, immigration, reporting, unemployment claims). You will translate People Ops strategy into practical, team-level action while improving the processes that make the function run.


Responsibilities will include:

  • Define and evolve team processes, tools, and communication practices to drive consistency
  • Lead execution of company-wide programs (performance reviews, merit communications, benefits education, engagement surveys) and provide input into program design
  • Collaborate with Payroll, Finance, Talent Acquisition, Legal, and IT on rollout and adoption, and bring field feedback to refine policies and processes
  • Oversee benefits administration and manage relationships with the broker, carriers, and plan administrators, including billing reconciliation with Finance
  • Lead open enrollment end-to-end and support benefits program reviews and vendor assessments
  • Own leave of absence administration (FMLA, state-mandated, parental, personal, military), including multi-state compliance, payroll coordination, and return-to-work and accommodation planning
  • Own assigned HR service areas and respond to unemployment claim inquiries
  • Oversee compensation changes (adjustments, promotions, reclassifications, off-cycle increases) and support merit and bonus cycles end-to-end
  • Build compensation tools and manager guides, and support pay equity analysis and the maintenance of grade structures and salary bands
  • Partner with Finance on compensation budgeting, headcount cost modeling, and payroll reconciliation
  • Own employer state registrations, Powers of Attorney, and state payroll tax, SUI, and workers’ compensation accounts, ensuring registration is in place before employees start in a new state
  • Respond to state agency notices and keep audit-ready records of registrations and compliance filings
  • Serve as an escalation point for employee relations issues, manager coaching, and conflict resolution
  • Partner with Legal and the Director of People Ops on ER investigations, documentation, and risk mitigation
  • Advise on federal, state, and local employment law compliance (wage and hour, I-9, leave, data privacy) and ensure consistent policy application
  • Translate People strategy (workforce planning, retention, talent management, career development) into tactical actions
  • Identify patterns across business units and recommend solutions and process improvements to People leadership
  • Serve as the key intake point for employee and manager questions, resolving moderate-complexity issues with People Generalists, global admin staff, and Senior People Partners

Professional Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent combination of experience and education); Master’s or HR certification (SHRM-SCP, SPHR) preferred
  • 7+ years of progressive HR experience, including leading a People Partner or People Generalist team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Proven track record of designing and implementing strategic HR initiatives
  • Strong knowledge of employment laws, regulations, and best practices, including multi-state compliance, leave laws, COBRA, and ACA
  • Experience with benefits, leave, and compensation administration, including merit and bonus cycles
  • Deep understanding of the employee lifecycle, manager coaching, and HR best practices
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, and EQ, with the ability to influence at all levels and deliver feedback with clarity
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; advanced Excel and PowerPoint; hands-on experience with HRIS (Rippling preferred), ATS, and data analytics
  • Ability to quickly learn new systems and act as an SME for key systems and processes

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

  • Competitive compensation aligned with experience and market benchmarks.
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Paid time off and company-observed holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and supportive work environment.
  • Access to tools, resources, and training to support success in the role.

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Director
jobs.excerpt: About Life360Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love.
jobs.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

We’re a small, senior Business Development team that grows Life360 through partnerships with leading companies. Our focus is named partners: we build the target list, open doors, close the deals, and stay involved after launch so that each partnership performs. We measure ourselves on members who become paying subscribers, not just sign-ups … every deal has to make sense for the business. We also help decide what Life360 should build, partner on, or buy. And because no team has every relationship, we’re good at bringing in outside experts who do. If you like opening doors and seeing your deals move the company’s results while helping keep families safe, this is the team for you.

About the Job

Life360 is the family safety and connection platform trusted by more than 100 million monthly active users worldwide. The next stage of our global growth will come from partnerships with the largest consumer technology and AI companies, partners who can bring Life360 to millions of families. We're hiring a senior business development practitioner to forge strategic partnerships and turn them into results.

You'll decide which partners matter most and why, get in front of the people who can say yes, and lead each deal from first conversation through launch and growth. You'll join a deliberately focused team where each person owns a small set of high-value partners and goes deep.

The US-based salary range for this position is $190,000 to $296,500. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You'll Do

In Your First Year

  • Set the direction for your partners. In your first 90 days, you’ll build a clear point of view on your partner targets: large consumer and technology companies, typically with millions of customers, in the US and in Life360’s priority international markets. Examples include device and wearable makers, financial services, and consumer apps and platforms. For each target, you’ll work out what the value is for them and for Life360, who to connect with, and which deals are worth pursuing. You’ll own that plan and keep it current.
  • Open new doors. You'll create opportunities that are yours from the start. You'll open connections with decision-makers at large partners, build relationships across their organizations, and turn initial conversations into real negotiations.
  • Sign three partners and launch two. By the end of your first year, you’ll have signed strategic distribution partnerships with three key partners, with at least two live and generating monetizable MAU or paying subscribers. Those partnerships will keep growing after year one, adding monetizable members and revenue that noticeably accelerate Life360 past its company goals.
  • Rally both sides. You'll bring together product, engineering, marketing, legal, and finance at Life360, along with your counterparts at each partner, to move every deal forward and keep it growing after signature.

What We’re Looking For

These are must-haves.

  • You open doors yourself. You get energy from reaching out to senior people at large companies you haven’t met yet, and you keep going when the first answer is no. You can point to partnerships that started with your outreach.
  • You have executive relationships at the companies that matter most to us. You have working, productive connections at major technology platforms such as Meta, Google, and OpenAI, and in industries such as travel, financial services, and consumer services. You can get a serious meeting with the right leaders and turn it into a deal.
  • You build the strategy and close the deal. You’ve decided which partners a company should pursue and why, and brought executives on both sides to a decision. You’ve led complex negotiations with large companies and driven those partnerships through launch to results that moved company-level member growth and revenue.
  • You bring people with you. You lead without authority. Product, engineering, legal, finance, and your counterparts at each partner want to work with you, because you build genuine, trusting relationships on both sides of a deal.
  • You work AI-native. You develop and apply AI-enabled workflows that improve how strategic partnerships are identified, evaluated, and executed, helping establish scalable practices across the team.

You’ll typically have around 15 years in technology business development or strategic partnerships, with substantial time at a senior level, ideally in mobile consumer apps, connected devices, or consumer subscription services.

How We'll Get to Know You

Our process is built around real work. You'll walk us through a partnership you originated, from the first outreach to the results it produced. You'll show us an AI workflow or agent you use in your deal work. You'll also join a working session where you choose a large potential partner for Life360 and show us how you'd open the door, which deal you'd pursue, and how you'd get it done.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for employees)
  • Paid parental leave
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment
  • Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers

Life360 Values

Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference

  • Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
  • Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
  • Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
  • High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful.Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!

jobs.excerpt: Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalized and profitable guest experiences.
jobs.description:
Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalized and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.
We are looking for a motivated Mid-Market Account Executive to add to our industry-leading GTM team. In this role, you will develop relationships with prospective brands ready to scale their digital potential. The ideal candidate will possess technical aptitude, sharp project management skills, and comfort selling into all levels of an organization. Sound like you? Read on.

Olo's industry-leading online ordering platform has changed the restaurant landscape, helping many of our customers achieve 40%+ digital sales. You will be helping new logo brands move beyond fragmented tech by adopting an integrated platform for ordering, payments, and guest engagement.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing group of Account Executives within Olo's Mid-Market Sales team, focused on restaurant brands with between 5 and 49 locations. You will report to the Senior Manager, Mid-Market Sales, and can work remotely from anywhere in the U.S. or at Olo’s headquarters in NYC.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Own the full sales cycle — from self-sourced prospecting and territory prioritization through discovery, demo, proposal, and close.
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline through outbound prospecting, referrals, industry events, and partner channels.
  • Drive awareness of Olo products and services to an assigned “Book of Business” and book meetings to explore sales opportunities.
  • Deliver a unified vision of Olo’s Order, Pay, and Engage solutions, and present a recommended proposal for each prospect based on a thorough understanding of their business model, technology stack, and growth plans.
  • Build and manage key stakeholders and "champions" through multi-threading within target organizations.
  • Conduct high-impact product demonstrations (video conference or face-to-face) showcasing how Olo solutions help brands deliver personalized hospitality at scale while driving incremental revenue.
  • Coordinate customer meetings and deliver timely recaps with associated follow-up materials.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from initial discovery and qualifying competitive threats to final contract negotiations.
  • Partner with the Deployment and Customer Success teams to ensure seamless program launches that meet client expectations.
  • Maintain a consistent pipeline to meet and exceed monthly/quarterly revenue and new client acquisition goals.

What Will Set You Up For Success

  • 5+ years of sales experience, with 3+ years in a closing role (B2B SaaS, payment solutions, or hospitality tech preferred).
  • You prospect as a daily habit to build pipeline independently, without solely relying on inbound or marketing leads.
  • You understand the whitespace of each account in your book and perform outbound prospecting to brands with relevant messaging to create the necessary pipeline coverage.
  • You conduct excellent discovery and adopt a structure to determine whether to continue the sales conversation.
  • You demonstrate an ability to identify, build, and manage key stakeholders throughout the process.
  • You adopt a standard sales process or methodology, clearly articulating the specific actions that each role is responsible for within the process.
  • You arrive for each key conversation with an agenda and set questions, and follow up with thoughtful discussion points and next steps.
  • You have experience selling platform-based products and are comfortable getting “into the weeds” with prospects.
  • Able to communicate with multiple internal departments about client feedback and work cross-functionally to solve problems.
  • You are proficient in demonstrating complex platforms and highly skilled in CRM (Salesforce), Excel, and data analytics tools.
  • Exceptional presentation skills and the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for C-level or founder-level decision makers.
  • You are experienced with deciphering legal contracts and navigating the nuances of multi-year SaaS agreements.
  • Comfortable managing a high volume of deals simultaneously in a fast-paced, remote-friendly environment.
  • You're client-focused, motivated, and have prior results to prove it.
  • Experience selling to the hospitality/restaurant industry, payment solutions and/or SaaS-based products is a plus.
  • Experience building trust with "Founder-led" brands, where decision-making is often highly personal and less bureaucratic than enterprise environments, is preferred.
  • Ability to consult brands specifically on the "inflection point" of scaling from 5 to 49 locations, positioning Olo as the foundation for growth is a plus.
  • Preferred: skill in tailoring customized ROI models that quantify the "cost of inaction" regarding fragmented tech stacks. Deep knowledge of the hospitality tech ecosystem to proactively differentiate Olo against legacy POS providers and niche ordering and guest engagement apps.
  • The social intelligence to manage the varying priorities of a brand leader, an operations lead, a head of technology, a finance lead, and a head of marketing simultaneously is a plus.

About Olo

Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. Learn more at .
We’re remote-friendly. Since 2015, we have been evolving our culture to continue to support a more distributed workforce and now over 75% of our team works remotely across the U.S. If you're in the New York City area, you can choose to work remotely or from Olo's headquarters.
We offer great benefits, such as 20 days of paid time off, 10 sick days, 11 holidays, plus year-end closure, health, dental, and vision coverage for yourself and your family, a 401k match, remote-office stipend, a generous parental leave plan, volunteer time off, gift matching policy, and more!
Our best estimate of the compensation range for this opportunity is $84,000 - $120,500 annually, depending on the experience you bring and your location. This role is also eligible for incentive compensation. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.

We encourage you to apply!

At Olo, we believe bringing together people with varied experiences and viewpoints leads to better results. Don't check every box in the job description? Research shows many qualified candidates hold back from applying unless they meet all listed requirements. We're committed to creating a genuine workplace where everyone can contribute their best work—this improves our decision-making and helps us better serve our communities. If you're enthusiastic about this role but your background doesn't perfectly align with every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly the right fit for this or other positions.
All applicants receive consideration for employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.excerpt: The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on, high-impact Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response, to strengthen security operations at Sezzle: detection, incident response, and vulnerability management across our cloud infrastructure and applications.

You will join the team that runs our SIEM and detection capability — from log ingestion and audit coverage to detection rules, alert tuning, and investigation workflows — so that access to sensitive systems is attributable and suspicious activity is caught and attributed by our own detections. You will operate the vulnerability-management loop end-to-end, and when incidents happen, you will lead the investigation and see the long-term fix through. You should consider yourself a DOer - someone who is comfortable diving into logs, analyzing systems, validating findings, and working end-to-end to get issues resolved.

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and network and zero trust — your detection and response work is what proves their controls hold. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to work on real-world security problems at scale. At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows for alert triage, investigation, and threat hunting that multiply what the team can cover.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build, operate, and mature SIEM/XDR capabilities, including log ingestion, detection rule development, alert tuning, and investigation workflows
  • Design and implement detection strategies for suspicious activity, including data exfiltration patterns using application and database telemetry
  • Extend audit and attribution coverage across the estate — Kubernetes audit logs, database audit logging, SSO and access-path telemetry — so access to sensitive data is attributable to a person or workload, with retention aligned to compliance requirements
  • Investigate and respond to security incidents across cloud infrastructure and applications, performing root cause analysis and driving long-term fixes
  • Run proactive threat hunts across cloud and identity planes, building agentic hunting workflows that make hunts repeatable
  • Operate vulnerability management across infrastructure, platforms, and applications - including internal scans, dependency analysis, and external findings, validating true positives and driving remediation with engineering teams
  • Triage and validate external security findings (including bug bounty reports), distinguishing true positives and coordinating remediation
  • Contribute to threat modeling and security design reviews for the detection, logging, and incident-response implications of new systems
  • Apply strong AWS and Kubernetes judgment to secure the systems you operate and advise owning teams on remediation
  • Support and implement security controls aligned with PCI DSS, SOC 2, and other compliance requirements — with your logging and detection work producing the audit evidence as a by-product
  • Develop and implement automation (including AI) to improve efficiency in security operations, detection, and response
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for detection and response and the services you own

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of experience in security, software, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on experience securing cloud-based production systems and working with real-world security challenges
  • Experience working with SIEM platforms (e.g., Wazuh, Splunk, ELK) for detection engineering, monitoring, and incident response
  • Experience designing and tuning detection rules, reducing alert noise, and improving investigation workflows
  • Strong hands-on experience in vulnerability management — scanning, triage and validation of scanner and bug-bounty findings, remediation coordination, and verification
  • Strong knowledge of AWS, Linux, and Kubernetes infrastructure, including security architecture and operational best practices
  • Ability to investigate issues directly using logs, cloud tooling, and system-level data
  • Experience assessing the detection and logging implications of new systems in design reviews
  • Knowledge of common security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies (OWASP, SANS, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS and SOC 2, particularly logging, monitoring, and evidence expectations
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today, and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — triage, enrichment, or hunting
  • Familiarity with log-based detection, telemetry pipelines, and security analytics use cases
  • Experience with internal penetration testing or adversarial exercises, and translating results into detection and remediation work
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native security controls, including IAM, network segmentation, and container security
  • Experience with container and dependency security tools (e.g., Snyk, Trivy, Grype) as an operator of their findings
  • Experience aligning technical security work with regulatory and compliance expectations
  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated environments

About You:

  • You think like an investigator - you turn telemetry into detections and detections into answers, and you are not done until the root cause is fixed.
  • You treat attribution as an engineering deliverable - every access to sensitive data has a name on it, and every finding has an owner and a date.
  • You are excited to use automation and emerging technologies (including AI) to take repetitive security work off the team's plate
  • You balance strong security standards with business needs and can support privacy and compliance requirements in a practical, scalable way
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
