Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a mid-level UX Designer / Researcher to help the General Services Administration (GSA) Regulatory Information Service Center (RISC) keep its regulatory review systems working for the people who rely on them while a modern replacement is built. RISC supports ROCIS, the system that federal agencies and the Office of Management and Budget's Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs (OIRA) use to manage rulemaking review, the Unified Agenda, Paperwork Reduction Act information collections, regulatory accounting, and privacy oversight. It also supports , the public's window into that work. You'll split your time evenly between two teams. On the Operations and Maintenance team, you'll research and design priority enhancements to the systems agencies use every day. On the Modernization team, you'll lead user research and design validation for the new platform that replaces the legacy system. You'll work directly with OIRA desk officers, agency clearance officers, administrators, and members of the public to understand how regulatory work actually gets done, then turn what you learn into designs that engineers can build and users can trust.

Applicants must submit a portfolio for review (please include passwords for restricted access sites) and prepare to discuss it if selected for an interview.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of up to three years. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the United States, excluding its territories. You must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $105,000 – $115,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Plan and conduct user research and usability testing with OIRA desk officers, agency users, RISC administrators, and members of the public to shape priority enhancements to ROCIS and .

  • Build discovery and user research into agile sprint cycles, partnering with the product owner and engineers to capture, document, and iteratively validate requirements.

  • Maintain a research plan and deliver research and usability artifacts in time to inform sprint planning, so every applicable sprint is grounded in evidence from real users.

  • Turn help desk trends, training feedback, and usage data into design recommendations and backlog items for both the operations and modernization teams.

  • Map current business processes across regulatory review, Unified Agenda, Paperwork Reduction Act, regulatory accounting, and privacy workflows, and identify pain points to improve upon.

  • Create process flows, design concepts, wireframes, and interactive prototypes that support Government decision-making before capabilities are built.

  • Validate proposed designs with agency users, oversight offices, and administrators under the direction of the Government Design Lead.

  • Refine business requirements by business process, translating research findings into user stories and clear acceptance criteria.

  • Design work queues, workflow tracking, notifications, dashboards, and search experiences that help OIRA and agencies manage workload, deadlines, and status across the regulatory lifecycle.

  • Apply WCAG 2.1 AA and Section 508 standards in every design, support accessibility testing, and help ensure public-facing sites meet 21st Century Integrated Digital Experience Act requirements.

  • Write user acceptance testing (UAT) plans, scenarios, and scripts, and support structured UAT with Government users before each release.

  • Prototype and test concepts that use structured, machine-readable policy information to improve analysis, traceability, search, and public understanding of federal regulations.

  • Contribute user insights to product roadmaps and release readiness, and partner with change enablement and training staff so users are prepared for every release.

  • Document research findings, design decisions, and design standards so knowledge carries from the legacy systems into the modernized platform.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in human-computer interaction, interaction design, information science, cognitive psychology, anthropology, or a related field and at least five years of experience in UX design and user research, or an equivalent combination of education and/or experience.

  • Demonstrated experience planning and conducting both generative and evaluative research, including interviews, contextual inquiry, and moderated and unmoderated usability testing, and synthesizing findings into clear design decisions.

  • Experience designing complex, workflow-driven enterprise or case management systems that serve multiple user roles with different permissions.

  • Proficiency creating process flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes using tools such as Figma, Mural, or Miro.

  • Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 AA and Section 508, including designing for and testing with people who use assistive technology.

  • Experience working on agile, cross-functional product teams with product owners, engineers, and testers, and timing research so it informs sprint work.

  • Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, and UAT scenarios.

  • Experience improving a system that people depend on every day while it remains in operation, balancing near-term enhancements with longer-term redesign.

  • Experience conducting research with federal government users, including awareness of Paperwork Reduction Act considerations when engaging members of the public.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, including the ability to present research findings and design recommendations to senior Government stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated history of interfacing with cross-functional teams, senior management, external clients, and other stakeholders.

  • Strong experience and comfort with the Microsoft Office suite and virtual collaboration tools (such as Miro, Slack, GitHub, Jira, etc.).

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Tier 2 Public Trust background investigation in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience with federal regulatory or information collection processes, such as Executive Order 12866 review, the Paperwork Reduction Act, or the Unified Agenda, or familiarity with ROCIS or .

  • Experience using or contributing to the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS) or other large-scale enterprise design system.

  • Experience designing data dashboards, reporting tools, or search experiences for oversight or analytics users.

  • Experience researching and designing AI-assisted features, such as document summaries or public comment analysis.

  • Experience with service design methods such as journey mapping, service blueprinting, or business process modeling.

  • Commuter benefits

About CAI Software

CAI Software builds purpose-built solutions that help manufacturers, processors, and distributors accelerate performance. jobs.title: Director, Anaerobic Wastewater Treatment
jobs.excerpt: At Mobius Renewables, we’re helping lead the global energy transition by transforming waste into renewable energy and measurable decarbonization.
jobs.description:
At Mobius Renewables, we’re helping lead the global energy transition by transforming waste into renewable energy and measurable decarbonization. We’re a fast-growing team of expert innovators, engineers, and problem-solvers committed to advancing global sustainability, fueling a circular economy, and creating a cleaner future for all. Join us and help shape the future of renewable energy.

Position Summary:

Mobius Renewables operates a growing fleet of plants across the USA, currently 13, that convert

biogas derived from the anaerobic digestion of wastewater in covered lagoons into renewable

natural gas (RNG).

The Director of Anaerobic Wastewater Treatment anaerobic digestion will serve as the company’s

primary technical authority and point person for wastewater feedstock management, covered-

lagoon anaerobic digestion, and biogas generation across the anaerobic digestion portfolio. The

role will combine deep technical expertise with engagement with wastewater-generating

counterparties.

This role serves as the organization’s subject matter expert for industrial wastewater treatment,

with particular emphasis on high-strength organic waste streams, biological treatment, anaerobic

processes, and the integration of wastewater treatment with anaerobic digestion and renewable

energy production.

The Director will work across Development, Engineering, Operations, Commercial, and Project

Execution to evaluate new opportunities, troubleshoot operating facilities, and drive continuous

improvement across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership on Wastewater Treatment

  • Serve as Mobius Renewables’ primary technical authority for industrial wastewater treatment within the anaerobic digestion business.
  • Evaluate wastewater characteristics including COD/BOD, TSS, FOG, nutrients, pH, alkalinity, toxicity/inhibition, temperature, and other factors affecting biological treatment and anaerobic digestion performance.
  • Provide technical guidance related to aerobic and anaerobic biological treatment, clarification, solids handling, DAF, nutrient management, pretreatment, polishing, and related wastewater technologies.
  • Maintain knowledge of emerging wastewater and resource-recovery technologies and assess their applicability to Mobius projects.
  • Candidate should have strong technical background covering both the biology and physical operation of these systems, including: (i) Covered anaerobic lagoons and high-strength industrial wastewater; (ii) hydraulic short-circuiting, dead zones, retention time, and inlet/outlet configuration; (iii) sludge accumulation, lagoon capacity loss, dredging, and solids management; (iv) FOG accumulation, floating crusts, and fat-cap prevention or removal; (v) mixing, recirculation, heating, pH, alkalinity, nutrients, and organic loading; (vi) process upsets, inhibition, foaming, odor, and declining gas yield; (vii) cover condition, gas collection, condensate, pressure, and methane recovery; (viii) field diagnostics and practical corrective-action planning.

Project Development & Engineering

  • Partner with Development and Commercial teams during evaluation of new wastewater and anaerobic digestion opportunities.
  • Conduct or oversee technical due diligence of wastewater streams, existing treatment infrastructure, and proposed projects.
  • Assess the treatability and variability of prospective feedstocks and wastewater streams and identify potential process risks.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project economics through process optimization, resource recovery, reduced chemical or energy consumption, and improved biogas production.

Operations & Performance Optimization

  • Partner closely with Operations to optimize wastewater treatment and anaerobic process performance across operating facilities.
  • Diagnose process upsets and recurring performance issues and lead development of corrective actions.
  • Analyze operating data and identify trends affecting treatment efficiency, system stability, biogas production, chemical consumption, solids generation, and operating cost.
  • Develop operating parameters, KPIs, monitoring requirements, and performance standards for wastewater systems.
  • Support root-cause investigations following significant process or treatment events.
  • Lead technical discussions with customers, regulators, engineering firms, and other external stakeholders as appropriate.
  • Develop capital and operating-cost budgets for improvements to the wastewater treatment systems, including any solutions identified for mitigations of problems, and work with operations to integrate into financial planning.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Biological Engineering, or a related technical discipline; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible experience in industrial wastewater treatment, process engineering, biological treatment, anaerobic digestion, or related fields.
  • Deep technical knowledge of high-strength industrial wastewater treatment and biological processes.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, commissioning, operating, optimizing, or troubleshooting wastewater treatment systems.
  • Experience with anaerobic treatment technologies and/or anaerobic digestion strongly preferred.
  • Experience with food and beverage, agricultural, manufacturing, or other high-organic-load wastewater streams strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of wastewater characterization, mass balances, biological kinetics, process controls, nutrient requirements, solids management, and treatment-system performance.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical matters to nontechnical audiences.
  • Ability and willingness to travel (up to 50%) to Mobius facilities, customer sites, and project locations as required.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in several of the following areas would be particularly valuable:

·High-strength industrial wastewater

·Food and beverage wastewater

·Anaerobic biological treatment

·Anaerobic digestion

·Renewable natural gas and biogas

·DAF systems

·Aerobic biological treatment

·Nutrient removal and management

·Solids separation and handling

·Wastewater reuse and resource recovery

  • Treatment-system commissioning and startup
  • Process troubleshooting and optimization

·Industrial pretreatment programs

  • Wastewater permitting and regulatory compliance
  • Evaluation of greenfield and brownfield treatment facilities

We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Grüns is scaling fast, and our supply chain has to move faster than the demand. As our Supply Chain Specialist, you'll be the execution engine behind it: owning purchase orders from creation to receipt, keeping inventory and inbound data airtight, and catching risk before it ever reaches a customer. You'll work side by side with our Director of Supply Chain and directly with our suppliers, co-manufacturers, and 3PLs. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role, and the work you do will protect product availability as we grow.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Own day-to-day purchase order execution, moving every PO through production, shipment, receipt, and exception resolution without dropped follow-up
  • Run the operating cadence with suppliers, co-manufacturers, and 3PLs, so every confirmation, delay, decision, and committed date has one clear owner: you
  • Maintain the source of truth for available, inbound, and at-risk inventory, so the team always knows what we have, what's coming, and what's in trouble
  • Spot shortages, production delays, material constraints, freight risk, and inventory imbalances early, and escalate with a recommended action, not just a flag
  • Build Claude-powered workflows that turn raw PO, inventory, production, and freight data into exception lists, supplier communications, meeting recaps, and decision-ready summaries
  • Standardize reporting, documentation, and recurring workflows (and write the SOPs) so the team can handle higher volume with fewer manual errors

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 1-3 years in supply chain, operations, procurement, production planning, logistics, or inventory management, working close to the physical flow of product rather than only reporting on it
  • Has worked in or around a fast-paced CPG, food/beverage, supplements, wellness, beauty, or other physical-product business (strongly preferred)
  • Has coordinated directly with external suppliers, manufacturers, or logistics partners, whether in a full-time role or internship, and held them to deadlines across multiple workstreams at once
  • Has hands-on experience with an ERP, inventory, or order management system (NetSuite-style) and can pull and organize clean source data without help
  • Uses Claude or other AI tools daily for real operational work: writes strong prompts, builds reusable workflows, and validates outputs against source data before acting on them
  • Can point to real examples of catching a problem early and driving it to resolution

Approach to the role:

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, without losing sight of what matters most to the business
  • Proactive: follows up before the deadline, not after something is already late
  • Comfortable in ambiguity, and builds structure where processes are still taking shape
  • Takes extreme ownership: closes loops and communicates risk early
  • Collaborative and low-ego, while still holding internal teams and external partners accountable
  • Treats AI as a force multiplier on the work, never a substitute for judgment

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package—grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is between $80,000 – $85,000 plus bonus depending on experience.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

jobs.description:
Position: Data Coordinator

Job Location: Remote

Position Type: TemporaryFull-Time, Exempt

Position Classification: Not Union Eligible

Compensation: $63,000 - $70,000 per year

Travel Percentage: 5-10 %

Reports to: National Data & Analytics Director

ABOUT FOR OUR FUTURE

Founded in 2016, For Our Future Action Fund and For Our Future run the largest, permanent progressive field program across key states. Our vision is to expand the progressive infrastructure and advance economic prosperity for all, strong community schools, climate justice, and racial and social justice. Along with community partners and volunteers, we consistently engage with people in face-to-face conversations around what issues matter most to them. By organizing people in lasting relationships, we win elections, drive local progress, make a community’s collective voice heard, and help build the transformative power needed to improve people’s lives.

POSITION CLASSIFICATION

For Our Future recognizes a staff bargaining unit, affiliated with the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers (IBEW) 2304, a labor union. This position is NOT included in the For Our Future bargaining unit.

JOB SUMMARY

For Our Future Action Fund seeks a Data Coordinator to play a key role in supporting For Our Future’s national data team. We are looking for campaign experts interested in a professional opportunity to learn and develop new data skills while working to support the electoral and grassroots programs run in all of For Our Future’s states. For Our Future is proud to run a data-driven program, and this is made possible by our dynamic and mission-driven data team helping to drive our program nationwide. The Data Coordinator shall serve as the point person for extracting, transforming and loading field data across voter contact platforms, assist in compliance reporting, and work with the data team to develop materials and curricula for trainings directed at technical and non-technical audiences. This role will also help states leverage organizational data to advance progressive change, and empower teams that build power, and contribute to winning elections.

This position is anticipated to run through at least November 28, 2024.

Essential Functions (Updated scope for 2026)

  • Reviewing voter contact materials including door, phone and sms scripts

  • Refreshing turf daily and making sure the correct universe is being used for all canvass programs

  • Implementing quality control and technical assistance for state programs, including daily reviews of turf management tools to confirm staff activity is logged correctly, and turf is ready for the days program

  • Building scripts in VAN, including survey, questions, script, content, and MiniVAN Campaigns, and testing script flow before launch

  • Collaborating with state staff to ensure voter contact materials are administered smoothly, including daily check-in to confirm scripts and program for the next day

  • Checking active texting campaigns for correct script branching, and providing texting admin coverage

  • Monitoring the data team slack support channel, responding to staff requests, and troubleshooting VAN access issues

  • Reconciling MiniVAN Activity report reports against state Turf Trackers to make sure all information about the canvas program is being properly maintained and reported

  • Logging and escalating persistent data problems, staff data issues, or bottlenecks to the national data team

  • Supporting staff onboarding and training on VAN, MiniVAN, and data processes, including setting up VAN accounts for new hires

  • Working with state staff to ensure that voter contact materials are executed in a culturally competent fashion

  • Working with the National Data Team and National Organizing Team on other program tasks as assigned

  • Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.

Skills and Qualifications

  • At least 2-3 years working in a competitive field experience; electoral campaigns, progressive politics or advocacy

  • Demonstrated knowledge of effective and successful electoral plans, including targeting, voter contact, GOTV and best practices with each.

  • Exceptional communications skills and extraordinary attention to detail

  • Proficiency with Google and Microsoft platforms, in particular Google Slides/Powerpoint and Google Sheets/Excel

  • Proficiency in VoteBuilder/VAN

  • Flexibility and a willingness to take on new tasks and work long hours as needed

  • Experience working on projects in a fast-paced environment

  • Experience working for a community-based nonprofit organization a plus

  • Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to successfully relate to voters and volunteers from a wide range of backgrounds.

Full Time: This position comes with a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Health Insurance Coverage - 95% Employer Paid

  • Paid parental leave

  • Retirement Savings Plan with matching contributions up to the first 5%

  • $150 Monthly Cell Phone and Internet Reimbursement

  • Monthly Mileage Stipend

  • 13 days paid time off every calendar year, as well as other paid holidays.

Expected Hours of Work

  • Normal hours of business are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time Monday through Friday, however,employees may be required to work outside of normal business hours including weekends, holidays, and nights.

  • Employees are required to abide by certain blackout dates during a campaign cycle or other key deadlines, and generally not allowed to take off during blackout periods. Emergencies are not affected by this policy.

Work Environment

This position is based in our Washington, DC headquarters, which is currently remote and will have a remote option until further notice. Employees will therefore work and interact primarily in a virtual environment. Employees may be required to periodically travel to and/or work out of office locations in Washington, DC or at state offices.

Health and Safety

For Our Future Action Fund ("FOF") is fully committed to the health and safety of our colleagues, candidates and the communities we serve. We encourage all employees to stay “up to date” with their COVID-19 vaccines and once eligible, to get COVID-19 boosters; however, this is not a requirement for employment at FOF.

All employees are required to adhere to the health and safety policies and procedures, when appropriate as implemented by the organization. Upon request, reasonable accommodations will be considered on a case-by-case basis for exemptions to this requirement in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Applicants may request a reasonable accommodation form by emailing Human Resources at

jobs.description:
Helios Software Group is looking for a detail-oriented, self-motivated Accountant to join our growing finance team. You’ll be responsible for the day-to-day accounting of our German operations.

Helios is part of Valsoft Corporation, an international group that acquires and grows vertical market software businesses. As part of Valsoft, you’ll benefit from the stability of a large group while working in a hands-on, entrepreneurial team.

You will report toDirector of Finance/ Head of Finance and work closely with the wider finance team. This is a fully remote role open to candidates located in Europe.

What your day will look like:

  • Support month-end and year-end close for our German entities, including journal entries and accounting analysis.
  • Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and support their review.
  • Follow up with vendors on missing invoices and prepare cost accruals for the P&L review.
  • Process payments and bank transfers, and make sure approvals are in place.

About you:

  • At least 3 years of accounting experience, with hands-on experience in German accounting (HGB) and German tax requirements.
  • Experience in the software / SaaS industry.
  • Multi-currency or multi-entity experience is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of accrual accounting.
  • A professional qualification in accounting or bookkeeping is an asset.
  • Proficient in MS Office, especially Excel. NetSuite experience is a plus.
  • Detail-oriented and diligent. You take accuracy seriously and your work is reliable.
  • Not afraid of cleaning things up. You enjoy bringing order to messy ledgers, open items and old processes.
  • Self-motivated. You work independently in a remote setup, take ownership and act on your own initiative.
  • A team player who enjoys working closely with colleagues and communicates proactively, even remotely.
  • Curious and quick to learn new systems, with the wish to grow and take on more responsibility over time.

For more information, please visit . Follow Mineralys on LinkedIn, Twitter and Bluesky”

Mineralys is a fully remote company.

Director, Legal

The Director, Legal (Commercial and Medical Review) will serve as the lead legal reviewer for promotional and medical materials. This individual will represent Legal in the Medical, Legal, and Regulatory (MLR) review process, will sit on the Promotional Review Committee (PRC) and Medical Review Committee (MRC), and will help design the standards and procedures that allow the company to review materials quickly, through planned launch and into commercialization. This is a hands-on role for an attorney who is comfortable giving clear, practical advice in a fast-moving, remote environment and appreciates autonomy.

Reporting to the VP, Commercial Legal, this role is accountable for providing practical legal guidance across advertising and promotion, medical affairs activities, commercial operations, market access initiatives, and product launch planning.

This role requires strong interpersonal skills and significant cross-functional interaction across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Legal and Compliance. Experience with patient support programs and related materials would be an asset to the role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the Legal representative on the PRC and MRC, reviewing HCP-facing, patient-facing, medical, and corporate materials for compliance with the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, FDA advertising and promotion regulations, FTC requirements, and other relevant and applicable industry codes
  • Provide advice across pre-launch and launch activities, balancing legal risk with business objectives
  • Review patient materials, including patient education, disease awareness, website and digital content, and patient support program communications, to ensure compliance with relevant regulations
  • Evaluate claims for substantiation, fair balance, and net impression, including comparative, subgroup, and pharmacokinetic claims, and provide clear direction to reviewers and authors
  • Advise on pre-approval communications, including scientific exchange, disease awareness, medical education, congress activity, and the boundaries between investor and corporate messaging and promotion of an investigational product
  • Review non-promotional and medical affairs materials, including responses to unsolicited requests, payor and formulary communications, and digital and social media content
  • Provide guidance on compliantly navigating the regulatory landscape in business activities such as disease education, HCP engagement, and patient-facing materials
  • Support corporate legal matters and business development initiatives as needed

Qualifications

  • JD from an accredited law school and active membership in at least one U.S. state bar
  • 6+ years of legal experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry
  • Strong knowledge of FDA advertising, promotion regulations, and commercial legal requirements
  • Knowledge of product launch planning and commercialization activities
  • Experience reviewing HCP and patient materials, and advising on patient support programs, including hub services, co-pay assistance, and nurse or educator programs
  • Experience supporting a product launch, ideally with a pre-commercial or newly commercial biotechnology company

Core Competencies

  • Strong business judgment with a practical, solutions-oriented approach to risk management
  • Ability to balance legal risk and apply appropriate mitigation strategies
  • Ability to influence and advise in a matrixed environment
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex legal and regulatory concepts into actionable business guidance
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and relationship-building skills
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, resource-constrained environment
  • High degree of autonomy, accountability, and execution focus

Travel

  • This position requires up to 10% travel. Frequently travel is outside the local area and overnight.

This position is eligible for standard Company benefits including medical, dental, vision, time off and 401K, as well as participating in Mineralys incentive plans are contingent on achievement of personal and company performance. Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. Job Details

JOB SUMMARY:

The Director of Technology Innovation Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic leadership role responsible for governing and advancing the evaluation, selection, and deployment of emerging technologies across the supply chain organization. This individual will own and continuously refine a structured stage gate process for vetting technology innovations — ensuring that investments are rigorous, aligned to business priorities, and positioned to deliver measurable supply chain value.

This leader will serve as the bridge between technology vendors, internal stakeholders, and executive decision-makers, championing a disciplined yet agile approach to innovation.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


Stage Gate Process Ownership

  • Design, implement, and continuously improve a multi-stage gate framework for evaluating, piloting, and scaling supply chain technology innovations
  • Define clear criteria, scoring rubrics, and decision checkpoints for each gate (e.g., ideation, feasibility, pilot, scale, sunset)
  • Lead cross-functional gate review committees, facilitating structured go/no-go decisions with executive stakeholders
  • Maintain a transparent innovation pipeline dashboard, tracking all active and archived technology candidates

Technology Evaluation & Scouting

  • Proactively identify emerging technologies relevant to supply chain operations (e.g., AI/ML, robotics, IoT, digital twins, blockchain, autonomous systems)
  • Develop and maintain relationships with technology vendors, startup ecosystems, and industry research bodies (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, industry consortiums)
  • Conduct structured technology assessments including market analysis, vendor due diligence, and total cost of ownership modeling
  • Represent Cencora at industry forums, innovation councils, conferences, and strategic vendor engagements; maintain awareness of supply chain innovation trends and benchmark practices across industries.

Stakeholder Engagement & Governance

  • Partner with Supply Chain operations, IT, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to ensure holistic vetting of technology candidates
  • Build and manage a Technology Innovation Advisory Board comprising internal subject matter experts and external advisors
  • Develop executive-ready business cases and investment proposals for technologies advancing through the pipeline
  • Drive alignment between innovation initiatives and the broader supply chain strategic roadmap

Portfolio & Performance Management

  • Manage the innovation portfolio budget, ensuring appropriate resource allocation across stages of the gate process
  • Establish KPIs and success metrics for piloted and deployed technologies, measure realized benefits including cost savings, productivity improvements and service enhancements and reporting outcomes to senior leadership
  • Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and refine the vetting framework over time

Team Leadership & CoE Culture

  • Lead and mobilize a cross-functional network of internal stakeholders and subject matter experts, driving innovative outcomes through influence rather than direct authority
  • Build trust and credibility across Supply Chain, IT, Finance, Operations, and other functions by demonstrating deep expertise, active listening, and collaborative problem-solving
  • Create alignment around a shared innovation vision by engaging stakeholders early and often throughout the stage gate process
  • Design and facilitate working sessions, workshops, and forums that draw out subject matter expertise and foster co-ownership of technology evaluation decisions
  • Cultivate a culture of curiosity and structured experimentation across the stakeholder community, encouraging teams to surface and champion emerging technology ideas

QUALIFICATIONS:


Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or a related field
  • 10+ years of experience in supply chain operations, strategy, or technology — with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role
  • Demonstrated experience designing or managing a stage gate, innovation pipeline, or technology governance process
  • Strong understanding of supply chain operations across distribution, logistics, procurement, or inventory management
  • Proven ability to build executive-level presentations and facilitate senior leadership decision-making forums
  • Experience managing cross-functional programs from concept through implementation

Preferred

  • Master's degree (MBA, MS Supply Chain, or related)
  • Experience in pharmaceutical distribution, healthcare supply chain, or highly regulated industries
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as Stage-Gate®, Lean Startup, or Design Thinking
  • PMP, Agile, or related certifications

What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Honeycomb is an observability platform that helps engineering teams understand how their software behaves in production. Our Tenant team is behind Honeycomb Private Cloud, a brand new product that allows customers to have their own Honeycomb instance.

What you'll do

  • Own delivery of Honeycomb Private Cloud — the infrastructure, tooling, and operational processes that let enterprise customers run Honeycomb inside their own cloud environment.
  • Grow the product — we anticipate significant growth in the next year; help us meet sales goals and build relationships to support it.
  • Work at the customer boundary — partner with Field Engineering, Support, and Sales on PoCs, security reviews, access negotiations, and contract asks, and help the team know when to take feedback and when to help us show the customer what good looks like.
  • Lead across the org — Private Cloud depends on many engineering teams across the org. We maintain a tight drift between SaaS and Private Cloud, and this role will need to be able to understand and prioritize work that touches all parts of our engineering org.
  • Feedback loops for developers. We learn a lot about Honeycomb as a product while building Honeycomb. Ensure that we push Private-Cloud-inspired tooling back into our SaaS infrastructure so each side continues to make the other better.
  • Build the team — grow and develop a small, tenured, senior, very high-context team; remove the single points of failure that come with that; hire and onboard the next engineers to scale the team as the product offering scales.

What we're looking for

  • 1+ year as an Engineering manager for a highly technical, senior team.
  • You have a solid track record as an engineer, influencing without authority, and leaving things better than you found them.
  • You've managed or led a team that carried a real production on-call rotation, and you treat operational health as a core requirement.
  • Experience shipping and operating software in environments you don't fully control — on-prem, private cloud, BYOC, or managed single-tenant. You know what version skew, partial telemetry, and customer security constraints do to a roadmap.
  • Enough Kubernetes and AWS fluency to review a design, ask the challenging questions, and be useful in an incident review. You don't need to be the person writing the Terraform.
  • Comfort being customer-facing with enterprise buyers: security questionnaires, access models, procurement, escalations.
  • Ruthless prioritization on a small team with an enormous surface area — you can name what you decided not to do, and why.
  • Hiring and onboarding engineers into a domain with a steep ramp.
  • Comfort with AI tooling, and a point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't.

Bonus points

  • Familiarity with observability / OpenTelemetry (Honeycomb's domain).
  • You're still hands-on and enjoy contributing to and reviewing code (welcome, but it won't be your primary role here).
  • Background in Go, Terraform, Kafka, and large-scale data infrastructure.
  • FedRAMP, GovCloud, or regulated-industry compliance experience.
  • A field-adjacent past — solutions architecture, consulting, or deployment engineering.

jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.
  • Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required.
  • Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations.
  • Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.
  • Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners.
  • Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.
  • Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.
  • Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.
  • Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development.
  • Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.
  • The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.
  • Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.
  • The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.
  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.
  • GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.
  • Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior.
  • Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments.
  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.
  • Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • A central role supporting our mobile development team.
  • The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.
  • Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.
  • Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your experience developing for both Android and iOS, including Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Your backend, database, and server infrastructure responsibilities.
  • Examples of GitHub Actions workflows and runner environments you have configured or maintained.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with examples of delivered results.
  • Your experience supporting developers, mentoring colleagues, or leading a technical team.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, GitHub repositories, and released application references are welcome where available.

jobs.description:
Assume a vital position as a key member of a high-performing team that delivers infrastructure and performance excellence. Your role will be instrumental in shaping the future at one of the world's largest and most influential companies.

As a Remote Access Lead Infrastructure Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Corporate Sector- Employee Platforms, you apply deep knowledge of software, applications, and technical processes within the infrastructure engineering discipline. You own the design and build of the infrastructure that delivers secure remote access to virtual desktops and applications for a global workforce. That estate covers application delivery controllers, access gateways, session brokers, and the certificate, network, and authentication services that support them across a multi-region global data center footprint. This is a hands-on engineering role with design authority where you will set the reference architecture and configuration standards, engineer capacity and regional failover, harden the externally reachable access path, and automate build and validation so the estate stays consistent as it scales in an environment that is tightly controlled. Continue to evolve your technical and cross-functional knowledge outside of your aligned domain of expertise.

Job Responsibilities

  • Own the engineering design, build, and lifecycle of global remote access infrastructure, including application delivery controllers, access gateways, virtual desktop brokers and pods, and the supporting network and certificate services
  • Define reference architecture and configuration standards across regions, retire one-off builds and legacy exceptions, and hold a multi-tenant estate to a consistent baseline
  • Engineer capacity, resiliency, and failover, including regional redundancy, recovery design, traffic distribution, and load testing against peak and contingency concurrency
  • Harden the access path end to end, covering TLS configuration, federation and multi-factor integration, device posture enforcement, firmware and vulnerability remediation, and integrity monitoring of externally reachable services
  • Automate build, configuration, and post-change validation, and lead cross-domain engineering with network, identity, security, and data center operations partners
  • Use enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate infrastructure analysis and design documentation, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements
  • Apply reuse-first, AI-assisted practices within delivery and automation routines to identify recurring issues and validate remediation options, ensuring changes are traceable/auditable and aligned to resiliency and security expectations

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Formal training or certification on infrastructure engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
  • Demonstrated experience engineering enterprise remote access, application delivery, or virtual desktop infrastructure at global scale in a regulated environment
  • Deep hands-on expertise with application delivery controllers and access gateways, such as Citrix NetScaler and Omnissa UAG (Horizon), covering multi-tenant instance provisioning, load balancing, virtual server configuration, SSL and TLS profiles, certificate lifecycle, authentication policy, and session settings
  • Strong engineering experience with enterprise virtual desktop platforms, such as Citrix and Omnissa Horizon, covering broker and connection server design, pod and image architecture, and protocol-level session delivery
  • Working command of enterprise networking and identity integration, including DNS, routing and firewall policy, TLS, SAML federation, multi-factor authentication, and directory services
  • Demonstrated capacity planning, load testing, and resiliency engineering for a high-concurrency platform, with automation built in PowerShell, Python, Terraform, or equivalent.
  • Experience in Cloudflare or Akamai
  • Deep knowledge of one or more areas of infrastructure engineering such as: hardware, networking terminology, databases, storage engineering, deployment practices, integration, automation, scaling, resilience or performance assessments
  • Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support infrastructure engineering workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity
  • Ability to review and validate AI-assisted recommendations before implementation, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to resiliency, security, and auditability expectations
  • Deep knowledge of cloud infrastructure and multiple cloud technologies with the ability to operate in and migrate across public and private clouds

Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills

  • Experience with zero-trust network access or cloud-delivered access services, including identity-aware proxy and outbound connector models
  • Track record of reducing internet-facing attack surface for externally reachable enterprise services without degrading user experience
  • Familiarity with thin client platforms and a diverse endpoint population across managed and unmanaged devices
  • Hands-on experience with appliance hardware refresh and firmware lifecycle in co-located data centers

jobs.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a friendly, organised, and proactive Customer Onboarding & Success Specialist to join a growing technology platform that connects ABA (Applied Behaviour Analysis) providers with Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs) to help meet their staffing and coverage needs.

As the platform continues to grow, we need someone who can take ownership of the onboarding process, support new users, and ensure providers and RBTs have everything they need to get started successfully.

You’ll be the main point of contact for users who need guidance, follow-ups, or assistance completing their profiles and onboarding requirements. Your role will be essential in ensuring users understand how to use the platform, outstanding tasks are followed up on, and nothing falls through the cracks.

This is a hands-on customer-facing role suited to someone who enjoys helping people, building relationships, and keeping processes organised. We’re looking for a dedicated onboarding and customer success professional rather than a general virtual assistant.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Onboarding & Follow-Ups

  • Guide ABA providers through the onboarding process and help them get set up on the platform.
  • Support RBTs as they register and complete their onboarding through the mobile app.
  • Follow up with users who have incomplete profiles, missing information, or outstanding onboarding steps.
  • Proactively contact users to keep the onboarding process moving and ensure tasks are completed.
  • Take ownership of follow-ups and ensure no outstanding items are overlooked.

2. Customer Support & Platform Guidance

  • Answer routine questions from providers and RBTs about the platform and onboarding process.
  • Help users understand how the platform works and guide them through the relevant steps.
  • Check in with providers to ensure they understand how to use the portal and submit coverage requests.
  • Provide a friendly, patient, and professional user experience.
  • Build positive relationships with users and help them feel confident using the platform.

3. Customer Success & Engagement

  • Monitor onboarding progress and identify users who may need additional support.
  • Follow up with providers and RBTs to encourage completion of their profiles and continued platform engagement.
  • Identify areas where users may be confused or struggling to navigate the platform.
  • Help improve the onboarding experience by sharing recurring questions, feedback, and common challenges with the team.

4. CRM & Administrative Coordination

  • Keep CRM records up to date, including contact details, onboarding stages, communication history, and next steps.
  • Track outstanding follow-ups and ensure users receive timely communication.
  • Use company phone and messaging systems to contact users and manage ongoing conversations.
  • Maintain accurate records of onboarding activity and customer interactions.

5. Issue Identification & Escalation

  • Identify potential platform bugs, technical issues, or recurring user challenges.
  • Gather relevant information and escalate technical issues to the appropriate team member.
  • Follow up on unresolved issues where necessary and keep users informed.
  • Use good judgment to distinguish between routine questions that can be handled independently and issues requiring additional support.

Requirements & Experience

  • Previous experience in customer service, customer success, client relations, onboarding, or a similar customer-facing role.
  • Excellent spoken and written English, with clear communication and a professional telephone manner.
  • A friendly, patient, and personable approach when assisting different types of users.
  • Strong organisational skills and excellent follow-through.
  • Proactive and reliable, with the ability to manage multiple conversations and outstanding tasks independently.
  • Good judgment and the ability to learn new processes and systems quickly.
  • Comfortable using phone, email, messaging platforms, and CRM systems.
  • Strong attention to detail when managing user information, onboarding stages, and follow-up activities.
  • Able to work independently in a remote environment while communicating effectively with the wider team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting a healthcare, medical, or ABA-related business.
  • Familiarity with ABA services, RBTs, or healthcare staffing.
  • Experience onboarding users to a software platform, app, or online portal.
  • Experience working with a growing business or technology-enabled service.

Please note: Advanced technical skills and extensive Excel or Microsoft Office expertise are not required. The priority is finding someone with excellent communication skills, a strong customer-service mindset, and the ability to take ownership of the onboarding process.

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping people and making their experience as smooth as possible. You should be comfortable following up without being pushy, explaining processes patiently, keeping track of outstanding tasks, and taking initiative when something needs attention.

The ideal candidate is dependable, personable, and naturally organised — someone who can build trust with providers and RBTs while ensuring the day-to-day onboarding process runs smoothly.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to join a growing platform at an exciting stage of its development. You’ll play an important role in improving the customer experience, supporting platform growth, and helping build the processes needed as the business expands.

If you're a people-focused professional who takes pride in excellent service, clear communication, and getting things done, we’d love to hear from you!

Independent | Referral Commission | 5% of Collected Revenue

Who We're Looking For

You know people.

Executives. Business owners. HR leaders. Organizational decision-makers. People you've worked with, advised, done business with, or built professional relationships with over the years.

And every once in a while, you hear about a problem and immediately think:

I know who needs this.

SteadyState is looking for professionals who can make meaningful introductions to organizations that may need our work.

  • You don't have to become a salesperson.

  • You don't have to prospect.

  • You don't have to run the sale.

You make the right introduction. We take it from there.

What We Do

SteadyState™ Work Partners is a human capital consulting firm specializing in human capital risk mitigation.

We work with organizations when a valuable person's Heat-of-the-Moment actions or inaction are creating business consequences—and knowing better hasn't been enough to stop it.

Our proprietary TAU Core™ intervention develops the I Caught Myself Reflex™: the ability to interrupt an automatic reaction before it becomes consequential action or inaction.

TAU Core™ includes an in-person component delivered in Austin, Texas.

What Counts as a Referral

A referral is more than the name of a company. You know the person and make the introduction.

For example:

Not a referral:
“You should call ABC Company. They need this.”

A referral:
“I know the HR leader at ABC Company. I've told her about SteadyState and that the service includes participation in Austin. She's interested in talking with you. I'll introduce you.”

You don't have to sell the service or determine whether it's right for them. You make the qualified introduction. SteadyState owns the sales process from there.

We determine whether there is a business opportunity, lead the conversations, answer questions, develop the engagement, and close the business.

Your responsibility is the introduction.

Who You Might Know

You may know an organization dealing with:

  • A valuable employee they don't want to lose

  • A manager whose actions or inaction keep creating problems

  • Recurring conflict, complaints, or performance incidents

  • Customer or business consequences tied to employee behavior

  • Someone the organization has already invested substantially in developing

  • A problem that training, coaching, or other interventions haven't resolved

The organization does not have to be headquartered in Texas.

It does need to be willing to send its participant(s) to Austin, Texas, for the in-person portion of TAU Core™.

You don't need to diagnose the problem or determine whether SteadyState is the answer. If you recognize the situation, know the right person, and they're interested in the conversation, introduce us.

Compensation

5% of collected revenue on eligible new business resulting from your qualifying referral.

For example: One $25,000 engagement = $1,250 referral commission.

There is no minimum number of referrals required. Make one introduction or make several.

If an eligible referral becomes a paying SteadyState client and SteadyState collects the revenue, you get paid. If the referral does not result in collected revenue, no commission is earned.

What You Don't Have to Do

You are not responsible for:

  • Prospecting or cold calling

  • Managing a sales pipeline

  • Conducting sales meetings

  • Preparing proposals

  • Negotiating the engagement

  • Closing the sale

  • Meeting sales quotas

Your job is to open a door that you can genuinely open. SteadyState handles what happens after that.

Where You Will Work

You can be located anywhere in the United States.

There is no set schedule and no required volume of referrals.

Your connections may be in Texas or elsewhere. What matters is that the organization understands that SteadyState's in-person work is currently delivered in Austin and is willing to send participants there if it decides to engage us.

This opportunity can exist alongside your current career, consulting work, business, retirement, or other professional activities, subject to any obligations or conflict-of-interest requirements that apply to you.

The Question

Who came to mind while you were reading this?

If you know an executive, business owner, HR leader, or organizational decision-maker who should know about SteadyState—and they're open to sending their people to Austin if the service makes sense—make the connection.

This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:

Honeycomb is an observability platform that helps engineering teams understand how their software behaves in production. Our Tenant team is behind Honeycomb Private Cloud, a brand new product that allows customers to have their own Honeycomb instance.

What you'll do

  • Own delivery of Honeycomb Private Cloud — the infrastructure, tooling, and operational processes that let enterprise customers run Honeycomb inside their own cloud environment.
  • Grow the product — we anticipate significant growth in the next year; help us meet sales goals and build relationships to support it.
  • Work at the customer boundary — partner with Field Engineering, Support, and Sales on PoCs, security reviews, access negotiations, and contract asks, and help the team know when to take feedback and when to help us show the customer what good looks like.
  • Lead across the org — Private Cloud depends on many engineering teams across the org. We maintain a tight drift between SaaS and Private Cloud, and this role will need to be able to understand and prioritize work that touches all parts of our engineering org.
  • Feedback loops for developers. We learn a lot about Honeycomb as a product while building Honeycomb. Ensure that we push Private-Cloud-inspired tooling back into our SaaS infrastructure so each side continues to make the other better.
  • Build the team — grow and develop a small, tenured, senior, very high-context team; remove the single points of failure that come with that; hire and onboard the next engineers to scale the team as the product offering scales.

What we're looking for

  • 1+ year as an Engineering manager for a highly technical, senior team.
  • You have a solid track record as an engineer, influencing without authority, and leaving things better than you found them.
  • You've managed or led a team that carried a real production on-call rotation, and you treat operational health as a core requirement.
  • Experience shipping and operating software in environments you don't fully control — on-prem, private cloud, BYOC, or managed single-tenant. You know what version skew, partial telemetry, and customer security constraints do to a roadmap.
  • Enough Kubernetes and AWS fluency to review a design, ask the challenging questions, and be useful in an incident review. You don't need to be the person writing the Terraform.
  • Comfort being customer-facing with enterprise buyers: security questionnaires, access models, procurement, escalations.
  • Ruthless prioritization on a small team with an enormous surface area — you can name what you decided not to do, and why.
  • Hiring and onboarding engineers into a domain with a steep ramp.
  • Comfort with AI tooling, and a point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't.

Bonus points

  • Familiarity with observability / OpenTelemetry (Honeycomb's domain).
  • You're still hands-on and enjoy contributing to and reviewing code (welcome, but it won't be your primary role here).
  • Background in Go, Terraform, Kafka, and large-scale data infrastructure.
  • FedRAMP, GovCloud, or regulated-industry compliance experience.
  • A field-adjacent past — solutions architecture, consulting, or deployment engineering.
Base Salary based on level of experience
$285,000—$320,000 CAD

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...
Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:
  • All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address
    • We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo.
  • Our recruiting process will never ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to:
    • Social security or tax identification numbers
    • Credit card numbers
    • Bank account information

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.
We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

Privacy Notice:

If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes.
For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice.
If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact . Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Hanwha Renewables, headquartered in Irvine, California, a member of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 firm that is among the eight largest business enterprises in South Korea. Hanwha Renewables designs, builds and manages renewable energy solutions.
