Hanwha Renewables offers the full spectrum of energy solutions – from power plant development, design, construction, operations, and maintenance. With proven capabilities across the renewable energy value chain, Hanwha Renewables minimizes uncertainty and risk, and helps customers achieve a higher return on their investment in renewable energy.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the Sr Development Engineer will be responsible for technical diligence, design, energy performance forecasts, performance analyses and verification for hundreds of megawatts of PV and ESS development projects and operating facilities. S/he will support Project Development and Preconstruction project startup phases with hands-on design engineering, energy performance modeling, technical specifications data analysis and interpretation for Solar, Solar plus Storage and Standalone Storage projects up to 1 GW; and will provide technical support and inputs for PPA and EPC RFP Exhibit preparations. Occasional travel to project sites throughout North America will be required. Remote working from a location close to a major airport in the US will be considered for suitably experienced candidates with evidence or references regarding their ability to manage and deliver first class work in a similar situation.

The employee may be required to perform other job-related duties as requested by management. All duties will be assigned in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Consolidate project information and inputs to conduct site technical diligence, feasibility analysis, risk identification and design layouts and reviews in support of M&A acquisitions and cost estimations
  • Perform conceptual or preliminary design evaluations using Helioscope, PlantPredict, SIFT, PVCASE and/or AUTOCAD design software to support site diligence and cost estimation for Green Field and M&A projects.
  • Perform energy production forecasting modeling and analysis activities using PVSYST for all development projects and operating facilities and support technical diligence on site selection and project acquisitions.
  • Implement energy production modeling analysis and provide modeling inputs to assist with the optimization of system designs for PV and ESS projects, to achieve targets for production yield, generating capacity, capital cost, financial returns, etc.
  • Evaluate and implement energy input assessments, including 3D shading and terrain models using PVSYST, Helios 3D and other related tools to simulate associated losses; soiling estimation based on site conditions and array technology. Perform analyses to optimize forecast and actual production and enhance project value.
  • Contribute to the development of technical team capability, technology roadmap, software tools, project and engineering management processes, etc.
  • Collaborate with colleagues, consultants, and contractors, and facilitate virtual and in-person meetings to achieve efficient use of resources, meet deadlines for deliverables, minimize delays, avoid crises, and resolve conflicts.
  • Support the ongoing search for improved system performance by contributing to evaluations of new techniques, technologies, systems, and components, and being a resource regarding emerging best practices, products, technologies, and techniques in the clean energy industry.
  • Follow up on RFIs with third-party contractors and consultants for timely completion of engineering deliverables. Experience using Procore software is an advantage.
  • Contribute to the development of technical scopes-of-work, contract exhibits and specifications in support of EPC RFP process.
  • Proven ability to work independently and proactively, with experience working with cross-functional teams including Business Development, Procurement and Project Management.
  • Basic understanding of solar project schedules, cost estimation or construction is preferred.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS, MS or higher degree in Electrical, Civil or Mechanical Engineering, Renewable Energy, Physics, or closely related numerate discipline.
  • At least five years of hands-on experience in conducting project site diligence, design engineering, performance modeling and energy forecasting for Utility-scale PV, PV plus BESS in the solar project development, energy project development spaces, or specialist technical consulting environment.
  • Exposure to Plant Predict, NREL System Advisor Model, or Helioscope is an advantage.
  • Previous exposure to one or more of: PV module manufacturing quality assurance, PV module performance evaluation and testing; renewable energy project development; solar plant performance and/or operations, testing and troubleshooting of inverters or generators.
  • Strong communications skills and ability to clearly convey technical information, both verbally and in writing, to diverse audiences, including technical teams, stakeholders, and non-technical individuals.
  • Proactive and problem solver with ability to identify and address potential technical issues before they escalate. Demonstrates foresight in identifying potential challenges and proposing solutions to mitigate risks.
  • Polished interpersonal, technical writing, and presentation skills.
  • Proficient computer skills using MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook.
  • Detail-oriented and self-motivated with the ability to manage and prioritize concurrent tasks, and to work effectively in a collaborative virtual environment.
  • Ability and willingness to travel occasionally to project sites (often in remote locations), to lead or participate in meetings or seminars, and when necessary to work overtime on short notice.

COMPENSATION: $165,000 - $185,000 salary

jobs.excerpt: The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work.

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on: the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through.

This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery.

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust — your platform is what their work composes with.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes: new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones.
  • Own the event-driven platform between the security services: the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability — so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it.
  • Integrate the platform end-to-end: scanners → finding system-of-record → tickets → metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering.
  • Own delivery of the security gates — SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning: scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery.
  • Build agentic security workflows: CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers — tooling other engineers actually adopt.
  • Build the triage-to-remediation automation: validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop — reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations.
  • Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own.

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience.
  • Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days.
  • Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven or message-based systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar): contracts, idempotent consumers, replay, back-pressure.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipeline tooling — jobs, shared templates, runners — GitLab CI at fleet scale is a strong plus.
  • Hands-on web application security knowledge: the OWASP Top 10 in real code — able to find these issues, fix them yourself, and encode the detection so they stop recurring.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tooling (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, gitleaks), including tuning them to a signal-to-noise ratio developers will tolerate.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and have built agentic workflows that other engineers adopted.
  • Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes as deployment targets for the services you build.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending, especially with systems in cardholder-data or regulated scope.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 as they apply to software development and change management — the platform you build is what produces that evidence.
  • Software supply-chain integrity: SBOM pipelines, dependency governance, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA).
  • Familiarity with policy-as-code and admission control (OPA, Kyverno, conftest) — your gates compose with the cluster's runtime policy-enforcement layer.
  • Exposure to bug bounty or external vulnerability report triage — enough to know what the automation you build has to get right.
  • Experience with threat modeling at a system level.

About You:

  • You measure yourself by other teams' code - a fix you shipped is good; a vulnerability class that stopped appearing across the fleet is better.
  • You'd rather ship a gate than publish a policy - you know that enforcement changes behavior and documents do not, and you build the enforcement so well that engineers want to keep it.
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You're not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things.
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting.
    You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

jobs.excerpt: About Shippo At Shippo, our vision is bold and clear: we are the shipping layer of the internet.
jobs.description:
About Shippo

At Shippo, our vision is bold and clear: we are the shipping layer of the internet. Our mission is to make every merchant successful through excellent shipping, delivering world-class logistics technology and infrastructure. We’re building the backbone of global e-commerce — connecting merchants to carriers worldwide through a single API and intuitive dashboard.

As a remote-first and globally distributed team, we believe flexibility fuels trust, autonomy, and performance. Our diverse perspectives — across continents, cultures, and time zones — drive our innovation and enable us to build solutions used by businesses everywhere. We invest in modern, scalable technology so our teams can build, ship, and iterate with confidence.

Your impact starts here: every person at Shippo plays a direct role in shaping the infrastructure that powers global commerce and makes shipping simpler for businesses around the world.

How we will deliver success together:

As a Finance Manager, Strategic Finance, you will own the financial backbone of Shippo: the full company P&L, the annual operating plan, monthly C-level reporting, and board-level financial materials. This is not a support role. You will be the primary financial operator for a high-growth logistics technology company, accountable for the numbers that the CEO, CFO, and Board rely on.

This role carries meaningful executive exposure. You will report directly to the VP of Strategic Finance and have a skip-level relationship with the CFO, meaning your work will be seen, challenged, and relied upon at the top of the organization. You will produce the quarterly Board of Directors finance addendum, present financials in monthly leadership reviews, and be a trusted voice in the room when the numbers matter most. For the right person, this is a fast path to genuine strategic influence.

You will work directly with the CFO (as your skip level), and partner with Accounting, People Ops, and Engineering, and the full leadership team. The right person for this role is a strong finance operator who thrives on ownership, thinks commercially, and isn't satisfied just reporting the numbers - they want to understand them, improve them, and communicate them to decision-makers who act on them.

Shipping & handling responsibilities

Company P&L & Close Reporting

  • Own the full company P&L, revenue through EBITDA, and serve as the primary finance partner to Accounting for the monthly close cycle.
  • Produce the monthly MBR (Monthly Business Review), flash report, and supporting financial narrative for senior leadership, translating actuals vs. plan into clear stories and actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with the Controller to ensure accuracy and alignment on actuals and variances vs. plan.

Annual Operating Plan & Forecasting

  • Own the Master P&L model, the company's single source of truth for forecasting, scenario analysis, and AOP. Build, maintain, and evolve it as the business changes.
  • Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) process across all functions, including headcount planning, cost modeling, and revenue scenario builds.
  • Drive 2-3 reforecasts throughout the year, surfacing risks and opportunities before they show up in actuals.

Board & Executive Reporting

  • Produce the quarterly Board of Directors Finance Addendum, including financial exhibits, variance analysis, and supplemental data packages reviewed by the CFO and CEO.
  • Build the financial models and materials that support executive decision-making on product investment and cost savings strategies.

Transaction Readiness & M&A Support

  • Own and maintain Shippo's transaction readiness infrastructure, auditable P&L and balance sheet flat files, Looker cohort and retention views, AR/AP aging standardization, ensuring the company is 80%+ deal-ready at any given time.
  • Serve as the internal financial lead for any M&A diligence process, managing the data room and coordinating with Legal, Accounting, and the CFO on financial workstreams.

Headcount & Cost Management

  • Partner with People Ops as the finance counterpart to headcount planning, managing req approvals and monthly HC reporting for the exec team and Board.
  • Own the R&D and cross-functional HC scenario modeling tools used by the CTO and CMO, and maintain the financial view of headcount by department.
  • Lead recurring software and infrastructure cost reviews (AWS, SaaS vendors) with technical and operational stakeholders to drive efficiency.
  • Own vendor contract audits, identifying and actioning lapsed or suboptimal contracts.

Strategic Analysis & Ad Hoc

  • Build investment briefs, pro formas, and carrier/partner sizing models to support strategic decisions, including carrier economics, new product monetization, and geographic expansion.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Sales Finance on go-to-market financial modeling.
  • Drive improvements in FP&A tooling, data integrity, and financial systems to support scalable growth.

Your shipping requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in financial planning & analysis, corporate finance, or strategic finance, with at least 2 years in a high-growth technology or SaaS company. Investment banking, private equity, or M&A advisory background is a plus.
  • Experience owning a full company or business unit P&L, not just a function or cost center, and navigating the ambiguity that comes with it.
  • Exposure to transaction processes (M&A, capital raise, or strategic review) and familiarity with financial due diligence data packages.
  • Expert-level financial modeling skills: multi-driver operating models, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and headcount planning models.
  • Strong proficiency in NetSuite and at least one BI tool (Looker, Tableau, or Power BI). Comfort with Rippling or similar HRIS is a plus.
  • Strong commercial instincts: you don't just explain the variance, you explain what it means for the business and what we should do about it.
  • Highly organized and reliable - business partners, the CFO, and the CEO depend on you to get this right, on time, every time.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related. MBA, CFA, or CPA is a plus but not required.

What is in the Shippo Package?

  • Healthcare coverage for medical, dental, and vision (90% covered by the company, incl. dependents). Pets coverage is also available!
  • Take-as-much-as-you-need vacation policy & flexible working hours
  • One week-long company wide winter slow down
  • 3 Volunteer Days Off (VTOs)
  • WFH stipend to set up your home office
  • Charity donation match up to $100
  • Dedicated programs, coaching, tools, and resources for your professional and career growth as well as an individual learning stipend for your personal and focused growth
  • Fun team in person time through our Shippos Everywhere program which includes regular team and company off-sites throughout the year as well as local Shippos gatherings

Compensation

Our Compensation Shippolicy:

We believe compensation is a custom experience and are commited to fair and equitable compensation practices. The standard base pay range for this role is min is $136,000.00 to a max $184,000.00 annual salary (we tend to anchor our offers at the mid point $160,000.00. Since we are focused on hiring Shippos Everywhere, we have 2 US pay ranges, a standard compensation range for the majority of the US and a standard +1 compensation range for those who live in areas where the cost of labor is higher, such as NYC and California.

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: financial budgets, work experience, training, transferable skills, business needs, and market value. The base pay salary ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future. Total compensation for this role will include, equity, medical, dental, vision and other benefits noted in our Shippos “package” section.

Sail through the process:

Here at Shippo, we celebrate inclusivity and are committed to creating equal access to opportunities for people from all backgrounds, perspectives and geographies. These values define who we are and everything we do. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. If you need assistance, or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please contact us at

Shippos in the wild:

Our people, much like the packages we help ship, are all over the world. This means, through our remote-first program, “Shippos Everywhere”, our roles can be based anywhere in the US with the exception of Delaware, Nevada, Ohio, Oregon, Hawaii, New Mexico and West Virginia and many roles can be based internationally.

For locations outside of the US and Ireland, the employment contracts are powered by Rippling.com.

Why Bixal?

Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Our federal client runs a set of governmentwide information systems that agencies across government use to manage, review, and track mission-critical submissions, along with a public-facing site that gives the public a window into that work. The client is now replacing these legacy systems with a consolidated modern platform, released in phases while the current systems stay available around the clock.

The Change Enablement Specialist gets agency users, administrators, and oversight offices ready for every release and does the hands-on work to get them there. You will write the change and communication plans and the release messages, build and deliver the training for each new capability, produce the guides people rely on, and track whether users are adopting the new platform. You will work across the operations and modernization teams and support the Training Delivery Lead on training for the current systems. The work is governmentwide in reach, on a multi-year modernization where change readiness is a contract deliverable.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of up to 3 years. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location:

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $100,000 – $110,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain the modernization Organizational Change Management Plan and communication plan, identifying alpha, beta, and general availability users, customers, and stakeholders, and describing how each will be informed, heard, and prepared for change.

  • Lead training for each modernization release: assess training needs, design release-based sessions, demos, and job aids, and facilitate virtual training for alpha, beta, and general availability users before and after go-live.

  • Assess change impacts and stakeholder readiness for each release, including the transition and decommissioning impacts as legacy system functions are reduced or retired.

  • Write and coordinate release communications for current systems and the new platform, including banner notifications, email messages, and help desk scripts that announce new features and point users to training and guides.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Autonomous Systems Engineer to design, build, and integrate software systems that power autonomous robots and robotic platforms. In this role you will work across the full robotics software stack, from low-level sensor integration and motion planning to high-level perception and behavioral systems. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep working knowledge of robotics frameworks, real-time systems, and sensor fusion. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop robotics software in C++ and Python, with strong attention to real-time performance and reliability.
  • Design and integrate sensor data pipelines including cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, and proprioceptive sensors.
  • Implement perception, localization, and mapping algorithms including SLAM and sensor fusion, integrating data from cameras, LiDAR, IMUs, and other sensors into robust real-world state estimation.
  • Develop motion planning, control, and trajectory generation algorithms that respect kinematic and dynamic constraints while delivering smooth, predictable, and safe robot behavior in production environments.
  • Build behavioral systems using state machines, behavior trees, or task planners.
  • Integrate ROS / ROS 2 frameworks with custom hardware and embedded systems.
  • Implement safety-critical patterns including watchdogs, fault detection, and safe stops.
  • Build simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim) for development and testing.
  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, electrical, and ML engineers, gathering requirements, aligning on technical approach, and ensuring that delivered solutions meet both functional needs and broader engineering and operational standards.
  • Design and execute field tests, including data collection and post-test analysis.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging robotics technologies and frameworks, assessing maturity, fit for purpose, and total cost of ownership, and make grounded recommendations on which to adopt, pilot, or defer based on real engineering needs.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of robotics software engineering experience.
  • Strong programming skills in C++ and Python.
  • Hands-on experience with ROS or ROS 2 in production projects.
  • Solid experience with at least one of perception, localization, motion planning, or control.
  • Familiarity with sensor fusion and Kalman/particle filter techniques.
  • Experience with simulation environments (Gazebo, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo).
  • Strong debugging skills in real-time and concurrent systems.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting field tests and hardware integration.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Advanced degree in Robotics or related field.
  • Exposure to autonomous vehicles, drones, or industrial automation.
  • Experience with safety-critical software (ISO 26262, IEC 61508).
  • Familiarity with ML-based perception pipelines.
  • Open-source contributions in robotics.

ActionDesk is an established AI, automation and technology consultancy.
We’ve been operating for almost 10 years, hold recognised accreditations and have an experienced technical and delivery team behind the business.
We help companies use AI and automation to make practical improvements to their business. That can mean increasing lead conversion, improving follow-up, automating admin and onboarding, reactivating old databases, improving compliance processes or removing repetitive operational work.
The important bit is that we’re not selling AI for the sake of AI. We look for genuine commercial or operational problems and build systems that solve them.
The role
Your job is straightforward: create opportunities and win business within commercial finance.
That could mean working with:
  • Commercial mortgage brokers
  • Asset finance brokers
  • Bridging firms
  • Invoice finance businesses
  • Specialist lenders
  • Commercial finance networks
  • Other businesses operating in the sector
We also want you developing relationships with potential introducers and partners who can bring us into their own client base.
If you’re good at opening doors but don’t want to handle the technical side of a deal, that’s fine.
We can join discovery calls, run demonstrations, help scope opportunities, prepare proposals and support you with closing. Once something is sold, our team delivers it.
We’ll also provide leads and accounts where we can, as well as specific companies and potential partners for you to approach.
What can you earn?
This is a commission-only position with uncapped earnings.
You can earn up to 15% commission on business you generate, with commission payable for up to two years, depending on the service and commercial agreement.
The numbers can become meaningful quickly.
For example, a recent deal worth around £50,000 would have generated approximately £6,000 in initial commission, with further monthly commission after that under the relevant agreement.
That's one client.
Build a portfolio of good accounts and you're building recurring income rather than starting from zero every month.

  • Uncapped earnings
  • Fully remote working

  • Technical people available for client meetings
  • Proposal and pricing support
  • Demonstrations and solution design
  • Marketing and sales material
  • Warm leads where available
  • Accounts and opportunities where available
  • Lists of potential introducers and partners to target

  • Product and sales training

This will suit someone who has spent a few years in commercial finance and has built up a genuine network.

  • Broker Development Manager
  • Relationship Director
  • Account Manager
  • Commercial Finance Broker

It could suit someone who is consulting, building a portfolio career, between senior roles or simply wants to make more from the network they’ve spent years building.

jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer - Swift, Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding
jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

jobs.title: Security Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren.
jobs.description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Hilf dabei, Shopware-Produkte sicherer zu machen, indem du während der gesamten Produktentwicklung Sicherheitsrisiken aufdeckst und reduzierst. Du arbeitest mit den Produktentwicklungsteams daran, Schwachstellen zu untersuchen, sichere Konzepte und Tests zu verbessern und praxisnahe Maßnahmen aufzubauen, die wiederkehrende Probleme in Commerce Core, Services und angrenzenden Produktbereichen verhindern.

Product Security Engineering ist eine Engineering-Funktion. Die Produktteams bleiben dafür verantwortlich, ihren eigenen Code zu korrigieren und zu testen. Dieses Team bringt gezielte Sicherheitsexpertise, eine gemeinsame Roadmap zur Prävention und eine klare Koordination für produktübergreifende Sicherheitsarbeit ein.

Requirements

  • Untersuche Schwachstellenmeldungen, Sicherheitswarnungen, interne Findings und Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen. Bewerte die technischen Auswirkungen und unterstütze dabei, bestätigte Aufgaben an die zuständigen Product Owner weiterzuleiten.

  • Arbeite direkt mit Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern an sicherem Design, Threat Models, Code Reviews, Ursachenanalysen, Fixes und Regressionstests für besonders risikoreiche Produktbereiche.

  • Entwickle und verbessere wiederverwendbare Sicherheitskontrollen, Leitfäden für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler, Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien und praxisnahe Automatisierung zur Erkennung und Behebung von Schwachstellen.

  • Unterstütze dabei, für Product-Security-Findings klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Schweregrade, Reaktionsziele, betroffene Versionen und Nachweise zum Abschluss festzuhalten.

  • Arbeite mit den Engineering-Teams von Commerce Core und Services an Sicherheitsaufgaben über verschiedene Repositories, unterstützte Versionen, APIs, Integrationen und das Extension-Ökosystem hinweg.

  • Unterstütze koordinierte Sicherheits-Releases: Ermittle betroffene Bereiche, prüfe technische Behebungen und stimme dich mit Engineering, Product Operations, Quality, InfoSec und DevRel ab.

  • Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases in konkrete Änderungen am Engineering, Tests oder Tools. Verfolge anschließend nach, ob diese Maßnahmen übernommen werden.

  • Kommuniziere bei zeitkritischen Aufgaben klar und dokumentiere Entscheidungen in den vereinbarten GitHub- und Confluence-Einträgen, damit Teams den Status nicht aus Slack-Verläufen rekonstruieren müssen.

  • Wirke an gemeinsamen Teampraktiken mit und vertrete bei Bedarf den anderen Produktbereich.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und Interesse an Produkt- oder Anwendungssicherheit.

  • Praktische Kenntnisse typischer Risiken in der Anwendungssicherheit, etwa Schwachstellen bei Authentifizierung und Autorisierung, Zugriffskontrolle, Datentrennung, API-Sicherheit, Umgang mit Zugangsdaten, Injection und Abhängigkeiten.

  • Die Fähigkeit, produktiven Code und Tests zu lesen und zu ändern, Risiken für Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler verständlich zu erklären und wartbare Fixes mit umzusetzen.

  • Erfahrung mit Threat Modeling, Sicherheitstests, Schwachstellenanalysen oder Secure Code Reviews; in einigen Bereichen bringst du fundiertes Wissen mit, in anderen möchtest du dich weiterentwickeln.

  • Gutes Urteilsvermögen bei der Einschätzung von Schweregrad, Auswirkungen auf Kundinnen und Kunden und Ausnutzbarkeit sowie bei der Frage, wann ein Problem sofort eskaliert werden muss.

  • Klare schriftliche Kommunikation und die Fähigkeit, bei unklaren oder dringenden Aufgaben teamübergreifend zusammenzuarbeiten.

  • Kenntnisse von PHP sowie mit Shopwares Produkten, Services oder dem Extension-Ökosystem sind hilfreich.

  • Erfahrung mit Sicherheitsautomatisierung, etwa Dependency Scanning, SAST, Fuzzing oder Tests für Missbrauchsszenarien, ist ein Plus.

Woran du deinen Erfolg erkennst:

  • Findings werden einheitlich bewertet, schnell an die zuständigen Verantwortlichen weitergeleitet und mit einem sichtbaren Reaktionsziel und Abschlussnachweis versehen.

  • Produktteams erhalten zeitnah praxisnahe Unterstützung bei Sicherheitsthemen und behalten zugleich die Verantwortung für die Umsetzung.

  • Sicherheitsprüfungen und Tests erkennen relevante Risiken vor dem Release. Wo sinnvoll, enthalten Fixes passende Regressionstests.

  • Aus Nacharbeiten zu Sicherheitsvorfällen und Releases entstehen konkrete, verantwortete Präventionsmaßnahmen statt ausschließlich einmaliger Patches.

  • Umfang von Sicherheits-Releases, betroffene Versionen, technische Verantwortliche und Validierungsbedarf sind für Engineering, Product Operations, Quality, InfoSec und DevRel klar dokumentiert.

  • Im primären Produktbereich des Engineers wächst die Sicherheitsexpertise. Gleichzeitig teilt das Team Standards und unterstützt sich bei Bedarf über Produktgrenzen hinweg.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!

Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Josephine Scheffler und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

Der Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten hat für uns oberste Priorität. Unsere Bewerberinformationen findest du hier.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager
jobs.excerpt: About HarperHarper is one runtime for any workload.
jobs.description:
About Harper

Harper is one runtime for any workload. We combine database, cache, application logic, real-time messaging, and APIs into a single process, so enterprise teams can retire a stack of point solutions and serve data in about a millisecond. Brands like Macy's, Ralph Lauren, Verizon, HP, Ford and Bass Pro Shops run on Harper, and we sell and deliver alongside partners including Akamai.

The role

You own retention and growth across a focused book of Harper’s most strategic enterprise accounts, with revenue targets tied to renewals and expansion. Strong relationships on the customer side and inside Harper mean you’re the first to know when something isn’t going to plan, and your project management discipline gets it back on track.

This is not a technical support role. Harper’s engineers, forward-deployed engineers, and partner support teams own the technical work. You orchestrate them: route each ask through the right process, bring in the right people before the customer has to ask, and make sure nothing falls between the customer, Harper, and our partners. You’ll need enough product fluency to match Harper’s capabilities to a customer’s business needs and to recognize when an issue needs engineering.

The best person for this seat has grown large, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts and has the renewal and expansion numbers to show for it. You’re a highly organized operator who takes personal ownership of outcomes. You write a clear weekly update without being asked, you prepare a day ahead rather than an hour ahead, and you spot the next expansion opportunity before the customer’s team does.

What you'll do

Own the account

  • Be the single accountable owner for some of our most strategic enterprise accounts, from day-to-day status through renewal and expansion, partnering with Sales leadership on pricing and approvals.
  • Know each account cold and keep a written plan for it: history, champions, what was piloted and promised, open commitments, risks, renewal date, and expansion opportunities.
  • Keep a finger on the pulse of every live implementation. Track adoption and usage, and make sure customers get full value from Harper so it never becomes shelfware.
  • Stay relevant as customer priorities shift. Know their roadmap, connect Harper to their new initiatives, and advocate for what’s right for their architecture.

Run the work like a project manager

  • Run active customer initiatives (pilots, upgrades, migrations, rollouts) with a clear plan, owners, and dates, and track every open item to closure. When a follow-up is owed, it goes out within one business day.
  • Flag risk early and loudly. If a deal, pilot, or deliverable is stalled on the customer, a partner, or Harper, you say so in the right channel and keep pushing until it moves.
  • Keep a steady operating rhythm: agendas sent ahead of every customer and internal sync, notes and action items sent the same day, and a Monday plan and Friday wrap-up to the team each week.

Manage relationships across three sides

  • Build multi-threaded relationships with champions, executives, procurement, and project leads at each customer, and navigate reorgs and leadership changes so every account always has an active champion and executive sponsor.
  • Partner with our channel partners' account teams as true co-owners. Keep them informed on scope, services, and billing, and build the relationship before you need it.
  • Coordinate commercial items such as professional services scopes, SOWs, and contracts, so work is never delivered without paper.

Orchestrate Harper's internal team

  • Route technical questions through the established support and escalation paths, and bring the right Harper experts into customer conversations, brief them in advance, and own the follow-up afterward.
  • Write customer-facing documents (responses, recaps, QBR decks, and proposals) that are accurate, complete, and reviewed before they go out.
  • Bring customer feedback, references, and case studies back to Product and Marketing.

What you'll bring

Must-haves

  • 6+ years managing enterprise accounts in B2B software with Fortune 500 customers, multiple stakeholders per account, and a track record of negotiating renewals and expansions against a quota.
  • Real project management experience: you have run customer rollouts, pilots, or implementations with plans, owners, dates and status reporting.
  • Experience working with or through channel partners, resellers, or alliance partners on shared accounts.
  • Excellent communication skills. Your recaps, updates, and customer documents are clear, accurate and ready to send.
  • You can connect a customer’s goals to the right product capabilities and spot expansion opportunities from their technical roadmap.
  • Fluency with a CRM and a project tracker (for example, HubSpot or Salesforce, and Asana).
  • Experience at a startup or small team, where you built the process instead of waiting for one.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with data infrastructure, CDN, cloud or developer platforms.
  • Accounts in retail, e-commerce, media or telecom.
  • Experience scoping and contracting professional services or SOWs.
  • A PMP, CSM or similar project management credential.
  • Experience with Harper

This role is not for you if

  • You prefer hunting new logos over growing within existing customers.
  • You need a manager to remind you about follow-ups or deadlines.
  • You would rather escalate a problem than own it.
  • You prefer a slower-paced environment where the day-to-day is predictable. Here, priorities shift with customer needs, and you’ll be juggling several accounts and initiatives at once.

Compensation and benefits

  • Base salary: $125,000–$145,000, depending on experience
    On-target earnings: $250,000 at 100% of plan
    Commission: uncapped, with accelerators above quota
  • Equity, health benefits and a 401(k).
  • Fully remote, with occasional travel to customer sites and team meetups.

Interview process

  1. 30-minute screen with People Operations.
  2. 45-minute conversation with the hiring manager.
  3. 60-minute working session: you get a mock account brief and present a 30-day plan, a risk log and a customer follow-up email.
  4. 45-minute panel with an engineer and a partner-facing teammate.
  5. 30-minute conversation with Harper leadership.

What success looks like

By 90 days, every account you own has a current written plan, a known renewal path and no surprises.

Timeframe

Outcome

30 days

Met every key stakeholder at each account and partner. Written history and stakeholder map for each account. Weekly Monday/Friday updates running.

60 days

Account plan and open-items tracker live for every account. Running the recurring customer syncs yourself. Every in-flight services engagement has signed paper or a dated path to it.

90 days

Leading at least one active customer initiative to its milestones. Partner account teams engaged on every shared account. One expansion opportunity qualified and in the pipeline.

12 months

Renewals closed on time. Expansion bookings against the agreed target. At least one customer reference or case study delivered to Marketing.

How we'll measure it

  • Gross and net revenue retention on your book
  • Expansion bookings against target
  • Follow-ups and weekly updates sent on time
  • Risks flagged before they slip a date, not after
  • Feedback from the customer, partner reps and Harper engineering on how easy you are to work with
Salary: $125,000 – $145,000 / year

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote (EMEA region)Reports to: Senior Product ManagerTravel: Quarterly travel to Frankfurt or Hamburg, Germany About Stonebranch:Stonebranch builds IT orchestration and automation solutions that transform business IT environments from simple IT task automation into sophisticated, real-time business service orchestration.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote (EMEA region)

Reports to: Senior Product Manager

Travel: Quarterly travel to Frankfurt or Hamburg, Germany

About Stonebranch:

Stonebranch builds IT orchestration and automation solutions that transform business IT environments from simple IT task automation into sophisticated, real-time business service orchestration. No matter the degree of automation, the Stonebranch platform is simple, modern, and secure. Using Stonebranch Universal Automation Center (UAC), enterprises can seamlessly orchestrate workloads and data across hybrid IT environments. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with points of contact and support throughout the Americas, Europe, and Asia, Stonebranch serves some of the world’s largest financial, manufacturing, healthcare, travel, transportation, energy, and technology institutions.

Your Part in this Growth Story:

Stonebranch is searching for an ABAP Technical Lead to own the technical direction of BatchMan, our SAP-native workload automation product. We want someone who takes full accountability for a business-critical codebase and moves it forward without waiting to be told what to build next. BatchMan runs inside SAP as an add-on. It extends SAP's native job scheduling into landscape-wide workload automation for more than 160 customers, ranging from long-established SAP enterprises to early technology adopters. The architecture decisions you make will shape how the product performs, evolves, and serves those customers for years to come.

This is a role built for where engineering is heading. We are transforming BatchMan development to an AI-first, specification-driven approach, and you'll lead that transformation. Using Claude Code as your primary AI agent, you'll write the technical specifications that drive development, then direct and verify AI-generated code with the senior judgment to catch what the AI gets wrong. That leaves your deepest focus for architecture and the hard technical decisions. On a codebase with more than 15 years of history, that judgment matters most. Knowing where classic ABAP and modern ABAP differ, and where the critical details hide, is what makes AI a force multiplier rather than a risk.

You'll join a small, focused team made up of an experienced fellow developer, AI agents, and the Senior Product Manager who owns the product. This is an individual contributor role with no people-management responsibilities. You will, however, make the high-level architecture decisions for BatchMan and set the engineering standards the codebase is built against. You'll also be the escalation point for our Customer Support team on complex technical issues, and you'll work directly with customers when an escalation calls for it. Because our customer base is largely German-speaking, business-fluent German is required.

Deep, hands-on ABAP expertise is essential. That includes experience building or maintaining a commercially shipped SAP add-on, not only customer-specific extensions. What sets you apart is ownership: the drive to make this product yours and keep it strong over the long term.

This is a remote position open to candidates based anywhere in EMEA, with a preference for candidates located near a Stonebranch office. Quarterly travel to our EMEA headquarters in Frankfurt, Germany or our Honico office in Hamburg, Germany is required. This role reports directly to the Senior Product Manager.

Your Impact on the Organization:

Technical Ownership & Architecture

  • Own the technical architecture of BatchMan and make the high-level design decisions that set the product's direction within the SAP landscape
  • Establish and maintain the engineering standards, coding conventions, and best practices that the BatchMan codebase is built against
  • Maintain and modernize a codebase that spans classic ABAP4, ABAP OO, and Java-based agent components, keeping it stable for existing customers while the product continues to evolve
  • Translate product requirements into sound technical solutions, balancing speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

AI-First Development & Code Quality

  • Lead the transformation of BatchMan's development pipeline to an AI-first approach, with Claude Code as the primary AI agent
  • Write clear, detailed technical specifications that serve as the foundation for AI-driven development
  • Direct, review, and verify AI-generated ABAP and Java code, applying senior judgment to catch errors, enforce standards, and protect architectural integrity
  • Build the documentation, context, and conventions that let AI agents work effectively and safely within a mature SAP codebase
  • Take part in peer code review to hold the codebase to a consistent quality bar

Product Development & Performance

  • Design and build new capabilities that extend SAP background processing and job scheduling into landscape-wide workload automation
  • Develop and maintain integrations through XBP/XMI, RFC, and web technologies (OData, REST) that connect BatchMan to the broader automation landscape
  • Optimize performance for high-volume job processing and large data volumes, including SQL tuning
  • Package and deliver releases through the SAP Transport System and Add-On Assembly Kit (AAK), so installations and upgrades run reliably across customer SAP environments

Customer Escalation & Collaboration

  • Serve as the technical escalation point for Customer Support, diagnosing and resolving complex issues beyond their scope
  • Engage directly with customers, in German or English, when an escalation requires hands-on technical involvement
  • Partner with the Senior Product Manager on roadmap feasibility, effort estimates, and technical trade-offs, and communicate technical direction clearly to both technical and business stakeholders
  • Collaborate closely with the team's other developer and share knowledge so that critical product expertise is not held by a single person

What You Will Bring to the Team:

Education and Experience

  • Degree in computer science or a related field, or completed vocational IT training (e.g., Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung) with equivalent professional experience
  • 10+ years of professional experience in software development
  • 8+ years of hands-on ABAP development experience, including substantial work in classic procedural ABAP (ABAP4)
  • Proven experience building or maintaining a commercially shipped SAP add-on or product, not solely customer-specific extensions or module customizations
  • Track record of owning a technical area and making the architecture decisions that shape it

Technical Skills

  • Expert-level command of ABAP4 and ABAP OO, including Dynpro UI, ALV, and the SAP Control Framework
  • Deep knowledge of SAP background processing and job scheduling:
    • SM36/SM37 for job definition and monitoring
    • SM50/SM66 for active work process analysis
    • ST22 for dump analysis on failed job steps
  • Hands-on experience with the XBP (External Batch Processing) and XMI interfaces
  • RFC programming and debugging, including configuring RFC connections in SM59
  • Strong understanding of core ABAP concepts, including authorization objects, lock objects, and LUWs
  • SQL optimization for large data volumes
  • Working knowledge of the SAP Transport System
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) and a strong interest in building an AI-first, specification-driven development workflow; experience writing specifications that drive AI-generated code is a strong plus
  • This is a hands-on technical role: day-to-day work combines writing specifications, directing AI agents, and reviewing and verifying code, with direct ABAP development where it's needed

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience packaging and delivering add-ons with the SAP Add-On Assembly Kit (AAK)
  • Java development experience, particularly with agent- or service-based architectures, including:
    • File I/O and protocols such as SFTP and SSH
    • JKS keystore management and TLS/SSL configuration
    • Reading and debugging multithreaded Java service code (Windows service / Linux daemon)
  • Experience with web technologies and data formats, including OData, REST, XML, and JSON
  • SAP Basis knowledge, including authorization configuration
  • Background with workload automation or enterprise job scheduling products

Ownership & Collaboration

  • Strong architectural thinking, with the judgment to make sound technical decisions and the accountability to own the outcomes
  • A driver's mindset: self-directed, proactive, and able to move a product forward without handholding
  • A methodical troubleshooter, able to diagnose complex issues in customer SAP environments and bring them to resolution
  • Ability to understand business needs and translate them into technical solutions
  • Effective written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical direction and trade-offs to colleagues, customers, and non-technical stakeholders
  • A collaborative team player, comfortable working in a small, focused, international team
  • Business-fluent German (C1 minimum) and fluent English (C1 minimum), both written and verbal, are required. German is the team's primary working language, including code documentation, technical discussions, and customer support cases

Why You’ll Love Stonebranch:

At Stonebranch, you’ll be part of a team that’s passionate about innovation, collaboration, and making an impact in the world of IT automation. We believe great work starts with a great workplace – one that values people, supports growth, and celebrates success.

  • Collaborative Culture: Join an international team of experienced, high-performing professionals who value teamwork, knowledge sharing, and mutual success.
  • Growth & Development: Take advantage of continuous learning opportunities and professional development to advance your career.
  • Work-Life Balance & Flexibility: Benefit from a flexible work environment with hybrid or remote options, designed to support balance and productivity.
  • Impact & Innovation: Be part of a high-growth company at the forefront of IT automation, where your contributions directly influence customer success and business outcomes.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Receive a competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with local market standards and employment regulations.
  • Community & Connection: Participate in regular team and company events that foster connection and a strong sense of belonging.

jobs.excerpt: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations.
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:
You will own the IP and optical architecture for CrowdStrike's global backbone, including connectivity to traditional and neocloud providers. You'll set the multi-year roadmap governing its evolution, including traffic engineering strategy, capacity planning, and demand forecasting for the network as a whole. You'll drive the initiatives that matter most to the business, from funding case through implementation and long-term operational stewardship, and act as the senior escalation resource in the 24x7 on-call rotation when an incident exceeds the depth of the engineers already on it.

What You'll Do:

You'll own platform selection for routing and optical hardware, working directly with vendor engineering teams to influence their roadmaps, and engage director- and VP-level stakeholders across datacenter, application, and business teams to keep network strategy ahead of the company's growth. You'll set the direction for network automation and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD, GitOps), and for telemetry and analytics strategy, increasingly including frontier and open-weight AI models for tasks like telemetry analysis and automated triage, with sensitive backbone data kept in-house. Part of the role is raising the technical bar of the organization: reviewing senior engineers' designs, setting the standards they build against, and mentoring them toward this level.

What You'll Need:

  • US Citizenship or Green Card holder status
  • 12+ years designing, building, and operating large-scale backbone networks, with ownership of architecture at global scale
  • Deep expertise in IP/MPLS core technologies: IS-IS, MP-BGP, segment
  • routing (SR-MPLS/SRv6), PE/P architectures, MPLS-TE, VRFs, DDoS mitigation, CDN
  • Deep expertise in optical transport: DWDM, coherent optics (400G/800G), ROADM architectures, amplifier design (EDFA/Raman), dispersion management, alien wavelengths
  • Strong grounding in cloud networking: direct connectivity, multi-cloud routing, and hybrid cloud at scale across major hyperscalers (AWS, GCP, OCI, Azure) and neoclouds (e.g., CoreWeave, Cerebras)
  • Working depth in adjacent infrastructure domains (virtualization, containers, databases, message queuing, large-scale provisioning) sufficient to architect across boundaries
  • Proven ability to set, not just execute, network automation and IaC strategy
  • Familiarity with applying frontier and open-weight AI models to network operations (e.g., telemetry analysis, automated triage, ChatOps tooling), including self-hosting open-weight models where data sensitivity requires it
  • Experience operating or architecting networks within FedRAMP-authorized environments
  • Track record of selecting, testing, and deploying networking hardware and software organization-wide, across major vendors (Juniper, Infinera, Nokia, Arista, Cisco, etc.)
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Large Claims Specialist
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Analyst with deep expertise in hospital claims adjudication, stop loss reporting, high-cost/catastrophic claims, and DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) reimbursement methodology.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Claims Analyst with deep expertise in hospital claims adjudication, stop loss reporting, high-cost/catastrophic claims, and DRG (Diagnosis-Related Group) reimbursement methodology. This individual will analyze itemized hospital bills and claims data to identify billing errors, coding discrepancies, DRG misassignments, and other overpayment opportunities, then work directly with claims administrators on behalf of our ASO clients to secure claim adjustments, recoveries, and repricing.

This is a highly analytical, client-facing role requiring both technical claims expertise and strong negotiation/communication skills.

This is a remote role.

Key Responsibilities

Claims Analysis & Review

  • Perform detailed audits of hospital and facility claims, including itemized bills, UB-04 claim forms, medical records, and remittance advices, to validate billing accuracy.

  • Analyze DRG assignments and coding to identify DRG upcoding, unbundling, duplicate billing, and other irregularities that affect reimbursement.

  • Review high-cost and catastrophic claims (typically $100K+) to identify overpayments, contract misapplication, and opportunities for negotiated adjustments.

  • Evaluate claims against plan documents, provider contracts, reference-based pricing methodologies, and CMS guidelines to determine appropriate reimbursement.

Stop Loss & High-Cost Claims Expertise

  • Understand and apply stop loss (specific and aggregate) provisions, laser terms, and reporting requirements as they relate to claim adjustments and client financial exposure.

  • Coordinate with stop loss carriers and reinsurers as needed to ensure adjustments and recoveries are properly reflected in stop loss reimbursement calculations.

  • Identify claims nearing or exceeding specific deductible thresholds and prioritize review accordingly.

Client Advocacy & Claims Administrator Negotiation

  • Serve as the subject matter expert and advocate on behalf of ASO clients in disputes with claims administrators (TPAs) and carriers regarding claim payment accuracy.

  • Prepare clear, well-documented findings packages (clinical, contractual, and coding rationale) to support requested claim adjustments and appeals.

  • Lead or support negotiations with claims administrators to reach adjusted payment resolutions.

  • Track disputes through resolution, escalating unresolved cases appropriately and maintaining strong working relationships with TPA claims and provider relations teams.

Data & Reporting

  • Analyze large claims data sets to identify trends, outlier claims, and systemic overpayment patterns across client populations.

  • Build and maintain claim tracking logs, savings reports, and client-facing summaries of identified and recovered savings.

  • Partner with internal data/analytics teams to refine claim-flagging logic and improve identification of high-value review opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • Hospital/Surgical/ICU Nursing background (RN) and clinical coding background for clinical validation of DRG and medical necessity issues.

  • 5+ years of experience in hospital claims analysis, medical bill review, claims auditing, or payment integrity, with direct exposure to self-funded/ASO plans.

  • Strong working knowledge of DRG methodology (MS-DRG/APR-DRG), UB-04 billing, ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT/HCPCS coding, and hospital chargemaster structures.

  • Demonstrated understanding of stop loss insurance, including specific/aggregate deductibles, laser provisions, and how claim adjustments impact stop loss reimbursement.

  • Experience analyzing high-cost/catastrophic claims and identifying overpayment or billing error patterns.

  • Prior experience interacting with or negotiating against TPAs, insurance carriers, or claims administrators on disputed claims.

  • Proficiency with claims data analysis tools (Excel required; SQL, Access, or claims analytics platforms a plus)

  • Knowledge of policy terms, coverage guidelines, statutory/regulatory compliance requirements and litigation/dispute workflows.

  • Ability to interpret and translate in common terms legal contracts, summary plan descriptions (SPDs), and statutory guidelines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build persuasive, well-supported adjustment requests and appeals.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage a high volume of complex claims simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Medical Bill Review Specialist, or similar credential.

  • Prior experience at a TPA, insurance carrier, hospital billing/coding department, or payment integrity/cost containment vendor.

  • Familiarity with reference-based pricing (RBP), Medicare fee schedules, and out-of-network claims repricing.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent identification of material overpayments and billing errors on high-cost hospital claims.

  • Strong track record of securing favorable claim adjustments through negotiation with claims administrators.

  • Clear, professional communication that strengthens client trust and TPA relationships.

  • Measurable contribution to client savings and stop loss cost containment.
