About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the Role

Reports to the Operations Principal, Change. The Strategic Operations team sits between Product, Technology, and Claims Operations and owns the work that turns a new way of working into one the organization actually runs on.

Not every change at Reserv arrives with a product release behind it. Programs change, client requirements change, and the way a claim is handled changes with them. We are hiring an Operations Lead to own process design and change across claims operations, so that how work is done is written down, current, and changed deliberately.

You own the process side of the function: before-and-after process design for each change, the SOP library and how it is governed, verification that changes landed in practice, and the training and communications for process changes. You will work alongside the Operations Lead who owns product change, since most product releases also change a process, and with claims leadership, who own the work you are documenting. You will be an excellent fit if you have redesigned how an operations team works, can write a process someone will follow, and verify that changes landed in practice.

Duties & Responsibilities

Process Design: Lead the before-and-after process design for each change, product-driven or not, working with leaders, managers, and team leads on what actually shifts in their day. Write the end-to-end process so it can be followed without further explanation, and pressure-test it with the people who will run it before it goes live.

SOP Ownership and Governance: Own the SOP library across lines of business and account variants: its structure, its currency, and its governance. Draft the standard language for each change, drive it into every affected SOP through the SOP owners against a date, and build the auditability that shows who changed what and when. Partner with the Principal on the platform and workflow the library should run on.

Change Readiness for Process Changes: Run process changes against the readiness standard: documented process, approved change plan, training and communications plan, onboarding updated, and metrics defined. Assemble the evidence for sign-off and flag gaps early.

Training, Enablement, and Communications: Build and execute the training and communications for process changes for leaders, managers, and frontline teams, and coordinate with Learning & Development so new-hire onboarding teaches the current process.

Verification and Feedback: Go back after each change and verify it landed in practice, through SOP checks, time studies, and conversations with the teams doing the work. Carry what you find back to the Principal and to claims leadership, and feed it into how the next change is designed.

Metric and Data Management: This person will be responsible for continually tracking metrics to determine success and make data-driven changes to rollouts

Requirements

  • 1-3+ years in management consulting, operational transformation, operations management, or a similar role where you redesigned how a team works and documented it.
  • Proven ability to write process documentation that people follow: SOPs, process guides, and before-and-after write-ups for operational change.
  • Experience running cross-functional change against dates, with verification that it landed.
  • Detail-oriented and organized, with comfort maintaining a structured record of changes, decisions, and history over time.
  • Working fluency with business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) to read what the numbers say about whether a process is being followed.
  • Active use of AI tools in your own work, and interest in applying them to process documentation and change.
  • Claims or insurance experience is helpful here and is not required.
  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications).

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Flexigrant is one of the specialist software businesses within a portfolio of Fluent Software Group, which is an operating group under Valsoft Corporation, an acquirer of specialist vertical-market software businesses with a long-term, buy-and-hold approach.

Flexigrant is cloud-based grant management software built for organisations that award funding, from community foundations to central government. It replaces spreadsheets and email with a single system covering applications, eligibility, assessment, awards, monitoring, and reporting, with a full audit trail throughout.

The platform replaces disconnected spreadsheets, emails and paper-based processes with one secure, configurable system, giving grant managers a complete and up-to-date view of every programme, application and award. Flexigrant also creates a clear audit trail of actions and decisions, helping organisations maintain transparency and meet their governance and reporting responsibilities.

Trusted by more than 100 organisations worldwide, the platform supports grant programmes of varying sizes and complexity. In the last 12 months alone, more than £6.4 billion in new grant funding was awarded through Flexigrant, demonstrating the important role its technology plays in helping funding reach research, communities and worthwhile causes efficiently.

The Role

As QA Analyst, you will own the quality of what we ship. You will plan and run testing across Flexigrant, from exploratory, functional and regression testing through to building automated tests, working closely with our developers and Product Manager to catch issues early.

This is a hands-on role for a fast learner who enjoys getting to know a complex product in depth. Much of that product knowledge is built on the job, alongside the development team, so a real appetite to learn is essential.

It is also an AI-native role. You will use AI tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot every day to plan, create and maintain tests, grow our automation and help build quality in as Flexigrant modernises. AI fluency will be explored at interview, so be ready to show how you work.

We are remote-first: you will work with colleagues across locations and are trusted to work wherever you are based.

Key Responsibilities

  • You will plan, design and run manual testing across Flexigrant, including exploratory, functional, regression and edge-case testing.
  • You will build and maintain automated tests and help grow our automated test coverage.
  • You will work with developers and the Product Manager to refine requirements and turn them into clear, testable acceptance criteria.
  • You will reproduce and document issues clearly, giving developers concise, actionable feedback so they can resolve them quickly.
  • You will carry out API testing and use SQL to validate data and investigate issues.
  • You will support releases each sprint, balancing planned testing with reactive support, and take part in refinement, sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
  • You will use AI tooling as a core part of your daily workflow to improve testing processes and speed up delivery.
  • You will share product knowledge across the team and help improve our QA processes and practices.

Key Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

  • 4+ years in a software QA or testing role, ideally within an Agile team.
  • Strong manual testing skills (exploratory, functional, regression and edge-case), including web applications across devices and browsers.
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as Selenium or Cypress.
  • API testing experience (for example Postman) and working knowledge of SQL for data validation.
  • The ability to turn requirements from meetings and conversations into test cases and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Experience with version control and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot, with the judgement to prompt, steer and critically review their output.
  • Excellent attention to detail and time management, with the ability to prioritise several test items at once.
  • A collaborative, patient communicator who builds trusted relationships with developers and product colleagues.
  • Interest or experience in AI-assisted and agentic testing workflows (desirable).
  • ISTQB Foundation (CTFL) or BCS Foundation Certificate in Software Testing, or a further ISTQB, test automation, API testing or Agile certification (desirable).
  • Familiarity with accessibility testing and WCAG (desirable).

No degree or formal qualification is required. Demonstrable QA experience matters most.

The Organisation

Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child but know this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And it is girls who are most affected.

Working together with children, young people, supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges girls and vulnerable children face. We support children’s rights from birth until they reach adulthood and we enable children to prepare for and respond to crises and adversity. We drive changes in practice and policy at local, national and global levels using our reach, experience and knowledge.

For over 85 years, we have rallied other determined optimists to transform the lives of all children in more than 80 countries.

We won’t stop until we are all equal.

Plan International’s Child Protection in Humanitarian Action (CPHA) Roster

As Plan International scales up its humanitarian impact, we are committed to becoming a leading global organisation for girls affected by crisis and disaster. Our humanitarian roster plays a critical role in delivering this ambition and we are seeking to further strengthen our roster of experienced Humanitarian Child Protection specialists who can be deployed globally to support humanitarian responses, typically for deployments lasting between two and six months.

Successful applicants will be added to our roster for Child Protection in Humanitarian Action and contacted for deployment opportunities as they arise. Whilst being a member of the roster is not paid, once you are deployed you will receive a salary as well as per diem, accommodation and travel insurance.

We maintain a close relationship with our Roster Members through regular engagement and access to online humanitarian learning, ensuring they benefit from being part of the roster both when deployed and when not deployed.

About You

The Child Protection in Emergencies specialist provides oversight and leadership to Plan International's child protection response in a specific crisis. You will be responsible for assessment, response analysis, design, coordination, capacity strengthening, implementation and monitoring and evaluation of child protection in emergency programmes as part of our broader emergency response. You will ensure that gender equality is core to our child protection in emergencies response and that our intervention meets the child protection and gender-based violence minimum standards.

Successful applicants require:

  • Solid work experience in international humanitarian settings with progressively responsible roles in designing, leading and/or coordinating Child Protection in Humanitarian Action programme responses.
  • Expertise in working with child survivors of sexual and gender based violence (SGBV).
  • Alongside proficiency in English, we require that you can comfortably work in Spanish to be considered for the roster at this time.
  • Commitment to ensuring safeguarding and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment. (PSEAH) is core to our ways of working.

Closing Date: Saturday 31st October

Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the very heart of everything that Plan International stands for.

We want Plan International to reflect the diversity of the communities we work with, offering equal opportunities to everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

Plan International is based on a culture of inclusivity and we strive to create a workplace environment that ensures every team, in every office, in every country, is rich in diverse people, thoughts, and ideas.

We foster an organisational culture that embraces our commitment to racial justice, gender equality, girls’ rights and inclusion.

Plan International believes that in a world where children face so many threats of harm, it is our duty to ensure that we, as an organisation, do everything we can to keep children safe. This means that we have particular responsibilities to children that we come into contact with and we must not contribute in any way to harming or placing children at risk.

Senior Azure Architect – MIM Modernization & Microsoft Entra ID

Industry: IT Services
Salary: ₹₹24 LPA
Experience: 10+ years

Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Azure Architect to lead the strategic modernization of our Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM) infrastructure and drive the adoption of Microsoft Entra ID. In this pivotal role, you will design and implement robust, scalable identity solutions that enhance security and operational efficiency across our cloud ecosystem. This position demands a deep understanding of hybrid identity environments, where you will bridge legacy systems with modern cloud-native architectures. Your expertise will be instrumental in orchestrating complex migrations, automating identity workflows, and ensuring seamless integration between on-premises directories and cloud services, ultimately securing our digital perimeter while enabling a frictionless user experience.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and execute the modernization roadmap for Microsoft Identity Manager, transitioning from legacy on-premises models to cloud-centric identity frameworks.
  • Design and deploy secure identity synchronization solutions utilizing Entra Connect and Entra Cloud Sync to maintain data consistency across hybrid environments.
  • Develop and manage serverless automation workflows using Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Azure Automation to streamline identity lifecycle processes.
  • Engineer custom integrations and extensions leveraging Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, and JSON protocols to enable advanced application connectivity.
  • Maintain and optimize hybrid directory services, including Active Directory, AD LDS, and Exchange Online, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Implement robust security postures by configuring Azure Key Vault for secret management and utilizing Azure Monitor and Microsoft Sentinel for proactive threat detection and response.
  • Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) initiatives using Bicep, ARM templates, and Terraform to ensure reproducible, version-controlled infrastructure deployments.
  • Create and maintain complex PowerShell scripts for Entra ID administration, enabling sophisticated automation and governance capabilities.
  • Provide architectural guidance on Azure infrastructure design to support identity and access management (IAM) requirements.

Requirements

Requirements:
  • Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in IT services, with a significant focus on Azure cloud architecture and identity management.
  • Proven expertise in Microsoft Entra Connect and Entra Cloud Sync configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Advanced proficiency in developing and managing Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Azure Automation runbooks.
  • Strong command of Microsoft Graph API, RESTful web services, and JSON data handling for custom integrations.
  • Deep knowledge of Active Directory ecosystems, including AD LDS and Exchange Online administration.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, and Microsoft Sentinel for security and observability.
  • Demonstrated ability to implement Infrastructure as Code using Bicep, ARM, or Terraform.
  • Specialized experience in Microsoft Identity Manager (MIM), including scripting, customization, and modernization strategies.
  • Extensive background in PowerShell scripting specifically for Microsoft Entra ID automation and management.
  • Comprehensive understanding of Azure Architecture principles and best practices for enterprise-scale deployments.

Job Title:

Sponsored Program Officer

Department:

ERIK | Office of Sponsored Programs Administration

The Sponsored Program Officer (SPO) position serves as the institutional business official and central administrative point of contact for faculty principal investigators (PIs) and department/college administrators on pre- and post-award management of externally funded grants and contracts from federal, for-profit, non-profit, and local agency sponsors.


Sponsored Program Officers are responsible for the following:

  • Pre-Award/Award Negotiation: Advises PIs on submission of proposals to sponsoring agencies. Prepares and/or reviews and approves budgets according to University and sponsor guidelines. Counsels PIs on compliance considerations (e.g. human subjects and animal protocols, conflict of interest, export controls). Ensures proposals conform to request for proposal (RFP), sponsor, and University requirements. Provides institutional approval and ensures successful and timely submission of proposals. Reviews agreements received from external sponsors and negotiates award terms to ensure consistency with University preferred positions and policies.
  • Award Set-up: Accurately enters new award information, including administrative and financial requirements, into grants management system. Communicates award information and grant account number to the PI and administrative staff, highlighting unique terms and requirements. Prepares, issues, and negotiates subaward agreements. Reviews consultant agreements for allowability and completeness.
  • Post Award/Closeout: Provides expenditure approvals and facilitates other post-award matters by troubleshooting, researching and communicating with appropriate stakeholders. Reviews monthly grant account reports to monitor assigned workload for allowable costs, cost share requirements, deficits, and closeout. Coordinates with purchasing and accounts payable to provide expense approvals. Serves as business official and point of contact to sponsor for prior approvals requests. Monitors and coordinates submission of required technical and financial deliverables. Analyzes and resolves problems and discrepancies related to financial compliance or availability of funds.
  • Other duties: Serves on OSP and University committees as appropriate for knowledge level and tenure. Builds relationships with constituents through PI visits and other department/college outreach activities. Relative distribution of duties will vary with constituency assignment.

A successful SPO has the ability to perform the following essential skills and competencies:

  • Balance working autonomously as well as within a team; understand the importance and value in providing exceptional customer service; be comfortable with being flexible and adaptable performing in a high volume and deadline driven environment.
  • Be capable of multi-tasking, problem solving, and possess superior verbal and written communication skills; possess time management ability, follow-through, organizational skills, and attention to detail.
  • Review and negotiate awards/contracts consistent with University preferred positions; create or review budgets using Excel spreadsheets as a tool.
  • Enjoy working in a culture that promotes work/life balance, peer collaboration, autonomy, and supportive leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Two years of administrative experience in a professional business capacity working in information management, compliance with policies and procedures, procurement, accounting, and/or financial management.
  • Two years of customer service and problem-solving experience. Proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.

Desired Qualifications

  • One year or more of experience and knowledge of federal or private agency sponsors, contract/grant regulations, and University policy.
  • Experience with electronic research tools and systems.
  • Demonstrated experience developing budgets and/or analyzing financial data.

Application Materials

  • A resume and cover letter are required to be submitted at the time of application to be considered for this position.

Additional Information:

Salary

The salary range for this position is $58,700-77,000. The offer for this position will fall within this range based on multiple factors including internal equity, unit’s available budget, and the candidate’s qualifications.


Work Location

This position is eligible for remote work within the state of Ohio.


Additional Information

Ohio State will not sponsor applicants for a work visa for this position.


Starting Day One: Comprehensive Benefits

Ohio State benefits give you options to take care of what matters most to you — and opportunities to make adjustments as your life and needs change, including:

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage, with Ohio State paying a significant portion of the cost.
  • Paid time off, including sick and vacation time and 11 holidays.
  • State retirement plan or an alternative retirement plan, both with generous employer contributions.

Enterprise for Research, Innovation and Knowledge Overview

Join the Research Development Office within the Enterprise for Research, Innovation and Knowledge (ERIK) at The Ohio State University and become a part of a dynamic, forward-thinking team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of discovery and innovation. ERIK positions Ohio State to expand curiosity-driven research and creative expression, further develop our research community of faculty, staff, and students, and grow the innovation ecosystem to address big challenges and improve communities locally and globally. We are seeking passionate individuals who are committed to making a meaningful impact through collaboration, innovation, and excellence. To learn more about our mission and work, please visit our ERIK website.


The Office of Sponsored Programs

The Office of Sponsored Programs (OSP), under the auspices of the Office of Research, supports the development, implementation, and coordination of sponsored research at the University from proposal development to project closeout. OSP provides a full range of research administration services to support Ohio State faculty, staff, and graduate students through research administration, responsible stewardship of funds and sound management practices. Please visit the Office of Sponsored Programs website for details.


OSP provides a collaborative, autonomous work environment with a strong emphasis on work/life balance and supportive leadership. Employees are provided several flexible work schedule and location options, including an option for remote work aligned with U.S. Eastern Time Zone. All staff are expected to attend certain periodic in-person work events during the year, regardless of work schedule and location. All employees are provided University-configured equipment and supportive technology tools. Employees will be required to provide reliable internet access and home office furnishings if they opt for part or all of their duties to be undertaken remotely.


To maximize staff success, OSP provides a robust training program including an assigned job coach who provides mentoring and guidance throughout the training period. New Sr. SPOs will be assigned a constituency following the focused training period.

The Data Validation Specialist checks that data entering and moving through our systems is accurate, complete, and consistent. The Data Validation Specialist is responsible for labeling, tagging, categorizing, and reviewing large volumes of structured and unstructured data (text, images, audio, video, or multimodal content) according to detailed project guidelines. This role also validates work completed by other annotators, identifies inconsistencies or errors, and provides feedback to improve annotation quality and guideline clarity. The ideal candidate is meticulous, comfortable with repetitive, detail-oriented work, able to follow complex and evolving instructions precisely, and confident flagging ambiguity rather than guessing. As a flex position, the role scales hours up during peak periods such as new AI model launches and down when volume is lower. Assignments are checked to verify progress, through a reporting mechanism by the Artificial Intelligence Project Manager.

What would you do in this role?

DUTIES AND TASKS, including but not limited to the following:


Seeks minimum guidance on the following tasks:

  • Label, tag, transcribe, segment, or categorize data (text, images, video, audio, or sensor data) according to project-specific style guides and taxonomies.
  • Apply bounding boxes, polygons, keypoints, or segmentation masks to visual data as required by computer vision projects.
  • Maintain consistent labeling speed while meeting or exceeding minimum throughput targets without sacrificing accuracy
  • Review annotations completed by peers or vendor teams for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Identify systematic errors, edge cases, and ambiguous instructions; escalate patterns to team leads or guideline owners.
  • Perform spot-checks and full audits on annotated datasets prior to delivery or model training.
  • Track and report quality metrics (accuracy rate, error rate, agreement rate, throughput) using internal tools or spreadsheets.
  • Re-annotate or correct flagged data points and document rationale for changes.
  • Provide structured feedback on annotation guidelines, identifying gaps, contradictions, or unclear edge cases.
  • Participate in calibration sessions to align understanding of labeling standards across the team.
  • Help pilot new annotation tasks, test draft guidelines on sample data, and report findings before full-scale rollout.
  • Document recurring edge cases and contribute examples to internal knowledge bases or FAQs.
  • Work within annotation platforms to complete assigned tasks.
  • Track task assignments, deadlines, and completion status in project management tools.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and data handling protocols, especially with sensitive, proprietary, or personally identifiable data.
  • Communicate blockers, ambiguous cases, or technical issues promptly to team leads.

QUALIFICATIONS


  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • Demonstrated ability to follow detailed written instructions with a high degree of precision.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistency, especially across repetitive tasks performed over long periods.
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity, and skilled at flagging uncertain cases rather than guessing.
  • Basic computer literacy: comfortable navigating web-based tools, spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets/Microsoft List), and ticketing/task systems.
  • Strong written communication skills for documenting edge cases and providing feedback.
  • Ability to meet productivity and quality targets in a metrics-driven environment.
  • Preferred prior experience in data annotation, content moderation, transcription, quality assurance, proofreading, editing, or a related detail-oriented field.

  • Notice of schedule - At least 1 week ahead where possible
  • Core availability - Some overlap with business hours (8:00am CST – 5:00 pm CST). Occasional evening and weekend hours.

Working conditions

Computer-based work, mostly at a desk.

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityTurnitin is looking for an experienced Enterprise Data Architecture & Governance Lead to help define the future of how we use data to run our business.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Turnitin is looking for an experienced Enterprise Data Architecture & Governance Lead to help define the future of how we use data to run our business.

Over time, our reporting capabilities have evolved across multiple functions including Finance, Revenue Operations, Product, HR and Engineering. Whilst these capabilities provide value locally, they have developed independently, resulting in inconsistent metric definitions, fragmented ownership and varying levels of confidence in enterprise reporting.

This role represents a unique opportunity to shape Turnitin's enterprise data strategy by establishing the foundations for trusted, scalable and decision-ready information.

Working closely with executive stakeholders across the organisation, you will assess our current environment, define a practical target state and provide a roadmap that enables future execution.

What you’ll do

You will:

  • Assess Turnitin's current reporting and analytics landscape;
  • Identify the root causes of fragmented reporting and conflicting metrics;
  • Define ownership and governance principles for critical enterprise data;
  • Develop a high-level target-state architecture for enterprise reporting and analytics;
  • Establish standards for enterprise metric definitions and trusted reporting;
  • Recommend an operating model that balances enterprise consistency with functional autonomy;
  • Produce a practical roadmap for future implementation and investment;
  • Facilitate alignment across executive and business stakeholders.

What success looks like

By the end of the engagement, Turnitin will have:

  • A shared understanding of its current data landscape;
  • Clear ownership of priority enterprise metrics;
  • Improved confidence in Executive and Board reporting;
  • A pragmatic governance framework;
  • A target-state blueprint for enterprise reporting and analytics;
  • A prioritised roadmap for implementation.

What we’re looking for

We're seeking a pragmatic enterprise data leader who is equally comfortable engaging with executives and technical teams.

You'll bring experience in areas such as:

  • Enterprise data architecture and governance;
  • Analytics and reporting governance;
  • Executive and Board reporting environments;
  • Metric definition and stewardship;
  • Cross-functional stakeholder management;
  • Data quality and reporting controls.

Experience in SaaS, subscription businesses or distributed analytics environments would be highly advantageous.

Why join us

This is an opportunity to define how an established global SaaS organisation measures performance and makes decisions.

You won't simply be building dashboards.

You'll help shape the principles, governance and architecture that underpin trusted enterprise insight across the business.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise data governance, architecture, analytics governance, or enterprise reporting controls.
  • Experience operating across Finance, Sales, Revenue Operations, HR, Engineering, Product, and Business Intelligence functions.
  • Strong understanding of data lineage, data quality controls, source-system reconciliation, data transformation processes, and reporting controls.
  • Experience supporting Executive, Board & Investor Reporting.
  • Experience defining governance frameworks, ownership models, and metric standards.
  • Demonstrated experience facilitating cross-functional agreement on enterprise metric definitions and ownership, particularly in environments where multiple functions have independently built reporting capabilities and no shared standard exists.
  • Experience designing operating models for enterprise data functions, including roles and responsibilities, decision rights, escalation mechanisms, governance forums, and resourcing requirements to sustain an ongoing data governance capability.
  • Familiarity with privacy considerations relating to the use of customer and employee data.
  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation, process design, and executive communication skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in SaaS, subscription, EdTech, or other data-intensive technology businesses.
  • Familiarity with sales, bookings, ARR, pipeline, retention, customer, usage, and financial reporting data.
  • Experience working with Salesforce and related GTM data structures.
  • Exposure to ERP, HRIS, and production data environments.
  • Experience supporting reporting used for Board materials, executive reviews, financial planning, or investor reporting.
  • Experience designing governance models in a distributed analytics environment where multiple functions have independently developed reporting capabilities.
  • Management consulting or specialist data advisory background, with experience leading multiple data governance or data strategy engagements across different client organisations.

Total Rewards @ Turnitin
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.

Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.

In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.

Our Mission is to ensure the integrity of global education and meaningfully improve learning outcomes.

Our Values underpin everything we do.

  • Customer Centric: Our mission is focused on improving learning outcomes; we do this by putting educators and learners at the center of everything we do.
  • Passion for Learning: We are committed to our own learning and growth internally. And we support education and learning around the globe.
  • Integrity: Integrity is the heartbeat of Turnitin—it is the core of our products, the way we treat each other, and how we work with our customers and vendors.
  • Action & Ownership: We have a bias for action. We act like owners. We are willing to change even when it’s hard.
  • One Team: We strive to break down silos, collaborate effectively, and celebrate each others' successes.
  • Global Mindset: We consider different perspectives and celebrate diversity. We are one team. The work we do has an impact on the world.

Global Benefits

  • Remote First Culture
  • Health Care Coverage*
  • Education Reimbursement*
  • Competitive Paid Time Off
  • Self-Care Days
  • National Holidays*
  • 2 Founder Days + Juneteenth Observed
  • Paid Volunteer Time*
  • Charitable contribution match*
  • Monthly Wellness or Home Office Reimbursement/*
  • Access to Modern Health (mental health platform)
  • Parental Leave*
  • Retirement Plan with match/contribution*

* varies by country

Seeing Beyond the Job Ad
At Turnitin, we recognize it’s unrealistic for candidates to fulfill 100% of the criteria in a job ad. We encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of the requirements because we know that skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and unleash your potential alongside us, join our team!

When you join Turnitin, you'll be welcomed into a company that is a recognized innovator in global education. For over 25 years, Turnitin has partnered with educators and institutions to develop learning integrity solutions that recognize the enduring value of critical thinking in a rapidly changing world. Over 16,000 academic institutions, publishers, and corporations use our services in more than 185 countries around the world: Turnitin Feedback Studio, Clarity, Originality, Gradescope, ExamSoft, Similarity, and iThenticate. Protecting the value of an authentic education is at the heart of who we are.

Experience a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in a way that best suits you, supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being. Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.

Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Community to shape strategy, define hypotheses, and measure impact.
  • Turn complex systems and constraints into intuitive, scalable, and accessible experiences.
  • Move comfortably from low-fidelity exploration to high-fidelity, production-ready designs and interactive prototypes (code-based prototyping is a plus).
  • Contribute to and evolve our design systems to support consistency, speed, and scale as the product grows.

jobs.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Big Sky Underwriters seeks a Binding Authority Underwriter to join our team.


Big Sky Underwriters is a leading independent Managing General Agency located in Missoula, Montana. As a General Agency, we represent many property and casualty insurance companies offering products to individuals and companies delivered solely through retail agents.


Over the years, Big Sky Underwriters has grown steadily building relationships with agents placing risks in many states including Idaho, Colorado, Montana, North Dakota, Oregon, Washington & Wyoming. The original General Agency was established in 1955 and began operating as Big Sky Underwriters in 1987.


In 2008, Big Sky Underwriters was acquired by Hull & Company, Inc. The core values of Big Sky Underwriters include integrity, quality, honesty, the highest of service standards and insurance education.


Our guiding principles support our staff, agent and company relationships by providing a relaxed, professional work environment where teamwork, courtesy, respect and active listening are values practiced every day.


WHO YOU ARE:

You believe in working as a team and thrive in fun, collaborative environments. You have a client-focused attitude and value the importance of relationships, professionalism and trust. You set goals high and aim higher. You have solid communication skills. You are detail oriented and organized. You enjoy learning new skills, systems, processes, and procedures. You are a great listener and are not afraid to ask questions. You believe that learning is vital to success.


How You Will Contribute:

  • Examines such documents as application forms, inspection reports, insurance maps, and medical reports to determine degree of risk from such factors as applicant financial standing, age, occupation, accident experience, and value and condition of property,
  • Reviews company records to determine amount of insurance in force on single risk or group of closely related risks, and evaluates possibility of losses due to catastrophe or excessive insurance,
  • Underwrite or broker risks, ensuring that all required information is obtained, proper applications are completed, quotes and binders are confirmed in writing, policies are issued promptly and accurately, state filings (where applicable) are made, and taxes paid in accordance with appropriate state laws. Secure payments on risks bound or written.
  • Review, analyze and underwrite risks submitted by Producers, rate submissions for premium and terms, analyze exposures for quotes for new and renewal business, issue written indications, quotes and binders; use inspection companies to obtain further information, quote rates, or explain company underwriting policies.
  • Markets and meets with retail agency customers to develop business and cultivate relationships in an effort to grow a book of business.
  • Understand and extend Company facilities, utilizing binding authorities or brokering risks when required to successfully negotiate a placement; be responsible for your underwriting results,
  • See that coding on specific required forms are completed and utilized.
  • Service and perpetuate existing business, produce new business, and have a keen awareness of priorities,
  • Instruct and train processors and assistants, review indications, quotes, binders, submissions and policies for completeness and accuracy.

  • Foster and improve relationships with other departments, producers, companies and competitors.

​

Preferred:

WHO WE ARE:

The Wholesale Brokerage Division of Hull & Company, a subsidiary of Brown & Brown, Inc., markets excess and surplus commercial and personal insurance products to retail insurance agencies, and reinsurance products and services to insurance companies throughout the United States. Our combined operations rank us as one of the largest wholesale brokerage operations in the excess and surplus lines marketplace.


Becoming a Teammate of Hull & Company introduces you to a career with virtually unlimited possibilities. Our unique corporate culture rewards self-starters and hard workers who adhere to our commitment to do what is best for our clients. With Hull & Company you will get the training, the mentoring and the tools you need to succeed.

$92,500 - $92,500 Annual

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Residential Cleaning Virtual Assistant

About the Role

We’re looking for an organized, reliable, and customer-focused Residential Cleaning Virtual Assistant to support the daily operations of a residential cleaning business. You’ll manage cleaning schedules, coordinate bookings, communicate with homeowners, and maintain accurate client records to ensure appointments run smoothly.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys helping customers, managing multiple priorities, and keeping daily operations organized in a remote environment. Strong communication, attention to detail, and proactive follow-through are essential.

What You’ll Own

Scheduling & Calendar Management

  • Manage the daily cleaning schedule and coordinate appointments for residential clients.
  • Book new appointments, update existing bookings, and resolve scheduling conflicts.
  • Confirm appointments and communicate schedule changes to clients.
  • Keep the calendar organized and ensure important booking details are accurate.

Client Communication & Customer Service

  • Serve as the first point of contact for homeowners through phone, email, and messaging platforms.
  • Respond to client inquiries professionally and in a friendly manner.
  • Send booking confirmations, reminders, and follow-up messages.
  • Ensure clients receive timely updates and a positive service experience.

Booking & Client Intake

  • Process new service requests from initial inquiry through confirmed appointment.
  • Collect important details about the home, access instructions, and service preferences.
  • Enter booking information accurately into the relevant systems.
  • Ensure all necessary details are available before each scheduled cleaning.

Issue Resolution & Follow-Up

  • Address client concerns and coordinate rescheduling for cancelled or missed appointments.
  • Identify scheduling or service-related issues and escalate them promptly when needed.
  • Follow up on unresolved requests to ensure they reach the appropriate outcome.
  • Keep clients informed throughout the resolution process.

Administrative Support & Recordkeeping

  • Maintain accurate client profiles, booking records, and internal documentation.
  • Perform data entry and update customer information as needed.
  • Prepare simple reports and assist with routine administrative tasks.
  • Keep records organized and current so the team can access information easily.

Reviews & Customer Feedback

  • Follow up with clients after completed cleanings to gather feedback.
  • Document concerns and communicate relevant feedback to the team.
  • Help identify recurring issues that may affect customer satisfaction.
  • Support consistent service quality through timely communication and follow-through.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in a virtual assistant, administrative, customer service, or similar role.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with U.S.-based homeowners.
  • Experience managing calendars, appointments, and scheduling changes.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, CRM platforms, or scheduling software.
  • Strong data entry skills and attention to detail when handling client and booking information.
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple requests simultaneously.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle customer concerns professionally.
  • Ability to work independently and manage responsibilities in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting a residential cleaning, home services, hospitality, or field-service business.
  • Familiarity with home services scheduling or customer management software.
  • Experience coordinating service appointments, managing customer bookings, or handling post-service feedback.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You stay organized while managing multiple bookings and customer requests.
  • You communicate proactively and identify scheduling conflicts before they become bigger issues.
  • You are dependable, self-directed, and comfortable working with minimal supervision.
  • You take ownership of details, from confirming appointments to updating client records.
  • You handle customer concerns with patience, professionalism, and a helpful attitude.
  • You follow through on outstanding tasks and ensure clients feel informed and supported.

What Success Looks Like

  • Cleaning appointments are scheduled accurately and calendars remain up to date.
  • Clients receive timely responses, confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups.
  • New bookings are processed smoothly with all necessary details recorded.
  • Scheduling conflicts and customer concerns are addressed promptly.
  • Client records and internal documentation remain accurate and organized.
  • Customer feedback is collected and communicated effectively to support service quality.

Typical Day

You’ll start by reviewing the day’s cleaning appointments, confirming outstanding bookings, and responding to client messages. Throughout the day, you’ll process new inquiries, update client profiles, coordinate rescheduling requests, and communicate appointment changes to homeowners.

You’ll also maintain accurate records, assist the administrative team with routine tasks, and follow up with clients after completed cleanings to gather feedback. By the end of the day, you’ll ensure outstanding requests are addressed and upcoming appointments are organized.

The Staff Pharmacist may track order status and outstanding issues as well as consult with patients regarding the use of medications and potential drug interactions.

Provide oversight and quality assurance to pharmacy technicians. Verify and confirm validity of controlled substances. Verify prescription information entered in the system by data entry or order entry. Advanced problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other departments to resolve issues.

Country Manager Benin

As Country Manager in Benin, you understand the crucial role strong business ecosystems play in driving economic growth, social inclusion, and sustainable development. You bring a solid local network of small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and partners, combined with proven experience in programme management and team leadership. Do you thrive on building meaningful partnerships, leading a result-driven team, and creating lasting impact across your country? This is your opportunity!

About PUM

PUM is a unique organisation committed to making a positive impact on a global scale. With a network of 1,200 skilled voluntary experts, we collaborate with ambitious entrepreneurs in 26 countries and 12 programmes, sharing expertise to strengthen business ecosystems and create economic, social, and environmental value. We work closely with SMEs, as well as the organisations that support them. We believe in the power of collaboration and in the magic that happens when diverse perspectives come together; Together we grow!

The role

You will lead the country acquisition team in Benin, consisting of 5 country representatives on a freelance basis who engage change-driven SMEs to participate in PUM's impactful programmes. You hold end-to-end responsibility for client relationship management after acquisition, ensuring continuity, quality of engagement, and strategic alignment. You will be part of the Africa regional team, reporting to the head of region and collaborating closely with 15 other country managers in the region, 12 programme managers, as well as other departments such as recruitment and communications & partnerships. Your daily activities will be varied and challenging:

  • You develop and implement the Country Impact Plan (CIP) in line with PUM’s mission, strategy, and organisational ambitions.

  • You center on strengthening business ecosystems, based on strategic analysis and in line with PUM’s programmes. You are able to establish partnerships and collaborate with wider networks of entrepreneurs, business organisations and other enabling organisations to advance business ecosystems.

  • You identify, develop, and secure funding opportunities from institutional donors, foundations, corporate partners, and other possible sponsors, contributing to the sustainability and growth of PUM's impact in Benin.

  • You foster strategic partnerships with SMEs and stakeholders through proactive account management and ongoing engagement, building trust and long-term impact, while expanding PUM's visibility, credibility and country influence.

  • You build, lead, and coach the country representative team, safeguarding the quality and continuity of acquisition.

  • You ensure team capacity, motivation, accountability, and performance through effective people management, including organising country team meetings (CTMs).

  • You qualify new clients using assessment criteria that emphasise diversity, inclusion, and alignment with PUM’s green and social goals within business ecosystems.

  • You approve project proposals, ensuring accurate and complete information so programme managers can identify the right expert match.

  • You collaborate closely with programme managers to ensure alignment, shared goals, and successful projects. Occasionally, you will welcome and accompany visiting experts.

  • You personally engage with clients after acquisition, ensuring continuity, quality of engagement, and strategic fit.

  • You lead professional briefing and debriefing sessions to ensure quality assurance, data collection, and learning.

  • You monitor performance and use data to share insights and improve results. 

  • You ensure compliance with organisational policies, quality standards, and project timelines.

Who are you?

As Country Manager, you combine strategic vision with operational excellence. You understand the challenges that local SMEs face and know how to translate entrepreneurial ambition into tangible impact. Does this sound like you?

  • You are a proactive, hands-on and strategic thinker with a bachelor's or master's degree.

  • You bring at least 10 years of experience in a coordinating role and leading a commercial or acquisition-focused team.

  • You have a strong local SME network and a deep understanding of business ecosystem development in your country.

  • You are familiar with European work culture and experienced in remote collaboration within international organisations.

  • You demonstrate strong intercultural communication skills and collaborate effectively across departments and stakeholders.

  • You have proven leadership and accountability skills, with experience in performance management and stakeholder engagement.

  • You are experienced in managing a remote team operating across the country.

  • You are willing to travel occasionally within Benin for project development visits, partnership meetings, and country team meetings.

  • You are strongly focused on impact, quality, and measurable results.

  • You thrive in an organisation in growth and transition and enjoy contributing to further professionalisation.

  • You are data-driven and comfortable using digital tools, including Microsoft 365.

  • You have excellent command of English and speak French fluently.

  • You are permanently based in Benin and available for 30 hours per week.

What we offer

This assignment is offered on an independent contractor basis with an expected commitment of approximately 30 hours per week, up to a maximum of 1.440 hours per year. The initial assignment is for one year, with the possibility of extension based on organisational needs and a successful collaboration. You will receive a competitive fee aligned with local market standards, reflecting the responsibilities and scope of the role. As an independent contractor, you are responsible for your own taxes, social security contributions, insurance and any other statutory obligations that apply in your country of residence. Reference checks and a declaration of good conduct are part of the selection process. At PUM, we celebrate diversity and inclusion as essential pillars of our organisation. We embrace the uniqueness of each individual, fostering an environment where everyone can thrive by being their authentic selves.

Ready to make a difference? Join us!

Becoming a Country Manager at PUM isn’t just a career move; it’s a chance to drive meaningful change. Working at a volunteer organisation like PUM offers extra fulfilment. In addition to the benefits mentioned, here’s what else awaits you:

  • Building a brighter future: Contribute to the sustainable development of communities, cultivating a profound sense of fulfilment

  • Optimal knowledge utilisation: Put your expertise to its best use, making tangible impact on businesses worldwide.

  • Continuous learning: Embrace new perspectives and gain insights by connecting with diverse people and cultures.

  • Building a professional network: Collaborate with a vast network of stakeholders, including institutional funders, government entities, and NGOs.

  • International exposure: Immerse yourself in a multicultural environment, broadening your horizons.

Apply now and be part of something truly meaningful!

Get inspired by one of our successful projects within our Horticulture programme in Benin: Sustainable growth in greenhouses in Benin - PUM

In the case of a high volume of applications we reserve the right to close the vacancy early and begin interviews before the deadline on 3 November 2026. Please submit your CV and motivation letter in English.

Highlights

Picture yourself as people manager, leading the country team of Benin. Are you ready to shape a brighter tomorrow? Join PUM and let’s make a lasting impact together!

jobs.excerpt: Get ready to Leave your MarkGemeinsam entwickeln wir Inspektions-, Klassifikations- und Zertifizierungslösungen.
jobs.description:
Get ready to Leave your Mark

Gemeinsam entwickeln wir Inspektions-, Klassifikations- und Zertifizierungslösungen. Mit großem Erfolg: Heute vertrauen mehr als 400.000 Unternehmen weltweit darauf, dass wir ihre Welt sicherer machen. Tag für Tag, mit mehr als 78.000 starken Persönlichkeiten in über 140 Ländern.

Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity sucht eine/einen Senior IT/OT Security Consultant (m/w/d)

Stellen Sie sich vor, Ihr Kunde ist ein führendes Produktionsunternehmen oder Betreiber kritischer Infrastrukturen, das auf die Herstellung spezialisierter Produkte oder die Bereitstellung essenzieller Dienstleistungen fokussiert ist, die Industrie und Gesellschaft am Laufen halten. Als OT-Security-Experte verfolgen Sie eine anspruchsvolle Mission: die Optimierung der Betriebseffizienz, die Sicherstellung der Compliance mit branchenführenden Zertifizierungen sowie den Schutz der Systeme, die das Herzstück der Betriebsabläufe Ihrer Kunden bilden.

Genau hier kommen Sie ins Spiel. Durch gezielte Schulungen führen Sie Ihre Kunden in die Welt der IEC 62443 ein, dem Goldstandard für OT-Cybersicherheit, sowie des Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), der zentralen Cybersicherheitsverordnung für Produkte. Unsere Gap-Analysen decken Schwachstellen in Prozessen und Systemen auf und schaffen eine klare Grundlage für mehr Cybersicherheit und Compliance. Sie arbeiten eng mit Ihren Kunden zusammen und unterstützen sie mit fundierter Beratung und praxisnaher Begleitung bei der Bewältigung ihrer Herausforderungen.

Mit unserer Expertise in Risikoanalysen und unabhängigen OT-Security-Assessments befähigen Sie Ihre Kunden, ein außergewöhnlich hohes Maß an Cyber-Resilienz zu erreichen. Von der Absicherung industrieller Steuerungssysteme bis zum Schutz kritischer Prozesse stärken Ihre Maßnahmen nicht nur die Sicherheitslage, sondern ebnen auch den Weg zu erfolgreichen Zertifizierungen.

Ihre Erfolgsgeschichte? Sie besteht nicht nur darin, Compliance-Anforderungen zu erfüllen. Sie sorgen dafür, dass die OT-Umgebung Ihrer Kunden widerstandsfähig, sicher und zukunftsfähig ist.

Als Cybersecurity-Sparte von Bureau Veritas möchten wir unser Beraterteam in Deutschland weiter ausbauen. Deshalb suchen wir einen Senior IT/OT Security Consultant (m/w/d) mit Sitz in Deutschland, der OT-Sicherheitsprojekte in verschiedenen Branchen begleitet.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Beratung unserer Kunden zu SCADA-, ICS- und OT-Infrastrukturen in kleinen bis großen Projekten. Dazu gehören Sicherheitsrisikoanalysen auf Basis der IEC 62443, Gap-Analysen, Security-Maturity-Assessments, Trainings sowie Beratungsleistungen.
  • Unterstützung bei der Konzeption von Sicherheitsarchitekturen und Sicherheitsdesigns für industrielle Netzwerke sowie Ableitung konkreter Verbesserungsempfehlungen.
  • Unterstützung unserer Kunden beim Aufbau oder der Weiterentwicklung ihrer SCADA-/ICS-/OT-Sicherheitsprogramme durch die gemeinsame Entwicklung von Roadmaps.
  • Anwendung von Secure-by-Design-Prinzipien, Threat Modeling und Risikoanalysen auf OT-Produkte.
  • Nachweisbare Kenntnisse der Normenreihe IEC 62443, des Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), von NIS2 sowie branchenspezifischer Standards wie TISAX, UR E26/E27, EASA Part-IS und weiterer relevanter Vorgaben.
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse deutscher Cybersecurity-Behörden, Themen und Regulierungen wie BSI, KRITIS sowie branchenspezifischer Sicherheitsanforderungen.
  • Durchführung von OT-Cybersecurity-Schulungen zu IEC 62443, CRA sowie weiteren Standards und gesetzlichen Anforderungen.
  • Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering- und Supply-Chain-Teams zur Implementierung und Überprüfung wirksamer Sicherheitsmaßnahmen.
  • Bewertung von Sicherheitslücken, Risiken, Richtlinien und Prozessen im Hinblick auf deren betriebliche Auswirkungen.
  • Planung und Durchführung von Assessments auf Basis international anerkannter Frameworks oder spezifischer Bureau-Veritas-Cybersecurity-Methoden sowie Unterstützung von Kunden auf ihrem Zertifizierungsweg.
  • Unterstützung unseres Vertriebsteams durch Ihre technische Expertise.

Ihr Profil

  • Erfahrung mit industriellen Systemen wie PLCs, DCS oder SCADA.
  • Kenntnisse industrieller Kommunikationsprotokolle wie Modbus oder IEC 104.
  • Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Risikoanalysen und Threat Modeling.
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch. Sie sind in der Lage, auf allen Ebenen zu kommunizieren, von der Geschäftsführung bis hin zu technischen Spezialisten und nicht-technischen Ansprechpartnern.
  • Kenntnisse relevanter Standards und Frameworks wie IEC 62443, MITRE ATT&CK for ICS, NIST CSF oder NIST SP 800-82.
  • Erfahrung im Wissenstransfer, beispielsweise durch Whitepaper, Fachvorträge, Präsentationen oder öffentliche Vorträge, beziehungsweise die Motivation, sich in diesem Bereich zu engagieren, ist ein großer Pluspunkt.
  • Eine proaktive Persönlichkeit. Sie denken gemeinsam mit Kunden an Lösungen und verstehen es, Menschen für Ihre Ideen zu gewinnen.

Was Sie bei Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity erwartet

Bei Bureau Veritas Cybersecurity arbeiten Sie in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Fachkompetenz und gesellschaftlicher Mehrwert im Mittelpunkt stehen. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Sie den größten Beitrag leisten können, wenn Sie Raum zur fachlichen Weiterentwicklung erhalten und aktiv an einer sichereren digitalen Gesellschaft mitwirken.

Sinnstiftende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die Cybersecurity-Sparte von Bureau Veritas wächst dynamisch, und Sie haben die Möglichkeit, mit uns zu wachsen. Ob mehr Verantwortung, eine höhere Sichtbarkeit innerhalb und außerhalb der Organisation oder Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen: Ihre berufliche Entwicklung hat für uns hohe Priorität.

You will design the grading rubrics, run the evaluations, classify failures by clinical severity, and turn the findings into changes the Studio and engineering teams make.

Roughly 85% of your time goes to safety. The remaining 15% splits two ways: building clinical modules yourself in Avo's Studio, so your safety judgments are grounded in how the content is actually produced, and joining sales and customer conversations as the physician who can explain how we test and why a CMIO should trust the output.

You report to the CMIO, with a dotted line to the Chief Commercial Officer.

What You'll Do

  • AI safety (core of the role)

    • Define the safety standard for each product line: what counts as a hallucination, an omission, or a clinically material error, and how severe each is
    • Design and run evaluation protocols for clinical AI modules, including hallucination detection, omission analysis, and accuracy checks against source records and evidence-based guidelines
    • Build and maintain a clinical harm taxonomy and grading rubric (NCC MERP-style severity scoring) and apply it across benchmark sets
    • Review AI-generated clinical content directly, and grade the automated graders so we know when to trust them
    • Own the release gate: write the go/no-go safety assessment for new modules and major prompt or model changes
    • Investigate reported clinical errors from customers, trace root cause, and drive the fix through Studio and engineering
    • Write the safety reports, validation summaries, and white papers that buyers and their clinical governance committees ask for
    • Track the regulatory and standards landscape for clinical AI (FDA, ONC, CHAI, Joint Commission) and translate it into internal requirements

    Clinical builder (~5-10%)

    • Build or revise clinical modules in Avo's Studio, applying evidence-based guidelines and your own practice experience
    • Feed what you learn from building back into the safety protocols, and vice versa

    Sales-forward clinician (~5-10%)

    • Join prospect calls and pilot evaluations as the physician who can speak to how Avo's content is validated
    • Present the safety program to CMIOs, CIOs, and clinical quality leaders, and answer their hardest questions about failure modes
    • Challenge the status quo in the room: name where legacy documentation and CDS workflows fail patients, and show how a tested AI alternative does better

What You Bring

  • Active clinical license (MD/DO, NP, or PA) with hands-on patient care experience
  • 3-7 years of clinical practice; you can read a discharge summary and spot the missed anticoagulation plan in under a minute
  • Experience with or strong interest in clinical AI, CDS, or health informatics
  • A testing mindset: you like designing the rubric, arguing about edge cases, and finding the error nobody else caught

Why Join Avo

Impact: Avo’s products run inside hospitals, helping clinicians make better calls at the point of care. The work is real, and the mission is meaningful.

Ownership: We have a bias for action; you'll work alongside teams who take initiative, follow through on commitments, and take accountability for results.

  • Serve as the primary technical authority for integrating access management and identity governance into a unified Zero Trust architecture across enterprise environments.
  • Design and execute scalable, high-throughput application onboarding and migration processes to integrate legacy and modern workloads with enterprise platforms such as Okta and SailPoint while minimizing mission disruption.
  • Implement automated migration pipelines and repeatable deployment workflows to accelerate application onboarding, configuration, testing, and production releases.
  • Develop and maintain standardized migration playbooks, technical procedures, validation criteria, and rollback plans to ensure consistent, secure, and repeatable ICAM transitions.
  • Coordinate engineers, application owners, cybersecurity teams, infrastructure teams, and client stakeholders to resolve migration dependencies, manage risks, and maintain delivery timelines.
  • Ensure all migrations meet client security policies, regulatory requirements, identity governance controls, least-privilege principles, and continuous authentication mandates.
  • Translate technical migration strategies, execution risks, and program milestones into actionable recommendations for client leadership, supporting informed decisions and enterprise-wide adoption.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Deep understanding of Zero Trust principles, least-privilege access, continuous authentication, privileged access controls, and enterprise identity security architectures.

Job Title: Market Activation Specialist – Digital & Social

Location: France (remote)

Contract: Full Time

Job Summary:

Centric Software, a fast-growing, innovation-driven enterprise software company, is looking for a Market Activation Specialist to build the digital presence and brand awareness of one of Centric's solutions — and to make it impossible to scroll past.

Your playground is the feed. You'll turn product and customer proof into content people stop for, share and talk about, and you'll make sure the right audiences at brands and retailers see Centric showing up, consistently and credibly, where they spend their time online.

This is a newly created Market Activation role, fully dedicated to digital brand awareness for the solution, with a focus on key markets in Europe and the US. You will work closely with Product Marketing, Corporate Communications and Regional Marketing, with real autonomy to experiment, test and activate where and how Centric should show up.

This role is ideal for someone 1–2 years out of business school who is digital-native and always on social — someone who spots a trend before it peaks and already thinks in hooks, formats and engagement. We'll teach you the product and the industry; we need you to bring the instinct for how attention works online.

What You'll Do:

1. Social-First Activation

  • Own digital activation for the solution — content, social and thought leadership across LinkedIn and other relevant channels.
  • Build and run an always-on content engine: short formats, video, visuals, carousels, employee and customer voices, built for the platform and not simply repurposed for it.

2. Audience Building

  • Grow reach and community among the people who decide: design and product, merchandising, e-commerce and content, and digital leaders at brands and retailers.
  • Engage with creators, experts and industry voices to extend Centric's reach beyond our own channels.

3. Listening & Real-Time Reaction

  • Monitor conversations, trends and competitor activity in our space, and react quickly with relevant, on-brand content.
  • Test, measure and iterate: double down on what resonates and drop what doesn't.

4. Cross-Functional Orchestration

  • Partner with Product Marketing to turn messaging and proof points into content people want to engage with.
  • Coordinate with Corporate Communications on PR and brand moments, and hand attention over to Regional and Digital Marketing to convert into demand.

What You Bring:

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree from a business school, marketing program or equivalent.
  • Experience: Around 2 years of experience in digital marketing, social media, content or communications (internships count); B2B, SaaS or tech exposure is a plus but not required.
  • Social native: Always on socials, with a natural feel for what works on LinkedIn and beyond. You understand the culture, codes and formats of each platform, and can show us accounts or content you've built or grown.
  • Tech-savvy: Quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and comfortable with social analytics, scheduling and content creation tools, including video and visual editing.
  • Languages: Fluent in English and French; German is a plus.
