jobs.description:
About AMZ Advisers:

AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Working at AMZ Advisers allows you to apply your skills, expertise, and passions to directly impact the lives and business of other people and entrepreneurs. Our staff solves dynamic, quickly evolving problems with our Founders, in-house team, and network of partnered tech companies. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

About the Role:

We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment where you will be provided the opportunity to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills. You will be offered resources and growth opportunities to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career.

The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who can confidently manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts while leading client relationships with a high level of ownership and professionalism. As an Account Manager, this person will be responsible for building strong strategies, guiding clients through clear and proactive communication, and ensuring their portfolio is progressing toward the right goals. They should be comfortable working closely with their Brand Strategist and cross-functional pod members, while taking the lead on day-to-day account direction, strategic execution, and client success.

This is a fully remote position. If hired, you will join a company with an amazing and talented staff.

What You’ll Do:

General Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of clients, gradually growing to approximately 10 accounts, while maintaining a high retention rate.

  • Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear, proactive, and confident communication.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and strategically guided at all times.

  • Set clear expectations with clients and manage those expectations throughout the lifecycle of the account.

  • Conduct regular strategy calls with clients to review performance, communicate progress, explain results, and align on upcoming priorities.

  • Build, track, and monitor KPIs for all accounts under personal portfolio management.

  • Conduct audits of client accounts and use data to identify opportunities, blockers, and areas for improvement.

  • Develop strategic growth plans tailored to each client’s goals, lifecycle stage, and account conditions.

  • Proactively identify and recommend strategies to improve account performance across sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, inventory, content, and advertising.

  • Report on account progress, key action items, and next-step priorities in a clear and organized way.

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee promotions, launches, and marketplace initiatives in alignment with the broader account strategy.

  • Coordinate the resolution of account issues by working with internal teams and escalating through the appropriate channels when needed.

  • Use internal and external software tools to analyze account performance and support strategy development.

  • Work cross-functionally with Ads, Specialists, Content, Onboarding, and Strategists to ensure strategies are executed effectively and aligned to client goals.

  • Attend Account Management meetings, trainings, and ongoing development sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise blockers, align on priorities, and maintain execution momentum.

Strategy Ownership

  • Conduct account audits and turn findings into clear, actionable strategies.

  • Build client strategies based on data, marketplace trends, account health, business goals, and realistic opportunity areas.

  • Understand how to prioritize focus SKUs based on performance, profitability, traffic potential, conversion, and growth opportunity.

  • Adjust strategies as needed based on data, seasonality, competitive changes, and evolving client objectives.

  • Ensure every recommendation has a clear reason behind it and can be explained confidently to the client.

Advertising & Amazon Knowledge

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of Amazon as a whole, including traffic, conversion, listing quality, profitability, inventory, account health, and category dynamics.

  • Understand Amazon advertising strategy well enough to contribute meaningfully to planning, decision-making, and client communication.

  • Be able to interpret ad performance, identify high-level opportunities or inefficiencies, and connect advertising decisions to the broader business strategy.

  • Work closely with the Ads team and Strategist to align ad direction with overall account goals, whether those goals are growth, profitability, ranking, launch velocity, or market share.

  • Communicate ad strategy and performance to clients in a way that is clear, accurate, and tied back to business outcomes.

Pod Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Brand Strategist within the pod to refine account strategy, validate recommendations, and escalate higher-level concerns when needed.

  • Collaborate with pod members regularly through meetings, brainstorming sessions, and strategy discussions.

  • Keep internal teams aligned by ensuring priorities, deadlines, and strategic direction are clearly communicated.

  • Support a collaborative pod environment where ideas, blockers, and opportunities are surfaced early.

Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Lead proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients.

  • Build trust by not only reporting on what happened, but clearly explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next.

  • Be able to handle difficult conversations, performance concerns, and conflicting client goals with confidence and professionalism.

  • Guide clients toward the right strategic decisions, even when those decisions require pushback or expectation resetting.

  • Ensure clients feel that their accounts are being actively managed, thoughtfully reviewed, and strategically guided.

  • Encourage client feedback and use it to strengthen the relationship and improve the service experience.

  • Help identify retention risks early and take action before they become larger client issues.

Check-ins, Accountability & Growth Opportunities

  • Regularly review account progress and raise issues, risks, or missed opportunities early.

  • Stay proactive in identifying upsell and expansion opportunities where appropriate.

  • Take ownership of account outcomes and maintain strong follow-through on action items.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve account performance, internal processes, and the client experience.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate - Percentage of retained clients from month to month.

  • Blocker/ Conflict Resolution Time - Monitor and decrease the time taken to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication - Assess the quality and frequency of client interactions for improved satisfactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness - Evaluate the success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

  • BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or other related studies.

  • 2+ years with client account management.

  • 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience.

  • 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and or Vendor Central.

  • Ability to build and maintain client relations.

  • Active listening and the ability to understand client needs.

  • Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently.

  • Strong ability to think outside the box, willingness to test new ideas, and develop and implement growth strategies.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask.

  • Ability and desire to learn new skills.

Technologies We Use:

  • G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

  • Microsoft: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • ClickUp

  • Nordpass

  • Slack

  • Sellerboard

  • Data Dive

  • Zoom

To Apply Please Include the Following:

  • Your CV/ Resume in English (ONLY English Resumes will be considered)

  • Two references who can attest to your competency in this line of work

  • Answers to the following questions:

    • Describe your experience with Amazon Seller or Vendor Central.

    • Do you have any experience leading a team?

    • Why are you interested in a new job/ this position?

    • Describe a situation in your career in which you were faced with a challenging problem and how you overcame it.

jobs.description:
About Augment Risk:

Augment Risk is a global capital risk solutions intermediary, partnering with clients to structure and place innovative solutions. We specialize in bespoke risk transfer strategies, leveraging deep expertise across geographies and disciplines, including Structured Reinsurance, MGA, ILS, Legacy, Parametric, and Captives. Our trusted, boutique approach combines agility, transparency, and creative thinking to deliver optimal outcomes for our clients.

Our model is different from traditional broking. We operate with a single global P&L and no silos, enabling our deal teams to collaborate across capabilities and geographies to put clients first and create greater enterprise value.

We are continuing to build our reinsurance capability and are looking to attract senior brokers who want to play a meaningful role in shaping and growing the business.

About the Role:

We are interested in speaking with experienced reinsurance brokers across a range of specialisms, markets and territories, including (but not limited to) Structured Reinsurance, MGA, ILS, Legacy Transactions, Parametric Solutions and Captives. We are equally open to individuals with expertise in other areas who can bring fresh perspectives, broaden our capabilities and contribute to the continued growth of the business. Above all, we want to understand your expertise, relationships, ambitions and what you would like to build.

This is not a predefined role tied to a particular class of business, product or geography. Instead, we want to give the right individual the autonomy and platform to leverage their existing relationships, book and specialist expertise, while identifying new opportunities to grow their business and deliver value for our clients.

You will have access to broader capital solutions, centralised data, analytics and technology, alongside a collaborative global platform that enables you to work across capabilities and geographies.

For the right individual, this is an opportunity to take ownership of client relationships, drive new business and deliver high-value solutions, while having a genuine influence on Augment’s next phase of growth and building and developing your own business within an entrepreneurial environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Business Origination: Identify, pursue, and develop new business opportunities with insurers, reinsurers, and capital market investors
  • Client Relationship Management: Cultivate and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key clients and partners.
  • Deal Structuring & Execution: Lead the structuring, negotiation, and placement of tailored (re)insurance and capital risk transactions, ensuring optimal client solutions
  • Market Engagement: Engage with global (re)insurers, capital markets, MGAs, and other counterparties to stay ahead of industry trends, client needs, and market opportunities
  • Advisory & Insights: Provide expert advisory services to clients on (re)insurance strategies, risk management solutions, and capital optimization
  • Cross-Sector Collaboration: Collaborate across teams to maximize synergies and ensure the seamless delivery of tailored solutions
  • Thought Leadership: Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and client meetings, positioning the firm as a leader in innovative capital risk solutions

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience and a track record of successfully generating, structuring, and placing business in at least one of the areas: Structured Reinsurance, MGA, ILS, Legacy, Parametric, or Captives
  • Deep knowledge of global (re)insurance and capital market dynamics, with a strong network of industry relationships
  • Strong negotiation, communication, and client-facing skills
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple complex transactions simultaneously
  • Self-motivated, with a strong sense of ownership and a desire to build and scale new business lines
  • Experience working across multiple geographies with a diverse client base

Why Join Us:

We offer competitive compensation packages, including base salary, performance-related bonuses, and equity participation.

We will provide you with the opportunity to be inventive and innovative; we love challenging industry norms.

You will work in a multi-disciplinary environment, collaborating closely with talented individuals within a flat structure.

You will be trusted and encouraged to take ownership and accountability.

We adopt a work from anywhere approach. Our colleagues and clients are globally distributed, which means flexibility is key to delivering great client outcomes, and that’s what matters to us.

We believe in rewarding success, and we want everyone to share in the value we create – therefore, all our employees are offered equity.

We look after our people and their loved ones. Our employee benefits are designed with that in mind.

Augment Risk is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We look after our people and their loved ones. Our employee benefits are designed with that in mind.

Ready to make a difference?

As a fast-growing company, our culture is centered around innovation, collaboration, and ownership. This is an opportunity to take the initiative, bring ideas that will matter and be heard, and be involved in making impactful decisions, all while contributing meaningful work to the company’s success, which is of course highly recognized and rewarded.

We ensure to build transparency into our culture to foster trust and high engagement. Open communication, shared ideas, clear decision reasoning, along with a strong and constructive feedback culture ensures our employees feel empowered and informed.

Within this dynamic environment, you will be wholeheartedly supported by your skilled and talented colleagues. We are seeking like-minded individuals aligned with this culture, to not only shape and grow the role, but be a huge part of our exciting journey ahead. If you feel well aligned to all the above, making this a great match for you, go ahead and apply now!

jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Rankings.iois seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Post Production Coordinator to support the day-to-day coordination of our video post-production workflow.

This role is responsible for keeping client deliverables organized, accurate, and moving through the production pipeline. The Post Coordinator will track monthly video deliveries, coordinate content repurposing and re-edits, maintain client production folders, support onboarding and offboarding, and assist with editor assignments when production volume increases.

The ideal candidate is proactive, self-sufficient, and comfortable managing multiple moving pieces at once. You should be someone who notices when something is missing, follows up without being asked, and takes ownership of keeping projects organized and on track.

Responsibilities

Project Tracking & Delivery Coordination

  • Audit assigned client accounts monthly based on their billing and delivery schedules.

  • Maintain organized internal client folders and accurate delivery counts.

  • Track outstanding revisions and follow up to ensure projects continue moving through the production pipeline.

  • Identify when additional content is needed and communicate those needs to the appropriate supervisor.

  • Prepare and submit monthly client delivery reports to the Client Success team.

  • Maintain visibility into outstanding deliverables, approvals, revisions, and production needs across assigned accounts.

Encore Video Coordination

Encore videos repurpose existing client content when new footage is unavailable or when high-performing content presents an opportunity for reuse.

  • Maintain a running list of clients' best-performing videos that can be repurposed or re-edited.

  • Identify videos suitable for Encore projects.

  • Assign hook rewrites to writers.

  • Coordinate re-edit assignments with the Encore editing team.

  • Track assignments through completion and help ensure repurposed content remains organized within the production workflow.

Client Onboarding

  • Confirm post-production folder structures are properly created and organized for new clients.

  • Ensure required folders and assets are ready before editing begins.

  • Identify and resolve organizational gaps that could delay production.

Client Offboarding

  • Organize completed client video assets into an "All Videos" folder in Google Drive, separated by the months of service.

  • Copy client prompts and supporting materials into the appropriate offboarding folders.

  • Organize unapproved videos within a clearly labeled "Not Yet Approved" folder.

  • Confirm offboarding materials are complete and notify the Client Success team when files are ready.

Editor & Production Support

  • Assist with building and organizing editor assignments as needed.

  • Pull best-performing videos for Remix and repurposing projects.

  • Organize specialized footage, including Hero Shots, Rapid Fire content, and other assets that may be used in future projects.

  • Help coordinate unexpected increases in production volume when clients submit large amounts of footage at once.

  • Work proactively with the post-production team to prevent production backlogs and keep client work moving efficiently.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Strong ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and client deliverables simultaneously.

  • Proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues before they create delays.

  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of recurring responsibilities.

  • Strong follow-through and ability to track outstanding work across multiple contributors.

  • Clear written communication skills and confidence following up with internal team members.

  • Comfortable working within structured digital workflows, shared drives, project management systems, and spreadsheets or tracking tools.

  • Ability to adapt quickly when priorities or production volume change.

  • Experience in video production, post-production, creative operations, project coordination, or a similar environment is preferred.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means our post-production pipeline stays organized and predictable. Client deliverables are accurately tracked, folders and assets are easy to navigate, outstanding work is followed up on, and editors have what they need to keep production moving.

You don't need to wait for someone to tell you that something is falling behind—you notice it, communicate it, and help get it back on track.

About the Role

We are looking for a high-performing Senior AI Engineer (including MCP) to lead the development and delivery of enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations in Phase 1, and governed multi-model access, evaluation, and observability in Phase 2.

The ideal candidate will combine strong backend software engineering in Python with direct hands-on experience implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI), tool-calling, and evaluation frameworks, ensuring robust, production-grade agentic workflows and reliable model interfaces across the engagement.

Programme Context & Phased Effort Allocation

The engagement is structured as a 22-week sequential programmedivided into two delivery phases, assuming a five-day working week:

  • Phase 1: MCP Gateway and Governance (Weeks 1–10 / 10 Weeks):Full-time allocation (1.0 FTE) developing reference MCP servers, API adapters, central registry onboarding checks, and validating Claude client tool-use workflows.
  • Phase 2: Model Access through Microsoft Foundry (Weeks 11–22 / 12 Weeks):Full-time allocation (1.0 FTE) integrating Claude, OpenAI, and specialist models, implementing streaming token protocols, usage attribution, and model evaluation harnesses.

Key Responsibilities

  • Reference MCP Servers & Adapters:Develop reference MCP servers and API adapters, including JSON-schema tool definitions, granular permissions, input validation, and graceful error handling.
  • Registry Integration & Onboarding:Implement MCP registry integration, automated onboarding checks, request/response logging, and telemetry ingestion.
  • Client Tool Connectivity:Connect the selected Claude client to approved MCP tools and thoroughly validate representative agentic workflows and tool-calling execution.
  • Multi-Model Provider Integration:Integrate Claude, OpenAI, and agreed specialist model endpoints through the approved Azure APIM gateway and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Streaming, Attribution & Evaluation:Implement and test provider interfaces, streaming token responses, tool use, usage attribution, prompt caching, and model evaluation suites.
  • Automated Testing & Documentation:Automate integration tests, resolve defects, and document reusable integration patterns and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • 6–10+ years of software engineering experiencewith senior proficiency in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio) or agreed backend integration languages.
  • Model Context Protocol (MCP) & Agentic Workflows:Hands-on experience implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification, JSON-RPC, tool-calling schemas, and client-server integrations.
  • Enterprise LLM Integration:Extensive experience integrating Anthropic Claude and OpenAI APIs, handling authentication, token rate limits, prompt caching, and streaming protocols.
  • Model Evaluation & Observability:Experience with automated model evaluation, benchmark datasets, prompt engineering, tracing (LangSmith / OpenTelemetry), and cost/usage attribution.
  • API Design & Automated Testing:Strong background in RESTful APIs, JSON schema validation, automated testing (pytest), mock services, and CI/CD integration.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

About the Role

The Technical Migration Senior Lead is an individual contributor who leads complex customer migration engagements from kickoff through successful go-live. You serve as the primary technical and strategic point of contact for your migration pod — building trust with customers, coordinating with our Global Delivery Center (GDC) engineering partners, and ensuring every engagement drives real, measurable value as customers move to modern cloud architectures.

This role sits at the intersection of customer relationship management and hands-on technical execution. You'll act as a trusted advisor who bridges a customer's legacy environment with their future-state platform — accelerating timelines through automated playbooks and AI-assisted tooling, while serving as a direct feedback channel to Product and Engineering on what's working (and what isn't) in the field.

Note: By applying to this Technical Migration Senior Lead role your resume will be reviewed by recruiters and hiring managers across the organization. Multiple roles are available supporting various product areas, including Data360, Revenue Cloud, Tableau, and Marketing Cloud. Our goal is for you to apply once and be considered for the opportunity that best aligns with your background.

What You'll Be Doing

Customer Engagement & Value Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end customer migration engagements — owning technical delivery, project health, and successful go-live outcomes.

  • Partner with Account Teams and Sales leadership to align migration goals with customers' broader business strategy, renewal, and expansion objectives.
  • Build strong relationships with both business and technical stakeholders, translating complex migration challenges into clear, actionable decisions.
  • Develop and execute focused delivery plans that prioritize high-impact milestones and hold pod-level timelines to account.
  • Facilitate enablement and alignment sessions to ensure customer teams are prepared and confident for platform transitions.

Strategic Partnerships & Tooling

  • Drive adoption of AI agents and automation toolkits to accelerate discovery, data mapping, and code conversion — reducing manual effort and compressing delivery timelines.
  • Collaborate closely with GDC partners, delegating repeatable technical tasks while maintaining full accountability for output quality.
  • Work in close alignment with Outbound Product Managers to stay current on product roadmaps and translate field insights into product improvements.
  • Identify underutilized platform capabilities and incorporate them into migration roadmaps to increase customer throughput and adoption.

Technical Expertise & Incident Response

  • Serve as a subject matter expert in at least one key domain: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
  • Apply AI literacy and prompt engineering skills to guide AI agents in data retrieval, migration health reporting, and task automation.
  • Act as the technical point of contact during major migration incidents — coordinating with Engineering and Product to protect the customer's operations during cutover phases.
  • Monitor technical trends proactively and provide tailored release recommendations to optimize migrated environments for performance and stability.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Professional Services, Customer Success, or Technical Consulting, with a strong focus on large-scale platform migrations.
  • Deep, hands-on domain expertise in one or more of the following: Marketing Cloud (Engagement/Intelligence), Data 360 (Data Cloud), Revenue Cloud (CPQ/Billing), or Tableau.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate technical discussions, and navigate complex stakeholder conversations.
  • Ability to translate complex technical architectures into business-friendly language and guide customers through data transformations.
  • Proven experience working with global or offshore delivery models (such as GDC) to accelerate project delivery.
  • Advanced knowledge of Salesforce core (Sales/Service Cloud) or specialized clouds (Marketing, Data, Revenue, or Tableau).
  • Familiarity with AI agents or automation tools applied to data mapping, sentiment analysis, or task automation.
  • Understanding of how target cloud platforms integrate with telephony systems, third-party data sources, and self-service portals.
  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications in relevant domains (e.g., Marketing Cloud Consultant, CPQ Specialist, Data Cloud Consultant, Tableau Desktop Specialist).
  • Prior experience as an individual contributor leading multi-million dollar transformation engagements.
  • Salesforce AI Associate or Agentblazer certifications.

What's in It for You

You'll join a team that is shaping how Salesforce customers adopt the next generation of cloud technology — with access to cutting-edge AI tools, a collaborative global delivery model, and a direct line to the Product teams building the platforms you work with. This role offers real influence: your field experience will directly inform how migration tooling evolves, and your work will be visible across the business.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Job Title: Cybersecurity A&A Risk Analyst

Job Code: ITS426

Location: Remote

Reports to: Program Manager

Prepared Date: 10/9/2026

A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens or legal permanent residents. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident to qualify.

This position requires an active Public Trust clearance or the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance to be considered.

Position Summary:

The Cybersecurity Assessment & Authorization (A&A) Risk Analyst provides advanced governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) support to federal information systems in alignment with the Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) and the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF).This position is responsible for managing external service authorization activities, conducting security risk assessments, and supporting the monitoring efforts. The role requires strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder engagement skills to ensure federal systems maintain compliance with applicable federal laws, regulations, and directives.

Compensation & Benefits:

Starting Salary Range for Cybersecurity A&A Risk Analyst: $110,000 – $112,000

Benefits That Set Us Apart

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights include:

  • Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security
  • Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage
  • Basic life and AD&D insurance, with supplemental life options
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage

•Paid holidays

•Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
  • Professional development, training, and certification support
  • Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.

Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities:

Includes the following:

  • Manage full lifecycle Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities in accordance with NIST Special Publication 800-37.
  • Develop, review, and maintain security authorization documentation, including System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Plans (SAPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), and Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms).
  • Review and assess FedRAMP authorization packages, and package updates, to support the evaluation and use of cloud services.
  • Monitor ATO packages in the FedRAMP Secure Repository
  • Communicate with system owners, information systems security officers (ISSOs), Cloud Service Providers, and security stakeholders frequently to review significant system changes and ensure continued compliance with federal security requirements.
  • Evaluate and validate implementation of security controls defined in NIST Special Publication 800-53 Rev. 5, including inherited and agency-implemented controls.
  • Conduct risk assessments using methodologies consistent with NIST Special Publication 800-30 and provide risk analysis and recommendations to Authorizing Officials and senior stakeholders.
  • Support continuous monitoring and ongoing authorization activities by reviewing vulnerability scans, tracking POA&Ms, and coordinating remediation efforts.
  • Peer review cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and implementation guidance.
  • Perform regulatory and policy analysis to ensure alignment with federal requirements and agency directives.
  • Conduct gap analyses to assess compliance posture and recommend remediation strategies.
  • Assist in development of control overlays, baseline updates, and security control tailoring guidance.
  • Provide subject matter expertise in governance discussions.
  • Support enterprise reporting activities, including risk metrics and compliance dashboards in ServiceNow.
  • Provide documentation and analysis support for internal and external reviews, including FISMA reporting activities.
  • Assist in preparing responses to oversight inquiries and tracking corrective actions.
  • Perform quality assurance reviews of security documentation to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

No supervisory/management authority

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Public Policy, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
  • Professional certification(s) such as CISSP, CISM, or CAP.
  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive cybersecurity experience, including at least 4 years supporting federal RMF/A&A efforts.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing the NIST Risk Management Framework.

Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP):

  • Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA)
  • Federal Zero Trust Strategy (OMB M-22-09)
  • Familiarity with federal cloud security requirements and FedRAMP-authorized environments.
  • Experience supporting Moderate and/or High impact systems.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 office applications.
  • Ability to engage effectively with technical teams and executive leadership.
  • Active Public Trust clearance or ability to obtain.

•Must be a US Citizen.

  • This position requires an active Public Trust clearance or the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance to be considered.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; may occasionally require standing or moving about the office for extended periods.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with ServiceNow, CSAM and/or comparable GRC tools.
  • Familiarity with Atlassian Confluence and JIRA.
  • Experience contributing to enterprise-level cybersecurity policy initiatives.
  • Familiarity with guidance pertaining to responsible AI usage by federal agencies (e.g., Executive Order 13960, OMB M-25-21 and M-25-22).
  • Experience supporting federal research or grant-management systems.

Work Environment:

Work is performed primarily in a climate-controlled environment.

Company Information:

Behind every government mission stands skilled, mission-driven talent: people whose expertise and dedication turn complex challenges into successful outcomes. Criterion Systems, part of Cherokee Federal, the federal contracting division of Cherokee Nation Businesses, is that team. We modernize aging systems, deliver care where it’s needed most, and keep missions supplied, staffed, and moving across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies. For more than 60 federal clients, we take on the work others won’t, and deliver where it counts. If that’s the kind of work you’re looking for, you’ve found your team. Learn more at cherokee-federal.com.

About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

The Director, Clinical Operations Analytics & Performance Excellence leads the analytics strategy for the global clinical trial portfolio and serves as the business owner for operational performance analytics, metrics, portfolio reporting, Clinical Operations data governance, and Veeva Vault Clinical capabilities. This role functions as the Clinical Operations subject matter expert (SME) for the Veeva Vault Clinical platform, ensuring alignment between business processes, system capabilities, data standards, and operational reporting requirements. The Director translates operational data into actionable insights to improve study execution, portfolio predictability, resource planning, site performance, inspection readiness, and risk-based decision-making.

This leader transforms operational data into strategic insights that improve study execution, portfolio predictability, resource planning, site performance, inspection readiness, and risk-based decision-making across the organization. Serving as the business lead and SME for Veeva Vault Clinical, the Director drives platform optimization, user adoption, process standardization, governance, and integration with the broader clinical technology ecosystem. Partnering with Clinical Operations, IT, Data Management, Biostatistics, RBM, Study Start-Up, Clinical Trial Management, and executive leadership, the Director develops scalable analytics capabilities and operational systems that enable data-driven study oversight and portfolio management. The role advances standardized data practices and leverages AI, automation, predictive analytics, and modern clinical technology platforms to support portfolio growth, operational excellence, and continuous process improvement.

Role and Responsibilities:

Clinical Operations Analytics Strategy

  • Develop and execute the Clinical Operations analytics roadmap aligned with organizational objectives, including priorities for AI, automation, predictive analytics, and advanced reporting.
  • Establish the portfolio performance measurement framework, defining leading and lagging indicators to assess study performance, operational health, quality, and execution risk.

Performance Excellence & Portfolio Performance Analytics

  • Translate the performance measurement framework into standardized Clinical Operations KPIs, portfolio health metrics, and reporting across clinical programs.
  • Establish operational scorecards for studies, sites, countries, vendors, and functions to monitor performance and quality.
  • Develop and maintain portfolio dashboards and executive reporting that provide visibility into Clinical Operations performance.
  • Partner with Clinical Operations leaders to interpret portfolio trends, identify risks, and recommend actions to improve study execution.
  • Present actionable portfolio insights and strategic recommendations to leadership and executive teams to support performance reviews and data-driven decision-making.

Clinical Operations Data Governance & Data Quality

  • Serve as the functional leader for Clinical Operations data governance, defining ownership and accountability for operational data quality.
  • Serve as the SME in data and processes in Veeva Vault Clinical, including processes within CTMS, SSU and Site Engagement capabilities.

  • Partner with CROs to align operational data transfers with Clinical Operations analytics requirements and governance standards.
  • Establish mechanisms to monitor operational data accuracy, completeness, and consistency, and coordinate issue resolution with accountable data owners.

Clinical Analytics Technology Enablement

  • Partner with IT and external vendors to optimize analytics platforms, reporting tools, data integrations, and data normalization within the enterprise data lake.
  • Define business requirements for analytics capabilities and operational technologies.
  • Support implementation and enhancement of operational data repositories and visualization platforms that scale with portfolio growth.
  • Evaluate and implement AI-enabled analytics, predictive capabilities, and reporting automation in partnership with IT to improve operational insights and reduce manual reporting effort.

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Use analytics findings to identify and prioritize process and quality improvement opportunities across the clinical portfolio.
  • Lead improvement initiatives that address operational inefficiencies and underlying workflow causes of data quality and reporting issues.
  • Apply Lean, Six Sigma, or equivalent methodologies to optimize Clinical Operations processes.

  • Drive adoption of standardized workflows and data governance practices through change management and training.
  • Drive improvements in Veeva Vault Clinical to support Clinical Trial process adoption and improved data governance across the clinical portfolio

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build a data-driven culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement across Clinical Operations.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of analytics professionals and business analysts.
  • Influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority to align priorities and advance analytics initiatives.

Preferred

  • Experience with AI-enabled analytics, predictive modeling, or operational intelligence solutions.

Description

Information Security Analyst | Cybersecurity | SOC 2 Compliance | Risk Management

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Information Security Analyst to help protect our organization's systems, data, and digital assets. This role is ideal for cybersecurity professionals who are passionate about identifying risks, strengthening security controls, ensuring regulatory compliance, and responding to security threats in fast-paced environments.

You'll work closely with IT, Engineering, DevOps, Compliance, and Business teams to maintain a strong security posture, support compliance initiatives (including SOC 2), and implement security best practices across cloud and on-premise environments.

If you're passionate about cybersecurity, governance, risk management, and helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Support and maintain compliance with security frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, and GDPR where applicable.

Join a company that values security as a strategic business priority. jobs.title: Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA (IA conversationnelle)
jobs.excerpt: Upgrade aide ses clients à avancer dans la bonne direction grâce à des produits financiers abordables et responsables.
jobs.description:
Upgrade aide ses clients à avancer dans la bonne direction grâce à des produits financiers abordables et responsables. Depuis 2017, nous avons aidé plus de 7,5 millions de clients à accéder à plus de 42 milliards de dollars en crédit à la consommation. En nous concentrant sans relâche sur l'amélioration du bien-être financier de nos clients, nous développons des produits qui leur permettent de faire des économies et qui les soutiennent pour un meilleur avenir financier. Nous sommes soutenus par certains des meilleurs investisseurs dans le domaine de la technologie et avons été récemment valorisés à 7,3 milliards de dollars.

Nous sommes constamment reconnus pour notre culture de collaboration et d'inclusion. Plus récemment, nous avons été classés parmi les Premières entreprises fintech au monde par CNBC, Meilleurs lieux de travail par Built In, et par le San Francisco Business Times, Meilleurs lieux de travail d'Amérique par Newsweek, Meilleur employeur ''Startup'' par Forbes, et Employeurs les plus sains par Phoenix Business Journal.

Nous recherchons de nouveaux membres d'équipe qui sont enthousiastes à l'idée de concevoir et de proposer des produits nouveaux et meilleurs. Rejoignez-nous et aidez à bâtir un meilleur avenir financier pour des millions de personnes.

À propos du rôle

Un(e) Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA est responsable du cycle de vie complet des parcours que nos clients vivent avec l'agent IA d'Upgrade par clavardage, par téléphone et par courriel : création, optimisation, gestion des cas particuliers et augmentation du taux de résolution autonome. Cette personne conçoit des parcours dans les outils sans code de Sierra, collabore avec les groupes produits d'Upgrade pour intégrer leurs processus de service à l'agent, et répond de la capacité de l'agent à résoudre le problème du client de façon sécuritaire, exacte et sans intervention humaine.

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(-euse) Expérience IA pour prendre en charge l'agent IA d'Upgrade destiné à la clientèle. Vous ferez le lien entre les équipes de développement, de produit et des opérations clientèle. Vous transformerez des processus de service, comme effectuer un paiement, consulter les détails d'un prêt, mettre à jour une adresse ou activer les paiements préautorisés, en parcours de production, et vous continuerez à les améliorer après leur lancement.

Vous concevrez et gérerez les parcours de A à Z, de la première ébauche jusqu'à leur pleine maturité. Le travail est à la fois celui d'un bâtisseur et d'un analyste : concevoir le parcours, gérer les cas particuliers, lire les transcriptions et augmenter continuellement le taux de résolution autonome. Le taux de résolution autonome, la satisfaction client (CSAT), la qualité des transferts et le taux d'hallucination sont vos indicateurs clés. Au cours de votre première année, vous serez responsable d'un portefeuille de parcours couvrant l'ensemble de nos produits (prêts personnels, carte, paiement différé (BNPL), marge de crédit hypothécaire (HELOC), dépôts) et contribuerez à établir les normes selon lesquelles Upgrade conçoit, teste et déploie ses expériences IA.

Nos technologies principales

Sierra Agent Studio (parcours sans code), simulations et analyse des conversations Sierra, API GraphQL et REST (comme outils de parcours), Genesys (transfert vers le centre de contact), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, Claude et autres outils de LLM.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Création de parcours : Concevoir et développer des parcours Sierra dans Agent Studio pour le clavardage, la voix et le courriel, de la phase de découverte avec les opérations jusqu'au déploiement en production
  • Optimisation : Analyser chaque semaine les transcriptions, les enregistrements et les données analytiques, repérer où les conversations échouent ou sont transférées, et déployer des correctifs à la logique des parcours, aux instructions et à la base de connaissances
  • Gestion des cas particuliers : Cartographier les scénarios problématiques (paiements refusés, identité non concordante, comptes en souffrance, demandes non prises en charge) et s'assurer que chacun se conclut par une réponse exacte ou un transfert fluide
  • Résolution autonome : Assumer la responsabilité des cibles de résolution autonome et de CSAT pour chaque parcours, mener des déploiements progressifs (1 % → 100 %) et prioriser les travaux ayant le plus d'impact sur ces indicateurs
  • Partenariat produit : Collaborer avec les groupes produits (prêts personnels, carte, BNPL, dépôts) pour définir la portée de nouveaux parcours, maintenir les parcours à jour au fil de l'évolution des produits et définir les API dont l'agent a besoin
  • Sécurité et conformité : Appliquer l'authentification à plusieurs niveaux et la vérification renforcée, le libellé de conformité exact ainsi que des garde-fous contre les hallucinations et les réponses non conformes aux politiques
  • Transferts : Concevoir les transferts vers des agents humains dans Genesys avec des résumés exacts et le contexte d'authentification
  • Tests : Créer des suites de simulation et de tests de régression afin que chaque modification de parcours soit déployée avec la preuve qu'elle n'altère pas le comportement existant
  • Surveillance : Suivre la latence, les erreurs et les abandons dans SumoLogic et Grafana, et être responsable des alertes
  • Optimisation vocale : Latence, phrases de transition, interruptions, personnalité et ton
  • Relation avec Sierra : Agir à titre de responsable technique de notre côté, faire remonter les problèmes liés à la plateforme et orienter les demandes relatives à la feuille de route

Ce que nous recherchons

  • De 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel, ou une expérience équivalente dans des rôles en solutions techniques, en IA conversationnelle ou en gestion de produits techniques
  • Connaissance pratique du comportement des agents LLM : instructions, appels d'outils, récupération de connaissances, et les points de défaillance de chacun
  • Expérience dans la conception d'évaluations pour des systèmes non déterministes : jeux de tests, simulations, LLM évaluateur (LLM-as-judge), seuils de régression
  • Une maîtrise technique suffisante pour lire des spécifications d'API, collaborer avec des développeurs backend sur des intégrations REST et GraphQL, et raisonner sur les autorisations et les portées de permissions
  • Un esprit axé sur le produit et le client : vous comprenez les procédures opérationnelles, lisez les transcriptions, accordez de l'importance au ton et mesurez votre réussite selon la résolution du problème du client
  • Sens des responsabilités en production : déploiements, surveillance, analyse de journaux et réponse aux incidents
  • Rédaction claire et capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs non techniques des équipes des opérations, de la conformité et des affaires juridiques

Atouts supplémentaires

  • Expérience pratique de Sierra Agent Studio ou d'une plateforme d'agents sans code comparable (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)
  • Expérience en IA vocale : reconnaissance vocale (speech-to-text), synthèse vocale (text-to-speech), optimisation de la latence, gestion des interruptions (barge-in)
  • Connaissance des systèmes de centre de contact tels que Genesys et de la conception de transferts vers des agents
  • Expérience en fintech ou dans un autre secteur réglementé (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)
  • Expérience en conception conversationnelle ou en rédaction UX

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Salaire compétitif ($140K-$180K) et plan d'options d'achat d'actions
  • Assurances médicales, dentaires et de la vue payées par l'entreprise
  • Congés payés flexibles
  • Possibilités de croissance et de développement professionnel
  • Congé parental payé
  • Initiatives de santé et de bien-être

Exigence linguistique

English language is required for this position, as it involves interacting with staff at Upgrade's offices worldwide.

L'anglais est requis pour ce poste, puisqu'il comporte des interactions avec le personnel des bureaux d'Upgrade à l'échelle internationale.

Conditions environnementales et de travail

Le travail s'effectue à l'intérieur dans un environnement au rythme soutenu qui exige la capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités et de respecter les processus de travail, les horaires et les attentes en matière de service établi.

Les employés saisissent, extraient et échangent régulièrement des informations avec précision à l'aide de systèmes et d'applications numériques afin d'appuyer les objectifs opérationnels et de service à la clientèle.

Le poste exige la capacité de recevoir et d'échanger des informations avec les clients, les collègues, les superviseurs et les partenaires interfonctionnels par le biais des moyens de communication disponibles, qui peuvent inclure des réunions, des courriels, des appels téléphoniques et des outils de collaboration numériques, et peut impliquer des échanges en temps réel, verbaux ou en personne selon les besoins de l'entreprise.

Les fonctions peuvent inclure la gestion d'un volume élevé d'interactions entrantes et/ou sortantes avec la clientèle ainsi que d'activités de travail à l'aide de systèmes de télécommunication et informatiques. Le poste exige la capacité de lire, d'analyser et d'interpréter les informations affichées à l'écran d'ordinateur et de maintenir une posture de travail pendant de longues périodes, conformément aux exigences du poste.

Le travail peut s'effectuer dans un centre de contact, un bureau ou en télétravail, selon les besoins de l'entreprise et la nature du poste. Les environnements de travail sur place peuvent inclure des espaces de travail partagés, un éclairage de bureau standard et un bruit de fond modéré typique des environnements de service à la clientèle ou opérationnels.

Les employés en télétravail sont responsables de maintenir un espace de travail sécurisé et productif avec une connexion Internet fiable qui prend en charge les systèmes de l'entreprise et protège la confidentialité des informations de l'entreprise et des clients.

Des mesures d'adaptation raisonnables peuvent être mises en place pour permettre aux personnes qualifiées vivant avec un handicap d'exercer les fonctions essentielles du poste, conformément à l'Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) et aux lois étatiques et locales applicables.

Nous sommes un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances et nous valorisons la diversité au sein de notre entreprise. Nous ne faisons pas de discrimination fondée sur la race, la religion, la couleur, l'origine nationale, le sexe, l'orientation sexuelle, l'âge, l'état civil, le statut d'ancien combattant ou le statut de handicap.

Upgrade n'accepte pas les candidatures spontanées soumises par des agences de recrutement, des cabinets de recherche de personnel ou toute autre tierce partie. Tout CV soumis à un employé d'Upgrade sans accord écrit préalable en vigueur sera considéré comme la propriété d'Upgrade, et Upgrade ne sera pas tenue de payer des bonus de recommandation ou de placement. Les agences doivent obtenir une approbation écrite au préalable du service d'acquisition de talents d'Upgrade pour soumettre des candidatures, et ce, seulement si une entente valide et dûment signée est en vigueur.

jobs.title: Senior System Administrator (IT Infrastructure and Security)
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Senior System Administrator (IT Infrastructure and Security)Remote (India) | Full-TimeAlso searched as: Senior Systems Engineer, IT Infrastructure Engineer, L3 Support Engineer, IT Security EngineerIf you were handed admin rights to every system a 425-person company runs on, what would you harden first?
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Senior System Administrator (IT Infrastructure and Security)Remote (India) | Full-Time
Also searched as: Senior Systems Engineer, IT Infrastructure Engineer, L3 Support Engineer, IT Security Engineer

If you were handed admin rights to every system a 425-person company runs on, what would you harden first?

On a typical day you might take an escalation off the systems engineer in the morning and turn its root cause into a runbook they can run next time, walk the MSP through a segmentation change on a Melbourne campus network after lunch, and end the day confirming with the People team that a leaver's access is actually gone.

About Contour

We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture.

The people we hire now will shape how Contour grows. This is one of those roles.

About This Role

You are the senior engineer in Contour's first in-house IT team, and the escalation point above it. You run the systems the company works in: Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot, Rippling and the LMS; the identity platform and the device fleet; the network, CCTV and door access at each campus; and the security posture across all of it.

You report to the interim IT lead in Melbourne until the handover is complete, then to the VP of Global Enablement and Support. They own the technology budget, vendor contracts and the call on which platforms we standardise on. Risk acceptance sits with the senior leadership team. Everything else is yours: the design, the configuration, the hardening, and the no when a vendor does not pass your review.

Expect roughly two thirds of your week on system ownership, hardening and project work, and one third on escalations. The team is you and a systems engineer who runs the L1 and L2 queue. You mentor them and review their work, but this is a hands-on-keyboard seat. Leading the team as it grows is open to you if you want it: welcome, not required.

The standard here is different in two ways. First, you fix the cause. An escalation you close carries a root cause and, if it has come up before, a runbook. Second, you hold the line on security and can explain why. You have said no to something convenient because it was not safe, and you can walk a non-technical executive through that trade-off without dumbing it down or hiding behind acronyms.

Contour has grown to three brands and two countries on systems that were administered alongside other jobs. The interim IT lead has spent the past few months setting the security baseline and documenting it. You take that handover and make it permanent, then build what comes after: identity done properly, a managed fleet, campuses you can see and control from India, and a change process people trust.

By the end of month three, you will have MFA and 2SV at full coverage, a first access review done, and offboarding revocation confirmed rather than assumed. You will have a change record on every production change, the top repeat escalations written into runbooks and handed to the systems engineer, the findings from our recent security review triaged into a dated remediation plan with the first fixes shipped, and the UniFi stack documented for each campus with SPF, DKIM and DMARC enforced on the domain. The controls you put in place in those first months will still be holding when the company is twice this size.

Where the Work Lives

  • Google Workspace:the identity core for staff and where most of the business's data sits. Admin console settings here are security settings: group-driven access, external sharing rules, and audit logs someone reads.
  • Slack:where the company talks and where tickets arrive. Most of what you decide gets explained here, to people who do not administer anything.
  • Rippling and the identity platform:Rippling is the HR system of record, and we are choosing a dedicated identity and device management platform now. Joiner, mover and leaver flows start in Rippling and end with confirmed access, or confirmed revocation, in every system downstream. You inherit the platform decision and run the rollout across a largely BYOD fleet of several hundred macOS and Windows devices.
  • HubSpot and the LMS:the CRM and our own learning platform. Sales, tutors and students work in them, so admin rights, integrations and data flow here protect student data as much as they serve the teams using them.
  • UniFi:the network at each campus, managed from one controller with alerts you cannot ignore. Segmentation, firmware and capacity discipline here are what keep a campus network boring.
  • 1Password:the enterprise password manager. Shared credentials get retired into it, and break-glass accounts are documented, sealed and tested.
  • Suptask:tickets come in through Slack. Each escalation you close records why it happened, so the trend report means something.
  • ​Make.com and Zapier:the automation layer. A scenario that fails silently is worse than the manual step it replaced, so alerting is part of the build.

What You Will Do

  • Take the L2 and L3 escalations and stop them coming back.Close what the systems engineer cannot, record the cause, then write the runbook so that ticket type is theirs from then on.Design identity and access.Role-based access, group-driven permissions, SSO where it is available, MFA and 2SV at full coverage. Run the periodic access review and own the technical side of offboarding.
  • Administer the workplace stack at senior level.The platforms above plus the approved AI platforms, device management across macOS and Windows, and the systems that finance, sales and tutors work in: hardening, admin rights, audit logging, licence use, and the integrations and data flow between them.
  • Run the campus networks, CCTV and door access from India.UniFi design, segmentation, firmware and capacity at each campus; CCTV retention and who can view footage; door access rules and their link to the identity platform. The MSP provides hands on site: you set the scope, run the escalation path, and hold them to their service commitments.
  • Own the security posture end to end.Endpoint security (disk encryption, patch levels, endpoint protection, compliance reporting on the fleet), email and domain security (phishing defence, conditional access, SPF, DKIM and DMARC), credential hygiene through 1Password and break-glass handling, and a security assessment of any new system or vendor before we adopt it. When the answer is no, say no.
  • Lead incident response for security incidents and outages alike.Contain, investigate, keep the timeline, write the RCA with what changed as a result. Close out the findings from our recent security review and keep the remediation on schedule.
  • Put a change record in front of anything touching production.Approver, rollback and verification step, with no exceptions. It exists so the next engineer can see what was done and why.
  • Write it down for whoever inherits it.System references for everything you administer, and guides that make sense to someone who was not there when it was built.
  • Report to the leadership team in plain terms.Ticket trends, availability, licence use and the seats nobody touches; security posture with the cost of fixing something and the cost of leaving it. Bring recommendations with the risk and the alternative you rejected.
  • Build automations that tell you when they break.Make.com or Zapier scenarios with error handling and alerting; the happy path is the easy part. Lead practical AI use across the team: where it helps, where it does not belong, and what it saves.
  • Mentor the systems engineer.Review their tickets, coach the diagnosis, correct habits early. Hiring stays with the IT lead for now.

HubSpot is fixed. Everything else is open: if a better tool exists for something we are doing manually, make the case and we will back it.


Requirements

What You Need

  • Four or more years in systems administration, systems engineering or senior IT support, including at least two years as the accountable administrator for a core business system: the person who decided how it was configured, and the person paged when it broke.
  • Administrator-level Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 at a few hundred users or more. We run Google Workspace, so if your depth is Microsoft 365, show us the concepts carry across.
  • Identity and access as a design discipline: SSO, MFA, an identity provider, and least privilege applied by default.
  • Security you owned, with evidence: hardening, access reviews, patching, endpoint protection, and at least one security incident you handled from detection to write-up.
  • Networking you can diagnose remotely: VLANs, routing, wireless design, and hands-on UniFi or comparable. The campuses are in Australia and you are in India, so working from the controller before you send someone on site is the job.
  • Endpoint management across macOS and Windows at fleet scale, including devices the company does not own.
  • A change process you have followed for real, including at least one change you rolled back cleanly.
  • Scripting to a useful standard: Python, JavaScript or Google Apps Script, and the habit of reading an API reference before asking.
  • Plain English for executives. The leadership team funds what it understands, so a trade-off you cannot explain without acronyms is a fix that does not get approved.
  • ​Comfortable working across the India and Australia time difference; the team you support sits in Melbourne.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on UniFi, CCTV or door access control work
  • HubSpot, Rippling, Aircall or Notion administration
  • Light scripting or automation: Google Apps Script, Zapier or Make.com scenarios, or basic Python
  • Time in education or another environment that handles student or minor data
  • A diploma, degree or certification in the field: CompTIA A+ or Network+, Microsoft 365 Fundamentals, Google Workspace Administrator

The Kind of People Who​ Thrive Here

The people who do well here see a gap and close it without being asked, holding the bar even when the clock is short. They give a direct read on the work in front of them, including when it's wrong, and when their own idea doesn't hold up, they say so and bring a better one. They build something that keeps running after they step back. Problems here don't show up on schedule or in the same shape twice, and they'd rather make the right call on limited information than let something break while they wait for a sign-off. That's the job. They name the blocker and the ask the moment they have it, on a call or a text, because decisions get made on the information you bring.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What good looks like

  • Fast first, then thorough: every ticket gets a quick first response and a fix that holds, in that order.
  • Closed means confirmed: a ticket closes when the person who raised it says it works.
  • Escalations carry evidence: what you tried, what you saw, what you ruled out, so the senior engineer starts where you stopped.
  • Offboarding leaves nothing behind: a leaver's access is gone on the day, with a name against every step.
  • Repeat work shrinks: the queue gets lighter over the year because recurring tickets get automated or documented out of it.

Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India. No travel: the campus hardware is in Melbourne and you work it through the MSP and the onshore team. Compensation details shared early in the hiring process. You will hear from us within a week of applying, and the process is a written screen, a short video response, a practical task, and two conversations.

Apply with a CV and one paragraph on a request you slowed down, scoped down or refused because it was not safe, and what happened next.
