jobs.description:
Convera is seeking a commercially driven Senior Business Development Manager to generate net-new pipeline and win strategic channel partnerships across North America. This is a dedicated proactive new business development role, focused on creating and converting new opportunities rather than managing established partner portfolios.

The near-term priority is workforce payments, with primary emphasis on payroll and pension and selected opportunities across travel and expense and global mobility. The role will target partners with recurring cross-border payment flows and a strong strategic fit with Convera’s network reach, compliance capabilities, foreign exchange expertise, local payout rails, and relationship-led service model.

Key responsibilities

  • Net-new pipeline generation: Build a continuously growing, high-quality pipeline across payroll, pension, travel and expense, and global mobility partners, with primary focus on payroll and pension.
  • Territory strategy: Develop and execute a North American account and territory plan based on addressable whitespace, strategic fit, corridor opportunity, competitive position, and route to revenue.
  • Ideal partner targeting: Prioritise partners with a large customer book, recurring cross-border flows, attractive corridor mix, mature KYC practices, limited high-risk exposure, and influence over payables or receivables.
  • Prospecting and market development: Create opportunities through targeted outbound activity, executive networking, referrals, advisers, technology ecosystems, conferences, and coordinated marketing.
  • Consultative discovery: Understand the partner model, end-customer journey, payment flows, statutory-payment needs, FX economics, technical requirements, implementation dependencies, and commercial value.
  • Value proposition: Lead with Convera’s strengths in global network and currency coverage, compliance, FX expertise, local payout rails, hedging capabilities, and relationship management.
  • Complex sales leadership: Own opportunities from initial engagement through qualification, business-case development, solution design, commercial negotiation, contracting, and internal approval.
  • Anchor partnerships: Identify strategically important partners that can provide brand value, market credibility, learning, or co-development potential in addition to direct revenue.
  • Cross-functional orchestration: Mobilise Product, Solutions Consulting, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Pricing, Finance, Operations, Implementation, and Marketing to progress opportunities and resolve barriers.
  • Disciplined handover: Transition signed partners to the appropriate implementation, partner activation, and account-management teams with clear commercial commitments, success measures, and ownership.
  • Selective future-vertical development: Maintain informed coverage of marketplace and AP automation opportunities, but pursue selectively and in line with product and technology readiness.
  • Sales discipline: Maintainaccurate CRM data, next steps, qualification, forecasting, risks, and commercial assumptions; use insight to improve conversion and sales velocity.

Measures of success

  • Pipeline creation: Value, quality, coverage, and progression of net-new qualified pipeline.
  • New partner wins: Signed partnerships and contracted revenue potential in priority workforce-payment verticals.
  • Strategic fit: Proportion of pipeline aligned to the target partner profile, priority verticals, and North American growth agenda.
  • Commercial quality: Sustainable economics, FX capture opportunity, scalable operating model, and clear route to downstream customer adoption.
  • Execution: Forecast accuracy, stage progression, internal alignment, and clean handover after signature.

What you bring

  • Experience: 7+ years in B2B business development or enterprise sales, ideally within payments, fintech, payroll, pension, HR technology, SaaS, or financial services.
  • Proactive new business development track record: Demonstrated success creating pipeline from the ground up and closing complex net-new business.
  • Channel sales: Experience selling through partnerships, platforms, intermediaries, or embedded distribution models, including an understanding of downstream customer economics.
  • Payments knowledge: Understanding of cross-border payments, mass payments, local payout rails, foreign exchange, hedging, compliance, and partner-led payment models.
  • Technical confidence: Ability to sell integrated and API-enabled solutions credibly while matching the solution to current product capability and implementation readiness.
  • Commercial acumen: Strong skills in qualification, opportunity sizing, business cases, pricing, negotiation, and multi-party deal structuring.
  • Executive influence: Confidence engaging senior commercial, product, technology, finance, treasury, compliance, and operations stakeholders.
  • Ways of working: High ownership, persistence, sound judgement, curiosity, and the ability to operate effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment.

Preferred qualifications

  • An established network across North American payroll, pension, HR technology, workforce management, travel and expense, global mobility, or enterprise payments.
  • Experience with complex partner models involving end-customer onboarding, activation, revenue sharing, FX capture, or joint go-to-market activity.
  • Experience working across the United States and Canada.

Role boundaries

  • The role is accountable for net-new partner acquisition and is distinct from the ongoing account management and development of established partner portfolios.
  • Post-signature end-customer activation, ongoing cross-sell, joint partner marketing, and operational issue management will be led by the designated activation and account-management owners, with the Senior Business Development Manager supporting an effective transition.
  • Aggressive pursuit of marketplace and AP automation partnerships is not the immediate core mandate and should remain selective until the required technology capabilities are ready.

About Convera

Convera is a global leader in commercial payments that powers international business by moving money with ease. We provide tech-led payment solutions to help more than 26,000 customers globally grow with confidence, from small businesses to CFOs and treasurers. As experts in foreign exchange, risk and compliance, with an unrivaled regulatory footprint, Convera’s financial network spans more than 140 currencies and 200 countries and territories.

Our teams care deeply about the value we deliver to our customers, which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we expand our team with growth-minded, results-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment. 

As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.  

We offer an abundance of competitive perks and benefits including: 

  • Competitive salary
  • Opportunity to earn a bonus (dependent on performance)
  • Great career growth and development opportunities in a global organization 
  • Corporate benefits 

There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform global B2B payments.

Pay Transparency Statement

Convera is committed to pay transparency and equity in accordance with applicable U.S. state and local laws. For this position, the expected base salary range is [$125,000 - $148,000] per year + commission, depending on factors such as experience, qualifications, and geographic location. We use a tiered geographic pay system to ensure fairness across regions. Candidates in high-cost areas may receive higher offers within the posted range.

Position Summary

The BCBA position will be held by an individual who has the training, education, and/or experience necessary to serve as a Qualified Autism Service Professional. This position will provide clinical supervision as well as oversight of the programs being implemented by the Supervisor/BCaBA and Behavior Interventionists. The BCBA is an individual who meets all of the following criteria: Provides behavioral health treatment, develops and Implements Treatment Plans with the oversight and guidance of the Clinical Director, and has training and experience in providing services for individuals with Autism, developmental disabilities, or other delays.

Essential Job Functions / Key Performance Areas

To perform this job successfully, the BCBA must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential function listed below:

  • Designing, developing, and implementing a wide range of ABA programs for individuals with autism, developmental disabilities, and/or delays.

  • Collaborating with families and other professionals to tailor ABA programs to each client’s specific needs.

  • Directly delivering individual and group learning experiences to assist each client served in obtaining his/her treatment goals and objectives.

  • Meet with, train, and supervise mid-level supervisors /BCaBA and direct care staff (Behavior Interventionists) to provide guidance and review progress on goals, determine the effectiveness of intervention strategies, and consult about the overall implementation of the treatment plan.

  • Conduct assessments, write treatment goals, analyze data and write progress reports, under the direction and supervision of the Clinical Director.

  • Conduct comprehensive Functional Behavior Assessments utilizing standardized assessment tools, including the VB-MAPP, ABBLS-R, Vineland-III, etc., under the direction and supervision of the Clinical Director.

  • Develop and oversee the implementation of behavioral plans for children.

  • Assist in the development of adaptive skills for the individual to take a more positive role in the school, home & community setting.

  • Provide prescribed behavioral consultation to the family and/or school.

  • Supervise ABA programs to assist clients learn a variety of skills related to cooperation with daily routines and demands, coping with stress, play and social interactions, functional communication, attending to tasks, safety awareness, and self-help.

  • Empower parents, caregivers and other support staff to influence clients within their natural routines so they can be more successful, independent, and self-empowered.

  • Establish and maintain positive and supportive relationships with clients, all family members and any other staff persons supporting the client’s individualized needs.

  • Define target behaviors and write treatment goals while coordinating evidence-based programs, reinforcement, antecedent management strategies, protocols, interventions, etc.

  • Model for and teach support staff how to implement intervention strategies and protocols.

  • Set up and maintain ABA session schedules for support staff and clients and manage planned and unplanned adjustments or cancellations.

  • Meet with families/caregivers in-clinic OR via telehealth on a weekly basis to review progress on goals, determine the effectiveness of intervention strategies, and consult about the overall implementation of the treatment plan.

Requirements:

  • Availability to work a consistent weekly schedule. Availability in the afternoon and evenings.

  • Ability to travel to clients' homes around service areas.

jobs.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

About the problem space

AI has changed what's possible in go-to-market, support, and business operations. The constraint is no longer "can we build it" — it's "can we deploy it into a real workflow, prove it made things better, and keep it working."

Most companies are stuck at the demo stage: a lot of clever prompting, very little that runs reliably on Tuesday morning without someone watching it. This role exists to get us past that, everywhere outside of engineering.

Little more about the team:

You'll sit on the Data team, which is where this work belongs. Our team already operates at the seam between the business and its systems — we partner daily with RevOps, Customer Success, Sales, and Product, and we own the data infrastructure these workflows depend on. AI-in-the-business is a data problem with a model attached, and you'll have the pipelines, the warehouse, and the domain relationships already in place.

What you'll do

You are a senior individual contributor. Your job is to take business workflows that are slow, manual, or inconsistent, and make them fast, automated, and measurably better — then do it again, and leave behind enough shared scaffolding that the third one is easier than the first.

Ship automated workflows end to end

  • Partner with department leaders to identify the highest-leverage workflows in their orgs, and go deep enough on how the work actually happens to know where a model helps and where it doesn't.
  • Define success before you build: cycle time, quality, cost, risk. Instrument it. Report on it honestly, including when the answer is "this didn't work."
  • Deliver working systems, not prototypes, with evaluation harnesses, human-in-the-loop review where the stakes call for it, and ongoing monitoring.
  • Iterate on adoption the way a product manager would: user research, documentation, and a real plan for getting people to use the thing.

Build the shared substrate as you go

  • Establish patterns for model access, orchestration and agents, prompt and tool management, evaluation, logging, and cost control — derived from what real workflows needed, not designed in advance.
  • Build on the Data team's existing infrastructure rather than standing up parallel systems.
  • Co-own shared components with your counterpart in Engineering; identify dependencies early and bring them into partner roadmaps collaboratively.

Make the company fluent

  • Create templates, playbooks, and golden paths: prompt patterns, agent patterns, safety checklists, evaluation patterns.
  • Run office hours, demos, and community-of-practice sessions that make adoption feel accessible rather than intimidating.
  • Develop enablement material for distinct audiences — GTM, operations, leadership — from fundamentals through advanced workflows.
  • Help people build judgment about AI: when to use it, when not to, and how to tell whether it worked.

Keep it safe and governable

  • Partner with Security, IT, and Legal on access control, data handling, vendor risk, and policy — so that employees have a clear, fast, safe path to experiment.
  • Work with the Data team to apply our data classification standards to AI use cases: what data can be used for retrieval and context, and what audit trails are required when sensitive data flows through LLM pipelines.

What you'll bring

  • Deep experience shipping systems into real business workflows — you've owned something end to end, in production, that non-technical people depended on daily.
  • Hands-on fluency with modern AI stacks: LLMs, retrieval, tool use and agents, evaluation, guardrails — plus the pragmatism to keep things shippable.
  • The ability to learn someone else's job well enough to improve it. This role lives or dies on understanding how support, sales, or finance actually work.
  • A track record of leading cross-functional initiatives without formal authority, bringing clarity, momentum, and crisp decision-making.
  • Comfort navigating security, privacy, and compliance tradeoffs in real organizations: data classification, retention, access controls, vendor risk.
  • Strong teaching instincts — you explain complex things simply, write clear docs, and meet people where they are.
  • Demonstrated ability to stay current as the landscape shifts, and to change your mind in public when the evidence does.

Nice to have

  • SQL fluency and comfort in a modern data stack (dbt, a cloud warehouse, BI tooling).
  • Experience with workflow automation or enterprise systems: case management, ticketing, CRM, knowledge bases.
  • Familiarity with observability practices for AI systems: monitoring, quality signals, evaluation pipelines, cost and latency analysis.
  • Change management experience across a distributed, multi-function company.
  • Interest in external evangelism — writing, speaking, podcasts, peer groups.

jobs.excerpt: About demandDrive:demandDrive is a growth-focused go-to-market agency that helps B2B organizations accelerate pipeline and revenue through integrated sales, marketing, and revenue operations solutions.
jobs.description:
About demandDrive:

demandDrive is a growth-focused go-to-market agency that helps B2B organizations accelerate pipeline and revenue through integrated sales, marketing, and revenue operations solutions. We partner with companies ranging from emerging businesses to enterprise brands to design and execute customized programs that align strategy, technology, and execution across the full customer journey. Our services include sales development, demand generation, digital marketing, website development, CRM optimization, and GTM systems support - all built to deliver measurable business outcomes. At our core, we combine smart technology, data-driven processes, and talented people to help clients grow faster and operate more efficiently.

Position Overview - GTM Engineer:

As our GTM Engineer, you'll work directly with clients to diagnose their go-to-market challenges and build the solutions that fix them. The GTM stack is the bedrock of all our services. On top of that, you'll bring in automation tools, AI, CRM integrations, and whatever else gets the job done. You'll own the client relationship from discovery through delivery and be the person they trust to turn their thorniest revenue problems into working, scalable systems.

Who We’re Looking For:

You know that feeling when you look at a broken, manual, 47-step process and think, "I could automate the hell out of that," and then you actually do it? That's who we want.

We're looking for someone who has at some point woken up at 2am with a Clay workflow idea and couldn't let it go. Not because we expect that (this is a 9-5, we mean it), but because that's the kind of person who genuinely loves this craft. Someone who gets excited about a hard problem, loves the puzzle, and gets real satisfaction from watching a system they built actually work.

We're an agency, which means you won't just be building in the background while someone else talks to the client. You'll be in the room. You'll work with companies across all kinds of industries, many of them large with genuinely complex and unique problems, and no two engagements look the same. One week you're untangling a broken outbound motion for a fintech company, the next you're building an enrichment engine for an enterprise SaaS team that's never heard of Clay. You'll lead those discovery calls, dig into the problem, collaborate with internal teammates, and then go build the thing that actually solves it. The puzzle is the job, and half the fun is cracking it with the people in front of you.

Job Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Lead client calls and discovery sessions to understand business goals and translate them into technical GTM solutions.
  • Build deep, multi-layered Clay workflows that pull from enrichment providers, intent signals, technographics, job postings, and custom data sources.
  • Design AI-powered automations and agent workflows to handle research, personalization, routing, and qualification at scale.
  • Integrate CRM platforms (HubSpot or Salesforce), outbound tools, and data sources into cohesive systems that work together.
  • Build and manage automation workflows using tools like Zapier and n8n to connect systems and eliminate manual work.
  • Create end-to-end workflows covering the full buyer journey, from first signal through to closed deal and renewal.
  • Run experiments, measure results, cut what isn't working, and scale what is.
  • Stay current on new AI capabilities and proactively bring ideas to clients before they think to ask.

Required Qualifications:

Clay (This One is Non-Negotiable): You need to be a genuine Clay power user. Multi-step enrichment waterfalls, custom API integrations, AI column chains, Claygent workflows, webhook triggers, and advanced filtering logic. Clay is the core of how we deliver for clients. If you've coached others on Clay, built workflows that made someone say "wait, how did you do that?", or competed in the Clay Cup, we want to hear from you. After all, we’re one of Clay's preferred partners!

AI-First Thinking: You approach every problem by asking how AI can do the heavy lifting. You're comfortable building with Claude and other leading models, not just prompting them but wiring them into real workflows. You stay current on what's new across the AI landscape, and you bring those capabilities into client work before anyone has to ask.

CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce - Must Have One): Deep working knowledge of at least one. You know how data flows through the system, where it breaks, and how to fix it. You've built complex workflows, lead scoring models, lifecycle stages, and attribution setups. Both are a big plus.

Automation Tools: Solid experience with Zapier and/or n8n to connect systems and automate processes. You know how to route data, trigger actions, and build reliable workflows that don't fall apart in production.

Client Leadership: You're comfortable leading calls with clients, including large enterprise stakeholders. You can run a discovery session, ask the right questions, scope a solution, and communicate clearly about what you're building and when it'll be done. You don't need hand-holding in client situations.

GTM Tool Stack: Hands-on experience with tools like ZoomInfo, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, Salesloft, Instantly, everything in between!. You know which tools solve which problems.

SQL: SQL skills are a big plus. Comfortable pulling and manipulating data to support analysis, enrichment logic, and reporting.

Technical Foundation: Comfortable with APIs and webhooks. Light scripting in Python or JavaScript is a plus. You can build an integration without pulling in a developer.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience at a Clay agency or GTM consulting firm.
  • Active in GTM engineering communities like the Clay Slack, RevOps groups, or LinkedIn GTM circles.

Benefits Include:

  • Hybrid or remote work model (depending on proximity to HQ - must reside in the U.S.).
  • Annual salary range: $105,000 - $115,000.
  • Health coverage and other health & wellness benefits via BCBS, vision care, dental coverage (Delta Dental), paid paternity & maternity leave, life & disability insurance, 401(k) matching.
  • Paid time-off and 14 paid holidays.
  • Positive team culture.
  • Company laptop, full tech stack, tools, and other resources provided by demandDrive.

Enterprise Sales Director

Location: Remote
Reports to: Vice President of Sales
Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt

The Role

Are you a proven enterprise sales leader who knows the language access industry inside and out? Do you have the relationships, industry expertise, and drive to open doors with major healthcare organizations and turn complex opportunities into lasting partnerships?

At Linguava, we're looking for an Enterprise Sales Director who can hit the ground running and make an immediate impact. This is a true hunter role for someone who knows how to navigate the healthcare landscape, build relationships with senior decision-makers, and close high-value, net-new business.

You'll lead the full sales cycle, connecting health systems, hospitals, clinics, and health insurance companies with language access solutions that help them better serve their patients. From onsite and video remote interpreting to telephonic interpreting and translation services, you'll help organizations find the right solutions to their most pressing language access challenges.

This role is about more than closing deals. It's about helping healthcare organizations improve patient outcomes, strengthen compliance, and deliver more equitable care to people with limited English proficiency. You'll bring together industry expertise, consultative selling, and strategic relationship-building to drive meaningful growth for Linguava and the communities we serve.

If you bring deep language access industry experience, a strong healthcare network, and a track record of winning complex enterprise deals, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Hunt for new business. Identify, develop, and close new enterprise partnerships with health systems, hospitals, clinics, Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), public health departments, and health insurance companies across the U.S.
  • Own the full sales cycle. Lead opportunities from prospecting and discovery through solution design, presentations, negotiations, and contract execution.
  • Sell solutions that make a difference. Connect healthcare organizations with the right combination of onsite, video remote, and telephonic interpreting, as well as translation services.
  • Build executive-level relationships. Establish trust and credibility with C-suite leaders, clinical executives, patient experience teams, and other key decision-makers.
  • Lead with a consultative approach. Uncover client challenges, understand organizational priorities, and develop tailored solutions that demonstrate measurable clinical, operational, and financial value.
  • Win complex enterprise deals. Navigate lengthy sales cycles, sophisticated buying processes, and high-stakes RFPs and RFIs to secure strategic contracts.
  • Bring the value of language access to life. Articulate how language access supports patient outcomes, health equity, regulatory compliance, and operational efficiency.
  • Stay ahead of the industry. Understand healthcare trends, evolving language access requirements, and the competitive landscape to help prospective clients make informed decisions.
  • Build strategic partnerships. Cultivate relationships that expand Linguava's reach, create new opportunities, and accelerate growth.
  • Own your numbers. Consistently meet or exceed sales quotas and key performance metrics while maintaining accurate CRM records, a healthy pipeline, and reliable forecasts.

Who You Are

  • A language access sales expert. You bring at least 7 years of direct experience selling language access solutions to healthcare organizations, including large hospitals, health systems, and payers. This experience is essential to success in the role.
  • A true hunter. You thrive on opening doors, creating opportunities, and winning new business. You know how to turn industry knowledge and relationships into revenue.
  • A strategic, consultative seller. You ask thoughtful questions, uncover the real business problem, and connect client needs to solutions that deliver measurable value.
  • Comfortable in the C-suite. You can engage senior healthcare leaders with confidence, communicate complex ideas clearly, and build relationships that lead to long-term partnerships.
  • A skilled negotiator. You have experience navigating complex contracts, enterprise procurement processes, and high-value deals with multiple stakeholders.
  • Well-versed in healthcare. You understand healthcare operations, patient experience, language access workflows, and relevant regulatory requirements, including Title VI and Section 1557 of the Affordable Care Act.
  • Tech-savvy and disciplined. You're comfortable using CRM tools such as HubSpot to manage your pipeline, forecast accurately, and maintain strong sales documentation.
  • Self-directed and results-oriented. You know how to prioritize your time, manage a complex sales pipeline, and stay focused on the activities that drive results.
  • Mission-driven. You believe language should never be a barrier to quality healthcare and are motivated by the opportunity to advance health equity through your work.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of direct experience selling language access services, including interpreting and translation solutions, to healthcare organizations.
  • Demonstrated success winning new business and closing complex, enterprise-level contracts with hospitals, health systems, and/or healthcare payers.
  • Proven expertise in consultative selling, executive-level presentations, and complex contract negotiations.
  • Experience managing formal RFP and RFI processes.
  • Strong understanding of language access service delivery models and the technology used to support them, including video remote interpreting.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms and sales forecasting tools.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Healthcare Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for client meetings, industry conferences, and business development opportunities.

Please note: Direct experience selling language access solutions to healthcare organizations is a requirement for this position. Candidates without this specific industry experience will not be considered.

Why Linguava?

At Linguava, language access is about more than communication. It's about helping people feel seen, understood, and cared for when it matters most. Our work helps healthcare organizations connect with patients, reduce barriers to care, and create better experiences for the communities they serve.

You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while helping grow a business with a mission that matters. If you're ready to put your industry expertise and enterprise sales experience to work, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.excerpt: Our MissionAt Big Health, our mission is to help millions back to good mental health by providing fully digital, non-drug options for the most common mental health conditions.
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Big Health, our mission is to help millions back to good mental health by providing fully digital, non-drug options for the most common mental health conditions. Our FDA-clear digital therapeutics—SleepioRx for insomnia and DaylightRx Treatment for anxiety—guide patients through first-line recommended, evidence-based cognitive and behavioral therapy anytime, anywhere. Our digital program, Spark Direct, helps to reduce the impact of persistent depressive symptoms.
In pursuit of our mission, we’ve pioneered the first at-scale digital therapeutic business model in partnership with some of the most prominent global healthcare organizations, including leading Fortune 500 healthcare companies and Scotland’s NHS. Through product innovation, robust clinical evaluation, and a commitment to equity at scale, we are designing the next generation of medicine and the future of mental health care.

Our Vision

Over the next 5-10 years, we believe digital therapeutics will transform the delivery of healthcare worldwide by providing access to safe and effective evidence-based treatments. Big Health is positioned to take the lead in this transformation.
Big Health is a remote-first company, and this role can be based anywhere in the US.

Position Summary
You'll own a portfolio of Big Health's provider accounts after they go live, and your job is to grow orders. That portfolio runs from large health systems to smaller practices and provider groups, and you'll flex between them: an executive business review with a health system one day, a working session with a practice manager the next. Pricing is set by contract, but revenue comes from one place: prescribers ordering SleepioRx and DaylightRx Treatment and patients activating.

You'll take accounts from Provider Experience and Clinical Transformation (PECT) once they're implemented and ordering, and build them into programs that grow year over year, with more prescribers, more sites, and more service lines. You'll work closely with Sales, PECT, and Market Access.

Key Responsibilities

  • Account Ownership and Growth
  • Own and grow your accounts. Build account plans with clear order growth targets, risks, and next steps. Know each account down to the site and prescriber: who's ordering, who stopped, who never started, and why.
  • Flex your coverage to the account. Health systems and large groups get high-touch coverage. For smaller practices, build scaled approaches such as group training, office hours, and practice-ready resources, so they get what they need without one-to-one coverage.
  • Expand. Find the next site, service line, provider group, or product inside each account and build the case with clinical and operational leaders.
  • Build the foundation. Create and improve playbooks for adoption, account health, retraining, and expansion. Synthesize learnings across accounts into repeatable approaches.
  • Provider Engagement
  • Drive repeat ordering. Monitor provider and site performance against agreed targets. Diagnose what's slowing adoption, such as workflow breaks, staff turnover, reimbursement friction, or losing a champion, and fix it with named owners, dates, and measurable results.
  • Build internal advocacy. Partner with executives, provider leaders, practice managers, and clinical champions to sustain prescribing and patient activation.
  • Train and retrain. Lead ongoing education for new prescribers, new sites, and practice staff, in partnership with Clinical and PECT. Track the impact on prescribing and activation.
  • Be the first line on day-to-day reimbursement issues. Spot denial patterns, billing workflow problems, and payer issues early. Bring in Market Access, who own reimbursement and payer strategy, and make sure the practice knows how to handle it next time.
  • Internal Stakeholder Management
  • Take a clean handoff from PECT. Work alongside PECT as implementation wraps up, then own the account once it's live and ordering. Bring PECT back in when an expansion needs new workflows or EHR work.
  • Own escalations. Serve as the primary account escalation contact and drive resolution across Sales, PECT, Market Access, Clinical, Product, IT Implementation, and Legal.
  • Partner with Sales on growth. Contribute to contract amendments, pricing, and forecasting.
  • Keep leadership informed. Provide timely, executive-ready updates to senior leadership and customer sponsors.
  • Reporting and Documentation
  • Keep Salesforce as the single source of truth for accounts, contacts, opportunities, activity, and forecast. Use dashboards to surface adoption, risk, and growth signals.
  • Run QBRs and JOCs with clinical, operational, revenue cycle, and executive sponsors, built on order and activation data and clear next steps.
  • Partner with Finance on account reporting, invoicing, and forecasting, including resolving practice invoice issues.

Required Skills and Experience

  • 8+ years in healthcare client success, account management, or field roles, including 4+ years in a customer-facing account role at a med device, diagnostics, digital health, or PDT company where revenue depended on providers ordering. Examples include ambulatory cardiac monitoring, home sleep testing, CGM, and RPM.
  • A track record of growing utilization or order volume across both health systems and smaller practices or provider groups. Bring the numbers.
  • Hands-on knowledge of how practices bill and get paid: fee-for-service, HCPCS/CPT, charge capture, and denials. You understand provider economics and what it means for a practice to carry reimbursement risk.
  • Credibility with clinical, operational, IT, revenue cycle, and executive stakeholders, and just as comfortable with a three-provider practice's office manager.
  • The ability to turn utilization data into an action plan and a credible ROI story. Salesforce and Looker (or similar) experience.
  • Disciplined organization, risk and issue management, and follow-through across a mixed portfolio.
  • Bachelor's degree required. An MBA, MPH, or clinical background is a plus. A clinical license is not required.
  • Willingness to travel 30–40% for onsite provider engagement, training, and account reviews.
  • Preferred
  • You've trained, mentored, or led others, or built a playbook from scratch.
  • Sleep medicine or behavioral health experience.
We at Big Health are on a mission to bring millions back to good mental health, in order to do so, we need to reflect the diversity of those we intend to serve. We’re an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building a culturally and experientially diverse team that leads with empathy and respect. Additionally, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
Big Health participates in E-Verify for all new hires in the United States.

Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

As a UX Designer Sr, you are passionate about experience innovation and eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible. You bring 5+ YEARS of experience, a growth mindset and a drive to make a lasting impact.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
  • A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
  • Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
  • Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role responsibilities

The Senior UX Designer is a key contributor within the Experience Design team, working closely with strategists, product owners, visual designers, creative directors, researchers, copywriters, developers, and client stakeholders.

This role is suited to someone with 5+ years of experience who can independently own significant UX activities within a workstream, while collaborating with senior leads on larger or more complex initiatives. It is not a people-management role, but it does include supporting junior designers through feedback, collaboration, and best-practice sharing.

The role operates across three core dimensions: Thinking, Interaction, and Storytelling.

Thinking: Research & Validation

  • Plan and conduct research and validation activities such as interviews, usability testing, heuristic reviews, and competitive analysis, to understand user behaviors, needs, and pain points.
  • Synthesize insights into actionable UX recommendations.
  • Advocate for user needs and support evidence-based decisions throughout the design process.

Interactive: IA, Flows & Experience Design

  • Translate user needs, business objectives, and technical constraints into user journeys, information architecture, screen flows, wireframes, and prototypes.
  • Design interaction patterns that improve usability, accessibility, findability, and task completion, contributing to scalable design systems and UX frameworks.
  • Collaborate with visual designers and developers to translate the UX direction clearly into design and implementation.
  • Set foundations for a design system and help visual design document the interface to pixel-perfection.

Storytelling: Narrative & Content Design

  • Shape user-centered narratives and content hierarchies that align business goals, brand ambition, and user needs, translating research insights into compelling journeys and experience concepts.
  • Contribute to UX writing and interface content where appropriate — navigation labels, calls to action, onboarding, microcopy, form guidance, and instructional content.
  • Partner with copywriters, content strategists, brand teams, and creative disciplines to craft cohesive experiences that help users understand products, services, and value propositions.

Leverage AI & Emerging Design Practices as part of the craft

  • Apply and experiment with hands-on experience using AI-enabled tools (such as Figma, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to support research synthesis, ideation, prototyping, content exploration, and documentation.
  • You will critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and decide when they are useful, appropriate, and aligned with project needs.
  • Approach the use of AI with balance, speed, quality, ethics, originality, and human judgment in design work.
  • Explore emerging technologies and how they can improve UX practice.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Partner with product, strategy, technology, and client stakeholders throughout the design process.
  • Present UX rationale, concepts, and recommendations clearly and confidently.
  • Participate in workshops, design critiques, and collaborative working sessions.
  • Support junior designers through collaboration, feedback, and the sharing of best practices.
  • Maintain high standards of UX craft, documentation, presentation quality, and client engagement.

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in UX design, product design, experience design, service design, or related disciplines.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong end-to-end UX work across web, mobile, services, or complex digital products.
  • Experience conducting research and translating insights into journeys, interactions, content structures, and design decisions.
  • Strong understanding of information architecture, user flows, interaction design, prototyping, accessibility, and usability best practices.
  • Ability to craft clear experience narratives through journey design, content hierarchy, and UX writing.
  • Experience contributing to design systems, leveraging AI and libraries such as shadcn to accelerate and scale digital experiences.
  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams across strategy, design, content, and technology.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills in English, with the ability to explain UX decisions to clients and internal teams.
  • Proficiency with Figma and modern UX design, prototyping, and collaboration tools.

Nice to have qualifications

  • Experience designing for luxury hospitality, travel, aviation, financial services, retail, or premium consumer brands.
  • Experience working with multicultural and distributed teams across regions and time zones.
  • Experience in a consulting environment or working directly with cross-functional client teams.
  • Familiarity with service design methods, including service blueprints, ecosystem maps, and cross-channel experience frameworks.
  • Experience facilitating client workshops, design sprints, usability sessions, or co-creation activities.
  • Familiarity with analytics, experimentation, content strategy, or behavioral insights in UX decision-making.

What sets you apart

You combine analytical thinking, interaction design, and storytelling to create experiences that are useful, usable, and meaningful. You can move confidently between research, journey design, and content, balancing user needs, business goals, and technical constraints while collaborating effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

The benefits

This is a full time position based in the United States. The offered salary range is $73,000-123,000 USD annually, depending on experience and location.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Flexibility, with remote and hybrid work options (country-dependent)
  • Career advancement, with international mobility and professional development programs
  • Learning and development, with access to cutting-edge tools, training and industry experts
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your family, plus employer contributions to Health Savings Accounts

Our benefits are tailored to each location. Your Talent Partner will provide full details during the hiring process.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If your skills and experience align with the role, we’ll reach out for next steps.Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud: Only engage with official Valtech email addresses.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Orbit
jobs.excerpt: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps.
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Principal Product Manager, Orbit, you'll define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for GitLab's software lifecycle context graph. Orbit connects source code and software development lifecycle data into a structured map of systems, relationships, dependencies, and ownership. You'll help engineers, software leaders, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents understand how teams build software and how changes affect the systems around it.

You'll shape Orbit from its underlying graph model and query experiences through customer value, pricing, packaging, launch, and adoption. This role combines technical product leadership with building a business around software lifecycle context. You'll balance foundational platform work with near-term customer needs, working directly with technical customers and senior Engineering and Design leaders.

You'll join Anand Ahire's product organization and partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success, including the teams building GitLab Duo and the broader AI-powered development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform.

What you'll do

  • Define Orbit's multi-year vision and roadmap across graph models and ontology, ingestion and indexing, query and retrieval, developer and agent interfaces, governance, and enterprise readiness. Shape how Orbit works across GitLab.com, Self-Managed, Dedicated, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, MCP-based external agents, APIs, and developer tooling.
  • Turn complex platform opportunities into customer problems, measurable outcomes, and investment decisions. Use evidence to decide where to invest, iterate, partner, or stop.
  • Partner with Engineering and Design on architecture and implementation tradeoffs across graph data models, indexing, query systems, application programming interfaces (APIs), Model Context Protocol (MCP), authorization, and scale.
  • Use AI tools such as Claude Code and GitLab to investigate problems, explore code and data, prototype concepts, and create or review merge requests when that's the fastest way to learn.
  • Lead discovery with developers, engineering leaders, platform teams, security teams, and technical executives to validate needs around dependencies, ownership, change impact, vulnerability exposure, pipeline health, and software delivery risk. Build repeatable feedback into roadmap decisions and help customers understand the value of connected graph context over disconnected searches or API calls.
  • Define target customers, priority use cases, differentiated value, and the path to product-market fit. Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Pricing, and Finance on positioning, packaging, pricing, launch, adoption, and expansion.
  • Develop business cases and track adoption, retention, usage, customer value, and revenue outcomes. Support executive briefings, analyst conversations, customer workshops, and field enablement.
  • Align teams and executive leaders around clear recommendations and tradeoffs without relying on direct authority. Mentor other product managers, share practical frameworks, and represent GitLab's product vision in customer and industry conversations.

What you'll bring

  • Experience owning complex technical products or platforms at Staff, Principal, or equivalent scope, with a track record of defining vision and roadmaps across multiple teams.
  • Deep technical fluency in one or more relevant areas, such as developer tools, DevOps, software delivery, data platforms, distributed systems, knowledge graphs, search, APIs, AI infrastructure, or agentic systems.
  • The ability to work credibly with engineers on architecture, data models, APIs, scale, reliability, and security.
  • Business judgment and experience in market assessment, product strategy, pricing, packaging, business cases, or commercialization of technical products.
  • Experience taking a product, platform, or category from early concept through launch, customer adoption, and iteration.
  • A customer-first approach and the ability to build trusted relationships with technical practitioners, engineering leaders, architects, and executives.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with experience explaining complex ideas, influencing across functions, and resolving competing priorities in ambiguous work.
  • Practical experience using AI tools in product work, including exploring code and data, prototyping workflows, and creating or reviewing merge requests. You take ownership, learn quickly, and move between strategy and implementation detail.

About the team

In GitLab's Analytics organization, we focus on making Orbit's context available through GitLab experiences, developer tools, MCP, APIs, and the command-line interface (CLI).

Our challenge is to turn complex, connected data into useful, trustworthy context for engineers and agents. You'll work with engineering and cross-functional partners who value technical rigor, clear product thinking, rapid learning, and direct customer contact. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, we collaborate asynchronously across regions, with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decisions.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

$203,200—$345,600 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

jobs.excerpt: Our missionWe're making Africa the first cashless continent.
jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We’re looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our team. You’ll work on projects across the business, from building credit scoring models and improving fraud detection to optimizing field visit schedules and designing A/B tests for targeted user promotions.

In this role, you’ll partner with product managers and business leaders to understand the problems they’re trying to solve and find practical ways to use data to improve outcomes. Our ideal candidate is product-minded, scrappy and thinks about data in terms of intuitive user behaviours rather than just inputs to a black box model.

In this role you’ll;

  • Be embedded closely with our product and operations teams.
  • Generate insights using customer, merchant and internal data using statistical modelling, data visualization, and machine learning.
  • Design, implement and analyze optimizations for our internal operations, user promos, and agent network to help teams scale and reduce costs.
  • Build data-driven heuristics and machine-learning models to improve user and business outcomes.
  • Take ownership of the analytics process - from project scoping and design to communicating findings to stakeholders.

Key details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (US, UK, Spain, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso.
  • Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once a year. Exceptions apply, but we’ve found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $130,600 - $236,200 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 30-40 days per year.
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirements

  • Education and Experience
    • Minimum Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. A Master's or PhD is a plus.
    • 5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning or technical analytics roles.
  • Technical Skills
    • Deep expertise with Python, SQL, and data visualization tools
    • Experience in one or more of the following: machine learning, causal inference, statistical modeling, or A/B testing. Experience applying these methods in operational settings with offline components (example: incentive structures for field staff) is a plus.
    • Highly effective written communication and presentation skills
    • A track record of translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and business stakeholder
  • Fluency in English. French is a plus.

You might be a good fit if you

  • Have a bias for action and ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you must create clarity and drive forward progress.
  • Have worked in early stage product teams (or a rapidly scaling product) and are able to drive product decisions.
  • Have excellent focus, prioritizing your research and work using an iterative approach (you know when a project is good enough to stop, and you rarely get lost in details).
  • Are able to compellingly present your findings to technical and non-technical audiences and make proactive recommendations based on data.

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer (Databases)
jobs.excerpt: Role OverviewWhen radiologists receive the right study at the right time, patients get answers faster, and behind every worklist, search, and assignment is a database that has to respond quickly and correctly.
jobs.description:
Role Overview

When radiologists receive the right study at the right time, patients get answers faster, and behind every worklist, search, and assignment is a database that has to respond quickly and correctly. As a Senior Software Developer focused on the data layer of our InteleOrchestrator team, you’ll modernize the SQL Server-backed platform that streamlines radiology workflows for healthcare providers around the world. You’ll write the code that changes the database: refactoring schemas and queries, untangling legacy data-access code, and moving it to type-safe, well-tested patterns while the system stays live for clinicians. This is a hands-on software development role, not a database administration role; your time will be spent in code, query plans, and pull requests rather than in backups, patching, or server operations. Success in this role means faster, safer, and more maintainable data access that reduces clinical burden and gives time back to the clinicians who depend on it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead complex database refactoring across a large, mature SQL Server schema, including restructuring tables, keys, and indexes, retiring legacy structures, and backfilling and normalizing data, delivered as safe, incremental, version-controlled migrations (e.g., Liquibase) with no disruption to clinical users.
  • Diagnose and resolve performance problems at the source by reading execution plans, rewriting queries to be sargable and set-based, replacing row-by-row processing with batched writes and properly indexed temp tables, and designing covering and filtered indexes based on real workload evidence.
  • Modernize the data-access layer by migrating legacy and inline SQL in PHP and C# code into type-safe Kotlin and jOOQ repositories, preserving behavior through characterization, regression, and scale testing.
  • Harden data access for security and reliability by eliminating SQL injection through parameterization and automated checks, establishing consistent locking, isolation, and query-timeout conventions, and building query attribution and diagnostics that trace database load back to the code responsible for it.
  • Build the tooling that makes database change routine, including migration and upgrade pipelines in Gradle and CI/CD, containerized SQL Server test environments, and automated checks that catch regressions before release.
  • Shape technical direction by defining SQL and data-access standards, documenting conventions, and contributing to architecture decisions and the InteleOrchestrator technical roadmap.
  • Partner with and mentor fellow developers through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance, helping application teams write efficient, safe database code and fostering a culture of continuous learning.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including 4+ years in which writing and refactoring database code (SQL, schemas, and data-access layers) for production systems was a core part of the role.
  • Expert-level T-SQL on Microsoft SQL Server, including query optimization, execution plan analysis, indexing strategy, temp tables, CTEs, window functions, stored procedures, and set-based design; PostgreSQL experience is also valued.
  • Proven track record of incrementally refactoring a large, legacy relational schema and the application code that depends on it while in production, not only greenfield database design.
  • Proficiency in Kotlin or Java, or an equivalent language, building backend services with Spring Boot or an equivalent framework.
  • Hands-on experience with database migration and version-control tools such as Liquibase or Flyway, treating schema as code within Git-based CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of concurrency, locking, isolation levels, and transactional integrity, and how they affect application behavior under load.
  • Solid grounding in secure data-access practices, including SQL injection prevention and safe handling of sensitive patient data.
  • Experience delivering in agile teams using Gradle, Git, and modern DevOps practices across Windows and Linux environments.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience with jOOQ or similar type-safe SQL libraries and code generation from database schemas.
  • Experience reading, maintaining, and porting legacy application code in PHP and/or C# (.NET).
  • Experience with database testing approaches such as Testcontainers or Docker-based SQL Server environments, golden-master or characterization tests, and load or scale testing of queries.
  • Familiarity with SQL Server diagnostic tooling (Query Store, DMVs, Extended Events) and observability platforms such as Datadog or New Relic.
  • Experience with AWS data services such as Amazon RDS for SQL Server.
  • Experience working with healthcare data standards such as HL7 and DICOM, or building software in other regulated industries (e.g., FDA- or FAA-regulated environments).
  • Location: This role is open to candidates based in the United States or Canada.

About Meltzer Hellrung

  • We Are Growth-Minded: We approach our service, our organization, and our careers with an innovative spirit. We look for ways to improve and progress as individuals and as a team. We continually look to evolve and add value.

About the Controller Role

The Controller is the hands-on accounting and finance operations leader for the law firm and its related management-services entity (MSO). This position owns the integrity of the general ledger, timely monthly close, reconciliations, financial statements, cash forecasting, and daily finance processes. The Controller manages staff and outside providers as applicable while remaining able to personally execute, review, troubleshoot, and correct accounting work. The role collaborates with the Managing Partners and fractional CFO on budgeting, financial analysis, and systems improvements; primary accountability is accurate and timely operational execution.

Duties:

  • Design, document, execute, and test internal accounting controls, including approvals, segregation of duties, bank and credit-card controls, and close checklists.
  • Own the preparation and execution of the annual budget process, departmental input schedules, rolling forecasts, and budget-to-actual reporting, in coordination with the Managing Partners and fractional CFO.
  • Maintain compliance-ready accounting records and coordinate with payroll, tax, audit, and other advisers; escalate regulatory, trust-account, and remittance issues promptly to responsible leadership.
  • Perform and review monthly reconciliations of every material balance sheet account, including bank and credit-card accounts, accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll liabilities, accrued expenses, and retirement-plan liabilities; investigate and resolve reconciling items.
  • Prepare accurate monthly financial statements and partner-ready reporting, including explanations of material variances, key assumptions, unreconciled balances, and risks. Independently validate figures before distribution.
  • Prepare and maintain a 13-week cash forecast and longer-range liquidity projections using reconciled starting cash, verified AR collection assumptions, AP, payroll, taxes, distributions, and other committed cash flows; reconcile projected cash changes to underlying drivers.
  • Maintain separate entity-level accounting for the law firm and MSO and prepare accurate consolidated management reporting, including intercompany balances and allocations.
  • Account correctly for legal-service revenue, reimbursable costs, government filing fees, pass-through client charges, and trust/IOLTA balances, including appropriate segregation and reconciliation of client funds.
  • Maintain reliable AR aging and collections reporting, AP aging and payment controls, billing-to-cash reconciliations, and documented review of outstanding payments and uncleared transactions.
  • Manage the monthly close calendar, assign preparer/reviewer responsibilities, complete reconciliations and adjusting entries, and deliver financial statements by agreed deadlines; flag delays before deadlines are missed.
  • Guiding financial decisions by establishing, monitoring, and enforcing policies and procedures.
  • Providing support to management, particularly to attorneys and managing partners.
  • Creating reports that help senior leadership/attorneys understand company financials.
  • Maintain documented procedures and an up-to-date register of deliverables, owners, due dates, dependencies, and unresolved issues; escalate inaccurate or incomplete information rather than presenting estimates as validated actuals.
  • Own the accounting workstream of financial systems implementations, including workflow design, master-data validation, integrations, testing, reconciliation, training, issue logs, and post-go-live controls; coordinate with internal and external implementation leads.
  • Own the general ledger, journal entries, accruals, account classifications, period-end adjustments, and accuracy/completeness of the accounting records for each entity and consolidated reporting.

About you:

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business/Accounting/Finance or a related discipline

Experience:

  • At least 7 years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 3 recent years in a hands-on Controller or Accounting Manager role with direct responsibility for close, GL, reconciliations, financial statements, and staff review; CFO-only oversight experience without recent hands-on execution is insufficient.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency, including multi-sheet financial models, linked schedules, lookup functions, pivot tables, formula auditing, and reconciling model outputs to source systems.
  • Demonstrated ownership of accounting-process improvement and accounting-system implementation/testing; able to execute independently rather than serve only as a project sponsor.
  • Demonstrated hands-on QuickBooks Online proficiency, including bank reconciliations, journal entries, account mapping, AR/AP, close, and reporting; experience with legal practice management/billing systems (LeanLaw or comparable) strongly preferred.
  • Recent professional-services accounting experience required; law firm accounting strongly preferred, including time and billing, WIP, realization, revenue recognition, reimbursable versus pass-through amounts, and government filing fees. Familiarity with trust/IOLTA accounting and multi-entity/MSO structures strongly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Understanding of applicable laws and regulations.
  • Understanding of economic principles, financial markets, and banking.
  • Understanding of financial data analysis and reporting.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform and supervise payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank and credit-card reconciliations, account analyses, and cash forecasting—not merely general familiarity.
  • Ability to meet a documented close calendar, prioritize competing deliverables, clearly disclose incomplete work or unverified assumptions, and escalate deadline or accuracy risks early.

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu

The Associate Product Operations Manager (APOM) is the delivery layer of Product Ops. That means you own your workstreams from intake to handoff, with the kind of discipline and rigor that makes downstream teams trust what comes from you.

The core scope includes: PCR intake and triage, Product Enablement Package (PEP) production, and launch readiness. You run the PCR lifecycle with quality and care. You write PEPs that people actually use. You take pride in clean handoffs.

This is a rotation-based role. Every 6-12 months you move to a new vertical pod: Consumer, Shopper, Enterprise. You build real product sense across all of them. Each rotation is a workstream you own end-to-end, not a support assignment. That breadth is what sets you up for the next level.

AI fluency isn't optional, but instead it's how the team works and works faster. You use AI tools regularly to accelerate your core deliverables, and you know the difference between a draft that's ready and one that still needs your judgment.

About the Team

Product Operations is organized into three pillars: Vertical Partnership Pods, Intelligence & Systems (the Horizontal), and the Enablement Team. This role is within the Enablement Team.

The Enablement Team is the shared engine that keeps launches moving. It's a centralized pool of team members, deployed to wherever priorities are highest. We execute inside the verticals, use the infrastructure the Horizontal builds, and feed back the cross-domain patterns we see across rotations. Our work is foundational to the team's promise of making outcomes more likely, faster, and more durable.

Your manager manages your deployments and development. Your pod partners are your day-to-day collaborators. The Horizontal is the infrastructure team and your systems partner.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • Own PCR intake end-to-end: validate problem statements, assess routing, and make sure everything is clean before it hits a vertical pod
  • Handle Tier 2 triage, the judgment calls that go beyond what the automated system can resolve on its own
  • Write and maintain PEPs, using AI-assisted drafts as your starting point and owning the quality, accuracy, and stakeholder fit of the final version
  • Drive launch readiness in your assigned area, coordinating with stakeholders so the people who depend on launches aren't caught off guard
  • Pull together customer signal and quality data into structured summaries that feed the Horizontal's intelligence work
  • Run PRDs through the PRD enabler and deliver results to POMs and Product with clear framing, not just raw output
  • Surface at least one cross-domain insight to the Horizontal per deployment — you're in a unique position to see patterns across pods, and that's part of the job
  • Use AI as a real part of your workflow: for triage, drafting, research, onboarding — and always edit before you share
  • Build the kind of cross-domain product sense across your rotations that's the foundation for cluster ownership at L5

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years in product operations, project management, business analytics, or related field, preferably in a technology or product-driven environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira or a similar project management tool
  • Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience in SQL and proficiency with Excel and/or Google Sheets.
  • Demonstrated use of AI-driven or automation tools to streamline operations.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across functions, communicate effectively, and advocate for customers.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience in go-to-market planning or product launch operations.
  • Prior success in a tech, SaaS, consumer product, or marketplace company.
  • Familiarity with BI and data visualization platforms (e.g., Mode, Looker, Tableau).
  • Experience establishing customer feedback mechanisms to drive process or product improvements.
  • Demonstrated initiative and ownership for cross-team process improvements or automations.

What you’ll bring

Required

  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise software implementation or architecture, including several large-scale transformation or core system projects.
  • 4+ years of hands-on Guidewire InsuranceSuite implementation experience (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ClaimCenter), including configuration and integration.
  • Strong expertise in at least one of: Gosu, Java, or similar object-oriented languages, plus solid understanding of REST/SOAP integrations, messaging, and batch processing.
  • Proven experience designing end-to-end architectures covering configuration, integrations, data migration considerations, and non-functional requirements.

As a Recruitment Coordinator at Mintskill HR Solutions LLP, you will play a critical role in managing client relationships, ensuring smooth recruitment operations, and supporting the internal hiring team. Unlike internal HR roles, this position focuses on external recruitment coordination for our esteemed clients in the banking, financial services, and allied industries. Your responsibilities will ensure timely closures, improve client satisfaction, and streamline candidate life cycles.

  • Develop a deeper understanding of client hiring preferences by proactively seeking insights on:

    • Ideal candidate profiles

    • Selection history

    • Interview processes and number of rounds

    • Factors that contribute to successful closures

  • Build rapport with clients to encourage continuous inflow of job mandates.

  • Act as the communication bridge for any interview rescheduling, feedback delays, or process clarifications.

2. Candidate Management & Coordination
