  • Collect and verify candidate documentation and share it with internal stakeholders and client SPOCs.

3. Recruitment Operations & ATS Management

  • Ensure timely entry and update of all job positions and interview opportunities in the Line-Up application and internal ATS.

  • Post job openings on LinkedIn and other job portals; track and respond to applications.

  • Maintain accurate records of selection status, interview attendance, and offer acceptance.

  • Support the team in maintaining joining trackers, line-up sheets, and master data files.

4. MIS & Reporting

  • Create and update daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for candidate status, client feedback, selection ratios, and joining status.

  • Generate and share recruitment performance matrices (such as LAP – Line-up Application Performance).

  • Provide recruitment marketing support by sharing performance highlights, job branding content, and candidate success stories.

5. Internal Team Support & Coordination

  • Serve as the go-to person for resolving internal team queries related to candidate progress, client feedback, and onboarding instructions.

  • Ensure recruitment consultants regularly update ATS and Line-up systems with real-time data.

  • Share consolidated status updates with team leads and management to facilitate decision-making and forecasting.

6. Training & Tools Onboarding

  • Train new team members and joiners on using internal tools like ATS, Naukri RMS, WhatsApp API, and Google Sheets.

  • Support internal documentation and knowledge sharing to ensure process standardization.

  • Strong communication and client-handling skills

  • Attention to detail and proficiency in managing multiple open roles simultaneously

  • Experience in recruitment coordination or client servicing in a consultancy/executive search firm preferred

  • Knowledge of ATS systems, job portals (e.g., Naukri, LinkedIn), Google Workspace and CANVA designing tool

jobs.description:
Boosters — це українська продуктова компанія. Ми створюємо глобальні продукти в сферах EdTech, Productivity та Wellness, які несуть цінність для 60 мільйонів людей. Для нас важливо будувати продукти з довготривалим впливом — системні, масштабні та здатні залишатися актуальними десятиліттями.

Можливо, ти вже знаєш наш флагманський продукт JustDone або спін-оффи — Avrora та Promova.

Тепер ми запускаємо новий продукт у сфері персональної цифрової безпеки та шукаємо Full-Stack Product Engineer, який долучиться до команди на ранньому етапі. Основна метацієї ролі - збільшувати ревеню компанії через розробку та розвиток продуктових фічей, які допомагають залучати нових користувачів і довше утримувати існуючих.

Твоє майбутнє середовище

Ти приєднаєшся до невеликої інженерної команди, де кожен має реальний вплив на продукт і власну зону відповідальності. Тут не буде багаторівневої бюрократії чи готових рішень — ти зможеш самостійно будувати інфраструктуру, розвивати ключові фічі та разом із Tech Lead визначати технічні підходи.

Працюватимеш пліч-о-пліч з Олександром, Нікітою та Сергієм.

Лідер напрямку — Олександр Лісік, General Manager. Для Саші важливо, щоб розробник мав достатньо свободи у своїй зоні відповідальності, тому тут немає мікроменеджменту. Натомість є довіра, відкритий діалог, регулярний двосторонній фідбек і постійний пошук нових підходів до роботи. Окремий фокус - активне використання AI у щоденній роботі та обмін інженерною експертизою.

Ми свідомо будуємо середовище без технічних компромісів. Працюємо з AWS, використовуємо best-in-class інструменти та готові інвестувати в сервіси, які допомагають команді швидше створювати якісний продукт.

Саме в цій ролі ти отримаєш

  • 📌 Можливість будувати, а не підтримувати legacy - ти приєднаєшся до продукту на ранньому етапі, де більшість технічних рішень ще можна приймати з нуля.
  • 📌 Реальну автономію в технічній зоні - матимеш власні задачі та відповідальність, самостійно прийматимеш рішення без зайвої бюрократії.
  • 📌 Можливість працювати над складними backend та infrastructure задачами - від архітектури й системного дизайну до AI-інфраструктури та власних технічних рішень для продукту.

Твоя зона впливу

  • Брати участь у розвитку фічей на всіх етапах - від ідеї та дизайну до розробки, релізу й аналізу результатів.
  • Аналізувати ринок і конкурентів, знаходити цікаві рішення та пропонувати нові фічі для продукту.
  • Розробляти та розвивати backend і продуктові фічі, а за потреби - працювати з frontend частиною продукту.
  • Разом із Tech Lead обговорювати архітектурні рішення та підходи до побудови систем.
  • Проєктувати та розвивати інфраструктурні рішення для продукту.
  • Розвивати AI-native engineering environment, який дозволяє команді використовувати агентний кодинг та самостійно й безпечно розробляти й запускати рішення.
  • Підвищувати стабільність, надійність і масштабованість технічних рішень.

Для цього тобі знадобиться

  • Від 4 років досвіду в backend-розробці або Full-Stack із фокусом на backend. А також для нас важливий досвід роботи в продуктовій компанії.
  • Впевнений досвід Node.js + TypeScript.
  • Досвід frontend-розробки на React або Next.js з TypeScript.

  • Experience marketing to frontline and operations audiences

Compensation Package:

jobs.description:
Business Continuity, Information Security & Cybersecurity Manager

In GFT Italia stiamo potenziando il team Operations e Cybersecurity e cerchiamo una figura chiave che contribuisca a rafforzare la resilienza organizzativa, la sicurezza delle informazioni e lo sviluppo delle capability Cybersecurity di nuova generazione. Il ruolo combina responsabilità operative e strategiche in ambito Business Continuity, Information Security, Zero Trust, Digital Identity e AI Security, con l'obiettivo di proteggere gli asset aziendali, garantire la conformità normativa e supportare l'evoluzione delle offerte Cybersecurity di GFT.

Si tratta di una posizione ad alto impatto, con forte esposizione internazionale e la possibilità di influenzare processi, strategie e nuove iniziative di business.

Cosa farai

Information Security & Governance

Sarai responsabile della gestione e dell'evoluzione del sistema di sicurezza delle informazioni a livello locale:

  • Gestirai e svilupperai l'Information Security Management System (ISMS).

  • Tradurrai requisiti normativi, regolamentari e contrattuali in controlli e processi operativi efficaci.

  • Collaborerai con le funzioni locali, il SOC globale, il DPO e gli stakeholder internazionali.

  • Coordinerai attività di risk management, compliance, vulnerability management e incident handling.

  • Promuoverai iniziative di miglioramento continuo della postura di sicurezza aziendale.

  • Definirai e diffonderai framework e modelli di governance della sicurezza allineati agli standard di mercato.

Certificazioni e Compliance

Sarai il riferimento per la gestione delle certificazioni aziendali:

  • Supervisione del mantenimento e del miglioramento delle certificazioni.

  • Coordinamento degli audit interni ed esterni.

  • Monitoraggio della conformità agli standard internazionali.

  • Supporto alla definizione e all'implementazione delle azioni correttive e di miglioramento.

Business Continuity Management

Contribuirai alla resilienza operativa dell'organizzazione:

  • Coordinerai tutte le attività di Business Continuity in Italia.

  • Gestirai e aggiornerai Business Continuity Plan (BCP) e Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP).

  • Presiederai processi di gestione degli incidenti, escalation e recovery.

  • Supporterai Business Impact Analysis (BIA), piani di risposta e test periodici.

  • Garantirai l'allineamento alle linee guida e ai framework globali di Business Continuity.

Zero Trust & Digital Identity

Guiderai l'evoluzione delle capability di sicurezza moderne:

  • Definirai e promuoverai architetture e servizi basati su principi Zero Trust.

  • Supporterai iniziative in ambito Identity Security, IAM, PAM e Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA).

  • Contribuirai alla protezione delle identità digitali di utenti, applicazioni, workload e sistemi automatizzati.

  • Collaborerai alla definizione di architetture sicure per ambienti Cloud e ibridi.

AI Security & Secure AI Engineering

Sosterrai l'adozione sicura delle tecnologie di Artificial Intelligence:

  • Contribuirai alla definizione di approcci di sicurezza per Generative AI e Agentic AI.

  • Promuoverai principi di Security-by-Design e Secure AI Engineering.

  • Supporterai iniziative di DevSecOps, Secure SDLC e continuous remediation.

  • Collaborerai all'identificazione e alla mitigazione dei rischi associati a modelli AI, LLM, agenti autonomi e sistemi intelligenti.

Cybersecurity Advisory & Business Development

Contribuirai allo sviluppo delle capability e delle offerte Cybersecurity di GFT:

  • Identificherai esigenze e opportunità presso clienti e stakeholder interni.

  • Supporterai attività di advisory, presales, go-to-market e solutioning.

  • Collaborerai con CISO, CIO, CTO e management dei clienti nella definizione di strategie di sicurezza.

  • Svilupperai relazioni con vendor e partner tecnologici di riferimento.

  • Contribuirai alla crescita della practice Cybersecurity e alla definizione di nuove offerte e acceleratori.

Requisiti essenziali:

  • Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in Information Security, Cybersecurity e Business Continuity.

  • Solida conoscenza degli standard ISO 27001, ISO 22301 e ISO 9001.

  • Esperienza nella gestione di ISMS, audit, compliance e certificazioni.

  • Competenze consolidate in Risk Management, Incident Management e Security Governance.

  • Esperienza nelle architetture Zero Trust e nei modelli di Identity Security.

  • Conoscenza di Identity & Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM) e ZTNA.

  • Esperienza in Security Architecture, Cloud Security e Security-by-Design.

  • Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese.

Competenze altamente desiderabili:

  • AI Security, Generative AI Security e Agentic AI Security.

  • Machine Identity, Non-Human Identity (NHI) e AI Agent Identity.

  • Large Language Model (LLM) Security.

  • Model Context Protocol (MCP) Security.

  • DevSecOps e Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC).

  • Data Loss Prevention (DLP).

  • Security Service Edge (SSE) e Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).

  • Esperienza con ecosistema Zscaler (ZIA, ZPA, Zero Trust Exchange).

  • Esperienza nella definizione di offerte Cybersecurity e nello sviluppo di practice specialistiche.

Cosa offriamo

Range retributivo: 55.000k - 66.000k + variabile + benefit

L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi.
La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

Chi siamo?

GFT Technologies SE (GFT) fondata nel 1987, è oggi rappresentata da un team globale di circa 12.000 dipendenti in Europa, Nord e Sud America e Asia. Siamo costantemente impegnati a guidare la trasformazione digitale nel settore dei servizi finanziari, forniamo consulenza alle principali istituzioni finanziarie a livello mondiale e sviluppiamo soluzioni IT su misura – dalle applicazioni bancarie e sistemi di trading fino all’implementazione e al supporto di piattaforme complete, e modernization di sistemi core banking. Il nostro innovation team, che opera a livello globale, sviluppa, inoltre, nuovi modelli di business, focalizzandosi su temi quali blockchain, cloud engineering, intelligenza artificiale e Internet of Things, trasversalmente in tutti i settori.

In GFT potrai lavorare da remoto 5/5. Per informazioni sulle nostre policy sulla Privacy art13 L.679/2016 (GDPR), Diversity Equality & Inclusion, e Sostenibilità vai su: gft.com/it/it/about-us/Sustainability. GFT Technologies garantisce le pari opportunità nel percorso di selezione, assunzione e nei processi di crescita professionale.

GFT aderisce ai principi della Direttiva UE 2023/970 sulla Pay Transparency, promuovendo equità, inclusione e pari opportunità in ogni fase del percorso professionale. About Salesforce

We're growing faster than a penguin on a waterslide and we’re always on the hunt for customer-obsessed problem-solvers to help our clients unlock the full potential of their AI investments.

This isn’t some futuristic sci-fi movie set, this is AI for the real, gritty, essential world of healthcare where speed & data matter.

Your Epic Quest as Our Staff Engineer

The Staff Engineer finds the problems worth solving and sees them through. They drive technical direction with their own ideas and the evidence to back them, set the standard for technical quality from the code they write to the systems running in production, make AI a reliable part of how engineering work gets done, and raise the level of the engineers around them and of those we hire.

Your Day-to-Day Superpowers: What You’ll Actually Do:

  • Solve the problems that matter:Identify what limits how fast the business can move, advocate for solutions with the people who own the decision, and drive the agreed fix through, working with the owners of every system involved

  • Make AI a reliable part of engineering:Use AI throughout your work and answer for its output as your own. With your peers, define where it can be trusted, where it needs closer review, and what must always be verified, so results are consistent across engineers
  • Represent engineering:Represent engineering to internal and external customers as a confident technology leader: prepared, plain about trade-offs, and bringing the team along

Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Senior Pricing Analyst to support competitive proposal development and ongoing contract pricing activities across our federal portfolio.

Reporting to the EVP, Contracts & Pricing, you will own the development of cost volumes, pricing models, rate structures, and pricing strategies that meet FAR, DFARS, and agency-specific requirements, providing proposal teams with the pricing foundation they need to win new and follow-on business. This role is first and foremost a pricing role; the ideal candidate brings deep expertise in government cost and price analysis, proposal pricing strategy, and rate development. In addition to core pricing responsibilities, this professional will be able to support other contractual and forecasting activities across the portfolio, providing expertise as bandwidth allows.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: 100% telework. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Required Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • 8 or more years of federal government pricing experience, including direct experience preparing price/cost volumes for competitive proposals.
  • Working knowledge of FAR, DFARS, Cost Accounting Standards (CAS), and TINA requirements.
  • Experience with all major contract types: IDIQ, FFP, T&M, Cost-Plus (CPFF, CPAF, CPIF), and GSA schedule vehicles.
  • Experience developing pricing strategy aligned to win themes, competitive positioning, and customer priorities.
  • Experience developing basis of estimates (BOEs) with the solution architect team to justify the price and document any assumptions and risks.
  • Experience applying forward pricing rates and understanding their impact on contract pricing.
  • Prior experience supporting DCAA audits, DCMA reviews, CPSR Reviews and customer fact-finding sessions.
  • Familiarity with contract administration activities, including modifications, funding actions, and subcontract management.
  • Experience identifying and mitigating Organizational Conflict of Interest (OCI) terms in federal contracts.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the end-to-end teaming partner and subcontractor pricing intake process for competitive federal proposals, including issuing pricing requests and templates, enforcing partner submission deadlines, reviewing partner cost submissions for completeness and FAR/DFARS compliance, reconciling labor categories and rate structures across multiple partners, and integrating validated partner data into the Valiant cost model.
  • Experience negotiating subcontractor pricing terms, including rates, ceilings, escalation, and labor category mapping, under live proposal timelines.
  • Experience responding to prime contractor pricing data calls when serving as a subcontractor or teaming partner, including interpreting prime-provided templates and instructions, preparing cost inputs in the prime's required format, coordinating internal approvals on rate disclosures and proprietary data, defending rates and assumptions through prime clarification cycles, and meeting prime-imposed deadlines that precede the solicitation due date.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel for pricing model development, including dynamic models, complex formulas, and large data sets.
  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust security clearance.
  • Organized, reliable, and able to manage multiple competing priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desired Experience:

  • Strong working knowledge of federal contract management, including cradle-to-grave contract administration, subcontract management, and post-award compliance — sufficient to serve as a knowledgeable partner to the Contracts team on pricing-related contract actions.
  • Experience supporting DoD, DHS, or civilian agency procurements.
  • Proficiency in Unanet or comparable contract and project accounting systems.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce.com for pipeline and opportunity management.
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Acrobat for price/cost volume production and submission.
  • Experience conducting price-to-win (PTW) analysis, competitive positioning assessments, and should-cost modeling.

Responsibilities:

Pricing

  • Build cost-volume and price-to-win models for competitive federal proposals across all contract types, including IDIQ, FFP, Cost-Plus, T&M, and GSA Schedule vehicles.
  • Develop labor category structures, staffing matrices, and wrap-rate calculations aligned with Valiant's indirect rate structures.
  • Translate technical and management approaches into defensible pricing narratives and basis of estimates (BOEs) that evaluators can follow and score.
  • Review RFPs, RFQs, and solicitations to identify pricing requirements, Representations and Certifications, and compliance obligations before proposal development begins.
  • Lead proposal pricing kick-off meetings, Green Teams, and own participation in price review gates, and final management reviews to ensure cost volumes are complete, compliant, and competitive.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager, India
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Lifecycle Marketing Manager, IndiaRemote (India) | Full-Time Also searched as: Lifecycle Communications Manager, CRM Manager, Email Marketing Manager, Marketing Automation Manager What would you do if every email and SMS a student and their family receives from us was yours to own?
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Lifecycle Marketing Manager, IndiaRemote (India) | Full-Time

Also searched as: Lifecycle Communications Manager, CRM Manager, Email Marketing Manager, Marketing Automation Manager

What would you do if every email and SMS a student and their family receives from us was yours to own?

On a typical day you might lock a student and guardian welcome with Academics in the morning, build the incomplete-onboarding branch in HubSpot after lunch, and rewrite a class-change SMS before end of day so nobody gets two different rooms.

About Contour

We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. This role sits in Marketing, which owns student and guardian communications, events, and the brand.

You shape how families hear from Contour.

About This Role

You own every external email and SMS sent to students and guardians, from enrolment through re-engagement. You report to the Chief Marketing Officer. They own marketing strategy and brand. Everything else on the communications calendar is yours.

The standard here is different in two specific ways. First, the way you write: a student welcome, a guardian welcome, and a 160-character class SMS all land differently, on purpose. Second, you do not send what you are given if the information is missing or unclear, or it contradicts itself. You ask, then you chase until you get an answer. Then you send.

You start solo.

This work currently sits across other people. You make it a dedicated function, and you turn one-off sends into journeys that run without someone watching them. By the end of month three, you will have mapped the communications calendar across enrolments, onboarding, class updates, events, reminders, and re-engagement, shipped the first automated enrolment-to-first-class journeys in HubSpot (student versus guardian, automated versus manual), and have engagement reporting the CMO can read without asking. The work you do in those first months will still be in use three years from now.

Where the work lives

  • HubSpot:email, SMS, and lifecycle automation live here. Keeping journeys, lists, and the calendar current in HubSpot is how Academics and Digital Operations see what’s going out without having to ask you. Digital Operations manages the enrolment system and HubSpot itself; you own what gets sent, to whom, and when.

What You Will Do

  • Own all external email and SMS to students and guardians.Enrolments, onboarding, class updates, events, reminders, re-engagement, and academic information. The right message to the right person, on time.

  • Split student and guardian communications on purpose.Guardians get the logistics that matter. Students get what they need to show up prepared. Every send doesn’t go to both.

  • Build automated journeys in HubSpot rather than one-off sends.Enrolment through first week of class is the first one you build: welcome and onboarding chase, then three-day reminder, morning-of-class SMS, followed with post-class check-in. You decide what is automated and what still needs a human.

  • Work with Academics and Digital Operations on what needs to be said and when.Academics can change class information at short notice. You verify, you tell the people who need to be across it, and you stop any scheduled send that would now be wrong.

  • Run a large calendar.Roughly 100 student and guardian communications a month, across programs. You keep owners and approvals visible, and know what depends on what so two sends do not collide and create confusion.

  • Catch a bad brief before it goes out.If a draft says "there may be a room change" and does not name the class, the time, or the room it changes to, you do not send it. You chase the missing piece, ensuring only complete information goes out.

  • Track the right metrics.You track open, click, and completion rates well enough that the CMO reads them without asking you to explain them

If a better tool exists for something we are doing manually, make the case and we will back it.


Requirements

What You Need

  • 4-6 years in lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing, owning email and SMS end to end. This is a strong individual-contributor seat, not a people-manager seat.

  • Writing that is clear and human. A student welcome and a guardian welcome land differently, on purpose. So does a 160-character class SMS.

  • Audience judgment: you can distinguish what everyone needs from what only few people need, and what is transactional from what is engagement.

  • Organisation at volume. You can run a crowded calendar without letting a send slip or duplicate.

  • Automation thinking. You can describe a HubSpot-style journey: trigger, properties, branches, delays, exits, and the safeguards that stop the wrong person getting the wrong message.

  • Comfortable working across the India and Australia time difference.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on HubSpot (email, SMS, workflows)

  • EdTech, tutoring, or another student-and-family audience

  • Experience in an international or multi-country company

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here

The people who do well here see a gap and close it without being asked, holding the bar even when the clock is short. They give a direct read on the work in front of them, including when it's wrong, and when their own idea doesn't hold up, they say so and bring a better one. They build something that keeps running after they step back. Problems here don't show up on schedule or in the same shape twice, and they'd rather make the right call on limited information than let something break while they wait for a sign-off. That's the job. They name the blocker and the ask the moment they have it, on a call or a text, because decisions get made on the information you bring.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What good looks like

  • Right audience, right channel:students and guardians do not get the same email by default.

  • Journeys, not blasts:the enrolment-to-first-class path runs as a system, with a chase if onboarding is incomplete.

  • Nothing contradictory goes out:when class details change, scheduled sends are stopped or rewritten before anyone is confused.

  • You chase the brief:a copy that's missing something, or just vague, does not ship .


Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience, and we discuss it openly early in the process. From application to offer: a short screen, a technical assessment, a culture conversation with our People team, and a final interview with the Chief Marketing Officer in about four weeks.

Apply with a CV and one paragraph on a lifecycle journey you built: who it was for, what triggered it, what you wrote, and what you refused to send until you had the facts.

About the Role

The Technical Support Specialist (TSS) will own, manage, and scale our technical support queue for our market-leading EndoTool (IV & SubQ) glucose management platform.

As a TSS, you will be the primary technical shield and point of contact for our existing healthcare clients. Your main mission is to drive operational excellence by drastically reducing case resolution timelines and managing complex software environments. By owning the day-to-day support queue, you will enable our implementation teams to accelerate software delivery. You will comfortably straddle two worlds: maintaining legacy, mission-critical on-premises deployments while actively supporting our client base as they transition to the modern EndoTool Cloud environment.

** Please note this role while remote is expected to work East Coast working hours and a rotational after hour shift.

What you'll do

  • Support Ticket Management: Triage, investigate, and resolve inbound application and environment support tickets within CRM tracking software (Zendesk/Salesforce).
  • SLA Reduction: Direct ticket workflows and troubleshooting strategies to aggressively drive average case closure rates down
  • Legacy Interoperability Triage: Troubleshoot data flow, connectivity drops, and Medical Record Number (MRN) conversion discrepancies across traditional inbound and outbound HL7 message interfaces.
  • Modern API Interoperability: Analyze and debug modern EMR integration pathways by verifying FHIR API request/response payloads.
  • Clinical Workflow Integration: Support embedded EMR launch mechanisms and single sign-on workflows utilizing SMART on FHIR frameworks across major EHR platforms (Epic, Cerner, Meditech).
  • Identity Management Support: Maintain, test, and resolve user access challenges tied to Single Sign-On (SSO) frameworks, focusing on identity providers like Auth0 and OAuth2 token authentication.
  • System Maintenance & Expansion: Perform post-go-live software upgrades, configuration adjustments, and system unit expansions for existing client hospital systems.
  • Migration Assistance: Help execute technical server migrations, database migrations, and shifts from local hospital hardware to managed hosting or cloud platforms.
  • Critical Incident Coverage: Participate in a scheduled on-call rotation to provide crucial after-hours technical support for Severity 1 & 2 application infrastructure emergencies.
  • Documentation & Archiving: Create, revise, and maintain internal and external technical documentation, system schematics, and historical records of software modifications.

Qualifications

Technical Expertise

  • On-Premises Infrastructure: Direct experience with Windows Server administration, local network topologies, firewall configurations, and secure remote connection utilities is a must.
  • Database Management: Strong proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server and Transact-SQL syntax for querying databases and troubleshooting data integrity issues.
  • Cloud Environments: Foundational exposure to public cloud ecosystems (e.g., Azure or AWS), modern web services (REST APIs), and SaaS monitoring utilities.
  • Healthcare IT Frameworks: Comprehensive understanding of healthcare connectivity standards, including legacy HL7 v2/v3 message specifications, FHIR resources, and OAuth2 security profiles.
  • Strong technical proficiency in configuring, securing, and maintaining authentication/authorization protocols (OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML) with hands-on experience managing Auth0 tenant configurations and integrating with Active Directory.

Professional Competencies & Soft Skills

  • Industry Experience: Minimum of 2 years of technical support or application support experience, ideally operating within a regulated Healthcare IT, Medical Device Software, or B2B SaaS company.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to explain complex infrastructure failures clearly to hospital IT staff, interface analysts, and clinical leads.
  • Critical Thinking: Advanced problem-solving capabilities to systematically isolate root causes across multi-layered software and network environments.
  • Operational Focus: Highly disciplined approach to queue management, showing an ability to prioritize shifting workloads without succumbing to context-switching fatigue.

XTB is a global company from the financial industry, focusing on online trading of financial instruments. We are the largest FinTech in Poland and a leader in Central and Eastern Europe, and the range of our operations covers several countries, including Asia and South America. At XTB, we focus on the development of our employees, giving them opportunities to gain knowledge and skills in various fields, as well as offering a number of training and development programs. If you are looking for challenges and want to gain valuable experience in an international business environment, XTB is the right place for you.

We are a certified Great Place to Work company.

About the role

    We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer to design, build, and scale XTB’s hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure, supporting systems for millions of clients worldwide. In this role, you will drive infrastructure automation and cloud engineering best practices, ensure platform resilience, and shape our highly available environments across multiple cloud providers, ensuring our systems remain robust, secure, and scalable.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain large-scale, highly available multi-cloud and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Deploy and operate containerized workloads using managed Kubernetes services (e.g., AKS, EKS, GKE).
  • Build, maintain, and improve Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
  • Design and implement robust CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, incorporating GitOps principles.
  • Implement and manage core cloud services, including global content delivery, DNS, and object storage (e.g., CloudFront, Route 53, S3).
  • Ensure full operational visibility across cloud infrastructure by setting up metrics, dashboards, and alerts using tools such as Grafana and Prometheus.
  • Implement and manage Identity & Access Management (IAM) policies, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and least-privilege access across cloud environments.
  • Define and enforce Cloud Governance, Landing Zone structures, and Policy-as-Code standards (e.g., Azure Policies, AWS SCPs, tagging strategies).
  • Manage hybrid network connectivity and troubleshoot complex networking issues across distributed cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Collaborate with Security, SRE, and Platform teams to define and drive cloud best practices for observability, compliance, and operational reliability.
  • Support FinOps initiatives to optimize cloud environments for cost efficiency, scalability, and performance.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure with large-scale environments.
  • Proven practical experience with highly available cloud environments in a multi-cloud setup (strong hands-on knowledge of at least two providers: AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Strong understanding of DevOps, Platform Engineering, and GitOps principles.
  • Solid hands-on experience with managed Kubernetes orchestration (e.g., AKS, EKS, GKE).
  • Experience working in regulated industries (e.g., FinTech, banking) with strong compliance, security, auditability, and governance requirements.
  • Strong scripting or programming skills in Python, Bash, or similar languages.
  • Proficiency in creating and maintaining infrastructure using Terraform.
  • Strong experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines, preferably using GitLab CI/CD.
  • Practical experience configuring metrics, dashboards, and alerts using tools like Grafana and Prometheus.
  • Hands-on experience with Identity & Access Management (IAM), RBAC models, and implementing least-privilege security.
  • Solid understanding of hybrid networking concepts (e.g., BGP, VPN, Direct Connect / ExpressRoute, hybrid DNS resolution) and network troubleshooting.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical delivery, and support production-grade environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience with IaC PR-workflow automation and orchestration tools (e.g., Atlantis, Terragrunt).
  • Experience with GitOps delivery tools (e.g., Argo CD, Flux).
  • Experience with the Wiz security platform or similar cloud security posture management (CSPM) tools.
  • Experience with configuration management tools like Ansible.
  • Practical knowledge of FinOps practices and cloud cost optimization strategies.
  • Official certifications from AWS, Azure, GCP, or CNCF (e.g., CKA, CKAD).

What we offer

  • Real influence on the development of the company and the product.

  • Regular team-building meetings.

jobs.excerpt: Position:Quality EngineerJob Description:We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and self-motivated Quality Engineer to join our EMEA Quality team.
jobs.description:
Position:

Quality Engineer

Job Description:

We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and self-motivated Quality Engineer to join our EMEA Quality team. This is an exciting opportunity for a quality professional who is passionate about driving continuous improvement, ensuring regulatory compliance, and maintaining the highest standards of quality across our operations.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting and enhancing our Quality Management System (QMS), working closely with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve quality issues, improve processes, and ensure compliance with customer and regulatory requirements.

As this position will support customers and operations within the Italian market, fluency in Italian and English is essential.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Management & Compliance

  • Support the development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS) in line with customer requirements and applicable standards.
  • Maintain Quality Assurance system data and quality documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with customer requirements, regulatory obligations, and industry standards.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of the QMS and recommend improvements to enhance performance and efficiency.
  • Support internal and external audits, including customer audits, and ensure timely closure of corrective actions.

Customer Quality & Problem Resolution

  • Serve as the primary customer liaison for quality-related issues and inquiries.
  • Lead structured problem-solving activities, including Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and 8D investigations.
  • Drive the implementation and verification of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to prevent recurrence of non-conformities.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships through professional and responsive communication.

Continuous Improvement

  • Conduct fault trend analysis to identify recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.
  • Utilize quality tools and methodologies to improve process effectiveness and quality.
  • Participate in and support continuous improvement initiatives across the business.
  • Analyze operational processes and recommend improvements to enhance quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Sales, Engineering, and Distribution Centre teams to support business objectives and quality performance.
  • Support new business opportunities by providing quality expertise during customer engagement and onboarding activities.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer expectations and quality standards are consistently achieved.

Reporting & Performance Monitoring

  • Develop, monitor, and report on quality metrics and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Prepare quality reports and present findings, trends, and recommendations to management.
  • Ensure accurate and timely reporting of quality performance data.

Qualifications & Experience

Essential Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in a Quality Engineering, Quality Assurance, or related role.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 9001 and Quality Management Systems.
  • Experience leading customer-facing quality investigations and corrective action activities.
  • Fluency in Italian and English (written and spoken).

Technical Competencies

  • Thorough understanding of quality management principles and methodologies.
  • Experience using quality tools including:
    • 8D Problem Solving
    • Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
    • Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
    • Statistical Process Control (SPC)
    • Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA)
    • 5 Whys
    • Fishbone (Ishikawa) Diagrams
  • Ability to analyze data and identify trends to drive improvement initiatives.

Personal Attributes

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Highly organized with the ability to effectively prioritize workload and manage multiple tasks.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team environment.
  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes.

Software Skills

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly:
    • Excel
    • Word
    • PowerPoint

Why Join Us?

You will become part of a dynamic EMEA Quality team where your expertise will directly contribute to customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. This role offers the opportunity to work across multiple functions, influence business performance, and play a key role in maintaining world-class quality standards.

Who we are

As Arrow Global Components, part of Arrow Electronics, we are a leader in distribution and value-added services related to electronic components. We resell, customize and distribute electronic components to customers around the world. Our business is built on trusted, long-term relationships with leading suppliers and customers.

Find more information about us here:

Annual Hiring Range (for a full-time employee)

On Target Earnings (Base + Target Variable Pay)

31,500 to 53,000 EUR

Base Salary Hiring Range

28,636 to 48,182 EUR

Actual compensation offer to candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level. The pay ratio between base pay and target incentive (if applicable) will be finalized at offer. Internal candidates who have current pay within or above the hiring range are still encouraged to apply if interested. 

This position might include a benefits package tailored to the specific country of employment. Detailed information on the specific benefits (if any), compensation structure, and contractual terms for your location will be provided during the hiring process.

Arrow is committed to equal pay for equal work. We provide upfront salary transparency and do not request past salary history from any candidate.

Submit CV in English

jobs.description:
Overview

SailPoint is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Partner Manager to lead and develop our Japan partner ecosystem.

The Partner Manager will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic partner strategy that expands SailPoint’s market reach, strengthens partner capabilities and accelerates growth through the partner ecosystem. The role will serve as a key liaison between SailPoint and our partners, aligning business priorities, go-to-market strategies and joint growth objectives.

The successful candidate will have a proven track record in partner management and channel development within the enterprise software industry, with the ability to collaborate effectively across account sales, inside sales, marketing, solution engineering, professional services, customer success, legal, contracts, operations, global programs and worldwide & regional leadership teams.

This is a hands-on, entrepreneurial role requiring strong business acumen, strategic thinking, excellent communication skills, and a strong bias toward action. The Partner Manager will be expected to build trusted executive relationships, identify new market opportunities, create pipeline and drive measurable business outcomes through strategic partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive partner ecosystem strategy aligned with SailPoint’s business priorities and growth objectives.
  • Build and strengthen strategic relationships with key partners including consulting partners, system integrators, technology partners and distributors.
  • Identify, recruit and onboard new strategic partners to expand SailPoint's coverage and penetrate new emerging markets.
  • Leverage distributor and partner networks to increase SailPoint’s market presence and reach.
  • Collaborate closely with the field sales organization to identify new business opportunities and generate net-new pipeline and revenue.
  • Embed SailPoint’s solutions, technology and value proposition into partners’ go-to-market strategies and solution portfolios.
  • Establish a regular business review cadence with strategic partners to identify opportunities, track performance and drive mutual business outcomes.
  • Develop and execute partner enablement programs to strengthen partner sales, technical and delivery capabilities.
  • Drive partner delivery certifications and accreditations to strengthen implementation capabilities and ensure successful customer outcomes.
  • Develop and execute joint partner marketing strategies to generate market awareness, demand, pipeline and net-new opportunities.
  • Collaborate with partners on campaigns, field events, account-based initiatives and other demand-generation activities.
  • Ensure partners are aligned with SailPoint’s vision, product roadmap, corporate strategy and go-to-market priorities.
  • Ensure compliance on corporate channel policies, partner programs, operational processes, legal and contractual requirements.
  • Establish and maintain strong executive-level relationships across SailPoint and strategic partner organizations.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and key point of contact between SailPoint and partner leadership teams.
  • Influence cross-functional stakeholders and mobilize internal resources to support partner success and accelerate joint business outcomes.
  • Demonstrate leadership, integrity, accountability and creativity while operating within SailPoint’s high-performance and collaborative culture.

Requirements:

  • 15+years of proven experience in partner management, channel sales, alliances, or business development within the enterprise software industry.
  • Demonstrated success in developing and executing partner strategies that drive pipeline, revenue, and market growth.
  • Strong understanding of distributor, systems integrator, consulting and technology partner ecosystem.
  • Experience developing joint business plans, partner enablement programs, marketing initiatives and executive-level engagements.
  • Strong commercial and entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and translate them into measurable business outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, relationship-building and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to operate independently, take ownership and execute with a strong bias toward action.
  • Adapt and learn new and disruptive technologies
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence across multiple functions and organizational levels.
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, confidence, and accountability.
  • Experience in cybersecurity, identity security, non-human identity, Agentic AI, or other enterprise technology solutions is highly desirable.
  • Business proficiency in English is required to effectively engage with internal stakeholders across SailPoint’s global organization.

The path to success:

In setting the right foundations, you should achieve these milestones during your 1st month with the company.

  • Understand the SailPoint partner program
  • Understand the value proposition of SailPoint and the growth drivers in APJ
  • Segment and prioritize your partners in each market
  • Meet with the regional leaders to develop cross-functional collaboration

Continuing to build those foundations you should have achieved these milestones by the end of your 2nd month.

  • Understand the partner onboarding and enablement process
  • Meet with partners to understand their value proposition and services offered
  • Weekly meeting with sales management and AEs to align on field engagements
  • Develop partner market segmentation and playbooks

Building on the foundations, you should have achieved these milestones by the end of your 3rd month.

  • Meet with strategic and focused partners to develop a business plan
  • Map our key priorities with the GTM initiatives of our partners
  • Work with the AEs on their top accounts and partner engagement

By the end of your 4th month, in addition to the attainment and continued development of your first 3 months activities, you will have:

  • Develop the partner strategy for optimal market coverage
  • Develop joint GTM offerings and marketing activities for pipeline generation
  • Enablement plans to increase the sales and delivery capacity

On completing your first successful 6 months in this role at SailPoint you will have:

  • Develop the business plans with our strategic and focus partners for pipeline generation, GTM initiatives and customer success
  • Define the route to market to maximize the win rates
  • Lead an operational cadence to engage partners with business and deal reviews
  • Drive adoption of SailPoint accreditations and delivery certifications

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.

The Senior Informaticist works in the Process Insights team to analyze and provide quantitative insights from our AI Process Insights tools. They may coordinate with other analytics, IT and business areas across the organization to ensure work is completed with insights from knowledge SMEs. The Senior Informaticist work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

Program Summary

The Simplification Center of Excellence (CoE) is building a new enterprise capability that helps teams create simpler, more effective, and more human‑centered solutions for associates, members, patients, and providers. Joining this team means contributing directly to how the organization understands work today and builds better experiences for the future.

The CoE develops shared tools, methods, and guidance that support teams from discovery through delivery—bringing together process insight, research, ideation, rapid prototyping, and impact assessment to improve both speed and quality of outcomes. By establishing these capabilities, the team enables more informed decisions, stronger solution design, and greater confidence in what gets built and delivered.

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Informaticist to serve as a data and analytics expert within our process intelligence/mining program, working alongside a Program Manager. In this role you will contribute deep analytical expertise, translating complex process and operational data into clear, actionable insights that drive decision-making, prioritization, and continuous improvement.

You will leverage AI process mining tools such as Skan AI, and enterprise data sources to interpret how work is performed, identify meaningful patterns, and help define the metrics that matter most. Using tools such as Power BI and advanced visualization techniques, you will design, build, and continuously refine dashboards and infographics that make insights intuitive, compelling, and immediately usable by leaders and delivery teams. Your ability to combine quantitative analysis with strong visual storytelling will ensure data is not only accurate, but actionable.


Use your skills to make an impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and support the data strategy for each program that is onboarding to a task mining initiative.
  • Assess data readiness; identify source systems, event logs, and required data feeds for each program.
  • Interpret process, operational, and engagement data generated through task mining and related data sources to support insight generation for a single operational engagement.
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards using Power BI, translating complex data into clear, intuitive views tailored to the needs of the pod and operational team.
  • Work collaboratively with the Program Manager and operational partners to define, refine, and monitor key metrics and KPIs that reflect engagement goals and performance.
  • Apply creativity and visual storytelling techniques to experiment with infographics and alternative data visualizations, making insights easier to understand and act upon.
  • Analyze trends, patterns, and variances in data to surface opportunities, risks, and emerging signals relevant to the engagement.
  • Iterate on dashboards and visuals based on user feedback, changing engagement needs, and evolving questions, ensuring outputs remain relevant and actionable.
  • Clearly communicate analytical findings through concise narratives and visuals that support discussion, decision-making, and next steps within the pod.

Core Skills & Attributes

  • Data Interpretation & Analytical Thinking
    Strong ability to interpret complex process and operational data, identify patterns and trends, and translate findings into meaningful insights aligned to engagement goals.
  • Dashboard Design & Data Visualization
    Proven experience designing and modifying dashboards in Power BI, with an emphasis on clarity, usability, and visual storytelling rather than static reporting.
  • Creative Use of Infographics
    High level of creativity in experimenting with infographics and alternative visual formats to make data intuitive, engaging, and action‑oriented.
  • Metrics & KPI Development
    Experience working with stakeholders to define, refine, and monitor key metrics and KPIs that support operational understanding and performance tracking.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration
    Comfortable working closely with Program Managers and operational partners within a pod model, adapting analyses and outputs based on evolving questions and feedback.
  • Communication & Data Storytelling
    Ability to communicate insights clearly through concise narratives and visuals, tailoring messages to operational audiences with varying levels of data fluency.
  • Attention to Detail & Data Rigor
    Careful, methodical approach to data validation, consistency, and accuracy, balanced with the ability to move quickly in an engagement‑based environment.
  • Adaptability & Learning Mindset
    Thrives in a dynamic engagement setting, quickly learning new domains, adjusting analytical approaches, and iterating on outputs as needs evolve.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, informatics, business intelligence, or a related analytical discipline, with a focus on operational or process‑oriented data.
  • Hands‑on experience designing, building, and maintaining dashboards in Power BI, including the ability to modify and iterate on existing dashboards as engagement needs evolve.
  • Experience working with process, workflow, or engagement data (e.g., operational metrics, performance data, or AI‑generated process insights) to support analysis and decision‑making.
  • Demonstrated experience defining, refining, and analyzing key metrics and KPIs in partnership with operational or delivery teams.
  • Proven ability to use data visualization, infographics, and visual storytelling techniques to make insights clear, compelling, and actionable for non‑technical audiences.
  • Experience working in a collaborative, pod‑based or cross‑functional team model, partnering closely with program, product, or operational stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor, balancing analytical rigor with flexibility, creativity, and responsiveness in an engagement‑driven environment.

About the role:

Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group. Utilizing research and analytical skills, a Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations.

What you will do:

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have insights” content

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act

  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward

  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing Insights positions across a team of analysts

  • Bring provocative, independent insights to Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda

  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights

  • Provide clients and prospects with actionable advice aligned to their designated content area via virtual or face-to-face interactions

  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings

  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business

  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review

  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy

  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community

  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery

  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members

  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions

What you will need:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience; Graduate degree preferred

  • 12+ years of relevant field or industry experience

  • 8+ years work experience in SaaS/software contract negotiations, technology procurement, category management, vendor management or software asset management within a buying organization, outsourcer, consulting firm, or reseller.

  • 5+ years hands-on experience negotiating Microsoft renewals (including deals within last 12 months) with exposure to MCA, EA and CSP.

  • Subject matter expertise in Microsoft volume licensing with particular focus on commercial aspects, software and cloud services market trends, and reseller ecosystem.

  • Experience with software license compliance risk assessment, management, and/or mitigation in a software audit context, particularly with Microsoft, is desired.

  • Experience negotiating with and managing other major vendors (e.g., AWS, Google, Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, or ServiceNow) is desired.

  • Executive presence; able to immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high quality deliverables

  • Demonstrable excellence in research and writing ability

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges

  • Strong communication skills - able to explain complex concepts concisely and simply

  • Subject matter expertise; comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements

  • Strong business and financial acumen

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market

  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable)

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

jobs.description:
ICF's Disaster Management Division seeks a Director, Emergency Preparedness to lead high-impact emergency management programs, strengthen client readiness, and help communities prepare for and navigate complex disasters. This Remote U.S. role combines technical preparedness leadership, portfolio delivery, client partnership, and business growth, with nationwide travel up to 50%.

The Director will lead all-hazards planning, continuity, training and exercises, capability assessment, stakeholder coordination, and emergency operations support. The role also oversees multiple clients and teams, advances delivery quality and financial performance, and serves as a subject matter expert for strategic pursuits and proposals.

This is an opportunity for an experienced emergency management leader to shape resilient programs, guide multidisciplinary teams, and build trusted relationships with public-sector clients nationwide.

Key Responsibilities-

Emergency Planning and Preparedness
• Lead the development and maintenance of all-hazards Emergency Operations Plans, Emergency Support Function and hazard-specific annexes, continuity plans, crisis communications plans, EOC procedures, SOPs, field guides, and job aids.
• Ensure plans align with federal, state, and local requirements and recognized guidance, including FEMA CPG 101, NIMS, and ICS.
• Conduct hazard, vulnerability, risk, and capability assessments, and coordinate planning across public, private, nonprofit, and community partners.

Training, Exercises, and Continuous Improvement
• Lead integrated, multi-year preparedness, training, and HSEEP-aligned exercise programs, including seminars, workshops, drills, tabletop, functional, and full-scale exercises.
• Oversee exercise design, conduct, and evaluation, including objectives, scenarios, plans, manuals, MSELs, evaluation guides, briefings, and supporting materials.
• Facilitate hotwashes and after-action meetings; deliver After-Action Reports and Improvement Plans; and track corrective actions through completion.

Portfolio and Delivery Oversight
• Own portfolio performance across delivery quality, staffing, utilization, schedules, contracts, budgets, compliance, client satisfaction, and risk.
• Oversee on-call and task-order engagements, manage Project Managers and multidisciplinary teams, and establish clear standards, controls, reporting, and accountability.
• Identify and address delivery, compliance, staffing, financial, and client-retention risks while maintaining applicable FEMA, grant, contract, quality, and audit requirements.

Emergency Response Leadership
• Serve in a leadership or advisory role during EOC activations and incident response operations.
• Apply ICS and NIMS to support situational awareness, resource management, action planning, documentation, executive briefings, and interagency coordination.
• Provide timely recommendations to executive leadership on preparedness, response, continuity, and recovery priorities.

Business Development and Growth
• Grow the portfolio through existing-client expansion, add-on task orders, recompetes, and target-market pursuits.
• Build senior relationships with emergency management agencies, Public Assistance grant recipients, and preparedness and resilience stakeholders.
• Gather market and competitive intelligence and collaborate with portfolio, service line, capture, and technical leaders to advance growth objectives.

Proposal and Capture Leadership
• Lead or oversee proposal development and submission for assigned pursuits and support go/no-go decisions as required.
• Serve as a subject matter expert, solution architect, reviewer, and technical contributor on major emergency management and preparedness pursuits.
• Partner with capture and growth teams on win strategy, competitive positioning, staffing, proof points, pricing inputs, compliance, and proposal quality.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Attached resumes should be concise to clearly indicate your match to the qualifications and experience indicated.

  • Bachelor's degree in Emergency Management, Public Administration, Homeland Security, Public Health, Environmental Science, Business, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of combined emergency management and FEMA-related experience, including 3+ years in a leadership or client-facing capacity.
  • 3+ years of direct experience managing multiple clients, projects, Project Managers, or multidisciplinary teams.
  • 3+ years of direct experience developing, updating, implementing, or validating Emergency Operations Plans, continuity plans, annexes, procedures, or emergency management programs.
  • 3+ years of direct experience in emergency planning, preparedness, Emergency Operations Center activations, incident management, training, or exercises.
  • 3+ years of experience managing project or program budgets, schedules, staffing, contracts, client relationships, and delivery risks.
  • Willing and able to travel, both flight and vehicle, with anticipated travel up to 50%.
  • Must have a valid current U.S. driver’s license and can successfully pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check.

PREFERRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE:
These qualifications may provide additional preference beyond the required criteria.

  • Master's degree in a related field.
  • Certification as an Emergency Manager (CEM)
  • Leadership of comprehensive, all-hazards preparedness programs and multi-year Integrated Preparedness Planning activities.
  • Advanced knowledge of FEMA CPG 101 and experience with EOPs, ESF and hazard-specific annexes, COOP/COG plans, crisis communications plans, SOPs, EOC procedures, and field or position guides.
  • Advanced experience managing the full HSEEP exercise cycle, including program management, design, conduct, evaluation, improvement planning, hotwashes, and corrective-action programs.
  • Experience training exercise planners, facilitators, controllers, evaluators, EOC staff, or partner agencies.
  • Experience managing preparedness grants, grant-funded initiatives, accreditation requirements, audit readiness, or compliance activities.
  • Experience delivering work through on-call, indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity, master services, or task-order contract structures.
  • Demonstrated success managing a portfolio with multiple concurrent clients, project teams, and delivery priorities.
  • Experience developing client relationships and supporting capture, proposal, recompete, and account-growth activities.
  • Existing relationships with the Florida Division of Emergency Management, Georgia Emergency Management and Homeland Security Agency, or other Region 4 state and local emergency management organizations.
  • Experience presenting to executive leaders, elected or appointed officials, boards, regulators, community partners, or public-sector clients.

Preferred Training

  • Incident management: ICS-100, ICS-200, ICS-300, ICS-400; IS-700 and IS-800.
  • Exercises: FEMA HSEEP training, including K/L0146 or current equivalent.
  • Continuity: Continuity Excellence Series Level I or Level II.
  • Program management: Project Management Professional (PMP).
  • Foundational FEMA training: FEMA Professional Development Series or equivalent coursework.

PROFESSIONAL SKILLS

You will bring these with you day one.

  • Strategic leadership across preparedness, continuity, response, recovery, mitigation, and resilience.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, facilitation, negotiation, writing, and presentation capabilities.
  • Ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, manage competing priorities, address risks early, and deliver high-quality work under deadlines in a remote, highly collaborative environment across time zones.
  • Executive-level communication and relationship management with public-sector clients, partners, technical teams, and operational stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of FEMA programs and emergency management frameworks, including the Stafford Act, 44 CFR Part 206, FEMA Public Assistance policy, NIMS, and ICS, as applicable to assigned work.
