jobs.description:
Learning & Development Capability Partner

The Learning & Development Capability Partner is responsible for translating organizational priorities, workforce capability needs, and emerging skill requirements into practical, skill-driven learning and performance solutions.

This role supports capability development across Business Development, Client Delivery, Consulting, Project Management, People Management, Industry and Domain Expertise, Professional Effectiveness, Collaboration.

Partners with business leaders, subject matter experts, and stakeholders to identify capability gaps, define skill expectations, and design learning experiences that help employees perform effectively throughout the employee lifecycle.

This individual will lead the design, development, delivery, and evaluation of learning solutions that are practical, scalable, and embedded in the flow of work. The role will also help connect learning programs, skills frameworks, technology platforms, and workforce priorities into a cohesive enterprise capability-development strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Business and Workforce Alignment

  • Partner with the Director, Learning Strategy, business leaders, and subject matter experts to understand organizational priorities, workforce needs, and critical capability gaps.
  • Translate business challenges and employee development needs into actionable learning and performance solutions.
  • Ensure learning investments are aligned with business strategy, workforce readiness, employee development, and organizational performance.
  • Consult with stakeholders to identify the appropriate solution, which may include formal learning, skill labs, tools, resources, coaching, peer learning, or on-the-job enablement.
  • Balance enterprise-wide capability needs with the specific requirements of business areas, functions, roles, and employee populations.
  • Respond to emerging and in-the-moment learning needs while maintaining alignment with the broader learning strategy.

Enterprise Capability Development

Lead or support learning and capability-building initiatives across the following areas:

Business Development

  • Develop capabilities related to opportunity identification, account growth, capture, proposals, client relationships, and effective seller-doer practices.
  • Create practical learning experiences that help employees contribute appropriately to business development activities based on their roles and levels.

Client Delivery

  • Build capabilities that support consistent, high-quality delivery of client work.
  • Develop learning solutions focused on understanding client needs, managing expectations, delivering value, addressing challenges, and strengthening client relationships.
  • Reinforce behaviors that promote quality, accountability, responsiveness, and a client-centered mindset.

Consulting

  • Develop consulting capabilities such as problem solving, strategic thinking, active listening, asking impactful questions, engaging in difficult conversations, building trust, brining innovation & creativity, solution development, and achieving valuable outcomes.
  • Design applied learning experiences that allow employees to practice consulting skills using realistic business and client scenarios.
  • Support the development of trusted-advisor behaviors and consultative approaches across roles and career levels.

Project Management

  • Build foundational and advanced project management capabilities aligned with organizational and client-delivery needs.
  • Develop learning in areas such as project planning, scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, team coordination, stakeholder management, and project communication.
  • Partner with project management subject matter experts to ensure learning reflects relevant methodologies, standards, and business practices.

People Management

  • Design learning that prepares managers to lead employees and teams effectively.
  • Build capabilities in areas such as goal setting, coaching, feedback, performance conversations, employee development, delegation, team effectiveness, inclusion, and change leadership.
  • Equip leaders and managers with tools and resources that reinforce learning through day-to-day practices.

Industry and Domain Expertise

  • Partner with business and technical subject matter experts to support the development and sharing of industry, market, technical, and domain knowledge.
  • Create frameworks and learning approaches that help employees build relevant expertise over time.
  • Enable subject matter experts to contribute to scalable learning through programs, communities of practice, mentoring/coaching, knowledge-sharing sessions, and curated resources.
  • Connect domain-specific learning with consulting, client-delivery, and professional capability development.

Professional Effectiveness

  • Create learning experiences that help employees operate effectively in a dynamic professional environment.
  • Address capabilities such as confidence, credibility, accountability, adaptability, decision-making, problem-solving, critical thinking, resilience, influenceand navigating ambiguity.
  • Develop practical tools and resources that employees can apply directly within their daily work.

Collaboration

  • Build capabilities that help employees work effectively across teams, functions, disciplines, and organizational boundaries.
  • Develop learning related to teamwork, trust, conflict navigation, knowledge sharing, stakeholder engagement, collaboration, and shared accountability.
  • Support collaborative practices for virtual, hybrid, geographically dispersed, and cross-functional teams.

Learning Design and Development

  • Own the end-to-end design and development of learning experiences across an operating group.
  • Conduct needs assessments and define learning objectives, target audiences, desired behaviors, and success measures.
  • Select learning approaches that are appropriate for the audience, business need, and complexity of the capability.
  • Design practical and experiential learning that may include:
    • Workshops
    • Skill labs
    • Cohort-based programs
    • Simulations
    • Case studies
    • Practice sessions
    • Coaching
    • Mentoring
    • Peer learning
    • Digital learning
    • Performance-support tools
    • On-the-job assignments
    • Communities of practice
  • Ensure learning is relevant, accessible, and directly connected to employees’ work.
  • Incorporate realistic business, project, team, and client scenarios into learning experiences.
  • Develop reinforcement strategies that support behavior change and sustained application after formal learning concludes.
  • Curate and organize existing learning resources when developing new content is not necessary.

AI-Enabled and Modern Learning

  • Use modern learning approaches, including personalized learning pathways, adaptive learning, and learning embedded within the flow of work.
  • Incorporate AI-enabled tools, guided practice, and responsible prompt development into learning experiences when appropriate.
  • Explore opportunities to use technology to increase access, personalization, practice, feedback, and scalability.
  • Help employees use AI and other emerging tools effectively and responsibly within relevant capability areas.
  • Partner with appropriate stakeholders to ensure technology-enabled learning aligns with organizational standards and priorities.

Delivery and Facilitation

  • Facilitate high-impact virtual and in-person learning experiences for employees, people managers, and business stakeholders.
  • Create psychologically safe and engaging learning environments that encourage participation, practice, reflection, and feedback.
  • Adapt facilitation approaches for different audiences, career levels, formats, and business contexts.
  • Enable leaders and managers to reinforce learning and support on-the-job application.
  • Prepare subject matter experts and business leaders to serve effectively as facilitators, coaches, mentors, or learning contributors.
  • Build co-facilitator capabilities to support consistent and scalable delivery.
  • Establish facilitator guides, delivery standards, and quality-assurance practices.

Measurement and Impact

  • Define meaningful success measures for learning programs, skill labs, digital learning, and performance-support solutions.
  • Evaluate learning effectiveness using appropriate qualitative and quantitative measures.
  • Partner with the learning team and business stakeholders to determine how success will be measured before launching solutions.
  • Use data, employee feedback, and stakeholder insights to improve learning experiences.
  • Communicate learning outcomes and recommendations clearly to business and stakeholders.
  • Distinguish between learning activity measures and evidence of performance or business impact.

Integration Across the People Function

  • Connect capability-development efforts with broader workforce readiness and talent initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise learning programs, leadership development, career development, employee experience, talent acquisition, performance management, and other priority People initiatives.
  • Partner across leadership, Human Resources consulting, Human Resources operations, talent acquisition, total rewards, and other relevant teams to create a cohesive employee experience.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce duplication, connect complementary programs, and create clearer learning pathways.
  • Support an integrated approach to skills, learning, careers, leadership, and workforce development.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Learning and Development, Human Resources Management, Organizational Development, Education, Adult Learning, Instructional Design, Organizational Psychology, Workforce Development, Business Administration, Management, Management Consulting, Organizational Leadership, Project Management, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in learning and development, talent development, leadership development, organizational effectiveness, professional services consulting, workforce development, or a related discipline.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing, developing, and delivering learning solutions for professional or client-facing employee populations.
  • Experience managing learning programs or capability-building initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and subject matter experts.
  • Demonstrated experience translating business or workforce needs into practical learning and performance solutions.
  • Experience facilitating virtual and in-person learning experiences.
  • Experience supporting learning and capability development within a professional services, consulting, government contracting, or other client-focused organization.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of adult learning, instructional design, experiential learning, and performance consulting.
  • Experience partnering with business leaders, people managers, functional experts, and technical subject matter experts.
  • Experience developing experiential learning, practice opportunities, coaching approaches, and on-the-job reinforcement strategies.
  • Experience using modern learning platforms, skills technologies, collaboration tools, and AI-enabled learning solutions.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

The Supervisor, Revenue Cycle Systems and Analytics manages the day-to-day operations of the Exact Sciences Laboratories Systems team. The Supervisor, Revenue Cycle Systems and Analytics’ primary responsibilities include providing supervision, hiring, training, and coaching, managing workloads, and handling escalated concerns as related to revenue cycle systems and analytics. They will maintain accurate data reporting and be responsible for metrics and productivity measures, as well as any other key performance indicators. The Revenue Cycle Systems and Analytics Supervisor will facilitate contract implementation and revenue pull-through activities, both proactive and reactive, with internal and external parties as needed. This position will ensure billing and payment processes are efficient, timely, and in compliance with corporate goals, contracts and/or regulations.

This position is remote.


Essential Duties

include but are not limited to the following:

  • Coach, mentor, and engage team members to increase overall performance.
  • Assist in identification and reporting of system errors and workflow solutions.
  • Oversee the creation and maintenance of payor and client master files to ensure accurate and timely updates or changes.
  • Investigate and resolve electronic remittance errors.
  • Drive operational excellence of order entry and exception handling processes; including process flow, data integrity, information alignment, and continual process improvement.
  • Support and Lead cross-functional initiatives across multiple departments.
  • Act as a liaison between other functional areas within Exact Sciences Laboratories.
  • Collaborate with team leadership and support the day-to-day team operations.
  • Lead the development and maintenance of a contract database and contract management system, working with the credentialing and legal teams.

This is a remote position.

About Alternative Path
Alternative Path is a strategic operations consulting firm, founded in 2020, that helps growth-stage and enterprise organizations build high-performing, India-based teams across Technology Ops, Data Ops, Business Intelligence, and Finance. Every engagement is senior-led, and the firm has delivered 50+ engagements for clients across the US, Europe, and Australia.
Job Description -Senior Engineer - Quality AssuranceExperience: 3–5 Years
Location: Remote
We are looking for a passionate and proactive Senior Engineer - Quality Assurance to join our team and help build a modern, AI-driven Quality Engineering practice. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on functional testing experience, solid expertise in test automation using Playwright, and a genuine interest in using AI across the software testing lifecycle. This is not a traditional QA role. We expect the candidate to actively use AI to improve the way testing is planned, designed, automated, executed, analyzed, and continuously improved. The candidate should be comfortable experimenting with AI tools, building reusable AI workflows, creating Skills and AI Agents, and evaluating the quality and reliability of AI-generated outputs.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities – Quality Engineering
  • Understand business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product workflows to identify functional and non-functional testing requirements.
  • Design, execute, and maintain effective functional, regression, integration, API, and end-to-end test scenarios.
  • Identify critical business flows, risks, edge cases, negative scenarios, and boundary conditions.
  • Develop and maintain robust UI automation using Playwright.
  • Execute automated regression suites, analyze failures, and identify the root cause of failures rather than simply reporting failed tests.
  • Identify, log, track, prioritize, and verify software defects throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Collaborate closely with Developers, Product Managers/Product Owners, Business Analysts, and other QA engineers.
  • Participate actively in requirement analysis, backlog refinement, sprint planning, story grooming, test planning, and release validation.
  • Practice Shift-Left Quality Engineering by identifying defects and testability issues as early as possible in the development lifecycle.
  • Review implementation-level changes where appropriate and perform deeper validation beyond black-box testing.
  • Continuously improve test coverage, automation reliability, test execution efficiency, and overall product quality.
AI-Driven Quality Engineering
AI should be an integral part of the candidate's daily QA workflow rather than an occasional productivity tool. The candidate is expected to leverage AI across multiple phases of the Quality Engineering lifecycle, including:
Requirements & Test Planning
  • Use AI to analyze requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation.
  • Identify ambiguities, missing requirements, risks, dependencies, and potential gaps using AI.
  • Generate and refine test scenarios using AI while applying appropriate QA judgment.
  • Use AI to identify edge cases, negative scenarios, boundary conditions, and potential failure paths.
  • Leverage AI to improve test coverage and risk-based test planning.
Test Case Design
  • Generate, review, optimize, and maintain test cases using AI.
    • Use AI to transform requirements and acceptance criteria into structured test scenarios.
  • Identify redundant test cases and opportunities for regression-suite optimization.
  • Generate test data and realistic test conditions using AI where appropriate.
Test Automation
  • Use AI assistants to accelerate Playwright automation development, debugging, refactoring, and maintenance.
  • Generate initial automation structures using AI and independently validate and improve the generated code.
  • Use AI to analyze automation failures and suggest fixes.
  • Explore and contribute to self-healing or AI-assisted automation capabilities where applicable.
  • Build reusable AI-assisted workflows to improve automation productivity.
AI Skills & Agents
  • Create and use AI Skills to automate recurring QA activities and standardize testing workflows.
  • Develop or contribute to AI Agents that can perform QA-related tasks such as test analysis, test generation, defect analysis, regression analysis, or test execution support.
  • Understand how to provide appropriate context, instructions, tools, and guardrails to AI agents.
  • Explore integrations with tools such as MCP or other tool-based AI workflows to enable agents to interact with QA and engineering systems.
  • Convert repetitive QA processes into reusable AI-powered workflows rather than performing them manually.
AI Evals & Quality of AI Outputs
  • Understand the importance of Evals (evaluations) when building or using AI-powered QA workflows.
  • Design basic evaluation criteria to measure the accuracy, consistency, usefulness, and reliability of AI-generated test cases, automation code, defect analysis, or other QA outputs.
  • Create and maintain evaluation datasets/test cases for AI workflows where applicable.
  • Analyze AI output quality and continuously improve prompts, Skills, Agents, workflows, and evaluation criteria.
Defect Analysis & Root Cause
  • Use AI to assist with defect investigation, failure analysis, log analysis, and root cause analysis.
  • Correlate test failures, application behavior, logs, and available technical information to accelerate defect investigation.
  • Identify recurring defect patterns and potential quality risks using AI-assisted analysis.
  • Where appropriate, contribute to AI-powered defect analysis and quality analytics solutions.
Required Skills & Experience
Quality Assurance
  • Strong understanding of software testing fundamentals and SDLC/STLC.
  • Strong experience in functional testing and test case design.
  • Experience with regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Strong understanding of defect lifecycle and root cause analysis.
  • Good understanding of Agile/Scrum development practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Test Automation
  • Strong hands-on experience with Playwright.
  • Ability to develop, maintain, debug, and optimize automation frameworks/scripts.
  • Good programming/scripting skills, preferably JavaScript/TypeScript or Python.
  • Experience with API testing and basic understanding of CI/CD is desirable.
  • Understanding of automation best practices, maintainability, reliability, and test-data management.
AI & Modern Quality EngineeringThe candidate should demonstrate practical hands-on use of AI in QA, not just theoretical awareness. Experience with one or more of the following is highly desirable:
  • Claude / Claude Code
  • AI-assisted test generation/test automation
  • AI-assisted defect/root-cause analysis
  • AI-based test data generation
  • Claude Skills or equivalent reusable AI workflows
  • AI Agents / Agentic QA workflows
  • MCP or tool-based AI integrations
  • AI Evals/evaluation frameworks
  • Self-healing or AI-assisted automation
  • AI-based test optimization or regression analysis
Candidates should be able to demonstrate how they have actually used AI to improve QA productivity, coverage, quality, or engineering outcomes.

We are seeking a high-agency Fullstack Product Engineer (Golang + ReactJS) who takes full accountability for product outcomes, not ticket output. In this role, you own features from initial ambiguity, through architecture and implementation, to live production behavior and telemetry.

Operating with an AI-first engineering workflow, you will use AI coding agents as your daily delivery leverage while acting as the ultimate author of record—holding an uncompromising bar on system fundamentals, Clean Architecture, relational data integrity, and automated safety nets.   • Lead delivery using coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot) via spec-driven engineering, custom agent skills, and prompt guardrails; rigorously review generated code to reject over-abstraction, silent errors, or hollow tests.
  • Own automated testing (unit, integration, contract, E2E) shipped within the same PR; ensure every fix has a reproducing test so agent-assisted changes can merge safely at high velocity.
  • Deploy, containerize, and run Go microservices on open-source Kubernetes and Docker; instrument services with structured logs, metrics, and tracing to triage incidents and deliver permanent postmortem fixes.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively across time zones; document technical decisions, specs, and PRs thoroughly in English to unblock globally distributed team members without requiring synchronous meetings.

Key Requirements

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend services; hands-on experience designing microservices architectures (service boundaries, sync/async communication, failure isolation) alongside pragmatic judgment on when a monolith is preferred.
  • Hands-on production Go engineering experience, including active, continuous production use within the last 12 months.
  • Practical, working capability in ReactJS (Next.js or Vue) to independently build, integrate, and ship complete frontend slices.
  • Deep command of OOP, SOLID, Clean Architecture, and design patterns; ability to critique architectures, anticipate failure points at scale, and defend decisions in code reviews.
  • Proven proficiency in relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL—indexing, isolation levels, transactions, query optimization, migrations) and robust RESTful API design (versioning, idempotency, pagination, error schemas).
  • Practical working experience with open-source Kubernetes (deployments, configs/secrets, probes, limits) and Docker; disciplined adherence to 12-factor application standards.

  • Familiarity with event-driven systems, message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ), or media streaming protocols (HLS/M3U8).

What We Offer

DIABETES

Transforming diabetes care together, for greater freedom and better health. Our strategy is to become a holistic diabetes management company focused on making a real difference in outcomes and cost. We want to transform healthcare toward value-based models by driving both product and business model innovation with the goal of elevating patient experience, improving clinical outcomes and lowering the total cost of care for our customers.

New Ventures is focused on developing new diabetes systems, products and solutions in an inorganic, accelerator environment. Our team is unique in that we can adapt to a variety of business, patient and marketplace needs that span the entire spectrum of our product portfolio today and in the future. Our mission drives the need to be a highly skilled, flexible, extremely efficient, versatile and agile in medical device product development for the benefit of our patients with Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes in need of intensive insulin therapy.

FIELD CLINICAL RESEARCH SPECIALIST

In this exciting role as a Field Clinical Research Specialist, you will be responsible for overseeing and executing clinical programs for a powerful, developing therapy to treat a small but critical cohort of patients on a humanitarian basis. Leveraging a broad and diverse clinical experience and skillset, you will provide clinical and technical leadership to key centers, HCPs and patients on a national and international level.


The Clinical Specialist will support research and development in evaluating concepts for new therapy and product development and the modification of existing devices; serving as a clinical resource between engineering, leadership, clinical research, and the medical community. Among these responsibilities, the highest priority is given to the support of patients. We will strive to empower people with diabetes to live life on their terms by delivering a pump that truly matters and providing support in ways that is needed.   • Identify and educate new patients, physicians on new therapy development

  • Build and maintain optimal relationships and effective collaborations with various internal and external parties.
  • Oversee and resolve operational aspects of clinical trials in conjunction with project teams and in accordance with standard operating procedures (SOP), good clinical practice (GCP) and specific country regulations and may prepare clinical trial budgets.
  • Support clinical logistics with key centers, HCPs and patients for clinical research activities on a national and international level
  • Support IRB submissions for next generation product
  • Support the geographical expansion of centers

  • Bachelor’s degree required and minimum of 7 years of clinical research experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 5years clinical research experience

#BetterDaysStartNow

  • Experience working on a Global study team
  • Experience in Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and/or regulatory compliance guidelines for clinical trials.

  • Experience in managing clinical trial data review.
  • Ability to incorporate and adhere to good clinical practices and regulatory standards.
  • Ability to identify and implement solutions in addressing study issues.
  • Basic understanding of biostatistics and trial design.
  • Proficient knowledge of medical terminology.
  • Proficiency in MS Office applications: Excel, PowerPoint and Word, Project (or similar scheduling software), project management techniques and tools; and web-based applications.

jobs.excerpt: About CIRThe Centre for Information Resilience (CIR) is an independent organisation dedicated to exposing human rights violations and threats to democracy.
jobs.description:
About CIR

The Centre for Information Resilience (CIR) is an independent organisation dedicated to exposing human rights violations and threats to democracy. We achieve this through open source research, digital investigations, capacity-building with local partners, and collaboration with media to amplify our impact.

CIR was born out of a determination to expose those spreading harm – online and offline – around the world, particularly in areas of violent conflict, such as Ukraine, Sudan and Myanmar. Our projects are at the forefront of efforts to investigate and document human rights abuses, war crimes, harms targeting women and minorities, and influence operations. We work closely with multilateral and national justice accountability bodies.

Role details:

Contract Type: Contractor

Closing date: 26th October 2026 at 23:55pm

Contract length:  ASAP until 31st March 2027

Hours needed for this role:  Full time, 19-20 days a month. Part time roles may also be considered.

Location: Remote

About the Project

CIR specialises in rigorous, ethical, and impact-driven research on technology-facilitated gender-based violence (TFGBV), sexual and gender-based violence (SGBV), and conflict-related sexual violence (CRSV), translating evidence into accountability, advocacy, and practical interventions.

For this project, CIR’s is seeking to recruit an open-source researcher to investigate how gender norms and identity can be weaponised to escalate conflicts. We are seeking someone with experience in conducting narrative and network analysis in the MENA region, including analysing online narratives surges to verified online incidents, to test whether and how gendered identity content precedes, accompanies or follows escalation.

Main Responsibilities

  • Employ open-source intelligence (OSINT) and social media analysis (SOCMINT) tools, techniques, and methodologies to conduct research into the MENA information environment.
  • Use SOCMINT tools to conduct audience analysis and gather audience insight.
  • Analysing and documenting evidence of Ethnic, Religious and Gendered Hate speech, coordinated Inauthentic behaviour and other violations of platform terms and conditions and standards.
  • Contribute to CIR’s investigations into how gender and identity are exploited on social media in relation to ongoing conflicts in the MENA region.
  • Input information into the project’s databases and code that data to pre-set information fields as required. Ensure that all data is preserved and archived according to project and organisational standards.
  • Work with other investigators to analyse data from multiple sources and create comprehensive analytical reports on gendered hate speech and narratives, trends, and dynamics.
  • Support the design and production of high-quality reports that effectively explain insights and the evidence and methodology underpinning them.

Requirements

Essential Criteria:

  • Proven experience with open-source intelligence (OSINT) and social media analysis (SOCMINT) tools and techniques.
  • Expertise in monitoring of ethnic, religious and gendered hate speech.
  • Expertise in narrative tracking and social media research techniques.
  • Proven experience with the development of GESI framework and lexicons.
  • Ability to write short- and long-form reports using concise, clear and accurate language.
  • Flexibility and capacity to adapt to fast-paced changing, and sometimes high-pressure, environments.
  • Proactivity and willingness to work, learn from, and collaborate with members of the project team and the wider CIR.

Desirable skills

  • Experience on conflicts in the MENA region
  • Ability to speak and/or integrate multiple languages
  • Use of network mapping and data visualisation tools

Recruitment Process

To apply, please submit your CV and complete the application form questions. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview, which can be conducted remotely unless specified otherwise.

CIR is an equal opportunities employer. If you require adjustments or additional support to complete this process, please let us know in your application.

A candidate’s guide to artificial intelligence (AI) in recruitment at CIR

CIR does not use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision-making tools at any stage of its recruitment process. All applications are reviewed, and decisions are made, by trained members of staff.

When applying for a role, please do use AI for:

  • Plan your ideas and thoughts
  • Check the spelling and grammar of your CV and cover letter
  • Research CIR
  • Generate mock interview questions for you to practice before your interview
  • Use AI as a support tool, not as a substitute for your own thinking or judgement

Don’t use AI to

  • Invent or misrepresent your skills and experience
  • Complete any tests provided by CIR
  • Assist you during an interview to help answer the questions being asked by the panel

Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer. Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers.

Jouw rol

Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation).

Requirements

Wie ben jij?

We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties. Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen.

Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWSCDK, Terraform of CloudFormation. Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre. Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Solliciteren

jobs.description:
The Senior Forward Deployment Engineer, DxS helps customers adopt DeepHealth’s Diagnostic Suite (DxS) correctly as one integrated solution. The role owns the end-to-end technical design across core PACS, Viewer, Reporting, integrations and AI for assigned customers, leads the product-area FDEs, coaches implementation teams, resolves complex cross-component issues, and turns recurring field needs into standard product workflows.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports, reporting to the Service Engineering Lead, Enterprise Intelligence. It operates within DeepHealth’s Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) function, whose purpose is to help customers adopt DeepHealth products correctly. The role sits at the intersection of the Technical Delivery Manager (TDM), Product, Service and Solution Delivery teams to ensure smooth customer adoption. It transitions best practices to the Service and Solution Delivery teams and plans upcoming product changes with them to ensure commercial readiness.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end technical solution design of the Diagnostic Suite for assigned customers, combining core PACS, Viewer, Reporting, integrations and AI into one clinical workflow.

  • Lead suite-level technical discovery with customers and implementation teams, and produce the solution design and configuration plan used for implementation.

  • Lead the product-area FDEs (Reporting Pro, Viewer, HL7 Integration) and own OS/Core PACS configuration directly, to deliver a consistent customer solution.

  • Partner with the assigned implementation counterpart for this workstream to adopt learnings and best practices into customer configuration and implementations; train and coach implementation teams on suite-level configuration standards; maintain reference architectures and deployment playbooks.

  • Serve as customer-facing technical lead during go-lives, hypercare and escalations that span multiple components.

  • Provide technical support to the implementation teams for cross-component issues in assigned accounts, including root cause analysis and resolution with engineering (approximately 20–30% of time).

  • Convert recurring customer needs into standardized workflows and product requirements, distinguishing product gaps from configuration or training issues.

  • Own the AI adoption strategy across the DxS suite: define requirements, expected customer impact and success criteria, and feed them back to Product and Engineering.

  • Support customer adoption of AI-enabled workflows across the suite as they are released, coordinating rollout, site readiness and customer adoption with the Technical Delivery Manager and Product Manager.

  • Own escalation of engineering issues for assigned accounts: triage, document reproducible defects, track status with engineering and close the loop with customers.

  • Support site reliability (SRE) for assigned accounts: monitor service health with observability tools, participate in incident response and drive reliability improvements with engineering.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, Information Systems or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience (required).

  • Experience: 8+ years of overall experience in healthcare IT, medical imaging or clinical systems (required).

  • Experience: 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role across multiple enterprise imaging components (PACS, viewer, reporting, RIS), such as solutions engineer, technical consultant or senior implementation engineer (required).

  • In-depth knowledge of DICOM and HL7 v2, and how they connect across the radiology order-to-report workflow (required).

  • Hands-on configuration of PACS and diagnostic viewers, and experience integrating radiology reporting systems such as PowerScribe (required).

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end radiology clinical workflow, including RIS, worklists, reading, reporting and results distribution (required).

  • Working knowledge of cloud-hosted applications (GCP, AWS or Azure), networking, storage and SSO/authentication (required).

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate technical decisions to radiologists, IT leaders and executives, including in escalated situations (required).

  • Imaging informatics or clinical credential such as CIIP, PARCA or ARRT(R) (preferred).

  • Experience deploying or supporting clinical AI applications in radiology (preferred).

  • Experience in a regulated medical device environment (FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, IEC 62304) and with ITIL practices (preferred).

  • Microsoft Office experience required.

Quality Standards

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Travel: 30%

The Role:

IonQ is developing the world's most powerful full-stack quantum computer based on trapped-ion technology. We are pushing past the limits of classical physics and current supercomputing technology to unlock a new era of computing. Quantum computing has the potential to impact every area of human society for the better. IonQ's computers will soon redefine industries like medicine, materials science, finance, artificial intelligence, machine learning, cryptography, and more. IonQ is at the forefront of this technological revolution.

We are looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager, Quantum Adoption & Technical Enablement to join a dynamic, cross-functional team dedicated to driving IonQ's mission of delivering exceptional experiences for our customers. In this role, you will be IonQ's primary customer-facing technical expert, going hands-on with customers to drive real adoption of our trapped-ion quantum computers. You will bridge deep platform and quantum-algorithm expertise with customer empathy, guiding organizations through performance optimization, circuit design, and workflow integration as they build on IonQ's platform.

As a trusted technical advisor, this position offers a high-visibility opportunity to influence and inspire highly technical internal and external stakeholders, ensuring they have the best possible experience on our platform. Scientific expertise and hands-on credibility, combined with exceptional communication skills, are essential for success in this role.

  • Technical Onboarding & Platform Mastery: Facilitate adoption for major accounts by translating contract terms into technical provisioning, leading onboarding sessions, and managing day-to-day technical engagement operations.

  • Technical Support & Blocker Removal: Standardize troubleshooting workflows for job failures, establish Customer Success team best practices, and provide direct, high-touch technical support to remove barriers to adoption.
  • Curriculum & Enablement Content: Expand IonQ's user base by identifying real-world challenges for industry customers and creating workshops, challenges, and curricula, including code, circuits, slides, and videos, that empower them to learn and apply quantum computing.

  • Data-Driven Customer Health: Design and maintain dashboards tracking job metrics, system usage, and overall customer health, and leverage usage data to provide actionable technical intelligence to internal teams.
  • External Technical Representation: Represent IonQ on standards bodies, government committees, quantum working groups, industry panels, and other relevant forums, leading technical sessions and workshops at industry conferences.

  • Proven ability to teach complex topics to diverse audiences, tailoring curricula to customer needs, including large lectures, smaller study sessions, and one-on-one mentoring.

Summary

The Partner Success Manager will be the dedicated point of contact for ETF Partners and ETF Enterprise Partners, building trusted, long-term relationships that maximise the value, engagement and impact of their ETF Partnership.


Working collaboratively with partner organisations and colleagues across ETF, the postholder will support Partners to translate their organisational priorities into meaningful professional development opportunities, strengthening workforce capability, professional practice and continuous improvement. They will guide Partners throughout the partnership lifecycle, from sales, onboarding and implementation through ongoing engagement with ETF products and services, impact measurement and renewal.

Acting as a trusted advisor and strategic critical friend, the Partner Success Manager will develop a strong understanding of each Partner’s objectives, workforce development priorities and evolving needs. They will connect Partners with ETF’s professional membership, resources, professional status pathways, CPD programmes and wider expertise, ensuring that the Partnership remains relevant, delivers tangible value and supports agreed outcomes.

The role will be accountable for the effective management and development of an allocated portfolio of Partners, driving engagement, satisfaction, retention and renewal, while identifying opportunities for partnership growth and wider workforce development solutions in collaboration with relevant commercial colleagues.

  • Monitor progress and demonstrate the value and impact of the Partnership through feedback, engagement data and outcome reporting.

  • Lead renewal preparation and discussions, demonstrating the value delivered and identifying future priorities.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records of Partner activity, objectives, risks, renewals and agreed actions.

  • Identify opportunities to grow existing Partnerships, including progression to Enterprise Partnership and engagement with ETF’s wider workforce development programmes.

Senior Software Engineer - Integrations

About the job

HeroDevs is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for our Evergreen team. HeroDevs keeps critical open-source software secure long after it reaches end of life. The Evergreen team owns EOLDS, our end-of-life dataset, which internal teams and integration partners rely on to understand which open-source software has reached end of life, the risk that carries, and how to remediate it. We also build the systems that turn that data into packages our partners can consume, and we need those systems to produce packages at scale when a partner needs them.

Position Summary

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help take EOLDS to its next stage. You'll help build the pipelines that let us generate and publish large numbers of packages for partners on demand. This is a high-ownership role. You'll make design decisions, set patterns for the team, and work closely with partner-facing teams to understand what partners need from the data.

Responsibilities

  • Improve EOLDS data quality through validation, deduplication, provenance tracking, and automated checks that catch regressions before they reach partners
  • Investigate and document how our current risk heuristics work, including their inputs, assumptions, and edge cases
  • Design and build a multi-model risk scoring framework that supports different risk profiles for remediation, including CVE-centric models alongside our existing heuristics
  • Build weighted, configurable scoring so risk profiles can be tuned per partner or use case, with clear explanations of how a score was produced
  • Integrate EOLDS with Kafka and our data lake, including event schemas, producers and consumers, backfills, and consistency between systems
  • Build automated pipelines that can generate, version, and publish large numbers of packages for partners on demand, reliably and reproducibly
  • Add monitoring and data quality metrics so problems with the dataset, scoring, or package delivery surface quickly
  • Work with product and partner-facing teams to translate partner requirements into data and scoring changes
  • Write services and tooling in TypeScript/Node.js, with automated testing and CI/CD
  • Review code and designs, mentor other engineers, and help raise the team's engineering bar
  • Write clear documentation for the dataset, scoring models, and pipelines you build
  • Work to automate package requests from our partners

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant time spent building data-intensive systems or data pipelines in production
  • Proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js)
  • Experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka, and with data lakes or data warehouses
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills
  • Experience designing data validation and data quality checks for datasets other teams or customers depend on
  • Comfort reasoning about scoring, ranking, or heuristic systems, such as weighted models or risk scores, and explaining their tradeoffs
  • Experience building build, release, or publishing automation, including CI/CD pipelines
  • The ability to dig into an unfamiliar system, figure out how it works, and write it down so others can understand it
  • Strong written communication and the ability to drive technical decisions in a distributed team
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience with git-based software development (preferably on GitHub)

Preferred (Nice-to-Have) Skills

  • Familiarity with vulnerability data and scoring, such as CVEs, CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, OSV, or GitHub Security Advisories
  • Experience with package ecosystems and their publishing workflows, such as npm, Maven, PyPI, RPM, or Debian packaging
  • Experience with schema registries and serialization formats such as Avro or Protobuf
  • Experience with lakehouse table formats such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Parquet-based storage
  • Background in software supply chain security, including SBOMs, artifact signing, or provenance (e.g., Sigstore, SLSA)
  • Experience working with enterprise partners on data delivery or integrations
  • Experience mentoring engineers or acting as a technical lead
  • Interest in open-source software and long-term maintenance of critical software
  • Experience with Temporal Cloud or similar orchestration solutions
  • Experience with OpenSearch and/or ElasticSearch
  • Experience with OTEL/opentelemetry and Grafana
  • Experience with Argo UI

Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Job Title: Finance Manager

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S. business hours

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly analytical and hands-on Finance Manager to take ownership of financial operations and support strategic decision-making in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

This role combines day-to-day accounting with forward-looking financial planning. You will be responsible for maintaining financial accuracy, managing cash flow, building forecasts, and supporting leadership with insights that drive business decisions. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable operating independently in a startup setting.

Responsibilities:

Financial Operations & Accounting

  • Manage day-to-day bookkeeping, general ledger, and financial record-keeping.
  • Maintain accurate financial data within QuickBooks.
  • Oversee accounts payable/receivable and ensure proper documentation and controls.

Cash Flow & Financial Health

  • Monitor cash flow, liquidity, and overall financial health on a weekly basis.
  • Track burn rate and maintain accurate runway projections.
  • Provide insights into financial sustainability and risk areas.

Reporting, Budgeting & Analysis

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports for leadership.
  • Build and maintain financial forecasts and projections.
  • Develop and manage budgets, tracking actuals vs. planned spend.

Strategic Finance & Decision Support

  • Support leadership with financial analysis for key business decisions.
  • Build financial models for growth initiatives and new opportunities.
  • Contribute to long-term financial planning and strategy.

KPI & Operational Metrics

  • Define and track financial and operational KPIs.
  • Analyze revenue trends, cost drivers, and performance metrics.

Tax Strategy & Compliance

  • Coordinate with external accountants or partners for tax compliance.
  • Support tax filings, audits, and regulatory requirements.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Improve financial processes, reporting systems, and workflows.
  • Maintain financial dashboards and reporting models.

Growth & Scaling Support

  • Prepare financial reports and materials for investors or fundraising.
  • Support scaling of the finance function as the business grows.

What Makes You a Perfect Fit:

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently.
  • Detail-oriented with a high standard for accuracy and organization.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Analytical thinker who can translate data into actionable insights.
  • Proactive in identifying financial risks and opportunities.

Required Experience & Skills (Minimum):

  • 3–7+ years of experience in accounting, finance, or a related role.
  • Strong hands-on experience with QuickBooks.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for financial modeling and tracking.
  • Experience managing financial reporting, budgeting, and cash flow.
  • Strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ideal Experience & Skills:

  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth environment.
  • Exposure to healthcare or multi-entity business structures.
  • Familiarity with cash vs. accrual accounting transitions.
  • Experience supporting investor reporting or fundraising processes.
  • CPA certification or progress toward certification.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Finance Manager’s day is centered around maintaining financial accuracy while supporting business decisions. You will:

  • Manage bookkeeping and update financial records.
  • Monitor cash flow and track financial performance.
  • Prepare reports and analyze financial data.
  • Collaborate with leadership on planning and strategy.
  • Improve financial processes and systems.

In essence: you are the financial backbone of the business, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and informed decision-making.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting.
  • Cash flow visibility and financial stability.
  • Budget adherence and forecasting accuracy.
  • Quality of financial insights provided to leadership.
  • Efficiency of financial processes and systems.

We're a passionate team united by three cultural drivers:

Impact – We do work that matters.

Collaboration – We are in it together.

Human touch – We care deeply.

As a Senior Product Designer within our Clinical team, you'll design experiences that support healthcare professionals in making decisions, documenting care and managing complex clinical workflows.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers and Clinical Safety specialists, balancing innovation with the responsibility of creating safe, reliable healthcare technology.

You'll also help evolve how our design team works, using AI and emerging technologies to explore ideas, learn faster and deliver better outcomes.

This is a remote position.

Mathematics Content Developer, IndiaRemote (India) | Full-Time

Also searched as: Academic Content Developer, Math Content Writer, Subject Matter Expert (Mathematics), Educational Content Developer, VCE Math Content Developer

Do you want to build math resources from the ground up, the booklets, exams, and worked solutions that thousands of students actually learn from?

​In a typical week you might write a set of exam-style questions for Year 11 methods, build step-by-step solutions that read like a tutor talking a student through the problem, and align a booklet to the VCE syllabus with the onshore team.

About Contour

We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture.

For a student stuck on a hard topic, your worked solution is the moment it clicks or it does not. Clarity is the whole job.

About This Role

You create original mathematics content for Contour, for Grades 9 to 12, including practice exams, booklets, assignments, and assessments. This is a hands-on creator role, not editing or refining someone else's work: you write the questions, define the structure, and write the step-by-step solutions that mirror a tutor's voice, helping students understand the reasoning and not just the answer.

You align your work to the VCE and Pre-VCE syllabus for accuracy, consistency, and curriculum fit, and you keep resources logically structured so a student can follow the progression. You work alongside our existing India content team and report into the onshore academic team in Australia, aligning on requirements and learning objectives. You review and refine your content to keep it precise and rigorous, and you contribute to the processes that let content scale.

The bar that separates a strong hire is conceptual depth paired with the ability to explain simply. You understand the math well enough to make a hard method feel obvious, and you write solutions a struggling student can follow on their own. By the end of your first three months, you are producing exam and booklet material independently, aligned to the syllabus, with solutions that read clearly the first time.

What You Will Do

  • Create original math content forGrades 9 to 12: practice exams, booklets, assignments, and assessments.

  • Structure resources for clarity.Define the format and logical progression so material builds the way a student learns.

  • Write like a tutor.Produce step-by-step, student-friendly solutions that explain the reasoning, not just the result.

  • Align to the syllabus.Match the VCE and Pre-VCE curricula for accuracy, consistency, and fit.

  • Collaborate with the onshore teamto align materials with learning objectives.

  • Review and improve.Refine content for precision and rigor, and suggest better question design, structure, and delivery.


Requirements

What You Need

  • A bachelor's or master's degree in mathematics.

  • 1 to 3 years in mathematics content development.

  • Strong conceptual understanding across key mathematics domains.

  • Familiarity with curriculum design and syllabus alignment, VCE mathematics preferred.

  • Excellent written communication and attention to detail.

  • The ability to work independently and manage several projects at once.

  • Cross-timezone comfort, with overlap into Australian time.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in academic writing, booklets, or assessment development.

  • Exposure to edtech or international curriculum frameworks.

  • Interest in instructional design or educational technology.

The Kind of People Who Thrive Here

The people who do well here see a gap and close it without being asked, holding the bar even when the clock is short. They give a direct read on the work in front of them, including when it's wrong, and when their own idea doesn't hold up, they say so and bring a better one. They build something that keeps running after they step back. Problems here don't show up on schedule or in the same shape twice, and they'd rather make the right call on limited information than let something break while they wait for a sign-off. That's the job. They name the blocker and the ask the moment they have it, on a call or a text, because decisions get made on the information you bring.

Contour's current cluster heads started as team leads. The path from operator to leader is real here.

What good looks like

  • Original content, to standard:exams and booklets that are accurate, clear, and adopted.

  • Solutions a student can follow alone:the reasoning is visible, not just the answer.

  • Syllabus-aligned:material fits the VCE and Pre-VCE curricula and holds up to scrutiny.

  • It scales:you help content get produced faster and more consistently.


Benefits

Fully remote, anywhere in India. Compensation is competitive and benchmarked to the role and your experience,and we discuss it openly early in the process. From application to offer: a short screen, a technical assessment, a culture conversation with our People team, and a final interview with Content Development Lead, in about four weeks.

Apply with a CV and a short sample or description of maths content you created, a set of questions with worked solutions or a booklet section, and if you can, one worked solution you are proud of.

jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on, high-impact Senior Security Engineer, Detection & Response, to strengthen security operations at Sezzle: detection, incident response, and vulnerability management across our cloud infrastructure and applications.

You will join the team that runs our SIEM and detection capability — from log ingestion and audit coverage to detection rules, alert tuning, and investigation workflows — so that access to sensitive systems is attributable and suspicious activity is caught and attributed by our own detections. You will operate the vulnerability-management loop end-to-end, and when incidents happen, you will lead the investigation and see the long-term fix through. You should consider yourself a DOer - someone who is comfortable diving into logs, analyzing systems, validating findings, and working end-to-end to get issues resolved.

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and network and zero trust — your detection and response work is what proves their controls hold. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and wants to work on real-world security problems at scale. At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows for alert triage, investigation, and threat hunting that multiply what the team can cover.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build, operate, and mature SIEM/XDR capabilities, including log ingestion, detection rule development, alert tuning, and investigation workflows
  • Design and implement detection strategies for suspicious activity, including data exfiltration patterns using application and database telemetry
  • Extend audit and attribution coverage across the estate — Kubernetes audit logs, database audit logging, SSO and access-path telemetry — so access to sensitive data is attributable to a person or workload, with retention aligned to compliance requirements
  • Investigate and respond to security incidents across cloud infrastructure and applications, performing root cause analysis and driving long-term fixes
  • Run proactive threat hunts across cloud and identity planes, building agentic hunting workflows that make hunts repeatable
  • Operate vulnerability management across infrastructure, platforms, and applications - including internal scans, dependency analysis, and external findings, validating true positives and driving remediation with engineering teams
  • Triage and validate external security findings (including bug bounty reports), distinguishing true positives and coordinating remediation
  • Contribute to threat modeling and security design reviews for the detection, logging, and incident-response implications of new systems
  • Apply strong AWS and Kubernetes judgment to secure the systems you operate and advise owning teams on remediation
  • Support and implement security controls aligned with PCI DSS, SOC 2, and other compliance requirements — with your logging and detection work producing the audit evidence as a by-product
  • Develop and implement automation (including AI) to improve efficiency in security operations, detection, and response
  • Participate in the on-call rotation for detection and response and the services you own

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of experience in security, software, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on experience securing cloud-based production systems and working with real-world security challenges
  • Experience working with SIEM platforms (e.g., Wazuh, Splunk, ELK) for detection engineering, monitoring, and incident response
  • Experience designing and tuning detection rules, reducing alert noise, and improving investigation workflows
  • Strong hands-on experience in vulnerability management — scanning, triage and validation of scanner and bug-bounty findings, remediation coordination, and verification
  • Strong knowledge of AWS, Linux, and Kubernetes infrastructure, including security architecture and operational best practices
  • Ability to investigate issues directly using logs, cloud tooling, and system-level data
  • Experience assessing the detection and logging implications of new systems in design reviews
  • Knowledge of common security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies (OWASP, SANS, etc.)
  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS and SOC 2, particularly logging, monitoring, and evidence expectations
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today, and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — triage, enrichment, or hunting
  • Familiarity with log-based detection, telemetry pipelines, and security analytics use cases
  • Experience with internal penetration testing or adversarial exercises, and translating results into detection and remediation work
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native security controls, including IAM, network segmentation, and container security
  • Experience with container and dependency security tools (e.g., Snyk, Trivy, Grype) as an operator of their findings
  • Experience aligning technical security work with regulatory and compliance expectations
  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated environments

About You:

  • You think like an investigator - you turn telemetry into detections and detections into answers, and you are not done until the root cause is fixed.
  • You treat attribution as an engineering deliverable - every access to sensitive data has a name on it, and every finding has an owner and a date.
  • You are excited to use automation and emerging technologies (including AI) to take repetitive security work off the team's plate
  • You balance strong security standards with business needs and can support privacy and compliance requirements in a practical, scalable way
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

Your Role:

As a Product Manager - Accounts, you will be responsible for the strategy, roadmap, and execution of Alpaca's core account management and identity verification systems. You will be the voice of our partners, working to create a flexible and compliant global account infrastructure. This role is critical to enabling financial institutions around the world to seamlessly and securely onboard and manage their end-users. You will work closely with engineering, legal, compliance, and business development teams to navigate the complexities of different jurisdictions and deliver a world-class account experience.

Things You Get To Do:

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Alpaca's account opening and identity verification services
  • Manage the lifecycle of various account structures, including fully disclosed, omnibus, and omnibus with sub-accounting, to meet the diverse needs of our global B2B clients.
  • Develop and enhance features such as the ability to open accounts for entities, create sub-accounts for distinct trading strategies, and manage multiple account types (e.g., self-directed, robo, retirement)
  • Lead the strategy for KYC and identity verification, supporting various models from partner-led KYC to integrated solutions with third-party providers
  • Collaborate with legal, compliance, and regional business teams to navigate the complexities of different jurisdictions, ensuring our account systems meet local licensing, data management, and financial requirements
  • Author detailed product requirement documents (PRDs) and user stories to ensure clarity and alignment across all teams
  • Work with go-to-market teams to enable adoption of new account features and onboarding flows
  • Define and analyze key metrics such as onboarding success rates, account funding times, and KYC pass-through rates to measure success and identify areas for improvement

Who You Are (Must-Haves):

  • At least 5 years of product management experience, with a focus on B2B, fintech, or complex platform products
  • Experience with products related to user onboarding, identity verification (KYC/AML), or account management systems
  • A strong understanding of the operational and regulatory complexities in financial services, especially concerning client onboarding and account lifecycle management
  • Proven ability to understand complex technical and business requirements and work effectively with engineering, legal, and compliance teams
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders
  • Data-driven mindset with experience using analytics tools to track product performance and make informed decisions
  • A genuine passion for financial markets and a strong desire to build products that empower developers and democratize access to financial services
  • Experience working in an agile development environment

Who You Might Be (Nice-to-Haves):

  • A background in engineering
  • Direct experience working in the fintech or brokerage industry
  • Experience working in a globally distributed, remote-first company
  • Familiarity with different brokerage account structures (e.g., omnibus, fully disclosed)
  • Experience with global identity verification providers and regulatory technology (RegTech)

  • Health Benefits

Required Technical Skills
