The OpportunityWe're looking for an engineering-minded owner of the systems our Sales, Marketing and Revenue Operations teams run on: CRM, marketing automation, CPQ and the tools around them. This is not a ticket-queue role. Business teams will bring you solutions ("add a field", "build me a report"). Your job is to find the problem behind the request and see how a change affects every connected system. Then fix it once, ideally so the next person can do it themselves without filing a request. You'll have an internal engineering team to lean on, and you'll use AI tools daily to build faster.

Responsibilities

  • Own the GTM systems as one connected whole: know how CRM, CPQ, marketing automation and sales-engagement tools share data, and design every change with that in view.
  • Turn requests into problems: ask what the business is trying to solve, propose options, explain trade-offs, and say "no" or "not like that" when it's the right call.
  • Remove recurring manual work: measure the effort, then replace it with automation or self-service tools that business users run themselves.
  • Build automations, small tools and integrations, choosing the simplest approach that will hold up.
  • Keep the data model lean and trustworthy: retire unused fields and legacy workarounds, and enforce data quality where data enters rather than cleaning it up later.
  • Keep integrations reliable: use native connectors where they do the job; where something custom is needed, respect API limits, add error handling and monitoring, and keep sandbox and production consistent. Collaborate with our internal engineering team as necessary.
  • Use AI tools to build, investigate issues, and speed up routine work.
  • Provide EMEA-hours support for the GTM stack, and use what you see there to pick the next fix.
  • Document changes and follow change management from sandbox to production.
  • Current Sales/Marketing Tech Stack: Salesforce, Dealhub CPQ, Hubspot, ZoomInfo, Gong Professional, Gong Engage, Gong Forecasting, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dripify, Ringlead

Qualifications

  • 3+ years hands-on with Salesforce Sales Cloud (advanced Flow, data and security model), plus HubSpot and/or DealHub CPQ.

  • Comfortable using AI coding and automation tools every day.

MAKE IT REAL TECH, PART OF THE CUSTOMIZATION GROUP

B2B Sales Representative, EU & US Markets

Full-time · India (Remote)

A new-business sales role, working remotely from India. You prospect eCommerce merchants across Europe and the US, take every deal from first outreach to signed contract, and hand new clients to Account Management. Build the book, close the deals, shape the playbook. EU working hours, which is roughly midday to evening in India, with flexible overlap for US client meetings.

We are looking for a salesperson who finds and closes their own deals. You will sell print-on-demand production to eCommerce merchants in Europe and the US, and you will run the full sales cycle yourself.

About Make IT Real Tech

We are Make IT Real Tech, the Dubai-based subsidiary of The Customization Group. We are an information technology firm providing consulting services in IT, software, and Artificial Intelligence, and our AI-driven global team builds workflows and solutions across manufacturing, supply chain, and eCommerce.

The Customization Group itself is a global leader in mass customization and print-on-demand eCommerce. We manufacture up to 2,5 million personalized products daily in our own production sites in Germany, Poland, the USA, and Latvia. Millions of customers reach us through 20+ online shops and 1.000+ partner stores, and our 750+ colleagues from 40+ nationalities work at the intersection of manufacturing, eCommerce, and AI.

For this role, that matters: what you sell, we produce ourselves, on both sides of the Atlantic. Reliable production and fast delivery are promises you can stand behind.

The Role

Our B2B segment is growing fast, and Europe and the US are the key markets. You will win new clients: Shopify, WooCommerce, or marketplace merchants who are scaling and need a production partner that keeps up. We already work with many European and North American eCommerce brands; your job is to add new ones in Europe and in the US.

Most of your pipeline comes from your own outreach. You will also receive inbound leads to qualify and convert. Once a client is signed and running, colleagues take over the day-to-day relationship, and you focus on the next deal. This is a new-business role.

In a nutshell: Hunt EU/US eCommerce merchants. Own the full cycle from cold outreach to signed contract. Hand off clean accounts and go close the next one.

Working hours: This role operates on EU working hours (Riga time), which is roughly midday to evening in India. On occasion, you may need to extend your day by 1 to 2 hours to join a client meeting in US time zones, but there are no fixed US working hours.

What You Will Do

  • →Win new clients: Identify, contact, and close new B2B clients in Europe and the US, mainly eCommerce merchants with strong growth.

  • →Own the full sales cycle: Prospecting, qualification, discovery, negotiation, closing.

  • →Build your pipeline: Keep it strong through your own outbound work and by converting inbound leads.

  • →Drive deals to a decision: Manage opportunities, handle objections, and guide clients to a decision.

  • →Hand over cleanly: Give new clients a good start, with a clean internal handover.

  • →Work cross-functionally: Align with Marketing, Product, and Operations on offers and closing strategy.

  • →Represent the company: Attend industry events in the eCommerce and POD market.

Who We're Looking For

Sounds like you?

  • → 2 to 4+ years closing B2B deals in eCommerce, POD, SaaS, or another merchant-facing category.

  • → A real hunter: strong motivation and ability to acquire new clients, build pipeline and close deals.

  • → EU/US market understanding: familiarity with EU/US client expectations, communication styles, business culture and buying behavior.

  • → Track record of full-cycle ownership: you've prospected, negotiated, and closed deals end to end.

  • → AI proficiency: experience using AI tools to improve prospecting, outreach, and sales efficiency.

  • → Fluent in English (written and spoken). Strong negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills.

  • → Comfortable with HubSpot or similar CRM.

What We Offer

Global Collaboration

Gain international experience by working with globally distributed teams.

Remote Work

Enjoy the convenience of working from home, with the flexibility to manage your own environment.

Private Health Insurance

Prioritize your well-being with comprehensive medical coverage for peace of mind.

Growth Opportunities

Access to valuable knowledge and experience to support your career development.

Innovation and AI

Be part of an AI-first workplace that enables everyone to drive unique business solutions through state-of-the-art technology.

Our Interview Process

1

Application review

We review your application and get back to you.

2

AI interview with Lizzy

A short first interview with Lizzy, our AI interviewer.

3

Call with the Hiring Manager

A 30-minute conversation about your experience and the role.

4

Technical Interview

60 minutes walking through real deals you have run, from first contact to signature.

5

Offer

If it is a match on both sides, we make you an offer.

Not sure you meet every requirement? Apply anyway. What matters most to us is your ability to take ownership and make an impact in a growing team.

Teleflex is the home of Arrow™, Barrigel™, Deknatel™, LMA™, Pilling™, QuikClot™, Rüsch™, UroLift™ and Weck™ – trusted brands united by a common sense of purpose.

At Teleflex, we are empowering the future of healthcare. For more information, please visit teleflex.com.

Interventional – The Interventional business unit at Teleflex develops innovative medical devices used to diagnose and treat coronary and peripheral vascular diseases. We focus strategically on coronary and peripheral interventions, vascular and bone access, and large-bore closure solutions.

Our portfolio includes a broad range of clinically relevant products, such as the GuideLiner™ and Turnpike™ Catheters; the Orsiro™ Mission™ Drug-Eluting Stent; the PK Papyrus™ Covered Coronary Stent; the Ringer™ Perfusion Balloon Catheter; the Pulsar™ -18 T3 Self-Expanding Stent; Passeo™ Balloon Catheters; and the OnControl™ Powered Bone Access System.

Backed by a strong R&D pipeline, our rapidly growing Interventional business unit is well positioned to continue advancing new technologies that support the treatment of critically ill patients. Join a dynamic team dedicated to delivering innovative medical solutions that make a meaningful difference in patients’ lives.

Position Summary

The Clinical Affairs Specialist supports the clinical integration and evidence-based use of the product portfolio by collaborating with healthcare professionals and internal stakeholders throughout the product evaluation, implementation, and adoption process. Responsibilities include clinical education, development and delivery of training programs, support for product evaluations and onboarding activities, facilitation of evidence-based discussions, and addressing clinical questions to promote the safe, effective, and appropriate use of Teleflex products in patient care settings.

When required, supports the team and may also serve as a medical scientific liaison for accounts requiring advanced clinical training and post-installation training needs to advance and/or maintain stages within the product adoption cycle. This role plays a pivotal position in supporting customer experience and patient-centric care.

Principal Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with commercial and clinical teams to assess customer educational and clinical practice needs, providing product and procedural education, clinical training, in-service support, and appropriate follow-up to support safe and effective product utilization.
    • Maintain advanced knowledge of Teleflex Medical products, with focused expertise in designated clinical specialty areas, including relevant procedures, standards of care, and clinical applications.
    • Support the development of clinical relationships through professional engagement, evidence-based consultation, and discussion of best practices related to the appropriate use of Teleflex products.
    • Remain current on medical literature, clinical guidelines, healthcare trends, and the competitive landscape, and communicate relevant insights to cross-functional partners including sales, marketing, medical affairs, and product management teams.
    • Participate in scientific, educational, and professional programs at local, regional, and national meetings, conferences, and trade exhibitions.
    • Provide clinical support for customer inquiries through the clinical support call line and other designated communication channels.
    • Support clinical awareness and appropriate integration of Teleflex products through engagement with key opinion leaders, academic medical centers, and healthcare institutions to facilitate evidence-based education and clinical adoption.
    • Provide education and training to internal and external stakeholders on the safe and appropriate use of products in accordance with Instructions for Use (IFU), Operator’s Manuals, institutional policies and procedures, evidence-based practice guidelines, and applicable regulatory requirements.
    • Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Engineering, and other internal teams on strategic initiatives and product-related activities, applying critical thinking and clinical judgment to evaluate information, address challenges, and support informed decision-making within established company policies and practices.
  • Maintain accurate and timely completion of administrative responsibilities associated with clinical activities, including documentation, expense reporting, required reporting processes, and adherence to Teleflex policies and compliance standards.
    • Manage unsolicited off-label inquiries in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements, including appropriate documentation, escalation, and dissemination of balanced, non-promotional scientific information.
    • Adhere to and ensure compliance with Teleflex Medical’s Code of Conduct, all Company policies, rules, procedures, and standards.

Education / Experience Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree preferred.

  • Healthcare Provider with a minimum of 5 years’ patient care experience in a critical care area and/or interventional access specialty (i.e., Interventional Radiology, Cardiac Cath Lab, etc.)
    • Minimum of two years of Medical Device Industry experience preferred.

Overview

Acquire new clients for Elvoro's flagship AI-native social media marketing service, primarily targeting consumer businesses in the United States and Germany. As an independent B2B sales partner, you will own the sales process, from identifying prospects and pitching our solutions to negotiating, closing deals, and building lasting client relationships. We are looking for an experienced sales professional with a proven track record of winning clients. Earn attractive performance-based commissions, work independently on your own terms, expand your professional network, and represent cutting-edge AI technology, with the opportunity to build a rewarding, long-term sales partnership.

About the Company

Elvoro is an AI technology company specializing in marketing and advertising, developing proprietary AI technology and agentic systems on a mission to bring superintelligence to social media marketing and become the world's leading AI-native marketing company. We're an ambitious, founder-led company driven by innovation, speed, independence, and exceptional execution.

Responsibilities

Your primary goal is to consistently acquire new paying clients for Elvoro, build and maintain successful client relationships, and generate long-term revenue. Your responsibilities may include:

  • Prospecting & Research: Identify suitable consumer businesses, assess their commercial potential, and connect with relevant decision-makers, primarily in the US and Germany.

  • Outreach & Acquisition: Independently generate qualified sales opportunities through targeted outreach, and effective acquisition methods.

  • Inbound Demand Conversion: Convert inbound leads into sales and contribute to improving inbound demand strategies.

  • Sales & Presentations: Engage business owners and decision-makers, understand their objectives, and persuasively present Elvoro's solutions through calls, online meetings, and proposals.

  • Negotiation & Closing: Manage follow-ups, address objections professionally, negotiate commercial terms, and convert prospects into paying clients through signed agreements and initial payments. Our founder and team may support final commercial discussions.

  • Client Relationship Management & Growth: Build and maintain strong relationships with acquired clients, monitor satisfaction, coordinate with our delivery team to support client success, and identify opportunities for renewals, additional services, and referrals.

  • Pipeline Management: Maintain an organized sales pipeline, track opportunities, progress, and coordinate smooth client onboarding and handovers with our team.

Qualifications

  • Proven track record of independently acquiring and closing paying B2B clients, preferably for marketing agencies, technology companies, or professional services.

  • Strong experience in outbound B2B sales, including prospecting, presentations, negotiations, and managing the full sales cycle.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain professional client relationships, preferably involving recurring service contracts.

  • Excellent professional American English communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

  • Strong commercial judgment, independence, accountability, and a results-driven working style.

  • Preferred: Experience selling digital marketing or social media marketing services, an established network of relevant business decision-makers, and familiarity with the US or German markets. Native German language proficiency is required when selling to Germany.

Compensation & Benefits

Earn attractive performance-based commissions for successfully acquired clients, with the potential to build a substantial ongoing income opportunity as your client portfolio grows. Enjoy independence over how, when, and where you work; results matter, not hours logged. Represent proprietary AI technology in a rapidly evolving industry, expand your professional network through valuable business relationships, and collaborate directly with our founder for fast decisions and commercial support. Build lasting client partnerships and grow alongside an ambitious AI technology company, with the opportunity for a rewarding long-term collaboration.

Our Role

We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to lead how our frontend applications get built, tested, and shipped. You'll write and review frontend code, make architectural decisions about our Next.js applications, and take ownership of the tooling, pipelines, and infrastructure that let our frontend teams move fast and ship with confidence.

This is a hands-on frontend role first you'll be in the codebase, working with delivery pods, reviewing PRs, and solving real product problems. But you'll also own the platform underneath it: CI/CD, deployment, observability, and developer experience for every frontend team in the business.

Role Requirements

  • Strong, hands-on experience building and shipping production frontend applications with Next.js (or equivalent React frameworks), including SSR/ISR strategies and edge runtime considerations.
  • Deep understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript build tooling (Webpack, Vite, esbuild, Turbopack, or similar).
  • Experience owning or heavily contributing to CI/CD pipelines for frontend applications build times, caching strategies, artifact management.
  • Solid understanding of how SPAs are built, bundled, and deployed (static hosting, CDN configuration, cache invalidation).
  • Experience with npm/yarn/pnpm package management, dependency resolution, and registry configuration.
  • Comfortable working with Node.js in a production context (SSR, build servers, tooling).
  • Experience with monitoring and observability for frontend applications (error tracking, performance monitoring, Core Web Vitals).
  • Familiarity with containerising frontend applications and deploying them to Kubernetes.
  • Comfortable with Linux, shell scripting, and general infrastructure concepts.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar).
  • A genuine interest in developer experience, you notice friction and want to fix it, not just work around it.

Role Responsibilities

Frontend Engineering
  • Write, review, and ship production code across our Next.js applications, working directly alongside delivery pods.
  • Make architectural decisions on SSR/ISR strategy, edge runtime usage, and caching behaviour for frontend applications.
  • Set and champion frontend engineering standards — build tooling, code quality, testing practices, and performance budgets.
  • Occasionally embed with a delivery pod for a sprint to support a specific initiative or unblock a hard problem.

jobs.description:
About WebEngage:

WebEngage is an enterprise-grade customer engagement and retention platform that helps global brands across industries such as e-commerce, fintech, travel, edtech, gaming, media, and consumer apps. and turn data into measurable revenue impact. Trusted by 800+ brands globally, we have strong presence in India, UAE, KSA, SEA, Europe and beyond. WebEngage powers intelligent, real-time engagement across the entire customer lifecycle.
  • We are built for scale.
  • We are built for complexity.
  • We are built for outcomes.
At our core, WebEngage is a full-stack retention operating system that combines:
  • A powerful Customer Data Platform (CDP)
  • Real-time behavioral segmentation and intelligence
  • Omnichannel journey orchestration
  • AI-driven personalization and recommendations
  • Deep analytics, experimentation, and revenue attribution
  • WebEngage BLACK: our AI-native layer that brings Agentic capabilities to engagement.
Learn more about us at www.webengage.com

About The Role:

WebEngage’s Data Engineering team is the backbone of our analytics, personalisation, and machine-learning capabilities. As a Data Engineer, you will own the end-to-end lifecycle of data — from ingesting raw event streams and third-party feeds to building well-modelled, highly reliable datasets that power dashboards, predictive models, and customer journey orchestration. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will work at the intersection of product, analytics, and backend engineering. You will be expected to think beyond just moving data — designing for data quality, pipeline observability, cost efficiency, and long-term maintainability from day one.

Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Reliability

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest data from APIs, databases, event streams (Kafka/Pub-Sub), and flat files into the central data warehouse.
  • Implement idempotent, incremental load patterns with built-in retry logic, dead-letter queues, and SLA-based alerting to ensure zero-data-loss pipelines.
  • Own pipeline observability — set up data freshness checks, row-count validations, schema drift detection, and anomaly alerts using tools like Great Expectations or dbt tests.

Data Modelling & Warehouse Design

  • Translate business requirements into clean dimensional models (star/snowflake schemas) and maintain a well-documented data catalogue.
  • Design slowly changing dimensions (SCD Type 1/2), bridge tables, and fact tables optimised for analytical query patterns.
  • Enforce partitioning, clustering, and materialised view strategies to keep warehouse costs under control while maintaining sub-second query performance.

Code Quality & Engineering Best Practices

  • Write clean, modular, well-tested Python and SQL code. Follow DRY principles, use version control (Git), and participate in peer code reviews.
  • Build reusable transformation frameworks using dbt or equivalent tooling, with proper documentation and testing at every layer (staging → intermediate → mart).
  • Containerise data services with Docker and automate deployments via CI/CD pipelines (GitHub
Actions / GitLab CI).

BI, Visualization & Analytics

  • Build interactive dashboards and analytical tools using Streamlit, enabling stakeholders to explore metrics, run ad-hoc analyses, and make data-driven decisions without engineering dependency.
  • Design and maintain BI layers — semantic models, KPI definitions, and pre-aggregated mart tables that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across teams.
  • Translate raw data into compelling visual narratives using libraries like Plotly, Matplotlib, or Altair; present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Partner with product managers, analysts, and data scientists to understand data needs and proactively identify gaps in current data coverage.
  • Document data lineage, transformation logic, SLAs, and known limitations in a shared knowledge base to enable self-service analytics.
  • Contribute to internal engineering guilds, knowledge-sharing sessions, and post-incident reviews for pipeline failures.

Requirements:

  • Strong SQL skills with expertise in complex queries, performance optimization, and cost-efficient design on cloud data warehouses (BigQuery, Redshift).
  • Strong Python scripting for data ingestion, transformation, and validation, with hands-on experience in Pandas, SQLAlchemy, APIs, and automation.
  • ETL/ELT- End-to-end ownership of data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, and loading, with understanding of incremental loads, and backfills.
  • Data Modelling- Ability to design dimensional and transactional data models (star/snowflake, SCDs) and translate business needs into optimized table structures.

Good to Have:

  • Airflow, dbt, Docker, CI/CD
  • GCP/AWS, data warehousing concepts
  • BI tools / Streamlit / visualization

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 1–3 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a backend role with significant data pipeline work.
  • Strong understanding of data warehouse architecture — know when to use wide denormalised tables vs. normalised models, and the trade-offs of each.
  • Familiarity with version control workflows (Git branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews) and agile development practices.
  • A data quality mindset — you instinctively validate assumptions, add assertions to pipelines, and treat silent data failures as critical incidents.

Life at WebEngage:

  • We take transparency very seriously. Along with a full view of team goals, get a top-level view across the board with our monthly & quarterly town hall meetings.
  • A highly inclusive work culture that promotes a relaxed, creative and productive environment.
  • Practice autonomy, open communication, growth opportunities,while maintaining a perfect work-life balance

Perks & Benefits:

  • Learning is a way of life. Unlock your full potential backed with cutting-edge tools and mentorship (Macbook for Engagers!)
  • Get the best in class medical insurance (with Covid Care facilities), programs for taking care of your mental health, and a Contemporary Leave Policy (beyond sick leaves)

jobs.description:
Description

About Us

Sentra is the AI Data Readiness platform for enterprises deploying AI at scale. Sentra continuously discovers, classifies, and governs sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, data warehouses, and AI environments - giving security teams complete visibility into what AI systems can access, what they can expose, and where compliance violations exist. Unlike alternatives that copy data to vendor clouds or require customer-managed outpost infrastructure, Sentra provisions ephemeral scanners directly inside the customer's environment, delivering petabyte-scale classification at a fraction of the cost. Trusted by Lyft, SoFi, Munich Re, PennyMac, Glovo and others.

About the Role

Sentra's revenue engine runs on state-of-the-art AI-enhanced infrastructure that was made possible with GTM Engineering: GTM data syncs continuously into a warehouse. AI pipelines score every open deal daily and write their conclusions back into the CRM. Attribution models run across a hundred thousand touchpoints. A partner deal-registration portal, a content platform and an internal dashboard suite are all in production, deployed through CI with automated rollback. All of it was designed and shipped in-house, in a matter of hours to days, not weeks.

You will be the founding GTM Engineer within the GTM Engineering & RevOps team, where you’ll take over production systems, be asked to own them, harden them, and extend them into the parts of the revenue lifecycle we have not automated yet. The GTM team is your user base. You will find where revenue is leaking, build the system that closes the gap, and own both halves: the commercial reasoning about why a deal moves and the AI-systems that enable the team to act on it.

Responsibilities

  • Build and enhance the revenue data platform and AI automations and workflows: The CRM-to-warehouse sync, the enrichment and scoring pipelines, revenue forecasting systems. You will operate these processes, improve them, and keep them reliable where the team never second guesses the output.
  • Own the full revenue lifecycle systems management: One system from first touch to renewal, from demand capture and lead flow, pipeline and forecast, to renewals and expansion. Not three disconnected stacks with handoffs between them; this is genuine end-to-end ownership.
  • Create analytics infrastructure that allows decision-makers to scale the business. Every number we publish is versioned and carries a reason; you will keep it that way.
  • Drive Adoption: Building is half the job; you will measure whether reps use what we build, and treat non-adoption as a defect in the system rather than a failure of the rep.

Requirements

  • LLM tooling as an engineer, not a consumer. You have built something where an LLM is a component in a pipeline, and you have opinions about how you verified the output. Agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or equivalent) are part of how this team works.
  • 5+ years in GTM operations, sales engineering, revenue operations, marketing operations or sales systems at a B2B SaaS company, preferably at high-growth startups scaling from $10M - $100M+ ARR.
  • Data & Git fluency: You can write the joins and window functions behind a pipeline report without help, and you can tell when a number is wrong because the query is wrong. Branches, pull requests, code review, resolving your own conflicts. Everything here ships through version control and CI.
  • Practical scripting and API work: Python, TypeScript or JavaScript. You have read API docs, handled auth, paginated a response and dealt with rate limits without supervision.
  • Deep Salesforce knowledge: You can design an object model, write and debug a record-triggered flow, reason about sharing and field-level security, and you know when the right answer is a formula field rather than automation.
  • Enterprise marketing automation: Marketo strongly preferred (Pardot, Eloqua or comparable considered). Sync behavior, dedupe and lead-to-contact matching are part of the job, not someone else's problem.
  • Commercial judgment: You can explain what a stalled deal looks like in the data, and why that matters to a quarter.

Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. As a Senior Account Manager (Third-Party Vendor Enablement Coordinator) within PNC's Treasury Management Card Product organization. This is a remote position.

The Third-Party Vendor Enablement Coordinator serves as the central liaison between internal stakeholders and third-party payment enablement providers, supporting supplier acceptance and adoption initiatives across commercial card and virtual payment programs. This role is responsible for coordinating supplier enablement campaigns, managing vendor relationships, optimizing supplier matching and onboarding processes, and identifying opportunities to increase supplier participation and payment volume through strategic third-party partnerships. The position works closely with Commercial Card Clients, Account Managers, Client Solution Officers, retention specialists, suppliers, and external enablement partners to drive program growth and maximize value for customers and suppliers.

Key Responsibilities

Third-Party Vendor Management

• Serve as the primary day-to day point of contact for all Third-Party Provider (3PP) communications, meetings, and ongoing relationship management.
• Coordinate activities between internal stakeholders and third-party enablement partners to ensure effective execution of supplier enablement strategies.
• Act as the internal subject matter expert and advocate for 3PP programs, capabilities, and strategic partnerships.
• Maintain third-party provider network inventories, oversee network updates, and manage supplier matching processes to maximize supplier optimization opportunities.

Supplier Enablement & Campaign Coordination

• Manage supplier file submissions to third-party providers and ensure timely delivery of supplier data for campaign execution.
• Coordinate strategic supplier enablement initiatives targeting high-value suppliers, including suppliers generating significant annual spend, in partnership with providers such as Visa, Boost, and other enablement partners.
• Partner with Account Managers and Client Solution Officers to identify opportunities for supplier onboarding, activation, and payment acceptance growth.
• Support supplier retention efforts by partnering with retention specialists to manage supplier opt-out requests and identify opportunities to preserve and expand virtual card spend.

Analytics, Reporting & Performance Management

• Consolidate, analyze, and distribute weekly campaign status reports, supplier enablement metrics, and performance updates.
• Evaluate current and historical supplier enablement campaigns to identify trends, performance gaps, and opportunities for increased third-party provider engagement.
• Monitor program effectiveness and recommend enhancements to improve supplier adoption, activation, and spend performance.
• Maintain accurate documentation, reporting, and process tracking to support ongoing program management and executive visibility.

Strategic Growth & Optimization

• Identify opportunities to increase supplier participation and maximize value from third-party enablement partnerships.
• Support pricing discussions, vendor evaluations, and business case analysis to ensure the most effective third-party solution is selected for both customers and suppliers.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop strategies that improve supplier acceptance rates, payment volume growth, and operational efficiency.
• Assist with implementation of new enablement technologies, supplier engagement strategies, and process improvements designed to expand program reach and effectiveness.

Qualifications

• Experience in commercial card, treasury management, accounts payable automation, supplier enablement, vendor management, or payment solutions.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, reporting tools, and CRM platforms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a focus on driving measurable business outcomes.

• Increased supplier enrollment and activation rates.
• Growth in virtual card spend and supplier acceptance.
• Effective management of third-party provider relationships and campaigns.
• Improved supplier retention and reduced opt-out activity.
• Timely and accurate reporting of enablement performance metrics.
• Successful execution of strategic supplier enablement initiatives.This position may be eligible for remote work in select geographic locations, subject to approval by PNC.   • Implement secure engineering practices, vulnerability remediation, and compliance activities such as ATO, PCI, and FISMA
  • Conduct performance analysis, capacity planning, and system tuning; design and test continuity of operations (COOP) and disaster recovery (DR) capabilities
  • Manage Software configurations, version control, and source code repositories; participate in change control process

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • Comprehensive knowledge of security compliance and security control
  • Proficient skills in C, Java, JSF, Tomcat, PrimeFaces, JavaScript, CSS, and/or Linux shell
  • Strong experience implementing and supporting end-to-end automated DevSecOps pipelines and processes
  • Strong experience in RedHat Linux
  • Strong experience in and understanding of Cloud APIs and Cloud technologies with some programing experience
  • Strong experience with providing engineering support for software application in the full DevOps pipeline
  • Demonstrated ability to adapt to different enterprise security requirements.

jobs.excerpt: Leidos's Digital Sector is seeking a Systems Engineer-Sustainment Engineer and Digital Thread to support the U.
jobs.description:
Leidos's Digital Sector is seeking a Systems Engineer-Sustainment Engineer and Digital Thread to support the U.S. Coast Guard CG-TECH-DME organization in executing enterprise digital transformation, sustainment engineering, and digital engineering initiatives supporting Force Design 2028 objectives. The Senior Systems Engineer will provide technical leadership in sustainment engineering, product lifecycle management (PLM), and digital thread management across enterprise transformation activities, modernization efforts, and mission enablement initiatives. The role will support planning, coordination, analysis, implementation, and governance activities associated with sustaining Coast Guard systems across their full lifecycle (from requirements and design through fielding, sustainment, and disposal) with authoritative, model-based data connecting every phase.

This individual will work closely with Coast Guard leadership, program managers, product line managers, enterprise architects, logisticians, cybersecurity teams, and mission stakeholders to define sustainment and technical requirements, establish and govern the digital thread, and ensure alignment between operational readiness needs and enterprise engineering objectives.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide sustainment-focused systems engineering support for Coast Guard digital transformation and lifecycle modernization initiatives, including reliability, maintainability, availability, and supportability analyses that inform readiness and total ownership cost decisions.

  • Establish, manage, and govern digital thread linkages connecting requirements, architecture models, engineering designs, configuration baselines, technical data, and sustainment/logistics data across the system lifecycle.

  • Administer, configure, and champion adoption of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software (e.g., Arras Innovator, PTC Windchill, Siemens Teamcenter), including workflows, change management processes, BOM/product structure management, and integrations with engineering and logistics systems.

  • Support configuration management and technical data management activities, including engineering change proposals, configuration audits, baseline control, and technical data package (TDP) development and maintenance within the PLM environment.

  • Analyze operational and sustainment requirements and develop technical recommendations supporting enterprise modernization and lifecycle support objectives.

  • Develop systems engineering artifacts including CONOPS, requirements documentation, interface definitions, sustainment plans, workflows, and technical assessments.

  • Translate operational requirements and concepts of operations into traceable UAFML model artifacts that support digital engineering, sustainment planning, and architecture decision-making.

  • Build and maintain enterprise and system architecture models in Cameo Enterprise Architecture, including diagrams, elements, and views, while executing model queries, validation checks, and trade studies to inform engineering and sustainment decisions; link model elements to PLM-managed configuration items to maintain digital thread traceability.

  • Identify and manage obsolescence and Diminishing Manufacturing Sources and Material Shortages (DMSMS) risks, supporting proactive technology refresh and parts management strategies.

  • Coordinate with cloud, cybersecurity, data, and application development teams to support scalable, secure enterprise PLM and digital engineering solutions.

  • Participate in governance boards, configuration control boards, technical reviews, stakeholder meetings, and program status briefings.

  • Support development of technical roadmaps, PLM/digital thread implementation strategies, and data migration plans.

  • Monitor project risks, dependencies, technical issues, and integration impacts across sustainment and modernization initiatives.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts, digital engineering standards development, and operational readiness planning.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline and 8–10 years of related experience, or 6–10 years with a Master’s degree. Additional experience may be considered in lieu of degree.

  • Demonstrated experience in sustainment engineering or product support engineering for complex systems, including lifecycle support planning, configuration management, and readiness analysis.

  • Hands-on experience with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software such as PTC Windchill or Siemens Teamcenter, including product structure/BOM management, change management workflows, and document/data management.

  • Experience with digital thread management: establishing and maintaining authoritative, traceable linkages between requirements, models, design data, configuration baselines, and sustainment data across the system lifecycle.

  • Experience supporting complex federal IT, systems engineering, or modernization programs.

  • Familiarity with systems engineering lifecycle processes and requirements management practices.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • U.S. Citizenship required.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a DHS Public Trust and Secret clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading or supporting an enterprise-scale deployment of a PLM environment (e.g., Windchill or Teamcenter), including architecture definition, data migration, workflow configuration, integration with ERP/MBSE/logistics tools, and user adoption/training.

  • OMG Certified Systems Modeling Professional (OCSMP) – Model Builder certification, or equivalent demonstrated MBSE proficiency (SysML/UAFML, Cameo Enterprise Architecture).

  • Experience integrating MBSE environments (e.g., Cameo/Teamwork Cloud) with PLM platforms to maintain a continuous digital thread between architecture models and configuration-managed product data.

  • Familiarity with logistics product data and integrated product support standards (e.g., GEIA-STD-0007, S1000D, MIL-STD-3046, ANSI/EIA-649 configuration management principles).

  • Experience with DMSMS/obsolescence management programs and sustainment cost or level-of-repair analyses.

  • Experience supporting U.S. Coast Guard, DHS, or DoD sustainment, logistics, or product data management programs.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Process Improvement Professional analyzes and measures the effectiveness of existing business processes and develops sustainable, repeatable and quantifiable business process improvements. The Senior Process Improvement Professional work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

The Humana Pharmacy Benefits Management (PBM) Strategy Enablement team partners with PBM teams to improve processes that will help our members improve their lives through better health outcomes. This role, within the Process Improvement (PI) team of Strategy Enablement, will work closely with PBM leaders, as well as key partners in leading and delivering on initiatives and process capabilities that enable improved effectiveness, efficiency, and experiences (member, provider and associate).

The Senior Process Improvement Professional:

  • Researches best business practices within and outside the organization to establish benchmark data.
  • Defines and leads business improvement projects aligned with business strategies and operational priorities.
  • Collects and analyzes process data to initiate, develop and recommend business practices and procedures that focus on member experience, increased productivity and efficiency and reduced cost.
  • Determines how new information technologies can support re-engineering business processes.
  • May specialize in one or more of the following areas: benchmarking, business process analysis and re-engineering, change management and measurement, and/or process-driven systems requirements.
  • Begins to influence department's strategy.
  • Makes decisions on moderately complex to complex issues regarding technical approach for project components, and work is performed without direction.
  • Exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments.

As Senior Process Improvement Professional for continuous improvement within Humana Pharmacy, you will: design, implement, and improve business processes across designated areas of responsibility to help enhance business outcomes, directly impacting cost, quality and member experience.


Use your skills to make an impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and deliver a portfolio of process improvement projects that collectively achieve quantifiable annual cost savings targets.
  • Analyze and measure the effectiveness of existing business processes, taking into consideration industry benchmarks and overarching business strategy, to determine areas of focus for process improvements.
  • Partner with operations leadership to define and quantify initiatives to improve cost per, quality, and outcomes measures, driving cost reduction balanced with quality improvements.
  • Influence leadership and cross-functional partners without formal authority through data-driven insights and compelling storytelling.
  • Develop projects through the DMAIC, PDCA, Kaizen, or other standard process improvement methodologies (whichever best benefits the business), while identifying potential project risks.
  • Deliver quantifiable results, making technical decisions and escalating issues, with minimal supervision.
  • Monitor project performance metrics to ensure that organization objectives in the areas of cost, efficiency, and quality are met.

  • Proven Change Agent, with demonstrated abilities and successes in influencing and motivating at multiple of an organization.

  • Expertise in Project Management, Program Management, Problem Solving, and Issues Mitigation.

jobs.description:
ARE YOU A CURRENT US FOODS EMPLOYEE? PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY THROUGH OUR INTERNAL WORKDAY CAREER SITE

Join Our Community of Food People!

The Mechanical Engineer - Refrigeration is responsible for the design, analysis, optimization, and technical support of industrial refrigeration systems across the enterprise. This role provides subject-matter expertise for ammonia (NH₃), Co2 and Freon-based systems, ensuring safe operation, regulatory compliance, reliability, and energy efficiency in support of operational and business objectives.

This position is virtual/remote which means the work can be completed from anywhere is the United States except Hawaii or United States Territories.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Refrigeration System Engineering

  • Design, review, and support industrial refrigeration systems utilizing ammonia, C02 and Freon refrigerants, including compressors, condensers, evaporators, vessels, piping, and controls.

  • Develop and maintain engineering standards, specifications, and system documentation.

  • Evaluate system performance and recommend improvements to enhance safety, reliability, and efficiency.

  • Provide technical support for troubleshooting and root cause analysis of refrigeration system issues.

  • Core partner of Design and Construction team to set design standards for company.

Process Safety & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support Process Safety Management (PSM) and Risk Management Plan (RMP) requirements for ammonia systems.

  • Participate in PHAs, MOCs, mechanical integrity programs, and compliance audits.

  • Ensure designs and system modifications comply with OSHA, EPA, IIAR, ASHRAE, and applicable codes and standards.

  • Support incident investigations and development of corrective actions.

Capital Projects & Modifications

  • Provide engineering support for refrigeration-related capital projects, expansions, and retrofits.

  • Review contractor and consultant designs for compliance with engineering standards and project requirements.

  • Support commissioning, startup, and system acceptance activities.

  • Provide technical input on equipment selection, vendor evaluation, and scope development.

Operations & Maintenance Support

  • Partner with Facilities and Maintenance teams to develop maintenance strategies, SOPs, and operating procedures.

  • Provide field engineering support during major outages, repairs, and emergency events.

  • Assist with contractor oversight and ensure technical work is executed safely and correctly.

Asset Reliability & Energy Optimization

  • Analyze system performance data to identify reliability risks, capacity constraints, and energy optimization opportunities.

  • Support lifecycle asset planning, condition assessments, and replacement recommendations.

  • Identify opportunities for system modernization and automation.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Maintain accurate P&IDs, equipment files, calculations, and technical documentation.

  • Ensure documentation supports PSM compliance, audits, and operational readiness.

  • Contribute to enterprise knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Other duties as assigned by manager.

RELATIONSHIPS

  • Internal Relationships: This role partners closely with Operations, Facilities, Maintenance, EHS, Asset Management, and Capital Engineering teams to ensure safe, reliable, and compliant refrigeration system performance. The Mechanical Engineer works collaboratively with site leadership and field engineering resources to support daily operations, capital execution, and continuous improvement initiatives across the network.

  • External Relationships: Interfaces with external engineering firms, refrigeration contractors, OEMs, and equipment suppliers to support system design, modifications, troubleshooting, and commissioning activities. The role may also be engaged with regulatory agencies, auditors, and PSM consultants as needed to support compliance efforts, inspections, and technical reviews.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

  • Travel to multiple distribution centers as needed.

  • Combination of office, warehouse, and field environments, including refrigerated and frozen areas.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5 years of experience in industrial refrigeration, with hands-on experience with ammonia (NH₃) refrigeration systems and working knowledge of Freon-based systems.

  • Expertise in industrial ammonia and Freon refrigeration engineering, including refrigeration thermodynamics and mechanical system design.

  • Strong knowledge of Process Safety Management (PSM) and Risk Management Program (RMP) compliance requirements.

  • Demonstrated experience in system troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and operational problem-solving within industrial refrigeration environments.

  • Experience supporting capital projects, including system upgrades, expansions, commissioning, and equipment optimization initiatives.

  • Proficient in interpreting and developing P&IDs, technical specifications, and engineering documentation.

  • Strong understanding of asset reliability, preventative maintenance strategies, and energy optimization practices.

  • Familiarity with OSHA PSM and EPA RMP requirements.

  • Ability to travel to operating sites as needed.

  • This role requires approximately >25% travel during the initial years, with the potential for reduced travel as the function matures and stabilizes.

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline

LICENSES

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Working knowledge of applicable industry standards and regulatory requirements, including IIAR and ASHRAE guidelines.

  • EPA Section 608 Certification

  • Experience in food distribution, cold storage, manufacturing, or logistics environments.

  • Experience supporting multi-site operations.

  • Experience with AutoCAD verification and updating.

PHYSICAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • Standard required physical activities including length of time performing each activity.

This role will also receive annual incentive plan bonus.​

jobs.title: VP of Materials Programs
jobs.excerpt: The Vice President of Materials at the International Living Future Institute (Living Future) is a key leader who leads the strategy and vision for engagement with our movement, overseeing a diverse team and set of programs and serving as a key relationship-builder for the organization.
jobs.description:
The Vice President of Materials at the International Living Future Institute (Living Future) is a key leader who leads the strategy and vision for engagement with our movement, overseeing a diverse team and set of programs and serving as a key relationship-builder for the organization. Overseeing the Materials Team is a role that focuses on creating and maintaining our Declare and Living Product Challenge (LPC) programs. The Materials Team is composed of team members who manage all aspects of our work to create supply chain transparency and certification of regenerative building materials, and who work in collaboration with the other Teams at Living Future (Buildings, Engagement, and Operations) to help advance progress towards a regenerative built world. The VP of Materials drives strategy and provides high-level leadership for a team of highly functional and passionate individuals.

The VP of Materials is accountable for strategy, execution and revenue generation for our Materials programs including leading the upcoming business strategy to scale our impact through a greater harmonization of Declare and the LPC. The role is also a key external ‘face’ for the organization, managing key client relationships and ensuring their continued engagement (philosophical and financial) in our programs. This role also sets and is accountable for the Materials Team revenue and expenses, tracking that budget and providing elegant and accurate reporting of Team impact and financial metrics to the Living Future team including the Board of Directors. The VP of Materials also plays a critical and active role in connecting Living Future to the wider movement for supply chain transparency and good materials in the building industry: the VP maintains active relationships and engagement with peer organizations and key leaders to ensure that Living Future is well-coordinated in our tactics and programs. The VP of Materials is also a member of the Management Team for Living Future, which is the core leadership team of the organization.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
Overall strategic and operational responsibility for the Declare and LPC programs, from research & development, client success, sales, marketing, and partnerships.

Relationship Management

  • Create and maintain strategic partnerships that grow the Declare and LPC programs and help Living Future grow its regenerative work and engagement with the movement
  • Leverage our community to create and iterate on our programs strategy by effectively co-creating and engaging clients as we consider adjustments to our Declare & LPC programs
  • Support corporate membership and sponsorship outreach efforts, playing an active role in relationship building with key Declare and LPC clients to encourage their participation in the larger Living Future movement and our other programs (including membership and events)
  • Serve as an eloquent and knowledgeable spokesperson for the organization at industry events and in strategic conversations with stakeholders.
  • Lead R&D fundraising efforts for the Materials Team, including relationship building with key collaborators (including philanthropic organizations where appropriate), drafting concept notes, developing pitch decks, and seeking opportunities for creative partnerships with peer NGOs and others to create mutually beneficial partnerships for the development of our movement.

Business Strategy

  • Lead the development of a practical and thorough business strategy (in written form, for Board and staff participation) for the evolution of our Materials programs, including a 2027 full plan towards a harmonized program structure for the Materials team (i.e. along the lines of our ‘three sisters’ concept).
  • Maintain effective and simple pricing systems and structures that ensure staff time is properly valued in our pricing and that allows us to scale our impact in line with our mission.
  • Maintain awareness of key industry trends, global regulations and funding opportunities that could impact our Declare and LPC programs.
  • Continuously assess and measure business operations, staff bandwidth and expertise, client sentiment, resilience and team strengths/gaps to ensure smooth operations and happy teammates as our programs scale.
  • Serve on the Management Team for Living Future, proactively contributing to coordination across teams, strengthening Living Future’s interdisciplinary approach to market transformation and movement building, and ensuring organizational health and smooth operations.

Program Oversight

  • Provide leadership to the Materials Team, fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment, optimized systems, and thoughtful programs that strengthen our movement.
  • Proactively and continuously foster the identification of program evolution opportunities (e.g. introducing new pathways, metrics, crosswalks, processes like third-party verification) and oversee the process and prioritization of these evolutions.
  • The role has 3 direct reports: a go-to-market leader and two R&D leaders. The VP will provide oversight, professional development and coordination for all of these individuals.
  • The role will serve as the primary contact for our Declare platform technology partner, Geofund, as well as other business partner organizations (including Living Future Oceania) for the Materials team. This involves negotiating and maintaining contracts with these entities, ensuring that all expectations are met on both sides, etc.
  • Set and maintain an annual Team budget, regularly track and report on revenues and expenditures in partnership with our Operations Team, and ensure that the team maintains alignment with the budget through establishment of and reporting on clear objectives and key results (OKRs).
  • Ultimately, this role is accountable for the revenue and impact of the Materials Team, which brought in roughly $1.25M in revenue in 2025.
  • Foster a positive and productive work environment for a group that is accountable, inclusive, and innovative.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 15+ years of experience in the nonprofit and/or sustainability sector, including 10+ years in a leadership capacity with revenue responsibility in the $1-3M range
  • Broad knowledge of green manufacturing, CSR, and DEI issues, trends, and programs.
  • Strong familiarity with business development, sales, customer service, and certification processes including comfort and willingness to use CRM platforms like Salesforce and customer service platforms like HelpScout.
  • Familiarity with Living Future’s labels and certifications, including familiarity with the broader theories of change in the building materials supply chain transparency movement.
  • Demonstrated strategic planning skills and experience, including business planning
  • Demonstrated organizational leadership and management experience including managing a growing team of direct reports
  • Demonstrated success in team leadership including thoughtful performance management processes and fostering growth and empowerment for team members.
  • Proficiency with financial management at the department level including the use of invoicing softwares, budgeting platforms and processes and efficient financial metric tracking.
  • Demonstrated operational experience, success in building out repeatable processes, quality assurance systems, staff training
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to encourage ideas and feedback from a diverse range of customers, funders, and other stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated commitment to diversity, equity, and creating an inclusive work environment.
  • Background and passion for sustainable design and development and values-driven business operations are highly desirable.

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Undergraduate or graduate degree in a related field.
  • Strong connections with leaders in the building materials industry, including manufacturers, architects and engineers, construction, key industry groups and others.
  • Experience with administering programs/standards, establishing third-party audit systems, adhering to best practices for program development and governance
  • Experience with and affinity for working across virtual teams and with remote management.
  • Living Future Accreditation. Candidates who are not already Living Future Accredited will be supported in achieving their LFA within one year.

Our mission at the Living Future is to build a future that is socially just, culturally rich, and ecologically restorative. We are committed to that vision within our organization and work to create a team that is equitable, inclusive, and diverse by hiring and supporting staff from a wide variety of backgrounds. We are committed as an organization to foster better cultural competency, equity, and diversity within our culture and policies and work to support staff in every phase of their career. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process. If you require any accommodations, please contact our hiring team at employment [at] living-future.org.

The salary range for this position is $111,981 to $122,445 annually and is supplemented by Living Future’s generous benefits package that includes employer-paid health, dental and vision insurance for employees and dependents as well as employee life insurance, short-term disability, and a 403(b) retirement plan. Annual time off benefits include three weeks of paid annual leave, 12 days of sick leave, and paid volunteer time.

Living Future offers a collaborative, team-oriented and mission-driven remote workplace. We offer a $50/month stipend to offset home internet costs.

Please include a resume and cover letter with your application. We will be reviewing applicants starting on November 30, 2026.

Living Future is a non-profit organization whose mission is to catalyze the transformation toward communities that are culturally rich, socially just and ecologically restorative. Our flagship program is the Living Building Challenge, the world’s most ambitious and holistic performance standard for resilient, healthy, and green buildings. Living Future offers other certifications, transparency labels, education, and events that enable organizations and individuals to communicate their commitment to a healthier world.

We believe that the building industry can shift dramatically far faster and more radically than many assume. We also believe that the industry can and should address ecological impact, social impact, health impact and cultural impact as intersecting issues. Living Buildings are beacons for change, data points for skeptics, inspirational stories for young people, and test beds for innovation. We seek to affect change in the building industry by envisioning a living future and showing it’s possible to embody that future in practice and policy. We are a fully remote organization, and are not seeking candidates based in the Portland area.

jobs.excerpt: GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk.
jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

We are looking for a skilled Security Engineer to support the implementation, optimization, and operational support of security operations technologies and workflows. This role will engage in the development of security telemetry pipelines, SIEM detection content, and security automation while providing “Wow Them” service to clients, internal customers, and co-workers.

The Security Engineer must demonstrate strong technical troubleshooting, analytical, and client communication skills. The engineer must lead through influence and apply sound business and financial awareness when making technical decisions involving project scope, level of effort, platform performance, data volume, and client value.

About the Northeast region SecOps practice

The Northeast region Security Operations Practice is responsible for helping clients design, implement, optimize, and operate the technologies and processes used to detect, investigate, and respond to cybersecurity threats. We deliver consulting and engineering services across SIEM, SOAR, security telemetry, detection engineering, observability, and SOC transformation.

Our team of engineers, consultants, architects, and platform specialists focuses on security data onboarding, detection coverage, workflow automation, platform optimization, and operational maturity. We partner with clients, account executives, project managers, technology providers, and internal delivery teams to implement practical and supportable security capabilities.

Key areas of focus include:

  • Creating repeatable and measurable Security Operations services.
  • Improving telemetry quality, detection coverage, and investigation efficiency.
  • Evaluating and adopting emerging security technologies responsibly.

Roles and Responsibilities:

SIEM Engineering

  • Architect, deploy, and maintain the SIEM platforms (e.g., CrowdStrike, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Elastic, Google SecOps), including data ingestion, parsing, normalization, and retention.
  • Onboard and tune log sources across cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP), identity (Entra ID, Okta, Active Directory), endpoint (EDR), network, email security, SaaS, and line-of-business applications.
  • Develop, test, and tune detection rules, correlation searches, and analytics mapped to MITRE ATT reduce false positives and close detection gaps.
  • Build dashboards, reports, and metrics for SOC operations, leadership, and audit/compliance needs.
  • Monitor SIEM health, data quality, ingestion costs, and performance; recommend optimizations.

SOAR Engineering and Automation

  • Design, build, and maintain SOAR playbooks (e.g., Palo Alto XSOAR, Splunk SOAR, Sentinel automation/Logic Apps, Tines, Torq) for triage, enrichment, containment, and case management.
  • Integrate security and IT tools via APIs, including EDR, identity, ticketing (ServiceNow/Jira), threat intelligence platforms, email gateways, and vulnerability scanners.
  • Automate high-volume use cases such as phishing response, account compromise, malware triage, and user-behavior alerts.
  • Establish version control, testing, and change-management practices for detections and playbooks (detection-as-code).
  • Measure and report automation impact (e.g., mean time to detect/respond, analyst hours saved).

Collaboration and Governance

  • Partner with SOC analysts, incident responders, threat hunters, and threat intelligence to turn lessons learned into new detections and automations.
  • Work with IT, cloud, and application teams to ensure appropriate logging and onboarding standards.
  • Support client-facing security questionnaires, audits, and assessments (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, client-specific requirements) with evidence and documentation.
  • Maintain clear documentation: runbooks, data source inventories, detection catalogs, and architecture diagrams.
  • Participate in on-call or after-hours support rotation for critical platform issues and major incidents, as needed.

Required Experience and Education:

  • 3-5 years of architecture, implementation, and troubleshooting experience with one or more SIEM/SOAR solutions
  • Proficiency developing log ingestion and aggregation strategies
  • Expertise developing security-focused content for one more SIEM platforms (Splunk ES, CrowdStrike NG-SIEM, Elastic Security, Palo Alto XSIAM, Google SecOps, Microsoft Sentinel, Sentinel One AI SIEM), including creation of complex threat detection logic and operational dashboards
  • Expertise with SOAR platforms (Splunk SOAR, Palo Alto XSOAR, Tines, Torq)
  • Familiarity with key security events on common IT platforms
  • Deep proficiency in client and server operating systems including Windows, Mac, and Linux
  • General networking and security troubleshooting (firewalls, routing, NAT, etc.)
  • Scripting and development skills (BASH, Perl, Python or Java) with strong knowledge of regular expressions
  • Ability to autonomously prioritize and successfully deliver across a portfolio of projects
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes

Preferred Experience and Education:

  • Experience with platforms such as Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Terraform and SaltStack
  • Experience with other Information Security solutions including CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, ZScaler, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, Microsoft Defender products, Carbon Black, Splunk, and/or Cisco
  • Experience authoring security runbooks, policy, and best practice documentation

Travel Requirements:

  • Up to 10% travel

Physical Requirements:

  • Sedentary work
  • Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day
  • Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

jobs.title: Principal Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren.
jobs.description:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Als zukunftsweisende Open-Source-Lösung wird Shopware bereits von einigen der größten europäischen Marken, Einzelhändlern und Herstellern im B2C- und B2B-Bereich eingesetzt.

Wir suchen eine:n Principal Platform Engineer (m/w/d) für den Aufbau und Betrieb unserer Data Platform – der Infrastruktur für Datenaufnahme, Speicherung und Laufzeitumgebungen, auf der alle Datenpipelines bei Shopware laufen. Du verantwortest ihre Architektur und Zuverlässigkeit: von der CDC-Datenaufnahme über einen dreistufigen Data Lake bis hin zur Orchestrierungsplattform.

Deine Arbeit ermöglicht es den Service-Teams und dem Management, unsere Kund:innen und Produkte besser zu verstehen. Zugleich schaffst du die technische Grundlage, um Anforderungen an Data Governance und Compliance tatsächlich durchzusetzen.

Du arbeitest eng mit Data & AI zusammen, die auf der von dir betriebenen Plattform Datenpipelines entwickelt. Im Service Enablement Team sorgst du dafür, dass für die Data Platform dieselben Golden Paths und Qualitätsstandards gelten wie für die übrige Service Platform. Die Position ist eine erfahrene Fachlaufbahn ohne Personalverantwortung. Wichtig ist, dass du gern mit vielen Stakeholdern, Kolleg:innen und Partnern zusammenarbeitest.

Requirements

  • Datenaufnahme: CDC-Ingestion über DMS/Lambda in den Raw-Bereich von S3 sowie Verantwortung für Raw-Schema und Datenverträge. Derzeit umfasst die Plattform 13 Domänen und rund 180 Schemata über drei Ebenen hinweg. 11 CDC-Quellen laufen bereits produktiv, weitere kommen hinzu.

  • Speicherung und Orchestrierung: Verantwortung für die mit Terraform bereitgestellte Orchestrierungsplattform auf Basis von Step Functions, EventBridge und Glue über alle drei Lake-Ebenen (Raw, Curated und Aggregated) sowie für die zugehörigen CDC-Terraform-Module.

  • Datenkatalog-Infrastruktur: Betrieb und Bereitstellung von OpenMetadata. Dazu gehören die Katalog-Infrastruktur und die Trennung zwischen Betrieb und Nutzung wie bei den Lake-Ebenen. Data & AI ergänzt darauf aufbauend Datensatzbeschreibungen, Glossar und Stewardship-Inhalte.

  • Tooling-Infrastruktur: Bereitstellung und Betrieb von Superset, dem Werkzeug der Teams für Datenabfragen und Visualisierungen.

  • Abgrenzung der Pipelines: klare Codegrenzen, ein Merge-blockierender Vertragscheck und eine eindeutige Regel für die Weiterleitung von Vorfällen: Bei Infrastrukturproblemen wirst du benachrichtigt oder alarmiert, nicht bei Fehlern in der Pipeline-Logik.

  • Zuverlässigkeit: Aufbau von Observability und operativer Exzellenz für die Data Platform, unter anderem mit Datadog, Incident Response sowie SLOs und SLIs. Du übernimmst den On-Call-Dienst; die Vergütung dafür entspricht vom ersten Tag an der Regelung anderer Teams.

  • Governance- und Compliance-Mechanismen: Die Richtlinien selbst – etwa Klassifizierungsstandards, Aufbewahrungsregeln und der Umgang mit DSGVO- und Datenschutzanfragen – werden außerhalb von SET und Data & AI durch Legal/Compliance oder eine datenschutznahe Funktion verantwortet. Du legst diese Richtlinien nicht fest, sondern implementierst die dafür erforderliche Architektur: Aufbewahrungsfristen, Zugriffskontrollen, Klassifizierungsmetadaten und die Weiterleitung von Löschanfragen.

  • Plattformübergreifende Konsistenz: Zusammenarbeit mit dem Principal Platform Engineer für Infrastruktur, damit die Data Platform dieselbe Self-Service-Philosophie und denselben Reifegrad wie die übrige Plattform erreicht.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte praktische AWS-Erfahrung mit Glue, Athena, Step Functions, EventBridge, Lake Formation und S3 sowie umfassende Terraform-Erfahrung beim Erstellen und Weiterentwickeln gemeinsam genutzter Module.

  • Praxiserfahrung mit CDC-Pipelines und einer Iceberg-basierten Lakehouse-Architektur mit den Ebenen Raw, Curated und Aggregated. Dieses Format ist heute produktiv im Einsatz.

  • Vertrautheit mit Kafka-basiertem Event-Streaming (MSK, Glue Schema Registry) für Ereignisse auf Anwendungsebene, die neben CDC-Daten in der Plattform landen.

  • Sicherheit im Betrieb einer Plattform, auf die andere Teams angewiesen sind: Erfahrung mit Incident Response und SLOs sowie das Urteilsvermögen, individuelle Anforderungen in den Backlog aufzunehmen, statt sie ad hoc umzusetzen.

  • Starke teamübergreifende Kommunikation: Du arbeitest direkt mit Data & AI daran, die Grenzen zwischen Infrastruktur und Pipeline-Logik klar zu halten, und stimmst dich mit dem Principal Platform Engineer für Infrastruktur zu übergreifenden Standards ab. Keine der beiden Beziehungen ist eine Berichtslinie.

  • Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis dafür, was eine datengetriebene Kultur nachhaltig verankert: Führungskräfte, die anhand von Kennzahlen handeln, organisationsweite Datenkompetenz, eine für alle Zielgruppen zugängliche Infrastruktur und Daten als gemeinschaftliche Ressource.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher gegenüber der Führungsebene und sprichst Zielkonflikte und Risiken proaktiv an, statt darauf zu warten, danach gefragt zu werden.

  • Du kommunizierst schriftlich klar und direkt und kannst technische Positionen gegenüber Engineering-Kolleg:innen ebenso wie gegenüber nichttechnischen Stakeholdern vertreten und begründen.

Nice to have:

  • Vertrautheit mit dbt (dbt-athena) oder Spark/pySpark – genug, um konstruktiv darüber zu sprechen, wo die Grenze zwischen Infrastruktur und Pipeline-Logik künftig verlaufen sollte.

  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau eines On-Call-Dienstes für ein Team, das bisher noch keinen hatte.

  • Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Legal- und Compliance-Stakeholdern: Anforderungen an Aufbewahrungsfristen oder Datenklassifizierung in konkrete Infrastrukturentscheidungen übersetzen – und nicht nur wissen, dass es solche Anforderungen gibt.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!

Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Yanina Schröer und steht dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung!

Der Schutz deiner persönlichen Daten hat für uns oberste Priorität. Unsere Bewerberinformationen findest du hier.
