jobs.excerpt: Position Title: Chief Growth Officer Reports to: Executive Director Team: 2 FTEs on partnerships + 1 marketing contractor Role Type: Full-Time Employee About Us:The Student Basic Needs Coalition (SBNC) is building the national model for connecting students with public benefits and basic needs resources.
jobs.description:
Position Title: Chief Growth Officer

Reports to: Executive Director

Team: 2 FTEs on partnerships + 1 marketing contractor

Role Type: Full-Time Employee

About Us:

The Student Basic Needs Coalition (SBNC) is building the national model for connecting students with public benefits and basic needs resources.

Millions of students are eligible for programs like SNAP and Medicaid, yet the majority never enroll due to complex rules, stigma, and administrative barriers. SBNC addresses this gap by partnering with organizations across the country to implement peer-led outreach programs and deploy Navvy, SBNC’s AI-enabled technology platform that screens students for benefits eligibility and supports the enrollment process.

Since launching in 2020, SBNC has grown rapidly. The organization now partners with 100+ campuses nationwide, has screened more than 50,000 students, and has referred students to over $116 million in potential public benefits. In 2024, SBNC hired its first full-time Executive Director and has since grown to a $2 million organization with a team of seven, expanding to ten staff members this year as it scales its national model.

Position Overview:

SBNC is hiring its first Chief Growth Officer (CGO) to turn strong demand and a growing national network into a repeatable growth and earned-revenue model. We already work with 100+ campuses and regularly hear interest from colleges, systems, states, funders, and other partners, but we have not yet built a sales engine or established pricing for our offerings. The CGO will help determine which institutional segments to prioritize, how to position and package our work, what institutions are willing to pay for, and how to move from interest and pilots to recurring paid partnerships. They will work closely with the Executive Director on SBNC’s highest-priority sales and relationships while building the systems, pipeline, and team needed to make growth increasingly repeatable. This role does not own fundraising; the CGO coordinates with the Executive Director so growth, partner, and funder messaging stay aligned.

The CGO will also lead SBNC's marketing, building our brand and positioning with institutional buyers while owning our direct-to-student and alternative distribution strategy. That includes deciding where investments in digital channels, creator partnerships, and non-campus partners such as national nonprofits, food banks, and workforce programs can most effectively connect students to Navvy. Direct-to-student channels are measured on reach and impact; earned revenue comes from institutional partnerships.

Growth doesn't end at a signed agreement. The CGO will own renewal and expansion, build a partner-success model that sets new partners up to launch well, and close the loop between the field and product so partner and student insights shape how Navvy evolves.

This is a player-coach role for someone who can move between strategy and execution: shaping go-to-market and pricing, personally advancing important partnerships, using data to decide where to invest, developing staff, and working closely with product and the executive team as SBNC scales. The ideal candidate's deepest strength will be institutional sales and partnerships, paired with the judgment to lead marketing and use data to test which channels best reach students.

Responsibilities

Growth Strategy & Leadership (15%)

  • Set SBNC's growth and marketing strategy across institutional and direct-to-student channels, identifying priority markets, segments, and distribution opportunities based on data, partner feedback, and org positioning
  • Achieve targets for Navvy screener adoption, partnerships, and revenue, reporting performance to the executive team, funders, and board on a regular cadence
  • Own and evolve SBNC’s go-to-market strategy for paid offerings, including market research, customer segmentation, positioning, packaging, pricing, pilot design, sales motion, and testing what institutions will pay for
  • Manage, lead and build the growth function over time, including defining roles, systems, processes, developing staff, and planning future hiring needs as the team expands

Business Development & Earned Revenue (40%)

  • Build and manage a strong, nationwide pipeline of campus, state, system, and other institutional partners
  • Lead partnership development and sales strategy from initial outreach through negotiation, close, and implementation, with direct personal ownership of the organization's highest-stakes system and state-level relationships and managerial oversight of all partnerships
  • Use Hubspot CRM data and forecasting to drive pipeline visibility and data-informed decisions across the growth team
  • Diversify and scale SBNC's earned-revenue base so it grows alongside philanthropic revenue, ensuring pricing and packaging decisions preserve equitable student access as well as organizational sustainability
  • Hold accountability for the earned-revenue P&L, setting annual and multi-year targets in partnership with the COO

Partner Success & Field Learning (25%)

  • Build a scalable partner-success model, ensuring new partners launch successfully with the support, tools, and expectations needed to drive student and staff engagement
  • Own renewal and expansion strategy and targets, identifying opportunities to deepen relationships, improve retention, and grow revenue over time

The way engineers build is changing, and we are looking for developers who are excited to be in the room when that happens. If you eat bugs for breakfast and believe great software should feel like magic, let's chat! 🚀

You'll work across Synera's product, from our web-based execution platform to the low-code desktop editor and customer portal, helping bring these pieces together into one cohesive and awesome experience. Along the way, you'll have room to experiment: trying out new approaches, bringing AI into your own workflow, and pushing for better ways of building rather than just the familiar ones.

That means shaping the way users interact with complex engineering automations, and making it feel simple, fast, and even fun. We're looking for someone who’s excited to own features end-to-end, explore new technologies, and help connect the dots between our different products.

If you enjoy working in a collaborative environment where ideas (and pizza 🍕) are always shared, you’ll feel right at home with us.

👉 What a week at Synera could look like:

  • Monday: You kick off the week by syncing with fellow devs across teams: sharing breakthroughs, tackling tough bugs, or dropping a hot tip about that obscure TypeScript feature you mastered recently.

  • Tuesday: Time to dive into a new technical challenge: you and your team huddle up for a design session to figure out how to make a complex feature feel like magic for the user.

  • Wednesday: You create a pull request for your current story that you’re proud of. Then you help a teammate level up their code with thoughtful reviews (and just the right amount of emoji feedback 🎯✨).

  • Thursday: It’s demo day! You show off what the team’s built during the sprint, watching features come together and getting high-fives (virtual or real) from across the company.

  • Friday: You sit in on a customer call with our success team and get real insights into what’s working, and what’s not. That afternoon, during your bi-weekly Friday project time, you spin up a quick prototype that just might solve their problem.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • You get to know our code base and product.

  • You start to support other developers by completing reviews.

  • You take on stories of increasing complexity with increasing independence.

  • You add and adjust skills of our software factory.

⚡ In 12 months:

  • You take responsibility for bigger features and epics.

  • You drive topics in an expert domain of yours.

  • You take ownership of design and decisions made to create a certain module or feature.

Here is our team at the summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary ranges are:

  • Experienced Level: €74,000 - €92,000 annually

  • Advanced Level: €88,000 - €116,000 annually

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

Requirements

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. You will have the chance to work on all parts of our technology stack and in close collaboration with our customers, to understand their needs and get direct feedback on the changes you ship.

The role

Our platform sits between our customers and dozens of third-party accounting and ERP systems. That makes reliability part of our product. When a call is slow or fails, our customers need to know why, and so do we. You’ll be the senior engineer who owns how our platform runs in production, and you’ll keep building the product alongside the team. You’ll work directly with our CTO, Lennart Svensson, and the wider founder team.

What you will do

Own our Azure infrastructure end-to-end

You know every service, how it’s deployed and what it costs. You’ll tighten what’s there and codify what isn’t. As we scale, you’ll keep the architecture simple: we run on managed services and plan to keep it that way.

Bring real observability to the platform

Metrics, logs, traces and alerts, across our services and the third-party APIs we call. You’ll define what “healthy” means, build the dashboards, and set up alerting and on-call so we catch problems before our clients do. When a mysterious timeout appears, you’re the one who can trace it to its source.

Raise the bar on security and reliability

Fintechs trust us with sensitive financial data. You’ll harden the platform, make sure we can deliver on incident response and SLAs, and keep us audit-ready as customers ask for certifications like SOC 2 or ISO 27001.

Build product and level up the team

You’ll ship features and integrations with the rest of the engineering team. You’ll also be the go-to person for production debugging, and you’ll mentor our engineers so the whole team gets better at running what we build.

What you bring

  • Experience: 5+ years building and running backend services in production, including real ownership of infrastructure, deployments and incidents.

  • Kind teammates and great collaborative atmosphere

Junior Account Executive DACH (German-speaking)

Location: Remote (Within +/- 2 hours of CET)

Contract type: Full-time

Salary: Starting from €40,000 OTE per annum gross (60% base / 40% bonus), subject to location, skills and experience


Not Your Typical Workplace:

Great talent doesn't stop at borders, and neither do the companies we work with. At WorkMotion, we're building the future of work: helping ambitious companies hire, onboard and manage the best people anywhere in the world, through smart, flexible workforce solutions. Remote-first, fast-paced, people-driven and globally connected, we empower businesses to build teams beyond borders. And we're looking for people who want to win while doing it.

More Than a Role

The German market is full of ambitious companies trapped by hiring borders. A Munich scale-up has found the perfect engineer in Lisbon but doesn't know how to employ her compliantly. A Hamburg founder wants to put fresh funding into expanding to three countries by next quarter. As our Junior Account Executive Germany, your mission is powerful: Open up the world's talent pool to German companies.

This is a Junior AE role, built for a top-performer who's ready to close their own deals, not by pushing a product, but by advising with substance and closing with confidence. You're confident in front of decision-makers, curious enough to ask the questions others don't, and ambitious about your numbers: hitting target is the minimum, outperforming it is what drives you. Your energy shows in your can-do attitude and follow-through, day in, day out.


Where Responsibility Meets Real Opportunity:

  • Command Your Territory: Own the full sales cycle in Germany, from first conversation to onboarded talent.
  • Curious Questioner: Ask the second and third question. Uncover where, why and how fast a company is hiring, and what's at stake if compliance goes wrong.
  • Champion Builder: Equip your HR champion with the arguments Finance, Legal and leadership care about, so decision-makers see the value, not just the price.
  • Deal Momentum: Create urgency, negotiate with confidence and keep deals moving.
  • Self-Made Pipeline: Roll your sleeves up and team up with the BDRs to go after the biggest opportunities in your territory.


What It Takes to Make an Impact Here…

  • Your Background: BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS, or another targetdriven, customer-facing role. You're self-driven, learn fast and know your numbers.
  • Discovery Experience: You've led conversations to uncover a prospect's or client's needs, and you're eager to take them all the way to a signed deal.
  • Outbound DNA: A cold call is a chance, not a threat. You know how to get a busy founder's attention, from a well-timed call after a funding round to a voice note they actually listen to.
  • AI-Savvy & Organized: AI is a natural part of how you work, making you faster and sharper every day. And your HubSpot (or similar CRM) is always up to date.
  • Coachable: You ask for feedback and put it into action the same day.
  • German Native: Native-level German and business-fluent English.

Bonus Points If You Bring:

  • Experience with HR tech, payroll, EOR or other compliance-heavy solutions
  • First closing experience, for example running your own demos or closing smaller deals
  • Creativity in getting your foot in the door: find a smart way to reach the hiring managers directly, and show them why you're the right person for this role

Not Your Typical Team:

We're a team of 26 sales minds, from BDRs, AEs and Team Leads to our CRM, Sales Enablement and Campaign Manager, based across Europe, Africa and the Middle East, a motivated, fully distributed crew that proves "remote" doesn't mean "disconnected." We don't just work together, we push, challenge and grow together. We share what works, celebrate each other's successes, learn from every win and loss, and jump in when a colleague needs a second voice to get a deal over the line. If you're looking for an environment where your ideas are welcomed, your voice is heard, and bold strategies thrive on collective brainpower and high-energy teamwork, you'll feel right at home.


The Perks of Being Here…

  • Global, remote, and thriving: We're a global team of talented individuals spread across 26 countries. Our WorkFlex program lets you work from anywhere, anytime. Whether it's a beachside office or a cosy home office, the choice is yours.
  • Your well-being is our priority: We know mental health matters, which is why we offer a dedicated Well-Being Day, a full day off just to recharge and relax.
  • Get fit and stay active: Whether it's yoga, weightlifting, or a quick jog, work out on your terms, at a discount with our subsidised gym memberships.
  • Learn, grow, and develop: We believe in constant growth. With our Training & Development Allowance, you'll have all the opportunities you need to keep expanding your skills and knowledge.
  • Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups!
  • Diversity is our superpower: We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

* Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations.

At WorkMotion, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, just let our Recruitment Team know at . We're here to support you every step of the way!

We are looking for a Senior Transformation Engineer with strong Google Workspace and GenAI experience to join our team. This is a direct consulting role working with large enterprise clients to design, build and deliver AI‑enabled productivity and collaboration solutions.

In this role you will work closely with enterprise customers to understand their business processes and collaboration need and then design and implement solutions that use Google Workspace, Google Cloud and GenAI tools.

You will combine engineering and consulting skills: spending considerable time client-facing, shaping requirements with business stakeholders, and then building and integrating solutions using App Script, Claude, Enterprise Gemini and related technologies. You will also draw on Microsoft 365 ability (particularly SharePoint) to support migration and integration scenarios.

If you are enthusiastic about Google technologies and excited by the potential of GenAI in modern workplaces, we would be keen to hear from you.

Location: UK – Remote - 25% travel to Customer sites, conferences, and other related events.

Key responsibilities:

  • Work directly with enterprise clients (typically 2–3 engagements at a time) to understand business requirements and design Google Workspace and GenAI‑based solutions.
  • Lead discovery, scoping and solution design phases (typically 3–4-month cycles), translating business needs into clear technical architectures and delivery plans.
  • Engineer and integrate solutions using Google Workspace (including App Script), Google Cloud and GenAI tools such as Claude and Enterprise Gemini.
  • Support and advise on migration and integration from Microsoft 365 (including SharePoint) to Google Workspace, ensuring minimal disruption for end users.
  • Run demonstrations, proof‑of‑concepts and technical walkthroughs for business unit leaders and end users, clearly explaining capabilities and values.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders across engineering, consulting and sales to ensure solutions are scalable, secure and aligned to best practice.
  • Function as a trusted technical consultant, able to respond quickly to client questions, challenge assumptions where needed and introduce innovative ideas and approaches.
  • Stay current with developments in Google Cloud, Google Workspace and GenAI, and proactively bring new capabilities and patterns into client engagements.

Key skills and experience:

  • Experience in technology consulting, solutions engineering or a similar client‑facing technical role.
  • Strong direct experience with Google Workspace and Google Cloud technologies, including automation and scripting (e.g., App Script).
  • Practical experience building or integrating GenAI solutions (e.g., Claude, Enterprise Gemini or similar), ideally in enterprise environments.
  • Good understanding of Microsoft 365, with strength in SharePoint, and experience supporting migrations or coexistence between Microsoft and Google platforms.
  • Proven ability to engage directly with business stakeholders and end users – excellent communication skills, able to explain complex technical topics in a clear, non‑technical way.

Along with excellent benefits and a compelling reward package, we offer the opportunity to work in a supportive environment with a high level of autonomy and creativity - there’s a reason our average employee tenure is over 6 years.

We strive to display our three core values of Hunger, Heart and Harmony every day. They represent and drive who we are here at Insight and by doing so we are doing amazing things. Insight started in a garage in 1988 and it is through harnessing our three core values that two brothers, Eric and Tim Crown, steered Insight to the Fortune 500 company it is today. We are now a Global IT Services and Solutions business, passionate about helping customers and the real people who sit behind them.

We will endeavour to contact you within five business days, should we feel your profile is a good match for this role. If you do not hear from us within this timeframe, please presume that on this occasion, your application was not successful.

Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo is seeking a Senior Software Engineer, Logical Network Inventory, to join our growing Lit Network Inventory team. In this role, you'll be a key player in building, scaling, and automating the next generation of our network tooling infrastructure.


The Senior Software Engineer, Logical Network Inventory is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting software solutions that improve the accuracy, automation, integration, and scalability of Zayo's Logical Network Inventory ecosystem.


This role will have a strong focus on automation, APIs, system integrations, and data quality solutions supporting Netcracker and associated network inventory systems. The Senior Software Engineer will work closely with the Logical Inventory Product Manager, Application Administrators, Network Engineering, Functional Leads, and other technology teams to deliver capabilities supporting the Logical Inventory product roadmap.


The position will serve as a senior technical resource within the Logical Inventory team, providing technical direction, solution design, code reviews, troubleshooting support, and mentorship to junior engineers.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and support software solutions supporting Zayo's Logical Network Inventory ecosystem
  • Design and develop APIs and integration services that enable reliable exchange of network inventory data between Netcracker and upstream/downstream systems
  • Develop automation to improve inventory creation, validation, reconciliation, remediation, and lifecycle management
  • Develop automated data quality controls to identify missing, invalid, inconsistent, duplicate, stale, or improperly modeled network inventory
  • Develop reconciliation solutions that compare Netcracker inventory against network discovery platforms and other authoritative data sources
  • Design automated remediation processes for inventory discrepancies where appropriate, including appropriate validation, controls, logging, and exception handling
  • Develop tools and services that reduce manual inventory administration and improve the scalability and reliability of inventory operations
  • Work with Application Administrators and network subject matter experts to understand complex inventory issues and develop sustainable automated solutions
  • Develop a deep understanding of network inventory models, including network resources, hierarchies, connectivity, relationships, dependencies, and service associations
  • Translate network and inventory requirements into technical designs, data models, integration patterns, APIs, and automation solutions
  • Support the Logical Inventory product roadmap by providing technical analysis, solution architecture, effort estimates, implementation recommendations, and identification of technical dependencies
  • Partner with the Logical Inventory Product Manager and Functional Leads to evaluate proposed capabilities and determine appropriate technical solutions
  • Design solutions that consider scalability, maintainability, performance, resiliency, observability, and long-term operational support
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, interface specifications, API documentation, data mappings, solution designs, and operational procedures
  • Establish and promote software engineering standards, including source control, code review, testing, deployment, logging, monitoring, and documentation practices
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical guidance to other engineers
  • Mentor and support junior software engineers through solution design, development, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing
  • Assist with complex production incidents involving inventory data, APIs, integrations, automation, or application interfaces
  • Perform root cause analysis of recurring integration and data quality issues and develop solutions that address systemic causes rather than relying on manual remediation
  • Collaborate with Application Administrators during Netcracker upgrades, application changes, and releases to identify and test impacts to APIs, integrations, automation, and data flows
  • Coordinate with internal engineering teams and external vendors as necessary to resolve complex technical issues
  • Identify opportunities to improve Logical Inventory architecture, automation, data quality, and engineering practices

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field, OR equivalent relevant professional experience
  • Minimum of seven (7) years of software engineering or application development experience
  • Strong Python development experience is required
  • Strong SQL experience, including experience working with complex relational data models, is required.
  • Experience designing, developing, and supporting SOAP/REST APIs and system integrations is required
  • Experience developing production-grade automation, data processing, or integration solutions
  • Experience with API authentication, error handling, retry strategies, logging, monitoring, and integration resiliency
  • Experience integrating enterprise applications using APIs, messaging, event-driven architectures, and/or batch data processing
  • Experience designing automated data validation, reconciliation, and data quality solutions
  • Experience working with large and complex datasets and performing root cause analysis of data discrepancies
  • Experience with source control, code review, automated testing, CI/CD, and modern software development practices
  • Ability to work effectively in Linux environments
  • Experience designing and supporting highly available production software and integration services
  • Experience with telecommunications network inventory systems such as Netcracker, MetaSolv, or similar OSS platforms is strongly preferred
  • Experience modeling or working with complex network structures, including network resources, hierarchies, connectivity, relationships, and dependencies, is strongly preferred
  • Understanding of telecommunications network technologies and the relationships between physical, logical, and service inventory is strongly preferred
  • Experience with network discovery, inventory reconciliation, or network automation platforms is a plus
  • Experience with cloud platforms, containers, orchestration, and modern application deployment technologies is a plus
  • Strong analytical and complex problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate business, network, and inventory requirements into scalable technical solutions
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, both oral and written
  • Demonstrated ability to work across software engineering, network engineering, operations, product, and vendor teams
  • Ability to independently lead technical design and problem-solving efforts
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to junior engineers
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to troubleshoot complex problems across application, integration, and data layers
  • Comfortable working in a rapidly changing technical environment
  • Experience documenting technical designs, architectures, APIs, integrations, and operational procedures

jobs.title: Program Officer, Instructional Design & Multimedia
jobs.excerpt: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster.
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

This position is contingent on receipt of grant funding.

Job Overview:

The International Rescue Committee (IRC) is one of the leading providers of high-quality programming for refugees resettling to the United States. The IRC is committed to developing innovative programs that respond to the refugees’ unique strengths and needs, using our learning and experience to shape policy and practice, and highlighting and promoting best practices in refugee services provision.


The IRC is seeking a Program Officer for Instructional Design and Multimedia for Settle In, a program providing information and support for newcomers in multiple languages through its website (SettleInUS.org), mobile app, and social media platforms. More information on Settle In can be found on


This position designs and produces the learning experiences newcomers encounter across Settle In’s platforms. The role combines two areas of practice: instructional design—structuring multilingual, self-paced learning journeys that help newcomers build knowledge over time—and multimedia production—creating videos, graphics, and other assets that support the full range of Settle In content.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Design multilingual, self-paced learning journeys for newcomer audiences, including learning objectives, sequencing, knowledge checks, and reinforcement. Apply instructional design, adult learning principles, plain language standards, and translation-ready structure so that content is usable by newcomers with varying levels of literacy, digital literacy, and prior exposure to U.S. systems.
  • In partnership with Switchboard’s Senior Program Officer, Instructional Design, establish instructional design standards for Settle In content and review materials developed by team members, subject matter experts, and contractors against those standards.
  • Incorporating Switchboard’s established instructional design standards, recommend and implement improvements to Settle In’s instructional design practice, and update previously developed Settle In learning resources on an established review cycle.
  • Create compelling, in-language multimedia content, including short-form video, infographics, motion graphics, and social media assets.
  • Manage post-production of all finalized work, including Adobe Premiere project organization, color correction and grading, sound design, motion graphics, music editing, sequencing, export and compression for multiple platforms, and archiving.
  • Coordinate with the multilingual Digital Community team on content creation, voiceover, subtitling, and translation review, and advise colleagues on audio and video recording tools and practices.
  • Ensure final products are easy to understand, culturally appropriate, linguistically and factually accurate, accessible across web and mobile, and aligned with Settle In standards, newcomer needs, and funder requirements.
  • Ensure all learning experiences and multimedia content meet accessibility standards (e.g., captions, alt text, screen-reader compatibility)
  • Maintain visual and instructional consistency across Settle In's platforms (website, mobile app, social media)
  • Coordinate and incorporate feedback across teams and projects and participate in user testing and other methods for optimization of content.
  • Manage production timelines across concurrent projects and coordinate the work of external contractors, including videographers, designers, and translation vendors.
  • Use platform data and user insights to set measurable goals for content and assess performance, and contribute to project reports, including monthly activity updates and performance monitoring reports.

Other duties as assigned.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in instructional design, education, communications, or other relevant field (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum four years of professional experience combining instructional design and multimedia production, including creating multilingual digital content for diverse populations.
  • Demonstrated experience designing self-paced learning for adult audiences, including experience with e-learning tools.
  • Excellent command of video editing (Adobe Premiere) and graphic design software (Adobe InDesign, Canva), and knowledge of social media platforms, especially Facebook.
  • Working knowledge of plain language principles and digital accessibility standards.
  • Experience contributing to project M&E (data collection, management, and reporting).
  • Ability to manage complex projects on strict timelines, with excellent written and oral communication skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Fluency in at least one of Settle In’s supported languages (Dari, Pashto, Spanish, and Haitian Creole) preferred.
  • Previous experience working with refugee resettlement or other immigration pathways, and familiarity with ORR-funded programs.
  • Ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, visual, and easy-to-understand learning content
  • Experience engaging with external subject matter experts, consultants, or production vendors.

Working Environment: This position is a remote working environment. Required domestic travel up to 20%.


Compensation: (Pay Rate: $70,000 - $85,000/yr). Ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, internal equity, and budget. Exact offers are calibrated by work location, individual candidate experience and skills relative to the defined job requirements.

Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct. Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding, Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients.


Cookies:


Benefits: IRC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package. Highlights include 10 paid sick leave, 10 U.S. holidays, 20-25 generous paid time off based on role and tenure, medical insurance starting at $163/month, dental starting at $6.50/month, and vision starting at $5/month, flexible spending accounts (healthcare, dependent care, and commuter), a 403(b) retirement savings plan with employer match (immediate vesting) along with a non-elective employer contribution based on age and years of service (3-year vesting), disability and life insurance, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential counseling and support services for employees and their families.


Equal Opportunity Employer: IRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. IRC considers all applicants on the basis of merit without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Role Title: Software Engineer (Open Source Contributor)

Your tasks: Build reproducible Reinforcement Learning Environments that test an AI model’s ability to fix code, add features, refactor, and optimize performance - including a golden reference solution for each problem

Bonus: experts who complete the AI interview for this specific role move through the process significantly faster.

We care about your human judgment: our interview and assessment stages are designed to see how you think, so we ask that you complete them on your own, without AI assistants or help from others.

Job Description

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

You'll create realistic, interesting and challenging coding tasks for AI to solve involving feature implementation and bug fixes, and implement deterministic verifiers that accept reasonable valid solutions and reject everything else.

What we're looking for

  1. Strong backend experience in Java, Node.js, Go, Rust, Typescript, Python, C++ or similar
  2. A track record building scalable services and APIs
  3. Comfort with debugging, performance work and automated testing
  4. Solid code review instincts

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Proven experience in backend development, with a track record of delivering high-quality and performant projects.
  2. Demonstrated success in identifying and resolving software bugs and system bottlenecks.
  3. Experience with codebase refactoring and implementing complex features in large-scale applications.
  4. Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and foundational computer science concepts.
  5. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

Scope of Work

  1. Contribute expert-level code samples, debugging strategies, and development insights in Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
  2. Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve complex software defects and performance bottlenecks in diverse codebases.
  3. Implement robust new features, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and adherence to software best practices.
  4. Refactor and optimize legacy code to improve clarity, efficiency, and long-term reliability.
  5. Document technical reasoning, solution approaches, and code decisions to enhance AI training data quality.
  6. Review and validate peer-contributed code and technical submissions for accuracy and clarity.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of the following: Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
  2. Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.
  3. Proven ability to debug complex systems, resolve bugs, and deliver effective optimizations.
  4. Experience with large codebase refactoring and legacy system modernization.
  5. Track record of delivering high-impact features from conception through delivery within cross-functional projects.
  6. Strong documentation and communication skills to articulate technical concepts clearly.
  7. Interest in or curiosity about AI and its technical challenges (previous AI experience not required).

Process:

  1. Apply to the role, filling out the screening questions
  2. Complete AI interview (aprox. 20 minutes)
  3. Technical Assessment (if your GitHub profile doesn’t fully showcase the expertise required for this role)
  4. Hiring Manager review

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

JHNA, CTSi, and EXPANSIA have come together to form a Defense Technology platform named Aether Aerospace focused on delivering high-impact technologies, technology-enabled services and advanced manufacturing solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense and related national security customers. Backed by Falfurrias Management Partners, the platform brings together deep domain expertise across Army, Navy, and Air Force and Space Force programs, digital engineering, systems integration, and specialized manufacturing capabilities.

The combined organization operates as a multi-entity aerospace and defense technology and tech-enabled services and manufacturing enterprise positioned for scalable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation

OVERVIEW

Full-time/Permanent Employee

Location: Remote
As a Software Factory Engineer IV, you will design, integrate, and improve secure software factory capabilities used by multiple mission software teams. You will connect cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps pipelines, development tools, cybersecurity controls, observability, and reusable platform services into a coherent delivery environment. You will advise programs on how to onboard to and use existing Department of the Air Force software factories, such as Platform One, ODIN, and DAF CloudWorks, including the technical, security, governance, and operational steps that follow initial access. Working as an emerging technical authority with considerable latitude, you will guide complex integration decisions, improve common patterns and developer experience, and partner with government and contractor stakeholders to deliver reliable, accreditable software.

RESPONSIBILTIES

    • Design and integrate software factory services spanning source control, CI/CD, artifact repositories, registries, security scanning, test automation, secrets, cloud infrastructure, and observability

    • Advise programs on factory selection and onboarding, including application architecture, access and identity, environment needs, interfaces, inherited and application-specific controls, release paths, and sustainment responsibilities

    • Lead technical integration of applications with established factories, including Platform One, ODIN, or DAF CloudWorks as applicable; resolve gaps between factory services and program delivery needs

    • Establish reusable CI/CD templates, infrastructure-as-code modules, container baselines, deployment patterns, and platform services that scale across application teams

    • Architect secure cloud and container environments, including networking, identity, secrets, storage, compute, Kubernetes, logging, and separation of environments

    • Embed automated testing, SAST/DAST/SCA, SBOMs, artifact provenance, vulnerability management, and evidence collection into delivery workflows in partnership with RMF/ATO stakeholders

    • Define application onboarding and self-service practices, documentation, templates, APIs, and support pathways that improve developer experience and reduce time to first deployment

    • Guide artifact promotion, configuration management, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and reliability practices across development, test, and production

    • Troubleshoot complex platform and toolchain issues, assess design tradeoffs, and implement changes that improve security, availability, performance, and maintainability

    • Mentor engineers and application teams, share architectural patterns and lessons learned, and coordinate technical decisions with customer and cybersecurity stakeholders

    • Measure platform adoption, onboarding friction, delivery performance, and operational health; use the results to prioritize improvements

    • Provide technical support to operational strategies aligned within your program and initiatives that optimize processes, enhance productivity, and ensure quality across all program functions

    • Ensure 100% of planned hours are worked and recorded

    • Identify and forward to your leadership any opportunities that could lead to growth within your work area

    • Participate in growth efforts as requested

    • Ensure all contractual deliverables are met/exceeded to the customer's satisfaction

    • Complete personal PDP and attend Staff Meeting and Storytime (with camera on)

    • Within your program, build productive and positive professional relationships with clients

    • Execute all contract requirements as assigned in accordance with the contract-specific LCAT and requirements

    • Perform other related duties as assigned

KEY QUALIFICATIONS

    Clearance:Active TS/SCI
    Education and Years of Experience: Bachelor's (or equivalent) with 8 - 10 years of experience, or a Master's with 6 - 8 years of experience in software factory engineering, DevSecOps, cloud/platform engineering, or IT operations

    • Extensive experience designing and integrating shared software delivery platforms, DevSecOps toolchains, and reusable CI/CD patterns across teams

    • Demonstrated experience guiding application teams through onboarding and sustained use of an established software factory, including security, access, integration, and release considerations

    • Proficiency in infrastructure as code such as Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation and advanced scripting with Python, Bash, or PowerShell

    • Strong cloud architecture expertise in AWS or Azure, including identity, networking, storage, compute, containers, and Kubernetes

    • Hands-on knowledge of automated security controls, software supply-chain protections, observability, and RMF/ATO evidence needs in DoD delivery

PREFERRED ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

    • Experience with Platform One, ODIN, DAF CloudWorks, or a comparable DoD software factory from both the platform and program application perspectives

    • Experience establishing standardized onboarding, self-service platform capabilities, and reusable development patterns for multiple programs

    • Knowledge of hardened container baselines, SBOMs, artifact provenance, security scanning, and continuous assessment practices

    • Experience with high-availability cloud architecture, networking, monitoring, and incident response

    • Experience mentoring engineers and evaluating AI-assisted or agentic development workflows, including MCP integrations, in a controlled delivery environment

Aether Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Clinical Supply Consulting & Intelligence
jobs.excerpt: About Us:Endpoint is an interactive response technology (IRT®) systems and solutions provider that supports the life sciences industry.
jobs.description:
About Us:

Endpoint is an interactive response technology (IRT®) systems and solutions provider that supports the life sciences industry. Since 2009, we have been working with a single vision in mind, to help sponsors and pharmaceutical companies achieve clinical trial success. Our solutions, realized through the proprietary PULSE® platform, have proven to maximize the supply chain, minimize operational costs, and ensure timely and accurate patient dosing. Endpoint is headquartered in Raleigh-Durham, North Carolina with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.
Endpoint Clinical is a trusted clinical trial technology and service partner delivering reliable randomization and trial supply management solutions. We are expanding our capabilities to bring clinical supply planning closer to real time trial execution, helping sponsors make better supply decisions with greater speed, confidence, and control. We are seeking an entrepreneurial executive to build and lead a clinical supply consulting and advisory practice focused on forecasting, planning, optimization, and intelligent decision support. This leader will combine deep clinical supply expertise with consulting discipline, executive presence, and commercial acumen.

The Opportunity

    This role sits at the intersection of clinical supply strategy, forecasting and optimization, RTSM/IRT, consulting services, product innovation, and commercial growth. You will serve as Endpoint's executive subject matter expert for clinical supply and help define how sponsors use data, technology, and practical expertise to improve decisions across the trial lifecycle. This is not a traditional clinical supply operations role. It is a build-and-lead opportunity for someone who can create repeatable advisory offerings, engage senior sponsor stakeholders, shape software capabilities, and establish a differentiated market position.

What you will do

    • Build and lead the consulting practice
      • Establish and scale a clinical supply consulting and advisory capability.
      • Develop repeatable offerings, methodologies, frameworks, delivery standards, and intellectual property.
      • Define an operating model that supports high-quality delivery, measurable customer outcomes, and sustainable growth.
      • Build and develop a team of clinical supply experts as the practice grows.
      • Advise sponsors on complex supply decisions
        • Partner with clinical supply, development operations, clinical operations, and cross-functional leadership teams.
        • Guide customers through forecasting, manufacturing scenarios, inventory strategy, depot planning, overage, risk mitigation, and protocol-change impacts.
        • Facilitate executive discussions that convert uncertainty and complex data into clear decisions and actions.
        • Support strategic customer engagements, governance meetings, and business reviews.
        • Connect clinical supply planning with RTSM execution
          • Help customers use planning assumptions and real-time trial information to improve supply decisions.
          • Identify opportunities to reduce waste, improve responsiveness, and protect patient service levels.
          • Bring deep practical knowledge of RTSM/IRT workflows, integrations, and clinical supply operating models.
          • Shape product strategy and innovation
            • Collaborate with Product, Technology, Commercial, and Delivery leaders to translate market needs into scalable capabilities.
            • Use consulting insights to inform product priorities, workflow design, analytics, and decision-support use cases.
            • Act as a voice of the customer in the evolution of Endpoint clinical supply intelligence solutions.
            • Driving commercial growth and industry leadership
              • Participate in strategic pursuits, executive briefings, proposals, and solution design.
              • Create consulting-led entry points and expansion opportunities within sponsor organizations.
              • Represent Endpoint at industry events and build a credible external point of view through speaking and thought leadership.

What you will bring

    • 15+ years of experience in clinical trial supply management, clinical supply strategy, supply-chain consulting, clinical operations, or a closely related discipline.
    • Deep understanding of global clinical supply planning and execution, including forecasting, packaging and labeling, manufacturing constraints, inventory, distribution, depots, comparators, returns, and supply risk.
    • Strong working knowledge of RTSM/IRT and the relationship between supply planning and live study execution.
    • Experience advising pharmaceutical or biotechnology organizations on complex operational and strategic decisions.
    • Demonstrated ability to build methodologies, offerings, teams, or new business capabilities.
    • Credibility and confidence with senior executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
    • Commercial judgment, including the ability to identify needs, shape solutions, support proposals, and create measurable value.
    • Excellent communication, facilitation, writing, and presentation skills.
    • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. An advanced degree or relevant professional certification

Leadership Profile

    • Entrepreneurial and comfortable building from an early foundation.
    • Customer-centered, outcome-oriented, and practical.
    • Analytical, data-driven, and able to simplify complex decisions.
    • Collaborative across product, technology, commercial, and delivery teams.
    • Visible and credible as an industry leader, while remaining hands-on when needed.
    • Committed to quality, speed, agility, and strong customer partnerships.

What Success looks like

    • A differentiated clinical supply consulting practice is launched with clear offerings and delivery standards.
    • Sponsor executives view Endpoint as a trusted advisor on clinical supply planning, forecasting, and optimization.
    • Consulting creates measurable customer outcomes and contributes to sustainable revenue growth.
    • Customer insights directly influence product priorities and scalable clinical supply intelligence capabilities.
    • Endpoint develops a stronger market voice and network across the clinical supply community.

Why Endpoint Clinical

    At Endpoint, you will have the opportunity to build a new capability within an established clinical trial technology organization. You will work closely with executive leadership, influence company and product strategy, advise customers on high-value decisions, and help define a more connected future for clinical supply planning and trial execution. If you are passionate about clinical supply innovation and energized by the opportunity to build, lead, and create measurable customer impact, we would like to hear from you.

Equal Opportunity

    Endpoint Clinical is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, consistent with applicable law.
Endpoint Clinical does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or any other third parties. Any unsolicited resume sent to Endpoint Clinical will be considered Endpoint Clinical property, and Endpoint Clinical will not pay a fee should it hire the subject of any unsolicited resume.
Endpoint Clinical is an equal opportunities employer AA/M/F/Veteran/Disability.
Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment, qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Job Title: Évaluateur clinique indépendant freelance bilingue en français/Freelance

Job Location: Edmonton, Alberta, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Part-time

Job Seniority Level:

Êtes-vous un professionnel expérimenté en santé mentale possédant une expérience en essais cliniques et une expertise dans les évaluations psychiatriques ?


Chez IQVIA, nous faisons progresser les soins de santé grâce à la recherche clinique innovante et à l’intelligence des données de santé, contribuant ainsi à rendre de nouvelles thérapies accessibles aux patients du monde entier.


Dans le cadre d’une future étude sur le trouble dépressif majeur, nous élargissons notre réseau mondial d’Évaluateurs Indépendants Centraux (Central Independent Raters - CIRs) et recherchons des cliniciens qualifiés pour réaliser des évaluations indépendantes et standardisées des patients. Ces évaluations jouent un rôle essentiel dans la qualité et l’intégrité des résultats des essais cliniques.


Il s’agit d’une excellente opportunité de collaborer avec une équipe mondiale de professionnels de la recherche et de contribuer de façon significative au développement de nouveaux traitements potentiels contre la dépression.


Ce que nous proposons

  • Poste 100 % à distance
  • Horaires de travail flexibles
  • Contrat de prestation de services (freelance)

Profil recherché

Professionnels ayant une expérience dans l’administration, la cotation, la révision ou la supervision des évaluations suivantes :

  • MADRS (Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale)
  • MINI (Mini International Neuropsychiatric Interview)

Qualifications requises

  • Diplôme de Master en psychologie, psychiatrie ou dans un domaine connexe
  • Minimum de 3 années d’expérience clinique après l’obtention du Master
  • Minimum de 3 années d’expérience dans le domaine des essais cliniques
  • Excellentes compétences en entretien clinique et en évaluation
  • Maîtrise courante de l’anglais et du français requise ; la connaissance d’autres langues constitue un atout

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Rejoignez une équipe internationale qui contribue à l’avancement de traitements innovants tout en bénéficiant de la flexibilité d’un travail à distance, basé sur des projets. Cette opportunité vous permettra de participer à des recherches cliniques porteuses de sens et d’avoir un impact positif sur la vie des patients à travers le monde.


Cette opportunité ne donne pas droit à un parrainage pour l’obtention d’un visa ou d’une autorisation de travail.


Are you an experienced mental health professional with clinical trial experience and expertise in psychiatric assessments? At IQVIA, we are advancing healthcare through innovative clinical research and healthcare intelligence that help bring new therapies to patients worldwide. We are expanding our global network of Central Independent Raters (CIRs) to support an upcoming major depressive disorder study and are seeking skilled clinicians to provide independent, standardized patient assessments that contribute to the quality and integrity of clinical trial outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with a global team of research professionals and play a meaningful role in the development of potential new treatments for depression.


In this role you can expect:

  • 100% Remote Opportunity
  • Flexible Working Hours
  • Freelance Contract

What We're Looking For:

Professionals with experience administering, scoring, reviewing, or overseeing the following assessments:

  • MADRS and MINI

Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Psychology, Psychiatry, or a related field
  • Minimum of 3 years of clinical experience following Master’s Degree
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience working in clinical trials
  • Strong interviewing and assessment skills
  • Fluency in both English and French is required; proficiency in additional languages is considered an asset

Why Join Us?

Join a global team helping to advance innovative treatments while enjoying the flexibility of remote, project-based work. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to meaningful clinical research and make a difference in the lives of patients worldwide.

*This opportunity is not sponsorship eligible.


IQVIA est un fournisseur mondial de premier plan de services de recherche clinique, d'informations commerciales et de renseignements sur les soins de santé pour les secteurs des sciences de la vie et de la santé. IQVIA se consacre à accélérer le développement et la commercialisation de traitements médicaux innovants pour aider à améliorer les résultats des patients et la santé de la population dans le monde entier. Pour en savoir plus, visitez

Tous les candidats qualifiés seront pris en considération pour un emploi sans égard à la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l’orientation sexuelle, l’identité de genre, l’origine nationale, le handicap, l’âge, l’état matrimonial ou tout autre statut protégé par la loi applicable. jobs.excerpt: AECOM is seeking a hands-on Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Engineer to join its Data Center team in our Buildings and Places (B+P) group in our Arlington, VA office; however, this position can be fully remote.
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a hands-on Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Engineer to join its Data Center team in our Buildings and Places (B+P) group in our Arlington, VA office; however, this position can be fully remote. This individual-contributor role is responsible for executing internal and external airflow, thermal, and equipment-discharge studies with minimal oversight. The successful candidate will convert complex simulation results into practical design actions, clearly communicate assumptions and limitations, and help establish repeatable, high-quality CFD workflows across multiple concurrent projects.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients. This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the full CFD study lifecycle: clarify the design question, define scope and acceptance criteria, develop the methodology, build geometry, generate the mesh, establish boundary conditions, solve, verify convergence, post-process results, and issue technical reports.
  • Perform internal data hall studies addressing rack inlet temperatures, airflow distribution, hot- and cold-aisle containment, bypass and recirculation, raised-floor or slab configurations, cooling-unit placement, rack density, failure modes, and capacity-expansion scenarios.
  • Perform external studies for cooling towers, chillers, dry coolers, generator and boiler exhaust, mechanical yards, relief air, outdoor-air intakes, heat rejection, plume behavior, short-circuiting, and thermal re-entrainment.
  • Conduct steady-state and transient analyses for cooling-system outages, equipment failures, load changes, control sequences, thermal ride-through, and other operating scenarios defined by the project team.
  • Develop defensible modeling assumptions using design documents, equipment data, controls narratives, weather data, commissioning information, and field measurements; identify data gaps and document their impact on conclusions.
  • Apply sound verification and validation practices, including mesh-sensitivity checks, mass and energy balance reviews, convergence assessment, comparison with hand calculations, and correlation to measured or monitoring data when available.
  • Evaluate results against project-specific criteria and relevant guidance, including ASHRAE TC 9.9 thermal guidance and applicable client, code, and industry requirements.
  • Translate findings into prioritized, actionable recommendations for equipment selection, airflow management, containment, intake/exhaust separation, controls, phasing, redundancy, and operational resilience.
  • Prepare concise, client-ready reports and visualizations that clearly communicate methodology, assumptions, scenarios, results, risks, limitations, and recommended next steps.
  • Present findings and coordinate directly with multidisciplinary project teams to resolve issues and confirm implementation of recommendations.
  • Contribute to standardized templates, modeling procedures, quality-control checklists, libraries, and lessons learned; support technical knowledge sharing and mentoring of less-experienced staff.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.
  • 6+ years of hands-on CFD experience, including direct application to data centers, mission-critical facilities, or similarly complex thermal-management environments.
  • Proficiency with at least one data-center or general-purpose CFD platform, such as Cadence 6SigmaDCX, Ansys Fluent, Ansys CFX, or OpenFOAM, and the ability to learn and apply project-required tools.
  • Strong fundamentals in fluid mechanics, heat transfer, thermodynamics, turbulence modeling, and HVAC system operation.
  • Experience modeling both internal environments, such as IT spaces and containment systems, and external environments, such as mechanical yards, cooling equipment, intakes, and exhaust discharges.
  • Working knowledge of data center cooling architectures, HVAC systems, redundancy concepts, controls and failure scenarios, and common thermal performance metrics.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering
  • Professional Engineer (PE)
  • Experience with US codes and standards.
  • Demonstrated success independently delivering CFD studies from scoping through final report, including geometry preparation, meshing, solver setup, convergence assessment, post-processing, and engineering interpretation.
  • Ability to develop appropriate boundary conditions from design information and equipment performance data, and to explain the sensitivity of results to key assumptions.
  • Strong technical writing, visualization, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex results to engineering teams, project managers, and clients.

Additional Information:

  • Relocation is not available for this role
  • Sponsorship for U.S. employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.

In this role, you will serve as a critical strategic link between frontline operations and cross-functional leadership—including Product, Engineering, Data, Legal, and Sales/Onboarding. We operate in a highly regulated environment where errors carry real and substantial financial risk, so precision is non-negotiable. We maintain data integrity through rigorous review, quality control, and escalation protocols, and we collaborate closely with Customer Success, Engineering, Product, and Compliance to optimize workflows, surface operational insights, and continuously improve the customer experience. We partner tightly with peer teams across Operations to share best practices, understand shared challenges, and strengthen Operations as a whole.

  • Risk Management & Control Environment: Maintain a rigorous control environment across all transaction lifecycles. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate operational risks to prevent financial loss and ensure full compliance in a highly regulated landscape.
  • Client Experience & Root Cause Analysis: Foster a client-first mindset that looks beyond vanity metrics to evaluate true customer experience. Lead deep-dive root cause analyses on operational trends and complex escalations to implement long-term structural fixes.
  • Process Optimization & Innovation: Drive a culture of innovation by identifying and scaling opportunities for workflow automation, process standardization, and system enhancements to maintain a lean operational footprint.
  • Change Leadership & Transparent Communication: Lead teams through change with clarity and empathy. Maintain clear, concise, and solution-oriented reporting cadences with executive leadership and internal stakeholders.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What you bring to the role

  • Experience: 4+ years of operational management experience in financial services, fintech, retirement services (401k), or banking, with 2+ years specifically managing other People Managers/Leaders.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of money movement processes, transaction lifecycles, and risk controls within a regulated environment.
  • Leadership Development: Proven track record of developing direct-report managers, setting clear expectations, managing performance, and building high-performing operational teams.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Demonstrated ability to leverage complex data reports, staffing models, and SLA metrics to drive strategy and prioritize trade-offs.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional ability to partner with cross-functional leadership (Product, Engineering, Legal, CS) to align on shared goals and advocate for operational priorities.
  • Change & Process Management: Experience designing end-to-end operational improvements, scaling processes, and leading large teams through organizational change.

  • Formal certification in process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) or continuous improvement frameworks.
  • Experience in high-growth, fast-paced fintech environments.

Why you will love working at Human Interest

jobs.description:
WE ARE TITANIUM HEALTHCARE

Titanium is a healthcare company that puts heart and compassion above all else. Millions of Americans just aren’t getting the medical care they need. We’re on a mission to change that. For patients that means exceptional support and better care. For providers it means better support and time to focus on patients, and for partners that means higher quality and lower cost.

Join us in our mission!

POSITION SUMMARY

The RN Clinical Consultant is a key member of Titanium Healthcare’s Enhanced Care Management (ECM) program, providing clinical oversight and guidance to support high-quality, coordinated care for complex member populations. ECM is a benefit under California Advancing and Innovating Medi-Cal (CalAIM), designed to deliver comprehensive, person-centered care that addresses medical, behavioral, and social determinants of health.

In this role, the RN Clinical Consultant partners closely with Lead Care Managers (LCMs) and interdisciplinary team members to ensure care delivery is clinically appropriate, compliant, and aligned with healthcare plan requirements. The Clinical Consultant supports clinical decision-making, risk stratification, and care planning across the ECM population.

The RN Clinical Consultant is responsible for oversight of Comprehensive Assessments, Care Management Plans, Transitions of Care, and clinical escalations, ensuring timely interventions and continuity of care. This role plays a critical part in improving health outcomes, reducing avoidable utilization, and supporting members through complex care journeys.

ECM services are provided to eligible Medi-Cal members enrolled in managed care plans and focus on sustained engagement, care coordination, and connection to community-based resources. Through collaboration with internal teams and external providers, the RN Clinical Consultant helps ensure members receive the right care, at the right time, in the most appropriate setting.

WHERE YOU’LL WORK

This position is remote and is based out of California. Standard business hours are Monday through Friday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Provide clinical oversight and support to ensure high-quality effective care management for members across the ECM program
  • Collaborate closely with Lead Care Managers (LCMs) and ancillary clinical staff (e.g., RNs, LCSWs, RDs) to support member care needs and clinical decision-making
  • Facilitate access to appropriate healthcare services including primary care, behavioral health, and specialty services, as needed
  • Complete clinical oversight of Comprehensive Assessments and Care Management Plans to ensure accuracy, appropriateness, and alignment with healthcare plan guidelines
  • Lead and/or participate in Emergent and Non-Emergent Clinical Case Conferences to address complex member needs and ensure timely interventions
  • Participate in Interdisciplinary Care Team (ICT) meetings to provide clinical input and recommendations to support coordinated and whole-person care
  • Conduct and/or oversee medication reconciliation to ensure safety and accuracy of member medication regimens
  • Support and guide smooth Transitions of Care (TOC) following emergency room visits and hospitalizations, ensuring timely follow-up and continuity of care
  • Engage members, as appropriate, using clinical expertise and motivational interviewing techniques to support health behavior change and care plan adherence
  • Provide health education within scope of practice to promote improved health outcomes
  • Coordinate care through collaboration with internal teams and external providers, ensuring seamless communication and continuity of care
  • Ensure all clinical activities are documented accurately and in accordance with organizational, regulatory, and healthcare plan requirements
  • Consult and collaborate with clinical leadership as needed for complex cases or escalations
  • Participate in case reviews and clinical discussions to support quality, consistency, and continuous improvement
  • Adhere to all departmental and organizational policies, procedures, and compliance requirements
  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned

WHO YOU ARE

Sensory Requirements

  • Fluent in English (written and verbal)
  • Ability to communicate clearly in-person, by phone, and electronically
  • Adequate hearing and vision (with corrective devices if necessary) to conduct assessments and documentation
  • Ability to identify problems and use logic and related information to develop and implement solutions
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality and adhering to ethical standards in healthcare practice

Physical Activity

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position

Environmental Conditions

  • Ability to maintain professionalism
  • Ability to work independently and carry out assignments to completion within the parameters of established policies and procedures

Technology Use

  • Frequent use of computers, keyboard, and handheld/mobile devices
  • Ability to type for extended periods
  • Competent with computers, email, virtual platforms, and Microsoft Office based programs

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Associate’s degree in nursing
  • Minimum 1+ years of experience as an RN working in a healthcare setting, such as a medical clinic or acute care hospital
  • A current and unrestricted CA state RN license
  • Experience using an EHR
  • Distraction-free home workspace with a secure internet connection

NICE TO HAVES

  • Care management experience
  • Bachelor's degree in nursing
  • Experience using eClinical Works (eCW)
  • Valid BLS certification from the American Heart Association
  • Valid CPR Certification
  • Bilingual in Spanish

WHAT YOU’LL ENJOY

  • Make an impact: an organization who cares about its employees, communities, and the future of healthcare
  • Inclusivity: be a part of a workplace where you not only belong but also can be the best version of yourself
  • Growth: opportunities to develop and grow your career with us
  • Community: you are encouraged to have a voice, share your opinions, and have an individual impact on the business
  • Paid Time Off: 12 holidays and up to 15 days of accrued PTO to rest and recharge plus additional time off for sick, jury duty, bereavement, reproductive loss, and therapy
  • Work Life Balance: enjoy flexibility to maximize your well-being and success with our hybrid work model
  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Benefits: we cover up to 100% of your premium and 50% of your dependents depending on the plan
  • Prioritize your mental health with unlimited therapy sessions funded 100% by Titanium Healthcare
  • Flexible Spending, Health Savings & Dependent Care Accounts
  • Life/AD&D insurance funded 100% by Titanium Healthcare
  • Supplemental Disability Plans
  • Employee Assistance Programs
  • Protect your pet(s) with Pet Insurance
  • Employee Referral Program: earn up to $1000 for each referral
  • 401(k) plan and Roth IRA options

EEO Statement

At Titanium Healthcare, our mission is to fearlessly reengineer the way healthcare works to reduce costs, ensure better outcomes, and provide everyone, everywhere, with the kind of compassionate and coordinated care they deserve. We believe that achieving this mission starts with a diverse and inclusive workforce.

We believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and equity in healthcare, enabling us to better serve our communities and make a lasting impact.
