Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Remote Work - we offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
  • Ongoing Learning - people at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
  • Home Office - we will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
  • Physical Well-Being - we will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
  • Fun Stuff - there is never a shortage of fun stuff.

Job Title: Clinical Eligibility & Intake Nurse

Classification: Part Time/1099 Contractor

Work Structure: Fully Remote

Shift: Monday-Friday; 3-5 hours per day / 15-20 hours per week*; schedule must overlap intake hours**

Team: Clinical Operations

Reporting to: Clinical Eligibility Lead (intake coverage coordinated with Care Delivery)

Location: United States

Compensation: $27-30 per hour

*Additional hours are available on intake coverage days and as enrollment projects arise that focus on specific target populations.

**Must be available for eligibility/enrollment team meetings and able to switch to intake coverage on short notice during scheduled hours.

About Us

One in three people die of heart disease - it's time to change that. We're redesigning heart health from the ground up so that everyone can live fuller lives. Our team consists of mission-driven clinicians, engineers, and professionals attacking a problem using evidence-based research and guidelines for cardiovascular rehabilitation. We're working to deliver exercise and wellness to older adults with cardiovascular disease using telemedicine. We are dedicated to delivering exceptional services that enhance the lives of our patients.

Job Summary

The Clinical Eligibility & Intake Specialist splits time between two kinds of work. Most days, you will review the EMR records of cardiac recovery patients to determine medical eligibility for Aviary Health's virtual cardiac rehab program. When intake needs extra capacity, such as a last-minute call-out, a schedule gap, or a high-volume week, you will step in to run initial assessments with new patients over video.

This role suits a nurse who is equally comfortable working a chart review queue independently and sitting with a new patient to explain the program, review their history, and build their plan.

Responsibilities

Clinical eligibility (majority of hours)

  • Reviewing patient charts in Epic and other EMRs to determine medical eligibility/ineligibility using the inclusion/exclusion list and decision tree
  • Identifying current cardiac rehab referral orders, or creating cardiac rehab referral orders when needed
  • Communicating eligibility and ineligibility decisions to the enrollment team through concise documentation in the appropriate platforms
  • Working the eligibility queue within team turnaround targets so patients can be scheduled without delay
  • Completing eligibility rechecks and supporting special projects as needed
  • Escalating cases that fall outside the decision tree to the Clinical Eligibility Lead

Intake coverage (as needed, often same day)

  • Conducting initial assessments by video for patients enrolling in our virtual cardiac recovery program
  • Reviewing medical history, cardiac procedures, and medications before and during the visit
  • Completing individualized treatment plans that include nutrition, psychosocial, fitness, and co-morbidities assessments
  • Educating patients on program benefits and the importance of risk factor modification
  • Using goal setting and motivational interviewing to start patients off motivated and engaged
  • Documenting each visit accurately and on time per clinical documentation standards

This position requires the ability to learn and retain a broad base of clinical knowledge, switch between chart review and patient-facing work within the same shift, and make quick, independent decisions using good judgment.

Qualifications

  • Active RN or LPN license (required); multistate/compact license preferred
  • 3-5 years of clinical experience in cardiac care, cardiac rehab, or chronic disease management
  • 3 years of experience in Epic or another EMR, including chart review
  • Working knowledge of cardiac conditions, procedures, and medications, including CHF
  • Experience assessing and educating patients, ideally older adults, in a clinical or virtual care setting
  • Comfort with motivational interviewing and goal setting
  • Strong written communication, with concise and accurate clinical documentation
  • Proficient computer skills, including Zoom, Google Suite, and EMR systems
  • Fluent in English (written and verbal)

Bonus points

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish
  • Cardiac rehab experience or knowledge of cardiac rehab eligibility criteria
  • Virtual care or remote/1099 contract experience
  • Coaching experience in smoking cessation, diabetes management, or special populations

Requirements

  • Citrix
  • Epic access/RTE
  • Google Suite
  • Zoom
  • Teams (required for GHS Epic training)
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet, private workspace suitable for live video visits with patients

SOPs

  • Clinical eligibility check process
  • Inclusion/exclusion list
  • Decision tree
  • ICD code list
  • Aviary platform macros
  • Initial assessment and treatment plan documentation

Note: This is a 1099 contractor position.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT OLIPOPAt OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale.
jobs.description:
ABOUT OLIPOP

At OLIPOP, we’re on a mission to positively impact consumer health at scale. And we’re doing it through something simple: soda. But not just any soda, a new kind of soda: one that’s delicious, refreshing, and actually good for you.

This mission is deeply personal for our CEO, Co-Founder, and Formulator, Ben Goodwin. Like many of us, Ben grew up consuming the Standard American Diet: lots of soda and processed foods that prioritized convenience over nutrition. But at 14, he took his health into his own hands. After making significant changes to his nutrition and exercise, he lost 50 pounds and saw a transformation in his energy, mood, and emotional clarity.

Those changes sparked a deep curiosity about the connection between nutrition and health. Ben became a relentless student of the gut microbiome and the ways it supports overall wellness. The more he discovered, the more passionate he became about finding credible, science-backed ways to make consumer health accessible to everyone.

The mission was clear. The vehicle? Less so. After exploring the possibilities, Ben landed on an unexpected yet familiar choice: soda. It was something he loved as a kid, and he knew millions shared that same nostalgia. But this wouldn’t be just any soda. With most Americans falling short on daily fiber, Ben set out to create a version with more fiber and less sugar, one that was perfectly balanced. The result? A deliciously refreshing soda with 6 to 9 grams of fiber and 2 to 5 grams of sugar, delivering science-backed benefits without sacrificing the classic taste people crave.

In 2018, the first OLIPOP cans hit the shelves, bringing Ben’s vision to life with a functional soda that anyone could enjoy. And by reimagining soda, we’re also reshaping culture. That means creating products that support health for all and building a business grounded in humanistic values: empathy, integrity, and a belief in better for everyone. From the ingredients we source to the culture we foster, we’re committed to proving that business (and beverage!) can be a force for good, and that soda has the power to bring people together.

So join us, and let’s write a new American soda story together. One we can all feel good about. One OLIPOP at a time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

OLIPOP is seeking a strategic, commercially minded, and highly operational Vice President of FP&A to lead enterprise financial planning, performance management, and strategic decision support through the company’s next stage of scale.

As Vice President, FP&A, you will serve as a senior finance leader and trusted partner to the CFO, executive leadership team, and cross-functional business leaders. You will own the company’s long-range planning process, enterprise financial model, forecasting operating rhythm, board and executive reporting, and strategic financial analysis that informs critical investment, growth, and profitability decisions.

This role requires a leader who can translate company strategy into financial priorities, build scalable FP&A capabilities, influence senior stakeholders through data-backed recommendations, and create the systems, routines, and team structure needed to support a high-growth CPG business.

You will be expected to balance strategic vision with operational discipline, bringing strong judgment, executive presence, and a clear point of view to ambiguous and high-impact business decisions.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise Financial Strategy & Long-Range Planning

  • Lead OLIPOP’s long-range planning process, partnering with executive and functional leaders to translate company strategy into multi-year financial plans, resource allocation priorities, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Own and evolve OLIPOP’s enterprise financial model, ensuring it serves as a dynamic decision-making tool for growth planning, profitability, capital allocation, and scenario analysis.
  • Partner with senior leadership to evaluate strategic tradeoffs across revenue growth, margin expansion, operating expense investment, working capital, and organizational scale.
  • Develop financial frameworks that help the business anticipate future risks, opportunities, and investment needs as OLIPOP continues to grow.

Financial Planning, Forecasting & Performance Management

  • Own the company-wide forecasting and planning operating rhythm across gross revenue, net revenue, trade, COGS, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, cash flow, balance sheet, and key business drivers.
  • Lead the annual budget, reforecasting, and monthly performance management processes, ensuring cross-functional leaders have clear visibility into financial expectations, tradeoffs, and accountability.
  • Establish clear financial governance, timelines, tools, and reporting standards that improve forecast accuracy, business ownership, and decision quality.
  • Compare monthly operating results against budget and forecast, identify key variances, and partner with business owners to understand drivers, risks, and corrective actions.

Executive, Board & Investor Readiness

  • Lead preparation of board, executive, and corporate reporting materials, ensuring financial narratives are clear, accurate, actionable, and tied to enterprise priorities.
  • Translate complex financial and operational insights into executive-ready recommendations that support high-quality decisions.
  • Support equity raise, debt, or capital markets initiatives as needed, including materials preparation, diligence support, quality of earnings support, cost of capital analysis, scenario modeling, and investor-facing financial narratives.
  • Serve as a senior finance partner in high-stakes discussions, bringing strong judgment, business context, and a clear articulation of financial implications.

Strategic Finance & Decision Support

  • Lead financial modeling and analysis for strategic decisions, including growth investments, new products, channel expansion, pricing strategy, margin optimization, tradeoffs, and process improvements.
  • Evaluate profitability by product, channel, customer, SKU, region, and other relevant dimensions to guide investment decisions and commercial strategy.
  • Partner with Sales, Revenue Growth Management, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Accounting to evaluate business performance and identify opportunities to improve profitable growth.
  • Develop and improve pricing, margin, and investment models for existing products, new products, channels, and customer opportunities.
  • Partner with revenue and commercial teams on deal pricing, trade investment reviews, commission structures, and customer-level financial decision support.

Finance Operating Model, Systems & Scale

  • Design and implement scalable FP&A processes, tools, reporting infrastructure, and operating rhythms that improve business visibility, speed, accuracy, and decision-making.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen financial systems, planning tools, data quality, and reporting automation to support company growth.
  • Build repeatable workflows that enable disciplined business reviews, faster insight generation, and stronger accountability across functions.
  • Lead ad hoc strategic analyses and special projects that support enterprise priorities and evolving business needs.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Build, structure, and develop a high-performing FP&A team aligned to OLIPOP’s strategy, business complexity, and future scale.
  • Establish clear roles, expectations, development plans, and operating cadences that strengthen team effectiveness and business partnership.
  • Coach and develop finance talent, creating a culture of accountability, curiosity, analytical rigor, continuous improvement, and strong stakeholder partnership.
  • Model OLIPOP’s leadership expectations by leading with clarity, trust, inclusion, sound judgment, and a strong ownership mindset.

Cross-Functional Influence & Executive Partnership

  • Serve as a senior connector across Finance, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, People, and Executive Leadership, ensuring financial insights are embedded into business planning and decision-making.
  • Influence senior leaders through clear financial storytelling, data-backed recommendations, and balanced assessment of risk, opportunity, and long-term impact.
  • Navigate ambiguity and competing priorities with maturity, transparency, and a company-first mindset.
  • Champion OLIPOP’s culture and values by creating clarity, raising the bar for financial discipline, and helping teams connect day-to-day decisions to company goals.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 12–15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant leadership experience in FP&A, strategic finance, corporate finance, or related functions.
  • Experience leading FP&A in a high-growth CPG, food & beverage, consumer products, retail, marketplace, or similarly complex operating environment strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to own enterprise planning, forecasting, financial modeling, budget management, and executive-level business performance reporting.
  • Strong commercial and operational finance acumen, including experience with revenue planning, margin analysis, pricing, tradeoffs, customer/channel profitability, working capital, and investment decision support.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing executive, board, investor, or lender-facing financial materials with clear narratives and actionable recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of accounting, budgeting, cost control, and finance principles, including GAAP.
  • Track record of building scalable FP&A processes, tools, systems, reporting routines, and financial governance in a growing organization.
  • Experience building, leading, and developing high-performing teams; able to create clarity, accountability, and development pathways during periods of change and scale.
  • Strategic and effective communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, simplify complex financial concepts, and drive alignment across diverse stakeholders.
  • Strong judgment and decision quality; able to evaluate complex tradeoffs, assess risk, and recommend practical paths forward in ambiguous situations.
  • High emotional intelligence and cultural competency, with the ability to build trust, resolve tension productively, and partner effectively across functions.
  • Strategic and hands-on: comfortable shaping enterprise-level finance strategy while also diving into models, details, and operating mechanics when needed.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field preferred; MBA and/or CPA a plus.
  • Comfortable operating in a remote-first, fast-paced, highly collaborative environment using tools such as Microsoft Suite, Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, NetSuite, Claude AI (other exposure to AI tools) and financial planning/reporting platforms.
  • Flexibility to travel as needed for company meetings, team offsites, board preparation, and cross-functional planning sessions. Estimated Travel:10-15%

REPORTS TO:

CFO

COMPENSATION:

$220,000-$260,000 base salary + bonus

HOW WE WORK

We may be fully remote, but we’re anything but disconnected. OLIPOP has grown from a few passionate people around a table to a nationwide team, and we’ve done it without losing our collaborative spirit or sense of purpose.

Connection here is intentional. From cross-functional projects and IRL offsites to thoughtful Slack threads and spontaneous gifs, we make the effort to stay close, even across time zones. Sure, we move quickly, but we lead with trust, transparency, and a shared commitment to doing work that matters.

We value thoughtful debate. We give feedback with care and receive it with curiosity, knowing that real growth, both personal and collective, comes from listening as much as leading. Because at OLIPOP, it’s not just about getting things done. It’s about growing together, staying true to what matters, and building something with lasting impact.

WHAT WE VALUE

At OLIPOP, our values aren’t just posters on a wall. They shape how we show up: for each other, for our customers, and for the mission we’re chasing together.

  • Mission Connectivity: Everything we do ladders up to our shared goal: supporting human health. Whether launching a new flavor or conducting clinical research, the mission stays front and center.
  • Indomitable Spirit: When things get messy, we get inventive. We stay curious, adapt quickly, and find the path forward, most likely with a dedicated Slack thread and a beautifully overbuilt deck.
  • Lead at Every Level: Leadership isn’t about titles, it’s about ownership. We speak up, follow through, and lift each other up. If you’ve got ideas and initiative, you’ve got influence.
  • Courageous Humility: We’re confident in what we bring and curious about what we don’t know (yet). We give feedback with care, take it with grace, and know that real growth takes both.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Success at OLIPOP doesn’t come from checking boxes; it comes from living our values, staying curious, and finding energy in both the pace and the purpose. We’re building something big, and we’re looking for people who:

  • Think big, move fast, and take thoughtful risks
  • Thrive in a high-performance, feedback-rich environment
  • Value real human connection and honest collaboration
  • Are fired up by building something new, and making it better every day

Startup life at OLIPOP is equally fun and fast-paced. If you’re energized by a dynamic environment, eager to grow, and excited to help shape something meaningful from the inside out, OLIPOP is a one-of-a-kind ride.

Submission of Application Materials
Applicants are required to submit only the materials specifically requested as part of the application process. Please do not include any unsolicited materials, as they will not be reviewed or considered.

jobs.description:
We're hiring a Business & Data Analyst to support the consolidation of an acquired screening platform into Veremark. You'll work under the direction of our M&A PMO, delivering analysis and data tasks against our established integration playbook.

Veremark is a background screening and workforce trust technology company. Employers use us to run pre-employment checks, to verify criminal records, right to work, references, identity, credit and more, through our platform and integrate us with their ATS and HR systems.

You'll sit in the PMO's lean core team, taking direction from the Program Director and supporting the operations, HR and finance leads, product and engineering. It's a hybrid role: half business analysis (processes, requirements, gap analysis), half hands-on data (profiling, reconciliation, reporting). It's a great fit if you've been a BA or data analyst for a few years and want broad exposure to a real M&A integration.

You'll pick up tasks from the Program Director and workstream leads, following our existing M&A integration playbook and flagging anything that doesn't fit.

Platform consolidation

  • Help map the acquired platform: check types, workflows, candidate journeys, client configurations and edge cases.

  • Carry out gap analysis against Veremark's product using the playbook templates, and present findings for decision.

  • Keep the migration plan and tracker up to date: cohorts, cut-over dates, dependencies and actions.

  • Document current and future-state processes, and draft requirements and user stories for review.

Integrations and billing

  • Build and maintain the inventory of ATS/HRIS integrations, API consumers and webhooks, and each client's migration status.

  • Help map products, price books and contract terms onto Veremark's pricing, flagging anything that looks off.

  • Support Finance with billing reconciliation through cut-over.

Data, validation and reporting

  • Profile the acquired platform's data with SQL: volumes, usage by client, active vs. dormant accounts, data quality.

  • Help build field-level mappings between the two data models, and test migrated data against them.

  • Run the validation and reconciliation queries on each client cohort, and log and chase data issues.

  • Maintain the migration dashboard and prepare data for PMO reporting.

  • Use AI tools to speed up the work: summarising legacy docs, drafting mappings, cleansing and classifying data.

  • Pull usage and revenue data to help the PMO prioritise which clients move first.

Customers and stakeholders

  • Provide data and client lists to Customer Success and Sales for migration comms.

  • Contribute progress, issues and data to the Program Director's weekly update.

  • Follow Compliance guidance on consent, data residency and audit when handling migrated data.

Must have

  • 2+ years as a business analyst, business systems analyst or data analyst, ideally in B2B SaaS.

  • Worked on a platform migration, system implementation or integration project as part of a team.

  • Solid SQL (joins, CTEs, aggregations): comfortable writing your own queries to profile and reconcile data.

  • Core BA skills: process mapping, gap analysis, data mapping, requirements and user stories, UAT.

  • Some experience building dashboards or reports in a BI tool (e.g. Looker, Metabase, Power BI).

  • Curious about how systems fit together, and confident asking engineers about data models, APIs and integrations.

  • Comfortable working to direction and a set playbook, and knowing when to flag an issue rather than guess.

  • Meticulous and organised, with a strong eye for detail and data accuracy.

  • Clear communicator who can explain data to non-technical people.

Nice to have

  • Exposure to pricing, contracts or billing data.

  • Experience in background screening, HR tech, RegTech or another regulated industry.

  • Familiarity with ATS/HRIS platforms (e.g. Workday, SuccessFactors, Greenhouse, Bullhorn).

  • Working knowledge of GDPR, data residency and audit requirements.

  • Python for data cleansing and automation, or experience using AI tools to speed up analysis.

  • Previous exposure to an acquisition or post-merger integration.

We are an all-remote organisation with ~200+ people spread across the world. We value Trust, Integrity, Data and Experience in everything we do - from the way we collaborate to the products we create.

We’re focused on transforming the industry while partnering with many of the leading technology platforms in the People & Talent ecosystem.

And we’re growing fast. Having recently been ranked in Deloitte’s Tech Fast 50 for the second year running, we’re looking for brilliant people, fast thinkers and passionate change-drivers to join our expanding team.

Veremark is a remote-first HR tech scale-up on a mission to help the world trust faster.

We started with background and reference checking, pioneering an entirely new approach through Verepass - a blockchain solution which facilitates instant verification by enabling candidates to own, manage, and share their securely-held and verified career credentials.

We have recently launched our second product - a Whistleblowing platform with end-to-end encryption enabling employees to report issues safely and anonymously.

But this is just the beginning. Join us and become part of the journey using technology to help the world trust faster.

We achieve this through open source research, digital investigations, capacity-building with local partners, and collaboration with media to amplify our impact.

CIR was born out of a determination to expose those spreading harm – online and offline – around the world, particularly in areas of violent conflict, such as Ukraine, Sudan and Myanmar. Our projects are at the forefront of efforts to investigate and document human rights abuses, war crimes, harms targeting women and minorities, and influence operations. We work closely with multilateral and national justice accountability bodies.

Role details:

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. The company is an OnchainGPT for autonomous trading.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

The company is an OnchainGPT for autonomous trading. It is an AI-powered mentor, advisor, and companion that helps users explore the onchain world, find alpha, auto-trade, and outsmart the market.
They are looking for Staff Software Engineer (Backend and AI Infra) who will own two critical workstreams :
- the agent runtime and backend infrastructure that powers every trade in their fleet,
- and the migration of model hosting and agent deployment in-house, moving the company off third-party LLM providers and hosted agent platforms to own infrastructure.
NOTE : This role is NOT a pure Devops role but rather a building role in which you will spend 80% of your time writing Go, Python, and TypeScript that ships to production.
You’re writing the backend services, runtime engine, and deployment systems that the entire company's agent fleet runs on.
When you ship, every agent in the fleet immediately gets faster, more reliable, and more autonomous.
You are in charge of managing the very infrastructure you are building, as its designer you are be the best person to operate it.
You’re building the backend for autonomous AI agents that manage real money in real time.
The runtime you build determines whether positions are protected.
The model hosting you stand up determines whether agents can think.
The deployment pipeline you create determines whether the fleet can evolve.
This is foundational infrastructure for a new category of software.
MISSIONS
Agent Runtime & Backend (+/-50%)
The runtime is the engine that makes every agent work. You’ll own the core systems:
Plugin Runtime — the per-agent process that runs position tracking (10s polling), the RatchetStop exit engine (tiered trailing stops with sub-second evaluation), and DSL state management. Currently Go + Python; migrating to a centralized Go service with Postgres state and real-time websocket price feeds
Scanner Gateway / Rules Engine — a YAML-configurable evaluation layer that sits between scanners and execution. Scanners produce raw signal variables; the rules engine applies gates, scoring, and filters defined in YAML. Users customize trading behavior without touching Python. This is the next major runtime feature
RatchetStop Backend — centralized profit-trailing service that protects positions even when the agent is offline. Evaluates tier upgrades and places stop-loss orders on Hyperliquid via websocket, replacing per-agent polling with condition-based evaluation across all positions
Execution Layer — the MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that bridges agents to the company's 48+ platform tools: position creation, clearinghouse state, market data, Smart Money intelligence. You’ll own auth, rate limiting, and the contract between agents and the exchange
Data Layer — enriched Hyperfeed pipeline (top 1K trader positions, momentum events, market concentration) flowing through Redis, Postgres, and ClickHouse. Real-time ingestion, 4-hour rolling windows, and the APIs that every scanner calls
Model & Agent Hosting Migration (+/-30%)
The company is moving off third-party hosted agents and external LLM inference to the company's owned infrastructure. You’ll lead the technical execution:
Agent deployment platform — migrate agents from Railway/OpenClaw to own-hosted infrastructure. Each agent needs isolated workspace, cron scheduling, state persistence, MCP connectivity, and Telegram notifications. Target: deploy any skill from a GitHub repo with one command
Model hosting — evaluate and implement the path from external LLM APIs (Anthropic, Google) to self-hosted inference. Options range from proxied external models with full telemetry capture, to fine-tuned models running on own GPUs. You’ll own the decision and execution
Agent telemetry — capture every scanner evaluation, every trade decision, every signal score across all agents. This data feeds the self-reinforcing loop: agents learn from fleet-wide performance, fork winning strategies, and improve autonomously
Deployment pipeline — CI/CD for shipping scanner updates, runtime patches, and skill configs to 50+ live agents without interrupting open positions. Zero-downtime rollouts where downtime = unprotected capital
Infrastructure & Operations (+/- 20%)
Build monitoring and alerting that catches agent failures, orphaned positions, state corruption, and Auth expiration before they cost money
Manage cloud infrastructure (AWS/EKS) with infrastructure-as-code
Own incident response — in a trading system, every minute of downtime is real dollars at risk
Health monitoring for the agent fleet: which agents are scanning, which are stuck, which have the midnight rollover bug

Requirements

MANDATORY
  • Strong backend engineering — you write production code daily in at least two of: Go, Python, Node.js/TypeScript. Go being the preferred language for the runtime services
  • Experience building backend services from scratch at a startup: APIs, job scheduling, state management, distributed systems
  • Solid understanding of real-time systems where latency matters: websocket connections, condition-based evaluation, sub-second response requirements
  • Production experience with Postgres, Redis, and at least one analytics DB (ClickHouse, TimescaleDB, BigQuery)
  • Kubernetes experience — deploying, scaling, and debugging production workloads on AWS EKS
  • You’ve owned a system end-to-end: designed it, built it, deployed it, operated it, fixed it at 3am
STRONG PLUS
  • Experience with model serving / LLM infrastructure — deploying, scaling, and optimizing inference (vLLM, TGI, TensorRT-LLM, or managed endpoints)
  • Background in trading systems, exchange APIs, or fintech where uptime has direct financial consequences
  • Experience with onchain infrastructure: wallet operations, RPC nodes, transaction monitoring, DEX integration
  • Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar agent-to-tool connectivity patterns
  • Experience building multi-agent platforms — orchestrating many independent processes sharing infrastructure but operating autonomously
  • Experience with CI/CD for systems where “deploy” means updating live trading agents, not just web servers

Benefits

  • Contract : Permanent role - Remote EU or US
  • Benefits: healthcare and life insurance, retirement plan, sponsored transportation, gym, lunch card, home office equipment, and other perks.
Recruitment process :
  • Video call with CEO/CTO (30mn).
  • Take home coding test
  • Code focus interview with tech teams
  • Final Interview​

What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!
If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:

AI is changing how software gets built, shipped, and run. It is increasing the need for sense-making of production software systems. We believe AI will reshape observability itself. Honeycomb created this category, and we want our next engineering leader to help us lead its reinvention.

The role

You’ll join the executive team as a full partner in setting strategy. Our exec team acts as a first team, working closely together to revise our strategy as the world changes. Right now, it is changing often! You’ll bring a wealth of experience and an imagination of what’s possible, help sharpen our bets, and decide with your peers the most elegant way forward. Then you’ll shape a strong engineering org to deliver on these decisions.

What you’ll do

  • Shape the strategy. Form your own view of where the product, technology and market are heading. Bring it to your closest partners: product and the CEO, and to the wider exec team. Some of our bets will need sharpening, and some new ones will need making.
  • Build alignment at the top. We believe our strength as a company depends on the strength of our exec team. We want you to make our exec team better, and for your first team to be the exec team. You’ll work closely with product and the CEO, challenging and being challenged in return, until the team is truly committed to a shared direction.
  • Help the whole org to make sense of fast change. When the ground moves quickly, people need help understanding what is changing and why. Burnout is high in our industry, and we want to keep our people motivated, excited to come to work, and with their full creativity and energy. You’ll explain engineering’s direction clearly and repeatedly, to engineers, managers, the exec team, and the rest of the company. We’re remote-first, so much of this happens in writing and in presentations.
  • Lead a high-performing team into what’s next. We have strong managers, directors, and ICs. You’ll aim that talent at our biggest opportunities and adjust the org’s structure, goals, and ways of working to be continually more effective. You’ll do this without losing what makes the team great.
  • Lead from technical credibility. You can’t lead an AI era shift without a deep understanding of the ergonomics of the landslide of change underway.

You might be a fit if

  • You’ve led engineering through large scale changes in direction, not just growth.
  • You’ve shipped software with AI tools yourself within the last 12 months.
  • You have a special talent for collaboration and improving executive teams.
  • You’re as interested in shaping strategy as in executing it.
  • You’ve worked at a larger company, and know what breaks as companies scale. But have a risk tolerance of someone from an early stage startup.
  • You’re comfortable with uncertainty, rapid change, and shaping new bets towards product-market fit.
  • You’ve led distributed teams and communicate well in writing and in person.
  • You care about developer tools and have good taste in them. (Having used Honeycomb is a bonus, not a requirement)
  • You share our values.

Worth reading: How we do business at Honeycomb in the AI era, our AI norms and values, and why engineering is all in on AI.

If you match some of this but not all of it, please apply anyway. We’d rather talk to a strong candidate who doubts themselves than miss them.

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

  • A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program
  • It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience
  • Time to recharge with unlimited PTO
  • A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)
  • Home office, co-working, and internet stipend
  • Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents
  • Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood
  • Annual development allowance
  • And much more...
Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:
  • All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address
    • We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo.
  • Our recruiting process will never ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to:
    • Social security or tax identification numbers
    • Credit card numbers
    • Bank account information

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.
We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.
As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

Privacy Notice:

If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes.
For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice.
If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact . Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

Therapeutic Area Expertise: Rheumatology, Dermatology, Rare General Medicine Diseases, Nephrology, Gastroenterology (GI).

  • Develop and execute study and customer engagement strategies that align with customer objectives, partnering with Business Development and Medical Strategy to secure new business and support account growth.

    • Build strong cross-functional partnerships with Business Development, Medical Strategy, and operational teams to develop competitive, customer-focused solutions.

Job Description

At Blue Cross NC, we recognize the dedication, discipline, and leadership that transitioning service members bring to the workforce. Through our DoW SkillBridge Program, we provide a unique opportunity for military personnel in their final months of service to gain hands-on experience in a civilian work environment while exploring meaningful career paths in the healthcare industry.

By joining Blue Cross NC’s SkillBridge Program, service members can deploy their leadership, problem-solving skills, and mission-driven mindset in a civilian setting. This internship provides a bridge between military service and a meaningful career in healthcare, allowing participants to continue their tradition of service—this time, by helping make healthcare better for all.

We are honored to support transitioning military professionals as they navigate this next chapter and invite you to explore how your skills can make a difference at Blue Cross NC.

**This program is open to only active military service members.**


  • Develop and execute strategic military and veteran-focused initiatives that advance Blue Cross NC's brand, business objectives, member outreach, retention efforts, and community impact. Strategies will include improving access to healthcare, behavioral health resources, benefits education, and social determinants of health for active-duty service members, veterans, and military families.
  • Collaborate with County Engagement teams and cross-functional business units to implement community-informed strategies that primarily support Healthy Blue, Blue Cross NC’s Medicaid plan.
  • Build and maintain relationships with military installations, Veteran Service Organizations (VSOs), Military Service Organizations (MSOs), Veteran Service Officers, healthcare providers, community-based organizations, and government agencies to expand Blue Cross NC's reach and impact.
  • Identify and implement opportunities for education and outreach initiatives focused on healthcare access, behavioral health, chronic disease prevention, food insecurity, housing stability, and other priority issues affecting military and veteran populations.
  • Lead and support military community events, Veteran Stand Downs, benefits education seminars, health screenings, wellness initiatives, and evidence-based training programs that connect individuals to healthcare resources and Blue Cross NC products and services.
  • Collaborate with Public Health, Faith-Based, Tribal and Regional Liaisons, and other business-facing divisions to ensure coordinated engagement strategies that maximize community impact and support organizational goals.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on military and veteran community needs, emerging healthcare trends, and barriers to care, providing recommendations to improve outreach, engagement, and member experience.
  • Lead, train and support County Engagement teammates and community partners, fostering a high-performing team committed to serving military-connected populations across North Carolina.
  • Communicate program activities, partnership outcomes, community insights, and measurable impacts through regular reporting, presentations, and internal communication channels.
  • Manage military engagement projects, programs, policies, and procedures, ensuring deliverables, strategic objectives, compliance requirements, and performance measures are successfully achieved.
  • Evaluate community needs and partnership opportunities to develop sustainable, long-term initiatives that strengthen trust within the military community while supporting Blue Cross NC's mission and business objectives.

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Applicants must be active-duty service members within their last 180 days of service at the time of internship start.
  • Participants must receive approval from their commanding officer and service branch to engage in SkillBridge. Blue Cross NC does not determine eligibility for participation.
  • A minimum of 12 weeks of commitment is required for internship placement at Blue Cross NC.
  • Candidates must have a clear end-of-service date that aligns with the internship timeline.
  • For more information visit DoW Skillbridge.

Internship Placement & Selection:

  • Internship placement is not guaranteed and is based on available learning/training opportunities and the alignment of the service member’s skills and interests with organizational needs.
  • Selected candidates will undergo a formal interview process to determine fit for available roles.

Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About the Role

Product Security is responsible for ensuring the continuous security of Harness customer-facing products and internal tools. The team is focused on proactively discovering security weaknesses, driving and advising risk remediation, building a paved road for developers to adopt secure development practices, and developing partnerships with engineering and product teams to accelerate the release of software with security by design.

The Senior Product Security Engineer is a highly skilled practitioner who drives hands-on security work across the Harness platform. You will own technical security initiatives end-to-end, partner closely with engineering and product teams to identify and remediate vulnerabilities, and build tooling and processes that elevate the security bar across our development lifecycle. This role is for engineers who love to build, break, and secure complex systems.

What You Will Do

  • Conduct threat modeling and secure design reviews for application backend services and business integrations.
  • Perform advanced penetration tests and adversarial attack simulations against Harness modules, APIs, and codebase using industry-standard frameworks.
  • Lead manual and automated code review efforts to discover vulnerabilities, weaknesses, and anti-patterns in the Harness platform.
  • Implement and operate security tooling including SAST, DAST, and SCA, and integrate these into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Consult and advise developers and Product Managers on security standards, vulnerability remediation, and security architecture.
  • Assess risks and trade-offs, and propose solutions for product security features such as authentication and authorization.
  • Participate in the creation, review, and implementation of technical security standards across global engineering teams.
  • Use the Harness platform to integrate security processes like vulnerability management into the SDLC.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering and Product to accelerate the release of software with security by design.

About You

  • BS in Computer Science or a related degree.
  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience with a strong security focus.
  • Solid experience with DevSecOps practices and secure SDLC methodologies.
  • Good working knowledge of cyber security frameworks including OWASP, SANS, NIST, and CIS.
  • Ability to describe software supply chain risks and Secure SDLC best practices.
  • Experience with public or private cloud environments such as K8s, AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Professional knowledge of enterprise applications, API development, and modern software delivery processes.
  • Previous experience in a cloud-native environment.

jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

jobs.title: Head of Revenue Operations
jobs.excerpt: About TiugoTiugo is the company behind CKEditor, TinyMCE, Uploadcare and ButterCMS, developer tools that power rich content creation inside thousands of applications and across the Fortune 1000.
jobs.description:
About Tiugo

Tiugo is the company behind CKEditor, TinyMCE, Uploadcare and ButterCMS, developer tools that power rich content creation inside thousands of applications and across the Fortune 1000. Formed in 2021 and backed by PSG, we have grown through acquisition into a ~$60M ARR business with strong gross and net retention and Rule of 60 performance.

We run two motions at once: a developer-led, product-led motion at high volume, and sales-led motion with a growing enterprise model built around our AI content platform. Our next chapter depends on running both well, across multiple brands, with one set of numbers everybody trusts.

Why this role exists now

Over the next eighteen months we are layering an enterprise, AI-led motion on top of an inbound Sales Assist motion and a product-led engine, across four brands with four histories and four stacks. That demands a revenue operations function that designs the engine rather than maintains it. One that owns how a customer moves from first touch through renewal, how we measure it, how we equip the field to run it, and how we automate the parts that should not need a human. The clearest example is renewals: moving the long tail to a tech-touch motion where people manage by exception, designed hand in hand with our Customer Success leaders. We are deliberately not backfilling the role as it existed. This is a bigger job, and we are hiring for the version of it we need in FY27.

In place today: a RevOps team; standardized stage and data definitions across instances; a weekly forecast cadence; a self-service channel; a central data warehouse.

What you'll build: field enablement, a deal desk, GTM engineering, a scaled tech-touch renewal motion, and real business analysis.

What you will own

  • The revenue engine's architecture. In close collaboration with the CRO and Sales & CS leaders, design the end-to-end customer journey across self-service and sales-assisted motions: segmentation, coverage, routing, lifecycle stages, and the handoffs between marketing, sales, customer success and partners.

  • Sales, customer success and partner operations. A single operations function serving the whole revenue motion. One funnel, one definition set, one system of record. This covers every Tiugo brand, and you decide where standardization pays off and where a lighter touch is right. Marketing operations sits today within Growth Marketing and works closely with this role on the shared funnel. As the function matures, bringing the two closer together is a path we'll consider.

  • Planning and performance cadence. Territory and coverage design, quota setting, capacity and productivity modeling, and the forecast process and its discipline. You design the incentive plans; Finance administers and pays them.

  • Deal desk. A function that works inside the deal cycle alongside our sellers, helping shape deal structure and pricing approach on enterprise and AI deals, and moving those deals through legal, finance and security review without losing momentum. It also brings together the sales support work that keeps deals moving, such as quoting. Finance and Legal keep their approval authority; this role owns the path to it. You will define how the function operates as part of building it.

  • Field enablement. Onboarding and ramp, sales methodology, and product and AI fluency across the field. This is a build rather than a maintain, and you will hire the leader for it.

  • GTM engineering and applied AI. In collaboration with a central AI team, own Revenue Organization automation across the revenue lifecycle and internal AI applications pointed at go-to-market work.

  • Business analysis for the revenue engine. Not report production, but interpretation. Monitoring what the business is actually doing, diagnosing what changed and why, and turning that into recommendations the revenue leadership team acts on. You will partner closely with our central data and analytics group, who own metric definitions, pipelines, governed dashboards and data quality. They own what is true. You own what it means and what we do about it.

Your first twelve months

By the end of year one, we should be able to say:

  • The revenue leadership team is making decisions from analysis you surfaced before anyone asked for it

  • Coverage, segmentation and routing are designed, documented and actually followed across brands

  • Forecast accuracy is materially better, and the process is trusted enough that it is not relitigated every month

  • Deal desk is a competitive advantage on enterprise deals rather than a bottleneck

  • An enablement function exists, is staffed, and the field can carry a credible AI conversation without escalating

  • Meaningful, measurable revenue work is automated, returning hours to sellers rather than producing slideware

Who you are

  • 10+ years in revenue or go-to-market operations, with 5+ leading the function at a B2B SaaS company between roughly $30M and $150M ARR

  • You have run operations for a business with both a product-led and a sales-assisted motion, and you understand why the two rarely share definitions cleanly

  • Deep Salesforce fluency, plus real command of the surrounding stack: forecasting, quote-to-cash, marketing automation, BI and billing

  • Genuinely technical with data. Opinionated about data models, and able to hold your own with a data engineering team

  • You have deployed AI operationally inside a go-to-market org and can tell the difference between what worked and what demoed well

  • You have built functions rather than inherited them, and hired people better than you into them

  • Comfortable in a globally distributed, multi-brand business where standardization is a negotiation rather than a mandate

How we will know it is working

Forecast accuracy. Pipeline coverage and conversion by stage and motion. Sales cycle and time to first value. Rep productivity and ramp time. Quote turnaround and deal desk cycle time. Time from question to trustworthy answer. Hours of manual revenue work eliminated.

How this role works with others

We are explicit about lanes, because ambiguity here is expensive. Some of your key partners will be:

  • Sales & CS leaders: they own their number, their teams and customer relationships, and what the customer journey should be: which signals matter and what coverage they need. This role is a key collaborator on customer journey design, and owns turning that into the operating model: coverage and capacity modeling, process design, data structures, automation, and the forecast cadence.

  • Operations (Data & Analytics): they ownthe corporate data warehouse and pipelines, company-wide metric definitions, governed corporate reporting, and enterprise systems such as billing. This role owns the GTM stack and everything in it, including Salesforce and Gong, revenue analysis, diagnosis and action. Requirements for how billing and other enterprise systems support the revenue process

  • Central AI team (forming): they own AI platform, governance and data access policy. This role owns which revenue workflows get automated, and building them within that governance.

  • Marketing: they own demand creation, campaign strategy, positioning and brand. Marketing operations, including marketing automation and campaign execution, sits in Growth Marketing today. This role owns shared funnel definitions, lead routing into sales, and attribution mechanics, in close partnership with marketing operations.

  • Finance: they own the model, plan administration and payout calculation. Rep-facing on questions about calculations of payout amounts and timing. This role owns quota and incentive design, and sales results reports for Finance to use in commission calcs. You are rep-facing on plan questions and crediting.

  • Product and Engineering: they own the roadmap decision. This role owns bringing structured go-to-market signal into prioritization.

Why Join Tiugo

Our people are a huge part of what makes Tiugo a great place to work! Aside from an impactful role working in great team, some of our benefits include:

  • Extra paid leave and dedicated funds to pursue personal development (up to 5 days and $1500 a year based on tenure)

  • Competitive medical, retirement and PTO benefits

  • Fully remote work environment

  • Access to a mental health and wellbeing platform with 24/7 dedicated psychological support, and targeted programs to promote wellness

About the team

The Public Cloud Foundations (PCF) team is part of Platform Engineering. We build the internal cloud platform that every Zillow engineer builds on: the self-service APIs, paved paths, and automation that turn the raw complexity of AWS into a small set of safe, reliable, well-documented product surfaces.

We treat the platform as a product. Rather than handling cloud infrastructure as a queue of tickets and one-off requests, we design software that lets teams provision accounts, networking, and shared infrastructure themselves, safe by default. Our current work shows the direction: self-service VPC connectivity, a Terraform delivery platform, container base images delivered as a managed product, and provisioning and policy capabilities exposed as APIs instead of runbooks. We partner closely with Runtime Platform, Database Engineering, Middleware Engineering, Delivery Engineering, and Security to replace manual cloud work with software.

PCF is where you help decide how Zillow uses the public cloud, and how a platform team turns operational surface area into engineered products.

About the role

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on Public Cloud Foundations, you will build the services and APIs that abstract away the complexity of the public cloud, and own them as products from design through operation.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and APIs that make cloud capabilities self-service: account provisioning, networking, IAM, and policy exposed as clean software interfaces rather than tickets or manual processes.

  • Turn recurring cloud work into products. Take patterns that today depend on human judgment or hand-run runbooks and encode them into APIs, controls, and automation that are safe by default.

  • Treat teams across Zillow as the customers of your platform: understand their use cases, shape the interfaces and paved paths they build on, and let their feedback and usage data drive your roadmap.

  • Own the reliability of what you build. Design for observability, SLOs, and self-healing so the platform runs itself. Like any team that owns services in production, you'll be on call for what you ship, and you'll lead the follow-up work that removes whole classes of problems rather than patching individual incidents.

  • Use modern AI-assisted and agentic tooling to accelerate design, implementation, and operations while keeping quality and safety high.

  • Influence how Platform Engineering approaches public cloud enablement, bringing a product mindset to design discussions and roadmap decisions.

You'll help take a set of foundational capabilities and turn them into a cohesive, self-service platform that Zillow engineers experience as a product, not a queue.

jobs.description:
About the Role

The Azul Sales Engineer is a hands-on, deeply technical pre-sales leader responsible for delivering the technical win across opportunities within their territory. Azul sells to the most demanding Java estates in the world — enterprises running mission-critical, high-throughput, latency-sensitive applications on the JVM — so this role demands genuine engineering depth, not just presentation polish.

A Sales Engineer earns credibility with engineers, architects, and executives alike by getting hands on: running technical evaluations in the customer’s own environment, tuning the JVM, interpreting GC and performance data, and translating measurable technical outcomes into clear business value. Beyond individual deals, the Sales Engineer uses their experience to mentor and uplevel the broader SE team.

What You'll Do (aka Responsibilities)

  • Own the technical win. Drive pre-sales engagements end to end — discovery of the prospect’s business and technical challenges, mapping Azul portfolio capabilities to those challenges, and validating the solution through demonstration and hands-on proof.
  • Lead hands-on pilots. Design, scope, and personally execute product pilots and proofs-of-concept inside the customer’s existing environment: installing and configuring the JVM, running representative workloads, and capturing empirical results the customer trusts.
  • Prove performance. Plan and run performance-focused engagements: establish benchmarks and success criteria, measure latency, throughput, GC pause behavior and resource efficiency, analyze GC and JIT logs, tune JVM settings, and quantify the improvement Azul delivers against the incumbent.
  • Win at enterprise scale. Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise engagements (large production estates, strict SLAs, security and compliance review, and long procurement cycles) coordinating technical validation across many teams and environments.
  • Present at every altitude. Deliver presentations and demos across all technical levels, from CxOs to hands-on developers, to “make the complex simple” and communicate Azul’s value to each audience.
  • Respond to technical requirements. Understand and respond to solicited and unsolicited proposals (RFI/RFP) by aligning Azul capabilities against detailed technical and business requirements.
  • Orchestrate the extended team. Engage Product Management, Engineering, and the CTO office as needed to remove technical blockers and secure the win.
  • Partner on territory strategy. Work alongside your Account Executive(s) on territory planning: pipeline generation, growing existing accounts, and enabling partners.
  • Grow and retain customers. Nurture existing clients to promote customer success and to create new upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Evangelize. Present at conferences, workshops, and roadshows to raise awareness of the Azul portfolio and build funnel.
  • Mentor the team. Provide expert assistance to other SEs on pilot planning and execution, run training sessions, and serve as a primary mentor to onboarding SEs.
  • Be a trusted advisor. Advise your manager on product, territory, and team matters.

Technical Competencies

    These are the core technical strengths that define a successful Sales Engineer at Azul:

  • Java & the JVM. Deep, hands-on knowledge of Java internals and the JVM: class loading, JIT compilation, memory model, and garbage collection. Able to read and reason about GC logs and runtime behavior, not just describe them.
  • Performance engineering. Practical experience benchmarking, profiling, and tuning JVM-based applications for latency, throughput, and scale; comfortable diagnosing GC pauses, warm-up, jitter, and resource-efficiency issues in production-like conditions.
  • Hands-on aptitude. Confident on the command line and in customer environments: installing, configuring, and troubleshooting runtimes; able to build and run a POC independently.
  • Enterprise application stacks. Solid understanding of Java-based applications and frameworks that run on or alongside Azul products (e.g., Cassandra, Kafka, Solr, Spring).
  • Cloud & containers. Working knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and container/orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Portfolio SME. Demonstrate SME-level depth and breadth across the entire Azul product suite, and continuously grow technical acumen through enablement, hands-on experimentation, and self-study.

What You'll Bring

    Qualifications

  • 5+ years in a Sales Engineering / pre-sales role supporting enterprise software, ideally in the Java, middleware, performance, or infrastructure space.
  • 3+ years of hands-on Java development or testing experience with a demonstrable command of Java architecture.
  • Proven track record of hands-on pilots and POCs and of performance-related engagements where you measured and demonstrated technical results in a customer environment.
  • Experience selling into large enterprises — complex, multi-stakeholder, mission-critical production environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related IT discipline; a master’s or higher in an IT or business discipline is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of cloud and container technologies (e.g., AWS, Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Solid knowledge of sales process and CRM (MEDDICC and Salesforce preferred).
  • Willing and able to travel up to 30%.
  • Fluent in your territory’s primary language, with strong professional English.

    • Skills & Attributes

  • Strong oral and written communication, effective one-on-one and in front of large groups.
  • Proven critical-thinking and problem-solving skills; able to solve complex technical challenges with minimal supervision.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, with excellent time management.
  • Highly professional and ethical.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can multitask across client challenges, meetings, and team needs, occasionally outside normal business hours.
  • Collaborates across disciplines, with the EQ to understand multiple perspectives toward a common goal.
  • A proven winning record.

What we Offer

·Referral Program

·Work with top experts worldwide whom contribute to the Java ecosystem

Our Culture & Values
