jobs.title: Senior Android Developer - Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding
jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

Olo is a leading SaaS platform accelerating digital transformation in the restaurant industry, by helping customers deliver more personalised and profitable guest experiences. As a result, our digital ordering, payment, loyalty and guest engagement solutions enable brands to do more with less and make every guest feel like a regular.

While our roots are in NYC, we’re intentionally investing in Belfast and Northern Ireland as a key hub, with an established leadership presence, a local team, and community for the long term. This role is fully remote, offering you flexibility to work from anywhere within NI.

Your new role

In this role, you’ll join as a Software Engineer on the ‘Core’ team, which is part of the wider ‘Order Engineering’ group.

The Core team owns key parts of Olo’s platform, including baskets, orders, checkout, promotions, capacity management, and the services that power ordering experiences at scale. We build and maintain the APIs, services, and tools that brands and partners rely on to create reliable, flexible, and high-performing digital ordering experiences.

As a Software Engineer on this growing team, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of these systems. You’ll help guide technical decisions, improve platform reliability and scalability, contribute hands-on code, and mentor other engineers. This is an opportunity to have meaningful influence across a broad and business-critical area of the platform while helping evolve the architecture for the next stage of growth.

On a management level, the team is led by a dedicated Engineering Manager who is based in Northern Ireland.

How you’ll make an impact

    • Develop an understanding of the ‘Core’ team's domain and technology stack and actively seek guidance to grow technical expertise.

    • Handle small-to-medium features with support from more senior engineers, ensuring tasks are completed according to set timelines.

    • Write code adhering to established coding standards and participate in code reviews to learn best practices.

    • Collaborate with team members to understand feature requirements and implement solutions with guidance.

    • Focus on building reliable and maintainable software components, contributing to team deliverables with a focus on quality.

    • Utilise version control systems to manage code changes and maintain a consistent development workflow.

    • Participate in team meetings and sprint ceremonies, such as daily stand-ups and sprint retrospectives, contributing updates and feedback.

    • Engage in learning activities, including game days and training sessions, to build familiarity with the company's tools and processes.

    • Troubleshoot and debug issues with guidance, learning to identify and resolve common software bugs.

    • Demonstrate a willingness to collaborate with other engineers and stakeholders, developing teamwork skills necessary for larger projects.

    • Demonstrate ownership of the team's delivery pipeline, ensuring that code quality, testing standards, and deployment practices are continuously optimised.

    • Use Claude Code and GitHub Copilot extensively as part of your daily workflow, and grow your skills through hands-on AI training designed to help you become highly effective with modern AI coding agents and IDEs.

    • Active participation in on-call duties is required, with specific responsibilities determined by your assigned team and area of expertise.

What will set you up for success

    • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

    • At least 1.5 years of experience in a software engineering role.

    • Programming Skills: Proficient in C#/.Net and familiar with basic programming constructs and design patterns.

    • Version Control Systems: Basic understanding of version control tools (e.g., GitHub) and how to use them for source code management.

    • Unit Testing: Familiarity with writing unit tests to validate small software components and test-driven development frameworks (e.g., NUnit, Jest).

    • Distributed Systems Fundamentals: Basic understanding of how distributed systems work, focusing on building reliable components.

    • Collaboration Tools: Experience using collaboration platforms for development, such as Jira, Confluence, and GitHub.

About Olo

Olo is a leading restaurant technology provider with ordering, payment, and guest engagement solutions that help brands increase orders, streamline operations, and improve the guest experience. Each day, Olo processes millions of orders on its open SaaS platform, gathering the right data from each touchpoint into a single source—so restaurants can better understand and better serve every guest on every channel, every time. Over 800 restaurant brands trust Olo and its network of more than 400 integration partners to innovate on behalf of the restaurant community, accelerating technology’s positive impact and creating a world where every restaurant guest feels like a regular. Hi, we’re MoonPay. We’re here to onboard the world to the decentralized economy by making digital money move as universally and effortlessly as the internet.

Why?

Because crypto, stablecoins and blockchain aren’t just technologies. They’re tools for global financial empowerment. They give people and businesses more control over their money, their digital assets, and their future, opening access to legacy financial systems that have been out of reach for many.

What we do

MoonPay is a unified payments platform for digital currency. We make it easy for anyone, anywhere, to buy, sell, swap and pay in digital currencies as easy as sending an email. That simplicity is intentional, our focus is reducing complexity so people can participate confidently, without needing to be crypto experts. We power the entire flow between fiat and crypto end to end, with compliance, identity checks, fraud prevention, and settlement all built in. This end-to-end approach reflects how we work internally: with accountability, rigor, and trust built into everything we ship.

Proven at scale

Trusted by over 30 million customers and over 500 ecosystem partners, our secure, enterprise-grade platform is driving mainstream crypto adoption worldwide. Behind those numbers are millions of real people and organizations relying on MoonPay every day.
We collaborate with innovative brands and projects to build secure, scalable solutions for a blockchain-powered future. This is an opportunity to help shape systems, not just scale them. And we’re committed to doing it right. Fully licensed in the U.S. and regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia, because trust and compliance are non-negotiable.
But we’re just getting started. We’ve launched a consumer app that makes crypto accessible, intuitive, and usable for everyone, and it’s growing fast. We’re iterating every day to make it the best it can be.
If you believe financial freedom should be for everyone. If you believe in building a fairer, more open financial system - we want you with us. To build systems that benefit all, we need contributions from all, regardless of background.
Come build the future of payments and the decentralized economy with MoonPay. Let’s make financial freedom and autonomy the new normal.

The engineer will review proposed architectures and implementations, identify technical or security weaknesses, recommend improvements, assist with complex configuration adjustments when necessary, and independently verify that systems have been implemented correctly.

The engineer will work closely with IT leadership, infrastructure teams, vendors, MSPs, and the cybersecurity team to ensure that technology implementations are reliable, scalable, secure, properly documented, and aligned with established cybersecurity and compliance requirements.

The role will also participate in the development of automation and AI-assisted compliance validation, including an AI CISO platform designed to continuously review technical controls, configurations, asset coverage, and compliance evidence.

Core Responsibilities

  • Review network and infrastructure architectures before implementation.
  • Review configurations implemented by internal teams, vendors, MSPs, and other technical resources.
  • Validate that infrastructure projects follow technical, security, and vendor best practices.
  • Identify design weaknesses, configuration problems, unnecessary exposure, and operational risks.
  • Provide recommendations for improving architecture, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Perform post-implementation reviews to verify systems were configured as designed.
  • Assist engineers with complex configuration changes and troubleshooting when senior-level expertise is required.
  • Independently validate remediation after identified issues have been corrected.
  • Participate in technical design and architecture discussions for new projects.
  • Review implementation plans, change plans, testing procedures, and rollback strategies.
  • Maintain and improve technical standards, configuration baselines, and review checklists.

Advanced Network Engineering Skills

The successful candidate should possess advanced Level 3 knowledge of:

  • TCP/IP and advanced network troubleshooting.
  • IPv4 addressing and subnetting.
  • Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching.
  • VLANs and network segmentation.
  • STP/RSTP.
  • LACP and link aggregation.
  • ACLs.
  • NAT.
  • DHCP and DNS.
  • OSPF and BGP.
  • VPN technologies.
  • Firewall concepts and policy design.
  • Multi-site networking.
  • Network redundancy and high availability.
  • Enterprise Wi-Fi.
  • Network performance analysis.
  • Packet-level troubleshooting using Wireshark or equivalent tools.

The engineer should be capable of reviewing an unfamiliar network environment and identifying architectural, configuration, performance, reliability, and security concerns.

Infrastructure Architecture & Technical Assurance

Strong experience reviewing:

  • Network diagrams and architecture.
  • Switch and router configurations.
  • Firewall rules and ACLs.
  • VLAN and segmentation strategies.
  • Management networks.
  • Wireless architecture.
  • VPN and remote-access configurations.
  • High-availability designs.
  • Internet and WAN connectivity.
  • Authentication and administrative access.
  • Logging and monitoring configurations.
  • Infrastructure firmware and software standards.
  • Backup and recovery architecture.
  • Vendor-proposed technical solutions.

Security & Compliance Engineering

This position is not part of the cybersecurity/SOC function, but the engineer must have a strong understanding of cybersecurity architecture and compliance requirements.

Required knowledge includes:

  • Network segmentation.
  • Zero Trust principles.
  • Least privilege.
  • Secure administrative access.
  • MFA and SSO.
  • Privileged-access concepts.
  • Endpoint protection architecture.
  • EDR/XDR architecture.
  • Secure Internet access.
  • Encryption requirements.
  • Logging and telemetry.
  • Vulnerability-remediation requirements.
  • Infrastructure hardening.
  • Secure configuration baselines.
  • Defense-in-depth principles.

The engineer should have working knowledge of frameworks such as:

  • NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
  • CIS Critical Security Controls.
  • Cyber-insurance technical requirements.
  • Common enterprise security-control requirements.

Configuration & Compliance Validation

A major responsibility of this position is independently validating technical controls.

Examples include reviewing whether:

  • Management interfaces are properly isolated.
  • Administrative access is appropriately restricted.
  • Network segmentation is implemented correctly.
  • Firewall and ACL rules match the intended design.
  • Required MFA controls are properly configured.
  • Endpoint-management platforms cover the intended systems.
  • Security agents are correctly deployed and communicating.
  • Required logs are being generated and forwarded.
  • Network equipment is running approved configurations and firmware.
  • Encryption requirements are implemented.
  • Infrastructure configurations follow approved security baselines.

Identity & Endpoint Architecture

Strong understanding of:

  • Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Duo MFA and SSO.
  • SAML.
  • OAuth/OIDC concepts.
  • Conditional Access concepts.
  • RBAC.
  • Privileged-access concepts.
  • Service accounts.
  • Windows enterprise management.
  • macOS enterprise management concepts.
  • RMM and endpoint-management architecture.
  • Patch-management architecture.
  • Endpoint security architecture.

Preferred Technology Experience

Experience with the following technologies is highly desirable:

  • Cisco networking and security technologies.
  • Cisco Secure Endpoint.
  • Cisco Secure Access.
  • Cisco Umbrella.
  • Cisco XDR.
  • Duo.
  • Extreme Networks.
  • ExtremeCloud IQ.
  • Microsoft Entra ID.
  • NinjaOne.
  • Microsoft 365.
  • Enterprise MDM platforms.

Automation & API Engineering

This role will help develop automated technical validation and compliance-assurance capabilities.

Desired skills include:

  • Advanced PowerShell.
  • Python.
  • REST APIs.
  • JSON.
  • OAuth and API authentication.
  • Webhooks.
  • SQL/data-query concepts.
  • Git/version control.
  • Data normalization.
  • Cross-system data reconciliation.
  • Secure API credential and secrets management.
  • Automated configuration validation.
  • Automated compliance checks.
  • Automated evidence collection.

Professional Skills

The ideal candidate should:

  • Be highly analytical.
  • Be naturally skeptical of unverified technical assumptions.
  • Have exceptional troubleshooting skills.
  • Be comfortable reviewing another engineer's work constructively.
  • Be capable of identifying subtle configuration and architectural problems.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly.
  • Explain risks without unnecessarily exaggerating them.
  • Provide practical remediation recommendations.
  • Work effectively with internal teams, vendors, MSPs, and cybersecurity personnel.
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation.
  • Understand the difference between theoretical best practice and practical business requirements.
  • Know when additional specialist expertise is required.

Experience

Preferred qualifications:

  • 7+ years of progressive network/infrastructure engineering experience.
  • Significant Level 3 or senior engineering experience.
  • Experience reviewing enterprise network and infrastructure architectures.
  • Experience with multi-site environments.
  • Experience working alongside cybersecurity teams.
  • Experience implementing or validating security requirements.
  • Experience reviewing vendor/MSP implementations.
  • Experience with automation, APIs, or infrastructure scripting.

Preferred Certifications

Relevant certifications may include:

  • CCNP Enterprise.
  • CCNP Security.
  • Extreme Networks certifications.
  • Microsoft infrastructure/security certifications.
  • CISSP.
  • Security+.
  • CySA+.

jobs.description:
Job Overview:

The Sr. Demand Planner will be responsible for creating, maintaining, and continuously improving a rolling 12-month forecast for all items. In this role, they will combine historical demand, customer forecasts, sales input, product activity, and other available information to develop an actionable demand plan. They will coordinate the Sales and Operations Planning meeting and work closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, and other groups to develop the forecast. The role requires the ability to work effectively with varied and incomplete data sets from both internal systems and customers.

RectorSeal is part of the Industrial Products division of CSWI, a publicly traded U.S. company. RectorSeal has an 80+ year track record of growth and success providing unique products to HVAC, Plumbing, and Electrical contractors as well as the commercial construction industry across North America. RectorSeal currently operates from five manufacturing locations in the United States and maintains strong third-party manufacturing and distribution relationships across the world.

The ideal candidate will possess strong quantitative and analytical skills, experience developing item-level forecasts, and the judgment to make sound recommendations when data is incomplete or inconsistent. They will be comfortable coordinating cross-functional discussions, challenging assumptions constructively, and engaging tactically in data preparation, forecast maintenance, and process improvement activities.

Key Responsibilities:

Operations

  • Create and maintain a rolling 12-month item-level forecast for the full product portfolio, including new, mature, seasonal, promotional, and discontinued items.
  • Analyze historical sales, orders, customer forecasts, market inputs, promotions, pricing activity, product lifecycle changes, and other demand drivers.
  • Combine, clean, validate, and reconcile incomplete, inconsistent, or differently structured data sets from internal systems and customers; document assumptions and identify material gaps.
  • Monitor forecast accuracy and bias, investigate variances, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions with commercial and operational partners.
  • Prepare for and coordinate the Sales and Operations Planning meeting, including, data preparation, presentation materials, decision tracking, and follow-up.
  • Maintain forecasting parameters, product hierarchies, customer mappings, and forecast inputs while improving data quality, and planning processes.
  • Support inventory and supply planning decisions by providing timely, accurate, and clearly documented demand assumptions.
  • Have a general understand of the products, markets, and customers to be able to make more informed decisions regarding the forecast.

Communication

  • Present forecast changes, assumptions, performance metrics, risks, and recommended actions.
  • Maintain effective communication with key internal stakeholders.
  • Identify process problems and data-quality concerns and implement improvements and solutions.

Required Experience:

  • Minimum of five years of experience in demand planning, forecasting, supply chain analytics, business analytics, or a similar role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Operations Research, Supply Chain, or a related field.
  • High-level Excel skills and proficiency with relevant business systems and Microsoft applications.

Skills/Competencies:

  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to form defensible conclusions from incomplete or imperfect data.
  • Ability to combine, clean, validate, and interpret data from multiple internal and customer sources.
  • Ability to work independently and as a member of a team.
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience with demand planning, ERP, business intelligence, or statistical forecasting systems.
  • Working knowledge of time-series forecasting, seasonality, trend analysis, forecast value added, segmentation, and exception-based planning.
  • Experience using customer-provided forecasts, point-of-sale data, order history, or other external demand signals.
  • Familiarity with inventory management, supply planning, service-level tradeoffs, and Sales and Operations Planning or integrated business planning processes.
  • Experience in a manufacturing or distribution environment.

Benefits:At RectorSeal, our employees enjoy the following benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, paid time off program with paid holidays, and various wellness programs.

About RectorSeal

Based in Houston, Texas, RectorSeal, LLC, is a wholly owned subsidiary of CSW Industrials, Inc. [NYSE: CSW] and is a leading provider of quality solutions for the professional trades serving heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC/R), plumbing, electrical, and construction markets. For more information about RectorSeal’s innovative products and brands that increase efficiency and improve reliability, please visit www.RectorSeal.com.

About CSW Industrials
CSW Industrials is a diversified industrial growth company with industry-leading operations in three segments: Contractor Solutions, Specialized Reliability Solutions, and Engineered Building Solutions. CSW provides niche, value-added products with two essential commonalities: performance and reliability. The primary end markets we serve with our well-known brands include HVAC/R, plumbing, electrical, general industrial, architecturally-specified building products, energy, mining, and rail transportation.

jobs.description:
About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Predictions

The Role: Senior Software Engineer (Mobile)

As a Senior Mobile Engineer on the Predictions team, you'll own the mobile experience for Gemini's CFTC-regulated prediction markets exchange. You'll build and ship trading interfaces for event contracts — from order entry and position management to real-time market data — within Gemini's React Native app. You'll work closely with product, design, backend, and compliance to bring new contract types (binary, range, combo) to market on mobile and drive activation and retention for a fast-growing product line.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain the Predictions mobile trading experience end-to-end: market browsing, order placement, portfolio views, and settlement flows.
  • Architect performant, real-time UI for streaming market data (orderbook, price charts, position P&L) using modern React Native patterns (TurboModules, JSI, native navigator integration).
  • Collaborate with backend engineers on gRPC and WebSocket integrations that power live trading surfaces.
  • Create reusable, well-tested UI components shared across Predictions and the broader Gemini mobile app.
  • Partner with product and design to shape mobile-specific UX for new contract categories (weather, economics, crypto, sports) and features like combo contracts and range contracts.
  • Scope and implement solutions independently, making informed architecture decisions and tradeoffs around native vs. JS boundaries.
  • Establish and improve mobile development processes — testing strategy, release quality gates, OTA vs. native release decisions.
  • Conduct thorough code reviews and mentor other engineers on React Native best practices.
  • Use analytics and experimentation data to inform product and engineering decisions around activation funnels, onboarding, and trading engagement.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years building production mobile applications with React Native.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript.
  • Deep understanding of React Native internals — bridging, native modules, performance profiling, and debugging.
  • Experience building real-time, data-intensive UIs (trading, dashboards, live feeds).
  • Strong UX/UI sensibility with a track record of contributing to design and product decisions, not just implementing specs.
  • Expertise in unit and integration testing for mobile.
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment where changes require rigor and auditability.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with financial or trading applications (orderbooks, charting, position management).
  • Familiarity with Expo, EAS, and OTA update strategies.
  • Experience with native module authoring (Swift/Kotlin) or SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose embedding via Expo Modules API.
  • Exposure to gRPC, WebSockets, or similar real-time transport protocols.
  • Experience with performance analysis tooling (Flipper, React DevTools profiler, native instruments).
  • Prior work at a fintech, exchange, or other regulated product environment.

It Pays to Work Here

The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:
  • Competitive starting pay
  • A discretionary annual bonus
  • Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant
  • Comprehensive health plans
  • 401K with company matching
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible time off

Salary Range: The base salary range for this role is between $140,000 - $200,000 in the State of New York, the State of California and the State of Washington. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations.

Description

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

Role overview

We're looking for a Marketing Design Team Lead who is equal parts creative leader, marketer, and AI geek, someone who knows how to achieve business goals through visuals that actually sell.

You will take a team of 3 AI-driven Creative Designers and scale it to 6. The team produces static ad creatives, photorealistic AI visuals for performance campaigns across paid media channels, and source assets for our video production pipeline.

Your job is to build the company's visual creative engine. Whatever the starting point- a brief, a hypothesis, a raw idea - it leaves the team as a creative that performs.

You'll work closely with Creative Producers, Marketers, Copywriters, Media Buyers, and the Video Editing team, and partner with our Generative AI Pipeline Engineer on tooling and workflows.

What you will work on

  • Lead, mentor, and scale a team of 3 to 6 AI-driven Creative Designers - grow people, not just output;
  • Own the production flow: task distribution, capacity planning, and strict QC - production-grade, not demo-grade;
  • Drive creative direction: concepts, hooks, and visual angles that stop the scroll and convert;
  • Generate ideas yourself and push the team beyond safe iterations - informed by visual trends and competitor creatives;
  • Own the creative testing loop: build a database of winners, analyze failures, turn performance data into next iterations;
  • Track new AI models and tools; be the company's go-to expert on what's creatively possible with AI, staying hands-on in the tools;
  • Run regular R&D and build prompt and style libraries that keep quality consistent as the team grows;
  • Stay hands-on: jump into the tools (Figma, Adobe Suite, AI platforms) when needed to unblock the team, take on the most complex creatives, or test new approaches;
  • Partner with the Generative AI Pipeline Engineer to turn the team's creative needs into pipelines, presets, and automation;
  • Work tightly with Creative Producers, Marketers, Media Buyers, and Video Editors: align on strategy, negotiate deadlines, solve bottlenecks.

Requirements

Your must-haves

You don't need to meet every single requirement. If you're excellent in most of these areas and can show shipped work, we'd love to hear from you.

  • 5+ years of Leadership Experience: You have successfully managed creative/design teams in digital marketing. (This is not a role for a senior designer looking for their first management gig);
  • Mature Leader & Problem Solver: You build clear processes, guide your team, gracefully resolve conflicts, remain highly proactive, and stay completely open to new ideas and approaches;
  • Strong Project Manager: You drive every project cleanly to the finish line. You guarantee top-tier quality, maintain absolute order, and hit strict deadlines without excuses;
  • Strong Visual Craft: composition, lighting, color, typography, anatomy. You can articulate exactly why a creative works or doesn't;
  • Design Toolstack: proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; comfortable connecting AI outputs with traditional design pipelines;
  • AI Geek: far beyond basic prompting. You track every new model release and can't wait to test how it could level up ad creatives. Hands-on with modern AI image platforms (Figma Weave, Higgsfield, Magnific, Runway, or similar), using them for creating photorealistic visuals. Able to choose the right tool for each task, as well as to catch and fix artifacts.
  • Performance Marketing DNA: solid understanding of static ad creatives (Google, Meta, and other paid channels). You know what stops the scroll, what makes a visual sell, and how creative decisions move CTR, CPA, and conversion rate;
  • Fluency in English - both spoken and written.

Nice to have

  • A strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives and AI-generated photorealistic work - ideally with examples shipped under your leadership and the results they drove;
  • Experience with creatives for high-CPA verticals (home improvement, insurance, health, legal, finance, or similar);
  • Experience creating visuals for North American audiences - you know what looks native to a US consumer;
  • Understanding of how static visuals feed video production pipelines.

What we offer

  • Paid vacations - generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge.
  • Unlimited Sick Days - we understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.

Performance Outcomes

Real-Time Queue & Contact Center Operations

  • Monitor live queue activity throughout the shift service level, average speed of answer, calls in queue, agent availability, adherence, and abandoned rate and take immediate action to balance staffing and workload.
  • Manage agent status and scheduling exceptions in Workday (WD), including log-in/log-out compliance, breaks, and after-call work.

  • Conduct scheduled and ad-hoc live-call monitoring and recorded-call reviews for every direct report on a defined cadence.
  • Evaluate calls against the intake call-flow standard (Connect / Understand / Assess / Resolve / Close), verification protocol, OPP procedures, disposition accuracy, and member-experience benchmarks.
  • Deliver timely, specific coaching after each observation reinforcing what worked and providing concrete, actionable guidance where the agent can grow.
  • Partner with the QA/Trainer to calibrate scoring, close skill gaps identified in QA trends, and ensure coaching is consistent across the team.
  • Coach agents on correct use of the Primary + Secondary disposition framework so call data remains reporting-ready for QA, trend analysis, and firm-level insights.

About Us

The North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services (DHHS) is one of the largest, most complex agencies in the state, and has approximately 17,000 employees. It is responsible for ensuring the health, safety, and well-being of all North Carolinians, providing human service needs for special populations including individuals who are deaf, blind, developmentally disabled, and mentally ill, and helping poor North Carolinians achieve economic independence.


Description of Work

The Child Care Consultant supports the regulatory functions of the Division by assisting potential and current child care providers in understanding and meeting child care licensing requirements. The role operates remotely within assigned service counties and requires independent planning and management of daily work.

Responsibilities include monitoring licensed and unlicensed child care settings for compliance, conducting investigations related to alleged violations, and documenting findings in accordance with program expectations. The position relies on effective communication and professional conduct in highly stressful situations. This role also utilizes computer software applications, including Microsoft Word and Excel, to complete regulatory and administrative tasks.

Key Duties Include:

- Monitor child care centers and homes for compliance with applicable licensing requirements through scheduled and unscheduled visits.

- Investigate reports alleging violations of licensing requirements, including allegations of unlicensed operation, and document findings accurately.

- Assist potential and current child care providers in understanding, achieving, and maintaining compliance with state child care regulations.

- Review facility operations, records, and practices to verify adherence to health, safety, and program standards.

- Prepare clear, accurate documentation and reports using Microsoft Word, Excel, and other required software applications.

- Communicate findings, expectations, and regulatory guidance to providers in a professional and supportive manner.

- Plan and manage daily workload independently to meet program expectations across assigned service counties.

- Respond to high‑stress situations with calm, professional judgment to support effective regulatory oversight.

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

We are seeking a Staff Full Stack Engineer to lead the technical direction of the team that builds Alpaca's Trading API product. Trading API serves developers, traders, and institutions who trade directly with Alpaca. The team owns that customer experience end to end: how customers access the platform, how their accounts are structured and secured, and the applications they use to trade.

The work spans the stack: customer-facing trading applications, the identity, account, and permission systems behind them, and integrations for partner apps and AI agents. The team also builds customer-facing trading features end to end, across our API.

This is a high-trust domain. These systems decide who can act on an account and what they are allowed to do. A defect can expose customer data, let the wrong person place a trade or move money, or lock a customer out at the moment they need to trade. The customer-facing surfaces also carry real-time trading: an order ticket or positions view that shows stale or wrong data can lead to a bad trade. We are looking for an engineer who has built and owned systems like this — identity and authorization, account models, and trading or financial applications — and who is as comfortable designing an authorization model as shipping the interface built on top of it.

You will not manage people directly. You will lead through architecture, code, design reviews, and mentorship, and you will remain a principal contributor. You will be the senior technical anchor for the team, partnering with the engineering manager, Product, and Design, and working closely with the trading, margin and risk, and platform teams behind the API.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture and technical roadmap for how customers access and use Trading API: identity and authentication, authorization and permissions, account and sub-account models, partner OAuth, and customer-facing trading and account-management applications.
  • Design the access model for increasingly complex account structures — multiple users per account, sub-accounts, entity and advisor accounts, and delegated API and agent access — so that permissions are explicit, auditable, and enforced on the server.
  • Lead technical delivery of next-generation Trading API customer applications, including real-time market data, order entry, and positions and order views, as the product expands to new customer surfaces.
  • Drive the move from legacy monolith endpoints to a dedicated application backend, with clear API contracts between customer applications and platform services such as trading, accounts, transfers, ledger, and market data.
  • Set the security bar for customer-facing systems: session and credential handling, MFA and passkeys, OAuth flows, rate limiting, input validation, and fast, durable responses to security findings.
  • Set the standard for safe delivery: feature flags, staged rollouts, preview environments, testing strategy, and production observability.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Compliance, Security, Brokerage Operations, and adjacent engineering teams to define behaviour and integration boundaries.
  • Lead design reviews, mentor senior and mid-level engineers, and raise the engineering bar as the team grows.
  • Act as a technical point of escalation for production issues on customer-facing Trading API systems, and drive durable prevention after incidents.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time on both backend services and customer-facing applications. Evidence of scope and ownership matters more than a strict year count.
  • Proven ownership of a production system where a defect could expose customer data, grant the wrong access, or cause financial loss.
  • Deep experience with authentication and authorization: OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, session and token management, MFA, and role- or attribute-based permission models.
  • Strong backend expertise in Go, or deep experience in Java, Kotlin, C#, or Rust and a clear willingness to work primarily in Go.
  • Strong frontend experience with TypeScript and React, including complex, state-heavy applications. Experience with real-time data over WebSockets or other streaming protocols is strongly preferred.
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), API design (REST and gRPC), and service-oriented systems running on Kubernetes.
  • Demonstrated care for correctness and security: threat modelling, testing strategy, edge-case analysis, and safe production rollout.
  • Clear communication with engineers, designers, product managers, and compliance and security partners, including when requirements are ambiguous or still being defined.
  • Track record of technical leadership and mentorship across teams. Product-minded: you care what the customer sees and why, and you are effective as a teammate.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience building trading, brokerage, or other financial applications: order entry, positions and P&L, charting, or real-time market data.
  • Experience with identity platforms or building identity in-house (for example, Amazon Cognito, Keycloak, or Auth0), passkeys and WebAuthn, or delegated access for third-party applications.
  • Experience with API platforms and developer products: API keys, scopes, rate limits, SDKs, or developer dashboards.
  • Experience with agentic AI integrations, such as MCP servers or tooling that lets AI agents act safely on a user's behalf.
  • Familiarity with FIX or institutional trading workflows.
  • Experience leading migrations off a legacy monolith in production-critical environments.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.

  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.

  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.
